papers.title: Hierarchical Denoising For Multi-Step Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video models are evolving into vision foundation models, yet they still lack human-like multi-step reasoning. Streaming autoregressive diffusion models are efficient but limited in reasoning, while bidirectional diffusion enables global revision with high inference costs due to dense frame-level denoising. Both paradigms struggle to achieve logical consistency and low-latency streaming for complex reasoning tasks. We propose HDR (Hierarchical Denoising for Visual Reasoning), a unified framework that integrates hierarchical latents into causal video generation for multi-step reasoning. HDR organizes video latents into a tree-structured hierarchy, enabling coarse-to-fine reasoning before streaming output. Coarse denoising layers preserve uncertain hypotheses for global planning, while finer layers progressively refine them into concrete visual states. A sparse hierarchical attention pattern (SHAP) further reduces temporal attention costs. We introduce a level-stratified multi-step video reasoning benchmark with out-of-distribution cases, covering six tasks: maze navigation, Tower of Hanoi, one-line drawing, sliding puzzle, Sokoban, and water pouring. Compared with streaming autoregressive diffusion baselines, HDR improves success from 34.22 to 60.29 (76.2% relative gain) and increases average progress from 76.00 to 89.56, demonstrating more consistent reasoning trajectories. HDR maintains low-latency streaming at 0.70 seconds per latent, achieving 54.2 times faster inference than bidirectional diffusion. It also retains 82.9% of full-data performance with only 2% training data, compared with 52.0% for bidirectional diffusion. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate HDR's potential for physical interaction and world modeling. Project demo: https://hierarchical-diffusion-reasoning.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 HDR（Hierarchical Denoising for Visual Reasoning），一个将层次化潜在变量集成到因果视频生成中的统一框架，用于多步视觉推理。HDR 将视频潜在变量组织成树形层次，实现从粗到细的推理，并通过稀疏层次注意力降低计算成本。在六个多步推理任务（迷宫导航、汉诺塔、一笔画、滑动拼图、推箱子、倒水）上，HDR 比流式自回归扩散基线显著提升成功率（从34.22到60.29）和平均进度（从76.00到89.56），且推理延迟低（每潜在变量0.70秒），比双向扩散快54.2倍。
Motivation: 现有视频模型缺乏人类式的多步推理能力：流式自回归扩散模型推理能力有限，而双向扩散虽能全局修正但帧级去噪导致高推理延迟，两者均难以同时实现逻辑一致性和低延迟流式处理。
Method: 提出 HDR 框架，将视频潜在变量组织为树形层次结构：粗去噪层保留不确定假设用于全局规划，细去噪层逐步精化到具体视觉状态；引入稀疏层次注意力模式（SHAP）减少时间注意力开销，实现从粗到细的推理再流式输出。
Result: 在包含分布外情况的六任务多步推理基准上，HDR 将流式自回归扩散基线的成功率从34.22提升至60.29（相对增益76.2%），平均进度从76.00提升至89.56；推理延迟为每潜在变量0.70秒，比双向扩散快54.2倍；仅用2%训练数据即可保留82.9%的全数据性能（双向扩散为52.0%）。真实机器人实验也展示了其物理交互潜力。
Conclusion: HDR 通过层次化去噪和稀疏注意力，在保持低延迟流式推理的同时显著提升多步视觉推理的逻辑一致性，并展示了在物理世界建模和交互中的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference latency. At this context length, we unlock new robot capabilities: one-shot in-context imitation from human video demonstrations, on-the-fly policy improvement, robustness to perturbations, and stronger performance on multi-stage, long-horizon tasks. We also observe, for the first time, steady gains in closed-loop performance as pretraining context length scales. At its core, RoboTTT integrates Test-Time Training into robot foundation models such as Vision-Language-Action policies, yielding a sequence model whose recurrent state consists of fast weights, parameters updated by gradient descent during both training and inference, compressing histories into weight space and retrieving contextual information for long-context conditioning. To scale training context length, the recipe combines sequence action forcing with truncated backpropagation through time. On challenging real-robot manipulation tasks, RoboTTT improves overall performance by 87% over the single-step context baseline and fully completes a five-minute, ten-stage assembly task, which no baseline ever does. RoboTTT trained with 8K-timestep context outperforms the same model pretrained with 1K timesteps by 62%, suggesting context length as a new scaling axis for robot foundation models. Videos are available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoboTTT，一种通过测试时训练（Test-Time Training）将机器人策略的视觉运动上下文扩展到8000时间步的方法，比现有技术高出三个数量级且推理延迟不增长。在真实机器人操作任务上，RoboTTT整体性能比单步基线提升87%，并首次完成五分钟十阶段组装任务。实验表明，预训练上下文长度增加可稳定提升闭环性能，揭示上下文长度作为机器人基础模型的新缩放轴。
Motivation: 现有机器人基础模型仅使用单步或短历史上下文，限制了复杂长时任务能力。本文希望扩展上下文长度以解锁新能力，如一次性模仿学习和在线策略改进。
Method: 将测试时训练（TTT）集成到机器人基础模型（如视觉-语言-动作策略）中，通过序列动作强制和截断时间反向传播来训练长上下文序列模型。模型循环状态由快速权重（梯度下降更新的参数）构成，在训练和推理时将历史压缩到权重空间中。
Result: 在挑战性真实机器人操作任务上，RoboTTT整体性能比单步上下文基线提升87%，8K时间步预训练模型比1K版本提升62%，并唯一完成五分钟十阶段组装任务。
Conclusion: 上下文长度是机器人基础模型的一个新缩放轴，RoboTTT实现了新能力（如一次性模仿学习、在线策略改进），但摘要未提及局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeanFlowNFT: Bringing Forward-Process RL to Average-Velocity Generators
papers.abstract_en: MeanFlow generators achieve fast few-step sampling by predicting average velocities over time intervals, making them attractive for efficient generation. Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful way to align diffusion and flow models with human preferences and task-specific objectives. In particular, DiffusionNFT offers an efficient forward-process RL framework that does not require reverse-process trajectories or likelihood estimation. However, applying such RL methods to MeanFlow remains underexplored. DiffusionNFT optimizes instantaneous velocities, whereas MeanFlow samples with average velocities. To bridge this gap, we introduce MeanFlowNFT. Inspired by the MeanFlow identity, which bridges average and instantaneous velocities, we construct an induced instantaneous-velocity predictor. We apply the DiffusionNFT objective to this predictor, making reward optimization well-defined for MeanFlow. Sampling remains based on the average velocity, preserving MeanFlow's fast few-step generation. We further prove that MeanFlowNFT inherits DiffusionNFT's strict policy-improvement guarantee. Experiments on image and video generation show that MeanFlowNFT consistently improves baselines. Moreover, it outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL-tuned few-step generators on most metrics ($6$ of $8$ on SD3.5-M), and can even surpass multi-step RL-tuned diffusion while using only a few sampling steps. For instance, on Wan 2.1, $4$-step MeanFlowNFT reaches a VBench score of $84.33$, surpassing $50$-step LongCat-Video RL ($82.57$).
papers.comment: Project Page: https://harahan.github.io/meanflownft-project-page/, GitHub: https://github.com/Harahan/MeanFlowNFT, Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/Harahan/MeanFlowNFT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MeanFlowNFT，将前向过程强化学习（RL）框架扩展到平均速度生成器（MeanFlow generators）。通过构造诱导瞬时速度预测器并应用DiffusionNFT目标，实现了对平均速度模型的奖励优化，同时保持快速少步采样。实验表明，MeanFlowNF在图像和视频生成中一致改进基线，在SD3.5-M上8个指标中的6个超越先前SOTA，且在Wan 2.1上4步生成达到VBench 84.33，超越50步RL调优模型。
Motivation: DiffusionNFT等前向过程RL方法针对瞬时速度优化，而MeanFlow使用平均速度采样，直接应用存在鸿沟。需要桥接这一差距以利用RL对齐优势。
Method: 受MeanFlow恒等式启发，构造从平均速度到瞬时速度的诱导预测器，对该预测器应用DiffusionNFT目标，使奖励优化适用于MeanFlow。采样仍基于原始平均速度，保留快速少步生成。
Result: 在图像和视频生成实验中，MeanFlowNFT持续改进基线；在SD3.5-M上，8个指标中的6个超越先前最先进的RL调优少步生成器；在Wan 2.1上，4步MeanFlowNFT达到VBench 84.33，超过50步LongCat-Video RL的82.57。
Conclusion: MeanFlowNFT继承了DiffusionNFT的严格策略改进保证，无需逆过程轨迹或似然估计，成功将前向过程RL应用于平均速度生成器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SciDiagramEdit: Learning to Edit Scientific Diagrams from Paper Revisions
papers.abstract_en: Editing the figures in a research paper is a routine and time-consuming part of everyday research practice: authors relabel components, rearrange panels, and restyle visuals as they revise their manuscripts. Automating this editing workflow under a natural-language instruction, however, is challenging, because a scientific figure is a dense infographic in which heterogeneous visual elements such as schematics, plots, photos, captions, and arrows are composed under a tight visual grammar to advance a specific argument. To address this, we present SciDiagramEdit, a benchmark and skill-evolution framework that learns from natural paper revisions and operates on the figure's editable vector source, where users can inspect and co-edit individual primitives alongside the agent. Our benchmark mines before/after figure pairs from arXiv version histories, each grounded in the authors' own revision intent. To accommodate the diversity of editing instructions, we adopt agentic learning via skill evolution: an agentic proposer continually refines the agent's skill specification from execution traces over multiple epochs. The resulting skill progressively lifts edit accuracy on a held-out validation set, providing evidence that natural paper revisions are an effective training signal for instruction-driven figure editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SciDiagramEdit，一个从论文修订历史中学习编辑科学图表的基准和技能演化框架。该框架利用arXiv版本历史中的前后图对和作者的修订意图，通过智能体学习不断优化编辑技能，提升指令驱动图表编辑的准确性。
Motivation: 科学图表编辑是日常研究中的常规但耗时工作，现有方法难以处理科学图表中密集的异质视觉元素（如示意图、曲线图、照片、标注、箭头等）在严格视觉语法下的组合。
Method: 提出SciDiagramEdit基准，从arXiv版本历史中挖掘前后图对，并基于作者的修订意图构建指令。采用智能体技能演化（agentic skill evolution）框架，通过执行轨迹多轮迭代优化智能体的技能规范。
Result: 在保留验证集上，编辑准确性随技能演化逐步提升，证明自然论文修订信号对指令驱动图表编辑的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文修订历史可作为有效的训练信号，用于自动化科学图表编辑，但具体数值和对比结果未在摘要中报告。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Neural Space Time Memory for Dynamic Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Online novel view synthesis from multi-view streaming videos faces a fundamental trade-off: maintaining a persistent, long-horizon memory to reconstruct temporarily occluded regions while operating under strict real-time constraints. While Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a powerful memory mechanism, standard models mandate gradient-based memory updates at every frame to adapt to the changing motion in dynamic scenes. The computational cost of heavy memory updates precludes real-time application and can lead to instability over long contexts. Given that memory updates are more demanding than memory application and video content is largely redundant, we propose to decouple the frequencies of these two processes. Our approach performs periodic memory updates while applying the memory on a per-frame basis, using cross-view attention to manage deformations between the prior memory state and the current frame. To lock in the historical context, we introduce two critical mechanisms: an auxiliary Memory Loss that forces persistent internalization of the scene, and a Memory Caching strategy that regularizes active weights against catastrophic drift. Our method demonstrates real-time, state-of-the-art performance on scenes with dynamic human motion as well as minute-scale online memorization.
papers.comment: 15 pages. Preprint. Project page with demos and video results: https://nst-mem.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Online Neural Space Time Memory (ONSTM)，用于多视角流视频的在线新视角合成。通过解耦记忆更新和应用的频率，实现实时性能，并引入辅助记忆损失和记忆缓存策略以保持历史上下文。在动态人体运动场景中达到实时最先进性能，并支持分钟级在线记忆。
Motivation: 在线新视角合成面临长时记忆与实时约束的权衡；标准 TTT 模型每帧梯度更新计算成本高，无法实时应用且长期不稳定。
Method: 提出周期性记忆更新与每帧记忆应用解耦的方法；使用跨视角注意力处理先前记忆状态与当前帧之间的形变；引入辅助记忆损失强制内化场景，以及记忆缓存策略防止灾难性漂移。
Result: 摘要称在动态人体运动场景上实现实时、最先进的性能，并支持分钟级在线记忆。
Conclusion: 通过解耦记忆更新与应用频率并引入正则化机制，实现了实时在线动态新视角合成。该方法适用于需要长期记忆和实时性的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Motion-Conditioned Multi-View Fusion for Myocardial Infarction Localization from Echocardiography
papers.abstract_en: Myocardial infarction (MI) remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide. Echocardiography (Echo) is a widely available modality for MI assessment, where regional wall motion abnormality is a key indicator. Prior learning based methods for myocardial motion analysis often use handcrafted descriptors or densely supervised estimation, but the need for extensive annotation limits applicability. Foundation models have recently improved vision-based Echo analysis; however, most methods operate on single views and segment-level localization remains unreliable under view-dependent ambiguity, especially in apical views. To address this, we propose MCF-Net, a novel motion-guided multi-view fusion framework that fuses myocardial motion cues with foundation model representations to localize infarction. Visual features are extracted using EchoPrime, a pretrained Echo foundation model shared across dual views. Cardiac motion is modeled with extremely sparse supervision: a single annotated template frame is transferred across videos to initialize point tracking, avoiding dense labels. Motion-derived segment-aware soft masks provide coarse spatial priors that selectively enhance features for challenging myocardial segments. A motion-conditioned fusion mechanism then integrates motion and vision across views, refining predictions without overriding strong appearance cues. On segment-level MI localization, MCF-Net achieves 72.4\% F1 and 84.9\% accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art motion-only, vision-only, and fusion baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MCF-Net，一种基于运动引导的多视图融合框架，用于超声心动图中心肌梗死定位。利用EchoPrime基础模型提取视觉特征，通过极稀疏监督（单一模板帧）建模心肌运动，结合运动条件融合机制，在节段级MI定位上达到72.4% F1和84.9%准确率，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法要么需要密集标注，要么依赖于手工描述符；多数工作在单视图上操作，且节段级定位在视图歧义下不可靠，尤其是心尖视图。
Method: 提出MCF-Net：使用EchoPrime提取双视图视觉特征；通过单模板帧点跟踪实现极稀疏运动建模；运动导出的段感知软掩码提供粗略空间先验，增强困难心肌节段特征；运动条件融合机制整合运动与视觉信息，不覆盖强外观线索。
Result: 在节段级MI定位上，MCF-Net达到72.4% F1和84.9%准确率，优于最先进的仅运动、仅视觉和融合基线。
Conclusion: 本文展示了运动引导和多视图融合可提升超声心动图中节段级MI定位性能，尤其在心尖视图下。

papers.title: Pretraining Data Can Be Poisoned through Computational Propaganda
papers.abstract_en: Poisoning pretraining data can introduce harmful behaviors to LMs that are difficult to detect and mitigate. Prior work on poisoning pretraining data has largely exploited established data sources such as Wikipedia, which do not represent the large scale and heterogeneity typical of pretraining corpora, and has ignored the interaction between poisoned data and data curation pipelines. We demonstrate that poisoning attacks on pretraining data are feasible beyond this limited setting through an existing web-scale content injection mechanism: public discussion interfaces. Additionally, to measure whether malicious content is included after web crawling and data curation, we introduce HalfLife, a novel analysis for estimating adversarial content inclusion in web-crawl based LM training data. We use HalfLife to explore the feasibility of poisoning pretraining corpora at web scale through open discussion interfaces. Our analysis demonstrates the importance of estimating whether poison injections are included in pretraining data, and establishes third-party webpage content as a possible vector for attacking language model pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了通过公共讨论界面（public discussion interfaces）可以在大规模预训练语料中注入恶意内容，从而对语言模型进行投毒攻击。作者提出了HalfLife分析框架，用于估计对抗性内容在网络爬取数据中的包含情况，并验证了预训练数据投毒在真实网络规模下的可行性。
Motivation: 现有预训练数据投毒研究多基于Wikipedia等有限来源，忽略了真实预训练语料的规模和异构性，以及数据筛选管线的交互作用。本文旨在探索更现实的攻击场景。
Method: 利用公共讨论界面作为网络规模的内容注入机制，并引入HalfLife分析方法，基于网络爬取数据的生命周期估计恶意内容的包含概率。
Result: 通过HalfLife分析，展示了通过开放讨论界面在预训练语料中投毒的实际可行性，并强调了评估投毒内容是否被纳入预训练数据的重要性。
Conclusion: 第三方网页内容可作为攻击语言模型预训练的潜在向量，未来需关注大规模数据投毒的检测与防御。

papers.title: SceneBind: Binding What and Where Across Vision, Audio and Language
papers.abstract_en: We present SceneBind, an omni-modal representation of realistic scenes with joint semantic and 3D spatial understanding across vision, audio and language. Existing omni-modal encoders excel at instance-level semantics (i.e., what is present), but often lack explicit spatial structure (i.e., where it is). SceneBind addresses this gap by representing each scene as a semantic-spatial entity, combining a global semantic embedding with object-centric semantic-spatial slots. This representation explicitly captures object-level semantics, spatial attributes, and uncertainty. We further propose SceneBind Matching, a semantic-spatial matching scheme that integrates global scene similarity with object alignment, supporting cross-modal scene retrieval and object grounding. To train and evaluate SceneBind, we curate a novel real-world binaural audio-visual dataset with structured semantic and spatial annotations, and propose a training protocol for aligning semantic and spatial signals across modalities. SceneBind is compatible with large-scale pretrained semantic encoders, adds lightweight spatial modeling with only a few additional tokens. It achieves state-of-the-art scene and spatial retrieval while enabling strong zero-shot transfer to downstream tasks such as audio-visual localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SceneBind，一种面向真实场景的全模态表示，同时联合语义和3D空间理解（视觉、音频、语言）。现有全模态编码器擅长实例级语义但缺乏显式空间结构，SceneBind通过将每个场景表示为语义-空间实体（全局语义嵌入+以对象为中心的语义-空间槽）来弥补这一缺陷。进一步提出SceneBind Matching方案，支持跨模态场景检索和物体定位。在自构建的真实双耳视听数据集上训练，与大规模预训练语义编码器兼容，仅需少量额外令牌即可实现轻量空间建模。
Motivation: 现有全模态编码器缺乏显式空间结构，无法回答“物体在哪里”的问题。本文旨在联合语义和空间理解，实现场景级别的跨模态表示。
Method: 提出SceneBind表示，每个场景由一个全局语义嵌入和一组对象级的语义-空间槽组成。槽显式编码对象语义、空间属性和不确定性。SceneBind Matching方案整合全局场景相似性和对象对齐，支持跨模态检索和物体定位。使用真实双耳视听数据集训练，利用对齐语义和空间信号的训练协议。
Result: 在场景和空间检索任务上达到最先进性能，并实现强零样本迁移到音频-视觉定位等下游任务。
Conclusion: SceneBind通过联合语义和空间表示，弥合了实例级语义和空间结构之间的鸿沟，且与大规模预训练编码器兼容，仅需少量额外参数。

papers.title: Beyond Success Rate: Cost-Aware Evaluation of Offensive and Defensive Security Agents
papers.abstract_en: Security-agent evaluations commonly measure peak offensive capability under generous inference budgets, emphasizing vulnerability discovery, exploit development, penetration testing, and CTF completion. Such measurements are useful but incomplete: in operational security, every reasoning step, tool call, telemetry query, and enrichment request consumes budget. We evaluate language-model security agents through this cost-success lens on offensive Cybench challenges and defensive Splunk BOTS v1 investigation challenges. Instead of reporting only best-case success, we compare models at fixed cost levels and decompose performance by inference spend and tool spend. Our results show distinct scalingregimes for red- and blue-team tasks. Offensive CTF performance improves with additional test-time compute, and scaled open-weight models can approach frontier proprietary systems while remaining cost-competitive. Defensive SOC investigation does not scale in the same way: success depends more heavily on disciplined tool use, telemetry navigation, and selective enrichment than on raw reasoning budget alone. We argue that security-agent benchmarks should measure economic efficiency and operational fit alongside task success. Cost-aware, SOC-native evaluations provide a clearer picture of which models are practically useful today and where defensive agents still need to improve. We present an interactive website with our results https://evals.frontier.security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种成本感知的安全代理评估方法，在固定推理预算下比较语言模型在进攻性Cybench挑战和防御性Splunk BOTS v1调查中的表现，发现进攻任务随测试时计算增加而提升，而防御任务更依赖工具使用而非推理预算。
Motivation: 现有安全代理评估只关注峰值成功率，忽略操作中的成本（推理步骤、工具调用等），无法反映实际运营中的经济效率和适用性。
Method: 在固定成本水平下评估模型，分解性能为推理支出和工具支出，分别分析红队进攻任务和蓝队防御任务的不同扩展规律。
Result: 进攻性CTF性能随测试时计算增加而提升，开源模型可接近前沿专有系统；防御性SOC调查不随推理预算线性提升，更依赖工具使用和遥测导航。
Conclusion: 安全代理基准应同时衡量任务成功和经济效率，成本感知的SOC原生评估能更清晰反映模型的实用性和改进方向。

papers.title: Decoding Market Emotion from Blockchain Activity: A Data-Driven Sentiment Classifier
papers.abstract_en: The growing use of Bitcoin as a decentralized digital asset and investment tool has sparked strong interest in understanding its market behavior. This study presents a new approach to analyze Bitcoin market sentiment by combining on-chain and financial data with social media posts. Unlike models that aim to predict prices, this work focuses on explaining market sentiment using blockchain transactions, historical price data of Bitcoin, and daily Twitter sentiment classifications. The method merges sentiment trends with on-chain and financial metrics, normalized into a dataset for detailed market analysis. Multiple machine learning models were tested using cross-validation, with Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) emerging as the most reliable model for classifying sentiment, achieving an average F1-score of about 0.84. SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), a game theory-based method for model interpretability, was used to quantify the contribution of on-chain features to the model's predictions, improving transparency. The results indicate that this data combination yields meaningful predictive signals and insights, supporting data-driven cryptocurrency analysis and future improvements with deep learning.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结合链上数据（区块链交易）、金融数据（比特币历史价格）和社交媒体帖子（Twitter情感）来分析比特币市场情绪，而非预测价格。使用多个机器学习模型进行交叉验证，其中Gradient Boosting（XGBoost）在情感分类任务中表现最佳，平均F1分数约0.84。采用SHAP方法量化链上特征对模型预测的贡献，提升了可解释性。结果表明该数据组合能产生有意义的预测信号，支持数据驱动的加密货币分析。
Motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于价格预测，但缺乏对市场情绪直接解释的工作。本文旨在利用区块链交易、历史价格和社交媒体情感数据，构建一个可解释的市场情绪分类器。
Method: 融合Twitter情感趋势与链上和金融指标，归一化后形成数据集；测试多种机器学习模型，经交叉验证选用XGBoost；采用SHAP量化特征贡献。
Result: XGBoost在情感分类上平均F1分数约0.84；SHAP分析揭示了链上特征（如交易量、活跃地址）对模型预测的显著影响。
Conclusion: 链上数据与情感数据的结合能有效捕捉市场情绪信号，为数据驱动的加密货币分析提供新视角；未来可引入深度学习改进性能。

papers.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress. When search attempts fail to yield useful evidence, current single- and multi-agent systems can become trapped in repetitive loops, wasting search budgets and ultimately compromising the quality and completeness of the final output. We introduce SearchOS, a system-level multi-agent framework that turns fragile, implicit search progress into explicit, persistent, and shared state. First, we formulate open-domain information seeking as relational schema completion with grounded citations, where agents discover entities, populate attributes across linked tables, and anchor each value to source evidence. Then we design Search-Oriented Context Management (SOCM), which externalizes the evolving state into Frontier Task, an Evidence Graph, a Coverage Map, and Failure Memory. Built on SOCM, SearchOS applies a pipeline-parallel scheduling mechanism that overlaps the execution of sub-agents and continuously refills freed slots with tasks targeting unresolved coverage gaps to improve utilization and throughput. To schedule and control the execution of search agents, SearchOS introduces a Search Tool Middleware Harness that intercepts model and tool interactions to record grounded evidence and react to stalls or budget exhaustion, and provides a reusable hierarchical skill system comprising strategy and access skills to augment the agents' search process and avoid repeating failed search patterns across runs. On WideSearch and GISA, SearchOS leads all metrics among the evaluated single- and multi-agent baselines, paving the way toward robust information-seeking collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SearchOS，一个系统级的多智能体框架，用于改善开放域信息检索中智能体的协作效率。该框架通过将隐式搜索进度显式化为共享状态，结合关系模式补全、面向搜索的上下文管理（SOCM）、流水线并行调度以及搜索工具中间件，解决了智能体在长交互历史中容易陷入重复循环和浪费搜索预算的问题。在WideSearch和GISA基准上，SearchOS在所有评估指标上超越了单智能体和多智能体基线。
Motivation: 现有工具集成的大语言模型在长交互历史中难以跟踪任务进度，搜索尝试失败时容易陷入重复循环，浪费搜索预算并降低最终输出的质量和完整性。
Method: SearchOS将开放域信息检索形式化为带引用的关系模式补全，并通过面向搜索的上下文管理（SOCM）将演化状态外化为Frontier Task、Evidence Graph、Coverage Map和Failure Memory。采用流水线并行调度机制重叠子智能体执行，并用搜索工具中间件拦截模型/工具交互以记录证据并处理停滞或预算耗尽，同时提供可复用的层次化技能系统。
Result: 在WideSearch和GISA基准上，SearchOS在所有评估指标上均领先于所评估的单智能体和多智能体基线。
Conclusion: SearchOS为鲁棒的信息检索协作奠定了基础，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: HoloGeo: Mitigating Landmark Bias in Geo-localization via Evidence-Driven Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved image geo-localization, yet existing models remain susceptible to landmark bias, causing them to overlook geographical cues or form spurious correlations, ultimately resulting in inaccurate localization. To systematically investigate this issue, we first design two quantitative metrics, Bias Intensity (BI) and Bias Harmfulness (BH), to characterize the impact of landmarks exerted on model reasoning, and establish a comprehensive benchmark, LandmarkBias-3K. To mitigate landmark bias, we further propose an evidence-driven reasoning framework, HoloGeo, to improve the reliability of geo-localization. HoloGeo is supported by a high-quality dataset, BF-30k, annotated with structured multi-evidence bias-free reasoning chains. By incorporating multi-dimensional rewards, HoloGeo explicitly encourages balanced attention over diverse visual cues and achieves evidence-driven joint reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HoloGeo not only maintains excellent performance on IM2GPS3K and YFCC4k but also significantly outperforms existing open-source VLMs on LandmarkBias-3K, validating its effectiveness for robust geospatial reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型在地理定位中的地标偏差问题，提出了偏差量化指标（BI和BH）和基准LandmarkBias-3K，并设计了一个证据驱动推理框架HoloGeo，配合高质量多证据无偏差推理链数据集BF-30k和多样奖励，以平衡视觉线索注意力，提升地理定位的鲁棒性。实验表明HoloGeo在现有基准上保持性能，并在新基准上显著优于开源VLM。
Motivation: 现有VLM在地理定位中易受地标偏差影响，忽略地理线索或形成假相关，导致定位不准确。需要系统量化偏差并提出缓解方法。
Method: 提出两个量化指标Bias Intensity (BI)和Bias Harmfulness (BH)，构建基准LandmarkBias-3K；提出证据驱动推理框架HoloGeo，基于31k多证据无偏差推理链数据集BF-30k，采用多维度奖励鼓励对多样化视觉线索的平衡关注，实现联合推理。
Result: HoloGeo在IM2GPS3K和YFCC4k上保持优异性能，在LandmarkBias-3K上显著优于现有开源VLM，验证了鲁棒空间推理的有效性。
Conclusion: HoloGeo通过证据驱动和多奖励机制有效缓解地标偏差，提升地理定位可靠性。

papers.title: teLLMe Why (Ain't Nothing but a Jam): Exploratory Causal Analysis of Urban Driving Data
papers.abstract_en: Traffic agencies now have access to large volumes of video-derived data for studying safety and congestion. Most of these data are observational and collected without interventions, which makes causal questions such as "How would rain change traffic density?" difficult to answer. We present teLLMe, a system for exploratory causal analysis of urban driving datasets. The system starts from a structured event table built from dashcam annotations and combines causal structure learning with the PC algorithm, bootstrap-based stability checks, and query-specific effect estimation using linear regression and DoWhy. Natural-language questions are mapped to structured causal queries through a schema-aware LLM, enabling users to specify treatments, outcomes, and subpopulations. teLLMe returns a "Causal Card" that summarizes effect estimates, adjustment sets, DAG support, and assumptions, followed by a short natural-language explanation. Case studies on BDD-derived traffic events show that the system can surface plausible relationships involving weather, peak hours, and traffic density, while making uncertainty and modeling choices explicit. The system is designed as a tool for hypothesis generation and expert reasoning rather than a source of definitive causal claims.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on UrbanAI. 6 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 teLLMe 系统，用于城市驾驶数据的探索性因果分析，从行车记录仪注释构建事件表，结合 PC 算法、自举稳定性检查和 DoWhy 进行因果结构学习与效应估计，并通过模式感知的 LLM 将自然语言问题映射为结构化因果查询，返回包含效应估计、调整集等信息的“因果卡”。BDD 交通事件案例表明系统能揭示天气、高峰时段与交通密度之间的合理关系。
Motivation: 交通机构拥有大量视频观测数据但缺乏干预，难以回答如“降雨如何改变交通密度”等因果问题；现有方法多处理预定义假设而非探索性分析。
Method: 系统从 dashcam 注释构建结构化事件表，使用 PC 算法学习因果结构，通过自举检验稳定性，利用线性回归和 DoWhy 进行查询特定的效应估计，并借助 schema-aware LLM 将自然语言问题转换为结构化因果查询。
Result: BDD 案例研究表明系统能发现天气、高峰时段与交通密度之间的合理关系，同时明确展示不确定性、调整集和模型假设。
Conclusion: teLLMe 旨在作为假设生成和专家推理工具，而非提供确定的因果结论，强调因果分析中的不确定性透明化。

papers.title: AutoSynthesis: An agentic system for automated meta-analysis
papers.abstract_en: Evidence synthesis is crucial for turning primary research into reliable knowledge for science, medicine, education, and policy. Yet, quantitative evidence synthesis remains largely manual and difficult to scale. Here, we introduce AutoSynthesis, an end-to-end multi-agent system for automated meta-analysis. Given a research question in natural language, AutoSynthesis formulates a search strategy, retrieves scientific literature, screens candidate studies, assesses full-text eligibility, extracts quantitative statistics, computes standardized effect sizes, and finally performs random-effects meta-analysis. AutoSynthesis further supports heterogeneity analysis to examine how effect sizes vary across moderators, as well as risk-of-bias assessment. As output, AutoSynthesis produces a transparent report aligned with PRISMA guidelines. In our application, AutoSynthesis screened over 28 studies and extracted more than 20 quantitative claims. The pooled effect estimates produced by AutoSynthesis are similar to Hedges' $g$ of expert-conducted meta-analyses, indicating close agreement with manual evidence synthesis. Together, these results show that AutoSynthesis can make quantitative evidence synthesis more scalable, thereby supporting evidence-based decision-making across disciplines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoSynthesis 是一个端到端的多智能体系统，用于自动进行元分析（meta-analysis）。给定自然语言研究问题，系统可自动完成文献检索、筛选、数据提取、效应量计算及随机效应元分析，并支持异质性分析和偏倚风险评估，最终生成符合 PRISMA 指南的报告。在应用中，系统筛选了超过 28 篇研究并提取了 20 多个量化声明，其合并效应估计与专家手动元分析的结果高度一致。
Motivation: 定量证据合成（quantitative evidence synthesis）对于科学、医学、教育和政策制定至关重要，但目前主要依赖手动操作，难以规模化。
Method: 提出一个多智能体系统 AutoSynthesis，包含研究问题解析、文献检索、候选研究筛选、全文评估、定量统计提取、标准化效应量计算及随机效应元分析等步骤，还支持异质性分析和偏倚风险评估。
Result: 在应用中，系统筛选了超过 28 篇研究并提取了 20 多个量化声明；合并效应估计与专家手动元分析的 Hedges' g 值相似，表明与手动证据合成高度一致。
Conclusion: AutoSynthesis 能够使定量证据合成更具可扩展性，从而支持跨学科的循证决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARMOR++: Agentic Orchestration of a Multi-Domain Primitive Set for Transferable Attacks on Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: The reliability of deepfake detectors frequently degrades under black-box adversarial transfer, as these models often rely on fragile, architecture-dependent forensic cues. Existing transfer attacks often lack semantic awareness and struggle to maintain effectiveness under strict no-query constraints, particularly when perturbations are transferred from convolutional surrogates to transformer-based targets. To address these limitations, this paper introduces ARMOR++, a robust multi-agent framework designed for high-transferability deepfake evasion. The framework leverages the Qwen2.5-VL Vision-Language Model (VLM) to supply spatial semantic priors, while the Qwen3 Large Language Model (LLM) orchestrates primitive selection, adaptive hyperparameter reparameterization, and entropy-regularized perturbation mixing. By integrating five complementary primitives, spanning dense optimization, saliency-based methods, spatial transformations, frequency-domain perturbations, and block-structured modifications, ARMOR++ effectively targets heterogeneous inductive biases. Rigorous evaluation on the AADD-2025 benchmark demonstrates that ARMOR++ significantly outperforms existing agentic and non-agentic baselines across both low- and high-quality image regimes. Statistical analysis confirms a substantial gain in blind-target Attack Success Rate (ASR) over the state-of-the-art agentic baseline, with further performance advantages evidenced against non-agentic benchmarks and under robust defensive configurations. These findings highlight a significant residual reliability gap in current deepfake detector deployments and demonstrate the efficacy of agentic orchestration in identifying latent vulnerabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARMOR++，一个多智能体框架，通过编排多个攻击基元（包括密集优化、显著性方法、空间变换、频域扰动和块结构修改）生成高迁移性的对抗样本，以欺骗深度伪造检测器。在AADD-2025基准上，ARMOR++在黑盒攻击成功率（ASR）上显著优于现有基线方法。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器容易受到黑盒对抗迁移攻击，但已有方法缺乏语义感知且难以在无查询约束下保持有效性，尤其是从卷积代理模型迁移到Transformer目标模型时。
Method: 利用Qwen2.5-VL视觉语言模型提供空间语义先验，Qwen3大语言模型编排基元选择、自适应超参数重参数化和熵正则化扰动混合。集成五种互补攻击基元，覆盖密集优化、显著性、空间变换、频域和块结构修改。
Result: 在AADD-2025基准上，ARMOR++在低质量和高质量图像场景下均显著超越现有基于智能体和非智能体的基线方法。统计显示，其盲目标攻击成功率大幅超过最先进的智能体基线，且在鲁棒防御配置下表现更优。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前深度伪造检测器部署中仍存在显著的可靠性差距，并展示了智能体编排在识别潜在漏洞方面的有效性。

papers.title: Mutable Low-Rank Sketches for Retrain-Free Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: A common bottleneck in two-stage recommendation is embedding staleness: when a user rates a new item, their embedding remains fixed until the next retrain cycle. We propose mutable sketches, which store each user's preferences in a KP-tree (a sparse segment tree with sum aggregation), fit a low-rank projection once, and recompute embeddings on-the-fly as ratings arrive. We prove that each new observation monotonically tightens the prediction error envelope (Theorem 1), a guarantee that FunkSVD and eALS lack. On KuaiRec, the mutable sketch achieves 0.810 RMSE at 1.8% data read vs. ALS 0.822 at 100%, with 8x faster per-batch updates. A new user receives personalized recommendations in <1 ms after their first rating, with no model retraining required. A comparison of sampling strategies across density regimes shows that the KP-tree's norm-proportional sampling provides 40-130% better item coverage on sparse data (<1% density), while uniform sampling suffices on dense matrices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对两阶段推荐系统中的嵌入陈旧性问题，提出可变草图（mutable sketches），利用KP-树（稀疏段树）存储用户偏好，仅需一次低秩投影，即可在评分到达时实时计算嵌入。证明每个新观测值单调收紧预测误差界，而FunkSVD和eALS缺乏此保证。在KuaiRec数据集上，可变草图以1.8%数据读取达到0.810 RMSE（ALS为0.822 RMSE且使用100%数据），每批更新速度快8倍，新用户首次评分后<1ms获得个性化推荐。
Motivation: 两阶段推荐中，用户对物品评分后其嵌入固定不变，直到下一次重训练，导致嵌入陈旧，影响推荐质量。
Method: 提出可变草图结构，用KP-树（稀疏段树，求和聚合）存储用户偏好，配合一次低秩投影，实现评分到达时的在线嵌入更新，无需模型重训练。
Result: 在KuaiRec数据集上，可变草图以1.8%数据读取达到0.810 RMSE，而ALS使用100%数据得到0.822 RMSE；每批更新速度提升8倍；新用户首条评分后个性化推荐延迟<1ms。KP-树的范数比例采样在稀疏数据（密度<1%）上比均匀采样提升40-130%的物品覆盖率。
Conclusion: 可变草图提供了理论上的误差单调递减保证，并在实际推荐任务中显著降低数据存储和计算开销，特别适合需频繁更新的实时推荐场景。

summary_sections.conclusion: 可变草图提供了理论上的误差单调递减保证，并在实际推荐任务中显著降低数据存储和计算开销，特别适合需频繁更新的实时推荐场景。

papers.title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Design Lessons for Trustworthy Multimodal VQA
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare multimodal AI must combine visual and textual evidence while remaining reliable and interpretable. Using MediaEval Medico 2025 as a retrospective GI endoscopy case study, we analyze design choices across nine documented systems for question answering and explanation quality. Parameter-efficient adaptation of pretrained backbones provides strong challenge performance, but answer-level gains do not consistently translate into faithful and complete clinical reasoning. Methods enforcing structured reasoning and explicit grounding show more reliable behavior across heterogeneous question types, although the evidence is correlational rather than ablation-based. These results motivate evaluation beyond lexical overlap, standardized evidence-linked explanations, leakage-aware data governance, and lightweight robustness and calibration checks. The findings support trustworthy multimodal healthcare AI based on data fusion, explainability, and resilient evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 39th IEEE International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (IEEE CBMS 2026) as a regular paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以MediaEval Medico 2025胃肠道内窥镜回顾性病例研究为案例，分析九个已记录系统在问答质量和解释生成上的设计选择。参数高效微调预训练骨干网络在挑战中表现强劲，但答案准确性的提升并未一致转化为忠实且完整的临床推理。采用结构化推理和显式接地的方法在多种问题类型上表现更可靠，但证据是相关性而非消融性。结果推动评估超越词法重叠、标准化证据关联解释、泄漏感知数据治理以及轻量级鲁棒性和校准检查。
Motivation: 医疗多模态AI需要结合视觉和文本证据，同时保持可靠性和可解释性，但现有评估多关注排行榜性能，缺乏对可信赖设计的系统分析。
Method: 基于MediaEval Medico 2025挑战赛，回顾性分析九个参赛系统的设计选择，包括参数高效微调、结构化推理、显式接地等技术，并比较它们在问答和解释质量上的表现。
Result: 参数高效微调在挑战中表现优秀，但答案准确性与临床推理忠实完整性之间存在差异；结构化推理和显式接地方法在多种问题类型上表现出更稳定的行为，但证据仅为相关性。
Conclusion: 未来应超越词法重叠评估，采用标准化证据关联解释、泄漏感知数据治理以及轻量级鲁棒性和校准检查，以支持可信赖的医疗多模态AI。

papers.title: In-Place Tokenizer Expansion for Pre-trained LLMs
papers.abstract_en: A tokenizer fixed at the start of pre-training allocates vocabulary in proportion to the pre-training corpus, reflecting the deployment priorities at that time. When those priorities shift, languages added later are split into many more tokens per word, which can raise latency, compute, and energy consumption for users of those languages. Cloud models can afford a broad vocabulary because the embedding and LM-head matrices are a small fraction of their parameters. On a compact model those matrices are a material share of per-token decode bandwidth, so on-device models ship small vocabularies and accept fragmentation outside a fixed language set. We present tokenizer expansion, an in-place recipe for upgrading a pre-trained model's tokenizer when the model producer controls its design. We continue the existing tokenizer's BPE merges on a multilingual corpus, so most source tokens carry over unchanged as single tokens and every new token has an exact decomposition into source tokens. We copy the carried-over embedding rows unchanged and initialize new rows as the mean of their source sub-token embeddings. A two-stage adaptation, embedding-only training then full-model continued pre-training, recovers source-checkpoint quality. We apply the recipe to a continued pre-trained checkpoint of LFM2-8B-A1B, an 8B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model, to help produce LFM2.5-8B-A1B with a 128K tokenizer. The expanded tokenizer encodes Hindi and Vietnamese in roughly $2.4\times$ and $2.6\times$ fewer tokens than the source (up to $4.0\times$ on Thai). Combining these reductions with the measured per-token cost of the larger vocabulary, we estimate a $2.2$-$3.7\times$ per-character decode speedup for these languages across our reference devices. We release the model weights and the expanded tokenizer, and report the negative findings that shaped the recipe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种“原地分词器扩展”方法，允许在预训练完成后向模型添加新语言词汇，而无需重新训练整个模型。该方法通过BPE合并继续、嵌入初始化与两阶段微调（仅嵌入训练+全模型继续预训练），在LFM2-8B-A1B模型上实现了tokenizer从原始词汇扩展至128K，对印地语、越南语等语言的token数减少2.4-4.0倍，并估计带来了2.2-3.7倍的逐字符解码加速。
Motivation: 固定分词器在预训练后难以适应新语言需求，导致后添加的语言被拆分成更多token，增加延迟、计算和能耗。小型设备模型受限于词汇表大小，无法支持广泛语言。
Method: 提出原地分词器扩展：在现有BPE分词器上继续合并多语言语料，保留原有token并确保新token可分解为源token；复制已保留的嵌入行，新嵌入初始化为源子词嵌入的均值；两阶段适应：先仅训练嵌入，再全模型继续预训练。
Result: 在8B参数的MoE模型LFM2-8B-A1B上应用，将词汇表扩展至128K，对印地语和越南语的token数分别减少约2.4倍和2.6倍（泰语达4.0倍），估计在这些语言上实现2.2-3.7倍的逐字符解码加速。
Conclusion: 该配方使模型生产者能灵活扩展分词器，而无需重新训练，尤其适用于设备端模型。报告了负向发现以指导实践。

papers.title: CRISP: Constrained Refinement via Iterative Squeezing Process for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Distribution shift in medical imaging remains a central bottleneck for the clinical translation of medical AI. Failure to address it can lead to severe performance degradation in unseen environments and exacerbate health inequities. Existing methods for domain adaptation are inherently limited by exhausting predefined possibilities through simulated shifts or pseudo-supervision. Such strategies struggle in the open-ended and unpredictable real world, where distribution shifts are effectively infinite. To address this challenge, we adopt the "Rank Stability of Positive Regions" as a working assumption under distribution shift, and use it to derive robust spatial hints for source-only segmentation. Guided by this assumption, we propose CRISP, a model-agnostic framework that, unlike deployment-time adaptation, requires no test-time parameter updates and no target-domain data--a target-free, plug-in refinement framework that segments with frozen weights. Rather than using ranking to directly output masks, CRISP exploits the stability of probability rankings under distribution shift to derive robust spatial priors. Via latent feature perturbation, perturbation-invariant high-grade regions define a high-precision (HP) core, while voxels that remain potentially foreground under at least one perturbation define a high-recall (HR) support; these dual priors are then recursively refined under perturbation. We then design an iterative training framework that progressively squeezes HP and HR toward the final segmentation. Extensive evaluations on multi-center cardiac MRI and CT-based lung vessel segmentation demonstrate CRISP's superior robustness, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods with striking HD95 reductions of up to 0.14 (7.0% improvement), 1.90 (13.1% improvement), and 8.39 (38.9% improvement) pixels across multi-center, demographic, and modality shifts, respectively.
papers.comment: X pages, 3 figures, 3 tables; submitted to AAAI 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像分割中的分布偏移问题，提出CRISP框架，基于正区域排序稳定性假设，通过潜在特征扰动得到高精度核心和高召回支持，并迭代细化。无需目标域数据和测试时参数更新，在多中心心脏MRI和CT肺血管分割上显著降低HD95，最高降幅达38.9%。
Motivation: 分布偏移是医学AI临床转化的主要瓶颈，现有域适应方法受限于预定义的模拟偏移或伪监督，难以应对真实世界中无限且不可预测的分布偏移。
Method: 采用正区域排序稳定性假设，通过潜在特征扰动定义高精度核心（HP）和高召回支持（HR），并设计迭代训练框架逐步将二者推向最终分割。
Result: 在多中心心脏MRI和CT肺血管分割任务中，HD95分别降低0.14（7.0%）、1.90（13.1%）、8.39（38.9%）像素，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: CRISP是一种即插即用的源域分割细化框架，无需目标域数据或测试时参数更新，显著提升域偏移下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Data Driven Block Replacement Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: We develop data-driven algorithms for maintaining $N$ independent identical machines under a \textit{block replacement policy}, in which each machine is replaced upon failure and all machines are jointly replaced at regular intervals of length $k$. The goal is to learn the cost-minimizing interval $k^*$ from operational data when the lifetime distribution is unknown. At each decision epoch, the operator selects $k \in \{1, 2, \ldots, K\}$, observes the resulting failure history (a mixture of complete and right-censored lifetimes) and incurs a per-unit-time cost governed by the renewal function. We formulate this as a stochastic multi-armed bandit and propose Hoeffding- and Bernstein-based lower-confidence-bound algorithms achieving $O(K \log T)$ regret, matching the Lai--Robbins lower bound. Exploiting a nested observation property unique to block replacement, correlated variants attain $O((K-k^*)\log T)$ regret and require only $O(1)$ direct pulls of suboptimal arms $k < k^*$. A complementary Kaplan--Meier renewal algorithm estimates the lifetime distribution nonparametrically from censored data, achieving almost-sure policy consistency and empirically near-zero incremental regret at long horizons. We additionally analyze two average-cost MDPs: a time-elapsed formulation establishing that block replacement is optimal within its policy class for any lifetime distribution, and an age-vector formulation proving a monotone threshold structure under increasing failure rate distributions and providing a gold-standard cost benchmark. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical ordering and reveal structural cost gaps between optimal block and age-dependent replacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对未知寿命分布下的批量替换调度问题，提出数据驱动的多臂赌博机算法以学习成本最小化替换间隔k*。基于Hoeffding和Bernstein的置信下界算法达到O(K log T)遗憾界，匹配Lai-Robbins下界；利用嵌套观测结构的相关变体进一步实现O((K-k*) log T)遗憾。补充的Kaplan-Meier更新算法非参数估计寿命分布，保证几乎必然一致性并在长时域接近零增量遗憾。两个平均成本MDP分析验证了批量替换策略的最优性并提供了成本基准。实验确认理论排序并揭示最优批量替换与年龄依赖替换之间的结构性成本差距。
Motivation: 在批量替换策略下，机器寿命分布未知时，如何从操作数据中自适应地选择成本最小的替换间隔k*是一个关键问题。现有方法多假设分布已知或依赖先验知识，缺乏数据驱动的在线学习框架。
Method: 将问题建模为随机多臂赌博机，提出Hoeffding-和Bernstein-based低置信界算法。利用块替换中嵌套观测结构的独特性质，设计相关变体减少次优臂的采样次数。此外，基于Kaplan-Meier估计的非参数更新算法可从右删失数据中学习寿命分布。同时分析时间流逝和年龄向量两种平均成本MDP模型，证明批量替换在给定策略类中的最优性以及单调阈值结构。
Result: Hoeffding和Bernstein LCB算法达到O(K log T)遗憾，匹配理论下界。相关变体达到O((K-k*) log T)遗憾且仅需O(1)次直接拉取k<k*的次优臂。Kaplan-Meier更新算法在长时域实现几乎必然一致且增量遗憾趋近于零。数值实验验证了理论排序，并显示最优批量替换与年龄依赖替换之间存在显著成本差距。
Conclusion: 数值实验确认了理论排序并揭示了结构性成本差距，表明数据驱动的批量替换调度在实际中具有竞争力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Divergent Gaze Patterns in Artistic Viewing: Spatial and Temporal Signatures of Attention Across Autistic Individuals, Artists, and Neurotypical Observers
papers.abstract_en: How different populations visually explore artworks bears on cognitive science and on accessibility design, yet most eye-tracking work in autism has used social scenes rather than art, and has analysed where the eyes land while ignoring when and in what order. We present a comparative free-viewing study across three groups, autistic adults (ASD), trained artists, and neurotypical observers, who each viewed 30 paintings for 15s. We introduce a directed, metric-grounded framework that compares groups along two complementary axes: a spatial axis, in which one group's fixation-density map predicts another's fixations under six saliency metrics (AUC-Judd, NSS, CC, SIM, KL, Information Gain); and a temporal axis, in which individual scanpaths are compared with MultiMatch, ScanMatch, a foveal-disc IoU score (FDISS), and dynamic time warping (DTW). Fixations are extracted uniformly for all groups with a dispersion-threshold algorithm. Three results converge. (i)Artists and neurotypicals are almost indistinguishable in both space (density-map correlation CC=0.96) and time (they form the most alignable scanpath pair), whereas ASD gaze diverges from both. (ii)ASD attention is dissociated: it matches artists' wide spatial exploration (dispersion, explored area) but carries a distinct temporal signature, shorter fixations, less dwell, and the most idiosyncratic (least self-consistent) scanpaths of any group. (iii)ASD gaze is not selectively artist-like on any metric; if anything it is marginally closer to neurotypical. Together these findings indicate that autistic viewing of art is a distinct, group-specific attentional profile in both space and time, and they motivate population-conditioned models of aesthetic attention. We release all analysis code and per-stimulus results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过眼动追踪比较了自闭症成人、训练有素的艺术家和神经典型观察者在自由观看绘画时的空间和时间注意模式。摘要报告了三个主要结果：艺术家和神经典型者在空间和时间上几乎无法区分，而自闭症注视在空间上与艺术家相似但具有独特的时间特征，并且自闭症注视在整体上更接近神经典型者而非艺术家。研究为群体特定的审美注意力模型提供了依据。
Motivation: 以往自闭症眼动研究多关注社交场景而非艺术，且仅分析注视落点而忽略时间顺序，缺乏对艺术观看中空间和时间模式的系统比较。
Method: 采用定向的、基于度量的框架，从空间轴（使用AUC-Judd、NSS、CC等六种显著性度量比较注视密度图）和时间轴（使用MultiMatch、ScanMatch、foveal-disc IoU和动态时间规整比较扫描路径）进行分析。注视点通过分散阈值算法统一提取。
Result: 三个主要发现：艺术家和神经典型者在空间和时间上高度相似（密度图CC=0.96）；自闭症注视在空间上与艺术家相似（广泛的探索），但时间特征不同（更短的注视、更少的驻留、最独特的扫描路径）；自闭症注视并不特别像艺术家，反而略微更接近神经典型者。
Conclusion: 自闭症观看艺术是一种独特的、群体特定的空间和时间注意特征，需要建立群体条件化的审美注意力模型。代码和每幅刺激的结果已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural-Semantic Reciprocal Learning for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USVI-ReID) is challenging due to the large modality gap and the lack of cross-modal identity annotations. Progressive association paradigms have been proposed to gradually bridge the gap, but they suffer from two critical bottlenecks: reliance on ambiguous global representations and unchecked propagation of pseudo-label noise in an open-loop manner. To address these issues, we propose Structural-Semantic Reciprocal Learning (SSRL), a framework that transforms open-loop association into a self-correcting closed-loop system. Structurally, we introduce Fine-grained Structural Decoupling (FSD) to extract discriminative body-part primitives as reliable spatial anchors, complementing ambiguous holistic silhouettes with spatially consistent structural details. Semantically, we design a Closed-loop Semantic Calibration (CSC) mechanism that reconstructs shared semantic prototypes at each epoch and feeds them back into the training loop, effectively filtering pseudo-label noise before the next clustering cycle. Through the reciprocal interaction between structural and semantic learning, SSRL achieves robust cross-modal representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the competitive performance of SSRL against state-of-the-art USVI-ReID methods on both SYSU-MM01 and RegDB, notably surpassing several supervised counterparts on RegDB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对无监督可见光-红外行人重识别（USVI-ReID）中模态差距大、无跨模态身份标注的问题，提出结构-语义互学习（SSRL）框架，将开环关联转变为自校正闭环系统。结构上通过细粒度结构解耦（FSD）提取判别性身体部件作为空间锚点，语义上设计闭环语义校准（CSC）机制重建共享语义原型并反馈到训练循环以过滤伪标签噪声。在SYSU-MM01和RegDB上超越现有无监督方法，并在RegDB上超过若干有监督方法。
Motivation: 现有无监督跨模态行人重识别方法依赖模糊的全局表示，且伪标签噪声在开环中不受控传播，导致性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出结构-语义互学习框架：结构层面用细粒度结构解耦（FSD）提取身体部件作为可靠空间锚点；语义层面用闭环语义校准（CSC）在每个epoch重建共享语义原型并反馈到训练循环，实现伪标签噪声过滤。
Result: 在SYSU-MM01和RegDB数据集上，SSRL取得了与无监督SOTA方法相竞争的性能，并在RegDB上超越若干有监督方法。
Conclusion: 通过结构学习与语义学习的互反馈，SSRL将开环关联转化为自校正闭环系统，有效缓解了模态差异和噪声传播问题。

papers.title: When Words Are Safe But Actions Kill: Probing Physical Danger Beyond Text Safety in Hidden-State Risk Space
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as high-level planners for embodied agents, where linguistically benign instructions can become unsafe once grounded in the physical world. We study whether this physically grounded danger is the same safety problem as ordinary text-level content danger. Through hidden-state direction analysis and random-split null tests, we show that content danger (CD) and physical danger (PD) form separable signals in LLM representations across Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B/32B, Phi-3.5 and SmolLM2. Building on the CD/PD separability, we propose PRISM, a single-layer L2-regularized logistic probe over full hidden states. PRISM achieves 86.2--87.7\% accuracy on SafeAgentBench with 11.7--13.7\% FPR, while same-scale LLM judges over-block safe tasks at 24.7--39.0\% FPR. We further introduce PhysicalSafetyBench-1K (PSB-1K), a contrastive benchmark of 1{,}000 physical-risk pairs without direct harm keywords, to test whether methods detect physically grounded danger rather than explicit unsafe wording. On PSB-1K, PRISM reaches 99.6\% accuracy and 0.7\% FPR, whereas a Qwen2.5-3B judge rejects 67.8\% of safe tasks. PRISM also replicates on SafeText and EARBench, supporting hidden-state probing as a representation-level method for physical safety beyond text moderation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）作为具身智能体规划器时的物理安全性问题，发现内容危险（CD）和物理危险（PD）在LLM表示中形成可分离信号。提出PRISM探针，在SafeAgentBench上达到86.2-87.7%准确率，并引入PhysicalSafetyBench-1K基准，验证了隐状态探测能超越文本层面的安全检测。
Motivation: LLM在具身智能中可能将语言上安全的指令转化为物理上危险的行为，现有文本安全方法无法区分，需要专门研究物理危险检测。
Method: 通过隐状态方向分析和随机分割零假设测试证明CD/PD可分离，提出单层L2正则化逻辑回归探针PRISM，在全隐状态上进行物理危险检测。
Result: 在SafeAgentBench上达到86.2-87.7%准确率（假阳性率11.7-13.7%），优于同尺度LLM评判器（假阳性率24.7-39.0%）；在PSB-1K上达到99.6%准确率（假阳性率0.7%），而Qwen2.5-3B评判器拒绝67.8%的安全任务。
Conclusion: 隐状态探测可作为表示级方法用于物理安全检测，超越文本审核的局限性，并在SafeText和EARBench上得到验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuronSoup: Evolving Asynchronous, Shared-Neuron Temporal Graphs without Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: We present NeuronSoup, a neural computation architecture that replaces synchronous layer-by-layer processing with asynchronous, delay-mediated signal propagation through a pool of shared neurons. Each path in the network routes a continuous-valued signal from one input neuron to one output neuron through a variable number of intermediate hidden neurons. Hidden neurons are physically shared across paths: when two paths pass through the same neuron, the second arrival encounters the accumulated state left by the first, producing constructive or destructive interference that depends on signal polarity and arrival timing. The entire architecture -- topology, weights, delays, and connectivity -- is co-evolved by a genetic algorithm operating on a flat real-valued genome of 14,602 genes. On 10-class MNIST digit classification using frozen ResNet18 features as input, the system evolves a network of 204 active paths through 266 hidden neurons (156 shared across multiple paths, with one neuron participating in 11 distinct paths) and achieves 85.9\% test accuracy after 10,000 generations. The trained model occupies 115 KB. We argue that this architecture addresses fundamental limitations of current deep learning: it requires no differentiable computation graph, adapts its computation depth per-sample, and discovers lateral interactions between processing pathways that current architectures must engineer explicitly. We discuss why genetic algorithms are the correct optimization tool for this problem class, why CMA-ES fails at this scale, and how the architecture generalizes to arbitrary domains by substituting the encoder and output structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuronSoup 架构，用异步、延迟介导的信号传播替代标准同步分层处理，通过共享神经元池实现路径间干扰。整个架构（拓扑、权重、延迟、连接性）由遗传算法协同进化，在基于 ResNet18 特征的 MNIST 分类任务上达到 85.9% 测试准确率，模型仅 115 KB。
Motivation: 现有深度学习依赖可微计算图和同步分层处理，无法自适应样本计算深度，且难以自然引入跨路径侧向交互。
Method: 构建共享神经元池，信号通过可变数量中间神经元从输入到输出异步传播，共享神经元产生极性依赖的累加干扰；所有架构参数由扁平实数基因组的遗传算法进化。
Result: 在 10 类 MNIST（冻结 ResNet18 特征）上，进化出 204 条活跃路径、266 个隐藏神经元（156 个共享），10000 代后测试准确率 85.9%，模型大小 115 KB。
Conclusion: 该架构无需可微图，能自适应样本计算深度并发现侧向交互路径，但仅在 MNIST 特征上验证，泛化到其他领域需更换编码器和输出结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often introduce errors when generating image captions, resulting in misaligned image-text pairs. Our work focuses on a class of captioning errors that we refer to as systematic misalignments, where a recurring error in MLLM-generated captions is closely associated with the presence of a specific visual feature in the paired image. Given a vision-language dataset with MLLM-generated captions, our aim in this work is to detect such errors, a task we refer to as systematic misalignment detection. As our first key contribution, we present Symbal, which utilizes a structured, dual-stage setup with off-the-shelf foundation models to identify systematic misalignments and summarize results in natural language. As our second key contribution, we introduce SymbalBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate automated methods on our proposed task. SymbalBench consists of 1.7 million image-text pairs from two domains (natural and medical images), organized into 420 vision-language datasets with annotated systematic misalignments. Symbal exhibits strong performance on this benchmark, correctly identifying systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets, a nearly 4x improvement over the closest baseline. We supplement our evaluations on SymbalBench with real-world evaluations, showing that (1) Symbal can accurately surface systematic misalignments in captions generated by four MLLMs and (2) Symbal is a powerful tool for auditing off-the-shelf image-caption datasets. Ultimately, our novel task, method, and benchmark can aid users with auditing MLLM-generated captions and identifying critical errors, without requiring access to the underlying MLLM. Code is available at https://github.com/Stanford-AIMI/Symbal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新任务——系统性错位检测（systematic misalignment detection），旨在识别多模态大模型生成图像描述中与特定视觉特征相关的重复性错误。作者构建了 Symbal 方法，利用现成基础模型的双阶段结构检测此类错误并以自然语言总结结果。同时推出包含170万图像-文本对的基准 SymbalBench，在自然图像和医学图像两个领域评估方法。Symbal 在基准上正确识别63.8%数据集的错位，比最接近的基线提升近4倍。
Motivation: 多模态大模型生成图像描述时常出现错误，导致图像-文本对错位。现有工作缺乏系统性检测与错误模式关联的视觉特征，难以审计大规模数据集。
Method: Symbal 采用双阶段结构：第一阶段使用现成基础模型（如视觉检测器、语言模型）提取候选错位模式，第二阶段通过推理机制验证并生成自然语言报告。
Result: 在 SymbalBench 上，Symbal 正确识别63.8%数据集的系统性错位，性能是最接近基线的4倍。真实场景评估中，能准确揭示四种多模态大模型生成的描述错误，并有效审计现成数据集。
Conclusion: Symbal 提供无需访问底层模型即可审计多模态大模型生成图像描述的工具，有助于识别关键错误。任务和基准为未来研究奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAGiSt3R: Multi-Agent Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction from Monocular RGB Videos
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents MAGiSt3R, a multi-agent 3D reconstruction framework performing reconstruction and camera tracking for monocular RGB videos at almost 10 FPS. MAGiSt3R relies on a feed-forward model from the 3R family to process RGB videos and regress local point maps, and on a merging model, MAGMA, that combines local maps at both intra-agent and inter-agent levels to obtain the final global point map. Furthermore, MAGiSt3R performs pose graph optimization to mitigate cumulative camera drift occurring along the feed-forward pipeline. We evaluate MAGiSt3R on both synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating its superior reconstruction and camera tracking accuracy compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGiSt3R，一个多智能体前馈3D重建框架，能从单目RGB视频中以接近10 FPS的速度进行重建和相机跟踪。它利用3R系列的前馈模型回归局部点云，并通过MAGMA模型在智能体内部和智能体之间合并局部地图以得到全局点云，同时使用位姿图优化减轻累积漂移。在合成和真实数据集上的评估表明，其重建和相机跟踪精度优于现有方法。
Motivation: 单目RGB视频的3D重建通常依赖慢速的优化方法或无法处理长时间序列，现有前馈方法在相机轨迹漂移和全局一致性方面存在局限。
Method: 采用多智能体架构，每个智能体处理视频子序列并回归局部点云，通过MAGMA模型进行层间合并，最后用位姿图优化修正全局漂移。

papers.title: Delocalization of bias in unadjusted Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and underdamped Langevin
papers.abstract_en: Unadjusted samplers such as unadjusted Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and underdamped Langevin are well-known to be biased. Metropolis--Hastings adjustment has been conventionally incorporated into Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to eliminate the bias. However, this adjustment can significantly increase the iteration complexity due to the small step size required for reasonable Metropolis acceptance rates. In this work, we extend the \emph{delocalization of bias} phenomenon, previously established for the overdamped Langevin algorithm, to these two unadjusted algorithms. We show that to control the $W_2$ bias of any $K$-dimensional marginal of a high-dimensional distribution, $O(\sqrt{K})$ integration steps suffice up to $\log d$ terms, assuming either weak or sparse interactions among variables. The discrete-time integrators here introduce technical difficulties beyond those of the overdamped setting, which we address through a broadly applicable matrix-polynomial framework that characterizes their propagators. Our result for the underdamped Langevin algorithm is valid for all large friction parameters, implying that the Leimkuhler-Matthews integrator for the overdamped Langevin dynamics also exhibits delocalization of bias.

papers.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) are emerging as a promising foundation for embodied control: rather than predicting actions alone, they learn representations that couple action generation with future world prediction. This coupling is often viewed as a source of robustness, interpretability, and safety, as a robot's action can in principle be checked against its imagined future. In this paper, we show that this assumption is fragile. We introduce BadWAM, a unified framework for modeling and evaluating World-Action Drift Attacks: a new class of WAM-specific adversarial attacks that use small visual perturbations to break the alignment between what a WAM imagines and what it executes. BadWAM characterizes this attack surface along two natural criteria: attack strength and stealthiness. When the adversary prioritizes disruption, BadWAM instantiates an action-only adversarial attack, which directly drives the model toward task-failing actions. When the adversary additionally prioritizes stealth, BadWAM instantiates an imagination-preserving adversarial attack, which seeks to induce harmful action shifts while keeping the model's predicted future close to its clean imagination. Together, these two attacks capture a spectrum of WAM-specific failures: from overt action hijacking to stealthier cases where the model appears to imagine a plausible future but executes a desynchronized action. We evaluate BadWAM across different variants of WAMs. Results show that our attacks substantially reduce task success rates under closed-loop execution. For example, our action-only attack reduces the model performance from 96.5% to 43.1% success. The results of our imagination-preserving attack further exposes a WAM-specific vulnerability: moderate future-preserving regularization can maintain strong attack performance while reducing future imagination drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭露世界-动作模型（WAM）的一个脆弱性：通过小的视觉扰动可以破坏模型想象未来与执行动作的对齐。作者提出BadWAM框架，包括两种攻击：动作-only攻击直接导致任务失败，想象保留攻击在保持未来预测接近清洁想象的同时诱导有害动作偏移。实验表明攻击显著降低任务成功率，如动作-only攻击将成功率从96.5%降至43.1%。
Motivation: 现有WAMs假设耦合未来预测和动作生成能带来鲁棒性和安全性，但本文证明该假设脆弱，缺乏针对WAMs的对抗攻击分析。
Method: 提出BadWAM统一框架，按攻击强度和隐密性两个标准定义世界-动作漂移攻击（World-Action Drift Attacks），包括动作-only攻击和想象保留攻击。
Result: 在多种WAM变体上，攻击显著降低任务成功率：动作-only攻击从96.5%降至43.1%；想象保留攻击显示中等未来保留正则化能保持强攻击性能同时减少未来想象漂移。
Conclusion: 揭示了WAM特有的攻击面，即模型可能想象合理未来但执行不同步动作，需要新的防御机制。

papers.title: MM-IssueLoc: A Controlled Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Evidence in Multimodal Repository-Level Issue Localization
papers.abstract_en: Real repository issues routinely include visual evidence such as screenshots, error dialogs, rendered UI states, and logs, yet repository-level issue localization is evaluated mostly as a text-only task. Existing multimodal SE benchmarks evaluate end-to-end repair, entangling localization with patch synthesis and obscuring whether visual input helped, hurt, or was ignored. We introduce \textbf{MM-IssueLoc}, a controlled benchmark and evaluation protocol for repository-level localization with visual evidence. MM-IssueLoc contains 652 issue-PR instances across 23 languages, with annotations for 7 image categories and 4 relevance levels. It provides file-level and function-level gold labels, paired text-only and with-image evaluation, and VCE-based diagnostics that convert images into structured textual evidence. We evaluate LLM-based and retrieval-based systems, including MM-IssueLoc-VL-Emb as a controlled multimodal retriever. Results show that existing systems remain far from reliable multimodal repository localization: the strongest agent reaches 38.96 file Acc@5 and 22.45 function Acc@10, while the strongest retriever reaches 33.86 function Acc@10. Cross-benchmark comparisons show that high localization scores on text-dominant SWE benchmarks do not transfer cleanly to multimodal issue localization. MM-IssueLoc turns visual evidence into an explicit evaluation variable, enabling future work to test whether systems improve by using visual evidence for localization, rather than by relying on text-only cues or downstream patch-generation effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MM-IssueLoc，一个用于多模态仓库级问题定位的受控基准和评估协议。该基准包含652个issue-PR实例，覆盖23种语言，带有7种图像类别和4种相关度级别的标注，并提供文件级和函数级黄金标签。评估表明，现有系统在多模态仓库定位上仍不可靠，最强代理达到38.96文件Acc@5和22.45函数Acc@10，最强检索器达到33.86函数Acc@10。
Motivation: 现有仓库级问题定位评估主要作为纯文本任务进行，而实际仓库问题常包含截图、错误对话框等视觉证据。现有多模态SE基准将定位与补丁生成纠缠在一起，模糊了视觉输入是否真正有帮助。
Method: 构建MM-IssueLoc基准，包含652个实例，带有多模态标注和黄金标签；提出基于VCE的诊断方法将图像转化为结构化文本证据；引入MM-IssueLoc-VL-Emb作为受控多模态检索器，并设计文本-only和with-image对比评估协议。
Result: 最强代理（基于LLM）达到38.96文件Acc@5和22.45函数Acc@10；最强检索器达到33.86函数Acc@10。跨基准对比表明，文本主导的SWE基准上的高定位分数不能直接迁移到多模态问题定位。
Conclusion: MM-IssueLoc将视觉证据转化为显式评估变量，使未来工作能够测试系统是否通过使用视觉证据改进定位，而非仅依赖文本线索或下游补丁生成效果。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Annotation quality is a major bottleneck in building reliable and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) systems for mental health research. In depression-related datasets, labels are often assigned without structured evidence, symptom-level justification, or traceable alignment with the criteria of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR), limiting both transparency and downstream model interpretability. We propose a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop annotation framework for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) that combines large language model (LLM)-assisted labeling with expert verification. The framework is intended to support the construction of explainable, DSM-5-TR-aligned datasets rather than to perform clinical diagnosis. It operates in three stages: candidate evidence selection from textual records, criterion-level DSM-5-TR analysis, and case-level synthesis that produces label-level diagnostic and severity annotations. A dual-memory architecture, composed of Example Memory and Reflection Memory, is designed to internalize expert feedback and iteratively improve future annotations without retraining. We describe this mechanism and leave its evaluation across multiple feedback cycles to future work. In addition to final labels, the framework exports clinical evidence, reasoning traces, and edit histories, enabling comprehensive auditability. In a pilot study using expert-reviewed samples, the proposed approach improves annotation consistency and explainability while reducing manual revision effort.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自进化的专家在环标注框架，用于基于DSM-5-TR标准的抑郁症症状解释性标注。框架结合大语言模型辅助标注与专家验证，通过三阶段流程（候选证据选择、标准级分析、案例级综合）生成带有临床证据和推理痕迹的标签。双记忆架构（示例记忆与反思记忆）内化专家反馈以迭代改进。试点研究表明该方法能提升标注一致性和可解释性，减少手动修订工作量。
Motivation: 抑郁症数据集中标签缺乏结构化证据、症状级理由及与DSM-5-TR标准的可追溯对齐，限制了透明度和模型可解释性。
Method: 三阶段框架：候选证据选择、DSM-5-TR标准级分析、案例级综合（生成诊断和严重程度标注）。双记忆架构（示例记忆与反思记忆）通过内化专家反馈实现自进化，无需重训练。输出包括临床证据、推理轨迹和编辑历史。
Result: 在专家评审样本的试点研究中，该方法提高了标注一致性和可解释性，并减少了手动修订工作量。
Conclusion: 框架专注于构建可解释、DSM-5-TR对齐的数据集，而非临床诊断。多反馈循环的评估留作未来工作。

papers.title: Mask-Aware Policy Gradients for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has proven effective for improving reasoning in large language models, but extending it to Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) remains challenging due to the intractability of the log-likelihood estimation. Existing approaches approximate this log-likelihood by modeling only the token predictions, ignoring the order in which positions are unmasked during generation. We observe that MDLM generation involves two decisions at each step: what tokens to place at each masked position and which positions to remask. We formalize this as a two-stage action MDP, showing that the policy gradient naturally decomposes into a token term and a masking term. Combining optimization of both terms leads to state-of-the-art outcomes on mathematical reasoning and coding benchmarks, with scores of 87.1% on GSM8K and 53.4% on MBPP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs)的强化学习训练问题，提出将生成过程形式化为两阶段动作MDP，策略梯度自然分解为token项和masking项，联合优化两者在数学推理和编码基准上取得最优结果（GSM8K 87.1%，MBPP 53.4%）。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法扩展到MDLMs时忽略生成过程中位置被掩盖的顺序，导致对数似然估计不精确，限制了模型推理能力。
Method: 将MDLM生成建模为两阶段动作MDP，策略梯度分解为token项（决定每个遮罩位置的token）和masking项（决定哪些位置重新遮罩），并联合优化两项。
Result: 在GSM8K数学推理基准上达到87.1%，在MBPP编码基准上达到53.4%，均达到当时最优水平。
Conclusion: 摘要认为联合优化token和masking项的策略梯度是提升MDLM推理性能的有效方法。

papers.title: Subjective Risk Decomposition: A New View for Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel viewpoint for uncertainty quantification. Uncertainty measures are not primitives, in need of axioms and argumentation, but instead consequences, of higher-level modelling decisions. We show how epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty measures can be derived via decomposition of a subjective risk, based on a strictly proper loss. Reverse cross-entropy provides a prominent example, where decomposition recovers the classic information-theoretic uncertainty terms. The same approach recovers numerous measures previously proposed across the UQ literature, providing them a common theoretical foundation. From a practical point of view, this suggests a new approach to UQ: given a modelling scenario and strictly proper loss, the corresponding epistemic and aleatoric terms are induced by the subjective-risk decomposition. We then extend our view to learning theory: we introduce and analyse subjective risk analogues of excess risk, approximation error, and estimation error, and identify the connections to UQ. We consider this a first step towards a full learning-theoretic framework for uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的不确定性量化观点，认为不确定性度量不是原始概念，而是更高层建模决策的结果。通过主观风险分解（基于严格真损失）推导出认知和偶然不确定性度量，反向交叉熵为例可恢复经典信息论不确定性项，为许多先前提出的UQ度量提供共同理论基础。
Motivation: 当前不确定性量化方法中，度量往往需要公理和论证，但缺乏统一的推导框架。本文旨在建立一种从更高层建模决策出发，通过主观风险分解自然导出不确定性度量的新视角。
Method: 提出主观风险分解框架，基于严格真损失将主观风险分解为认知和偶然不确定性项，反向交叉熵作为特例，统一多种现有UQ度量。
Result: 使用反向交叉熵作为例子，分解恢复了经典信息论不确定性项；许多先前提出的UQ度量可以通过该框架得到统一解释。

papers.title: Plover: Steering GUI Agents through Plan-Centric Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) automation remains challenging in real-world environments, where dynamic layouts, unexpected dialogs, and evolving interface states can cause autonomous agents to drift from user intent. Recent vision-based multimodal agents improve flexibility by operating directly over screenshots and natural language instructions, but planning and adaptation often remain internal, limiting users' ability to inspect, supervise, or correct system behavior. We present Plover, a plan-centric vision-based GUI automation system that externalizes task plans and replanning as persistent, inspectable, and revisable artifacts. Through a planner--executor architecture, Plover supports explicit supervision of evolving execution, localized correction through editable plans, natural-language guidance, and screenshot-grounded interventions, while preserving prior progress during repair. A formative study with six participants informed the interaction design. We then evaluate Plover through benchmark failure-case repair and scenario-based workflow analyses. Our results show that many autonomous GUI-agent failures are structurally repairable when plans remain visible and interventions are localized, and that explicit replanning helps make GUI automation more transparent, controllable, and adaptable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Plover，一种以计划为中心的视觉GUI自动化系统，将任务计划和重新规划外部化为持久、可检查和可修改的工件，通过规划器-执行器架构支持显式监督、局部修正、自然语言指导和基于截图的干预，同时在修复过程中保留先前进展。通过形成性研究和基准失败案例修复、场景工作流分析评估，表明许多自主GUI代理失败在计划可见且干预局部化时可修复，显式重新规划使GUI自动化更透明、可控和适应。
Motivation: 现有GUI自动化系统在动态布局、意外对话框和不断变化的界面状态下容易偏离用户意图，且规划与适应过程通常内部化，限制了用户的监督和纠正能力。
Method: 提出Plover系统，采用规划器-执行器架构，将任务计划外部化为持久工件，支持局部编辑和自然语言指导、截图干预，并在修复时保留先前进展。
Result: 基准失败案例修复和场景工作流分析表明，许多GUI代理失败在计划可见且干预局部化时可修复，显式重新规划提高了透明性、可控性和适应性。
Conclusion: Plover通过外部化计划和局部化干预使GUI自动化更可控，但摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Can We Trust Item Response Theory for AI Evaluation?
papers.abstract_en: AI benchmarks increasingly leverage item-level statistical models, particularly item response theory (IRT), to estimate model capabilities, rank systems, select informative examples, and diagnose benchmark quality. However, AI benchmark data often departs from the data regime of human testing, for which standard IRT estimation tools were originally developed: benchmarks typically involve fewer evaluated models, far more items, and capability distributions that may be skewed, clustered, or multimodal. We examine how these regime mismatches challenge the reliability of IRT modeling for AI evaluation. Using item parameters and capability distributions derived from six widely used LLM benchmarks, we simulate response matrices under three common IRT models and compare four estimation tools used in recent benchmark studies: marginal maximum likelihood, Markov chain Monte Carlo, variational inference, and a neural pseudo-Siamese estimator. Across 18,000 simulation conditions, we systematically evaluate computational feasibility, scalability, and the reliability of IRT inferences about model rankings, predicted performance, and item characteristics. Results show that classical estimators can become infeasible in large benchmark settings, whereas scalable estimators can produce unreliable item-level and ranking inferences with small or nonnormally distributed model sets. This study identifies when latent trait models reliably support or risk distorting AI benchmarking claims, and what sample sizes and diagnostics are needed for trustworthy use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了项目反应理论（IRT）在AI基准测试中的可靠性，发现经典估计器在大规模基准中不可行，而可扩展估计器在小规模或非正态分布的模型集上会产生不可靠的推断。研究基于六个LLM基准的模拟实验，涵盖18,000种条件，指出了IRT在AI评估中应用的条件和局限性。
Motivation: AI基准测试越来越多地使用IRT来估计模型能力、排名系统等，但AI基准的数据特征（如模型少、题目多、能力分布偏斜）与人类测试场景不同，可能影响IRT的可靠性，现有研究缺乏对此类失配的系统评估。
Method: 从六个广泛使用的LLM基准中提取项目参数和能力分布，在三种常见IRT模型下模拟响应矩阵，并比较四种估计工具：边际最大似然、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛、变分推断和神经伪孪生估计器。在18,000种模拟条件下评估计算可行性、可扩展性以及关于模型排名、预测性能和项目特征的推断可靠性。
Result: 经典估计器在大型基准设置中可能变得不可行，而可扩展估计器在模型集较小或非正态分布时会产生不可靠的项目级和排名推断。
Conclusion: 该研究识别了潜特质模型何时能可靠支持或可能扭曲AI基准测试结论，并指出了可信使用所需样本量和诊断指标。

papers.title: RTS Smoother-Guided Learning of Physics-Based Neural Differential Models
papers.abstract_en: Ordinary differential equations (ODEs) are widely used to model dynamical systems in physics, biology, neuroscience, and physiology, but in many applications some equations of the dynamics are unknown and only a subset of the state variables are measured. We propose a hybrid neural--physics framework in which the known components of the ODE are kept explicit and the missing components are represented by a neural network. The proposed method consists of two stages where we alternate between state and parameter estimation and iterate until a predetermined criterion is met. Specifically, in the first step, we treat the model parameters as being known and we infer the latent states from the available measurements using a Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) smoother. In the second stage, we treat the smoothed trajectories as being known and use them to estimate the neural networks' parameters through backpropagation. We evaluate the method on benchmark systems spanning linear, nonlinear, and stiff dynamics under partial state observation. Across these settings, the proposed method learns missing ODE components from incomplete measurements while exploiting and retaining interpretable mechanistic structure and improving latent-state reconstruction and long-horizon prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合神经-物理框架，将已知ODE分量保留为显式形式，用神经网络表示缺失分量，并通过RTS平滑器与反向传播交替迭代进行状态与参数估计。在部分观测下的线性、非线性和刚性动力学基准上，该方法能从不完整测量中学习缺失的ODE分量，同时保持可解释的机械结构并提升潜在状态重构与长时预测性能。
Motivation: 许多物理、生物等领域的动力学系统部分方程未知且只有部分状态变量可测，现有方法难以同时利用已知物理机制和从数据中学习缺失部分。
Method: 两步交替迭代：第一步固定模型参数，用RTS平滑器从测量中推断潜在状态；第二步将平滑轨迹视为真值，通过反向传播估计神经网络参数，直至收敛。
Result: 在线性、非线性和刚性动力学基准上，该方法从不完整测量中成功学习缺失ODE分量，改进了潜在状态重构和长时预测精度。
Conclusion: 该混合框架能保留可解释的物理结构，同时利用神经网络学习未知动态，适用于部分观测下的动力学建模。

papers.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: Transformer reasoning is limited by autoregressive decoding, which repeat edly compresses rich hidden computation through token space and makes it difficult for intermediate reasoning states to persist across time. We in troduce Transformers with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence (T2MLR), a transformers-based latent reasoning architecture that fuses a cached middle layer representation from the previous token directly into an earlier layer of the current token position, enabling abstract intermediate computation to persist across decoding steps with little inference overhead. Across natural-language pretraining and multi-hop reasoning finetuning, T2MLR consistently outperforms data- and parameter-matched Transformer base lines. Moreover, applying recurrence to only a localized middle-layer block (as little as 20% of the network) often outperforms full-layer recurrence. Im portantly, T2MLR does not require pretraining from scratch: retrofitting the recurrent pathway into an existing pretrained 1.7B Transformer and briefly finetuning substantially improves math reasoning, lowering the barrier to practical adoption. These results suggest that effective latent reasoning in Transformers does not require looping over all layers as in previous works, but can instead emerge more strongly from targeted middle-layer recurrence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 T2MLR (Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence)，一种基于 Transformer 的潜在推理架构。它通过将前一个 token 的中间层缓存表示直接注入当前 token 的早期层，使得抽象中间计算可以跨解码步骤持久化，且推理开销很小。实验表明，在自然语言预训练和多跳推理微调中，T2MLR 始终优于参数匹配的 Transformer 基线；仅对局部中间层（网络的 20%）施加循环效果优于全层循环。此外，该方法无需从头预训练，通过在已有 1.7B Transformer 上改造循环路径并微调即可显著提升数学推理能力。
Motivation: 标准自回归解码反复将丰富隐藏计算压缩到 token 空间，导致中间推理状态难以随时间步持续，限制 Transformer 的推理能力。
Method: 提出 T2MLR 架构，将前一个 token 的中间层表示缓存并直接注入当前 token 的较浅层，从而实现跨时间步的抽象计算持久化；循环仅应用于局部中间层块（例如网络的 20%）。
Result: 在自然语言预训练和多跳推理微调任务上，T2MLR 均优于数据量和参数量匹配的 Transformer 基线；仅 20% 网络层的局部循环性能常优于全层循环；在已有 1.7B 预训练模型上改造并微调后，数学推理能力得到显著提升。
Conclusion: 有效潜在推理无需像先前工作那样循环所有层，针对中间层的局部循环即可产生更强效果，且易于在现有预训练模型上部署。

papers.title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Scientific Visualization Literacy
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret visualizations, yet current evaluations remain largely chart-centric and provide limited evidence of understanding of scientific visualization (SciVis). We benchmark six MLLMs on the scientific visualization literacy assessment test, a standardized SciVis literacy assessment comprising 49 items based on 18 scientific visualizations and illustrations, spanning 8 techniques and 11 task types. We evaluate three closed-source and three open-source models under a closed-world protocol and compare their performance using data from 485 human participants. Results show that current MLLMs do not exhibit uniform SciVis literacy. Gemini is the strongest model overall, exceeding the human mean across the evaluated subsets, whereas the open-source models remain below the human baseline. Performance is highly uneven across techniques and tasks: models perform best on scientific illustration, search, and spatial understanding, but struggle on texture-based and integration-based visualizations and on quantitative estimation. Error analysis reveals recurring failures in fine-grained quantitative estimation, flow-direction interpretation, and grounded encoding interpretation. These findings position SciVis literacy as a necessary benchmark dimension for evaluating multimodal AI systems. Our code and model outputs are publicly available at https://github.com/patdmp/mllm-scivis-lit-benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对六个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在科学可视化素养评估测试（SciVis literacy assessment）中的表现进行了基准测试，该测试包含基于18个科学可视化作品的49个项目，涵盖8种技术和11种任务类型。在封闭世界协议下，与485名人类参与者的数据对比显示，当前MLLM的SciVis素养不均匀：Gemini最强，超过人类均值；开源模型低于人类基线。模型在科学插图、搜索和空间理解任务上表现较好，但在基于纹理和集成的可视化以及定量估计上困难。错误分析揭示了细粒度定量估计、流向解释和编码解释方面的反复失败。
Motivation: 当前对MLLM可视化理解的评估大多以图表为中心，缺乏对科学可视化（SciVis）理解能力的充分证据，亟需系统性的基准测试。
Method: 使用科学可视化素养评估测试，包含49个基于18个科学可视化与插图的项目，覆盖8种技术和11种任务类型。评估6个MLLM（3个闭源、3个开源），在封闭世界协议下进行，并与485名人类参与者数据比较。
Result: Gemini是综合最强的模型，超过人类均值；开源模型低于人类基线。模型在科学插图、搜索和空间理解任务上表现好，在基于纹理和集成的可视化以及定量估计上表现差。
Conclusion: SciVis素养应作为评估多模态AI系统的必要基准维度，当前MLLM在特定可视化任务上仍有显著不足。

summary_sections.motivation: 当前对MLLM可视化理解的评估大多以图表为中心，缺乏对科学可视化（SciVis）理解能力的充分证据，亟需系统性的基准测试。
summary_sections.method: 使用科学可视化素养评估测试，包含49个基于18个科学可视化与插图的项目，覆盖8种技术和11种任务类型。评估6个MLLM（3个闭源、3个开源），在封闭世界协议下进行，并与485名人类参与者数据比较。

summary_sections.conclusion: SciVis素养应作为评估多模态AI系统的必要基准维度，当前MLLM在特定可视化任务上仍有显著不足。

papers.title: MedFailBench: A Clinician-Built Open-Source Benchmark for Medical AI Safety Boundary Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Most medical AI benchmarks measure whether a model knows the correct answer. MedFailBench asks a different question: which safety boundary failed? We present a clinician-built synthetic benchmark and failure atlas that labels medical AI errors by severity (1--5) and safety gate type (missed urgent escalation, unsafe remote dosing, unsafe discharge reassurance, evidence fabrication, unsafe protocol execution, source support gap). The current public release (v0.2.1) contains 44 clinician-reviewed synthetic cases with severity annotations, a live HuggingFace leaderboard preview, a safety gate taxonomy, a clinical severity rubric, and an automated pipeline for archiving model-response screening runs. No patient data, clinical validation claims, or model rankings are included. MedFailBench is released under Apache-2.0 and CC-BY-4.0 and carries the Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21205535.
papers.comment: 6 pages; clinician-reviewed synthetic benchmark; no patient data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedFailBench是一个由临床医生构建的开放基准，用于评估医疗AI系统的安全边界失败类型。当前版本包含44个经临床医生审核的合成案例，按严重程度和安全门类型标注，并附带失败分类法、安全门分类和严重程度评分标准。该基准仅用于安全边界检查，不包含患者数据或模型排名。
Motivation: 现有医疗AI基准大多只衡量模型是否知道正确答案（即正确性），而忽略了模型在哪些安全边界上失败的问题。MedFailBench填补了这一空白，专门用于识别和分类AI在不同安全门类型上的失败模式。
Method: 构建了一个由临床医生审核的合成基准（v0.2.1包含44个案例），并定义了一个失败分类体系：按严重程度（1-5级）和安全门类型（包括遗漏紧急升级、不安全远程用药、不安全出院确认、证据捏造、不安全协议执行、来源支持缺口）对错误进行标注。同时提供自动化的模型响应筛选记录流水线。
Result: 当前发布版仅提供基准本身，未报告任何模型性能排名或临床验证声明。该基准已附带HuggingFace排行榜预览。
Conclusion: MedFailBench旨在促进医疗AI安全边界检查的标准化评估，强调其开放性和非临床属性（无患者数据、无临床验证声明）。作者希望社区利用该基准识别和改进模型在关键安全门上的失败模式。
