papers.title: CFM-Bench: A Unified Multi-Domain, Multi-Task Benchmark for Channel Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Channel foundation models (CFMs) are developing rapidly, with recent studies reporting benefits from pretraining across downstream wireless tasks. Yet CFMs are commonly evaluated in model-specific pipelines with different data, radio configurations, partitions, adaptation procedures, task definitions, and metrics. Reported comparisons therefore tend to show that pretraining improves over supervised training from scratch within one pipeline, but neither rank CFMs nor compare them fairly with task-specific models. We release CFM-Bench, a unified multi-domain, multi-task benchmark designed to address this gap. It curates six channel configurations spanning 3GPP statistical simulation, two independent ray-tracing pipelines, industrial and aerial measurements, and synchronized vehicular multimodal simulation. Official partitions isolate complete trajectories, measurement sessions, vehicle links, simulation realizations, or buffered spatial regions. CFM-Bench does not prescribe an external pretraining corpus or strategy; no benchmark split may be used for foundation-model pretraining, and the official training split is reserved exclusively for downstream fine-tuning. The benchmark additionally requires disclosure of all data used during model development and prohibits training-stage use of official test units. Six task groups are organized along three CFM application dimensions: physical-layer (PHY) channel intelligence, radio-access-network (RAN) decision intelligence, and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC). They cover CSI feedback, frequency and temporal channel extrapolation, propagation-state classification, current- and future-beam prediction, and single-frame and temporal localization. CFM-Bench provides a common substrate for comparing the transferability of channel representations across models, domains, and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CFM-Bench，一个统一的多域、多任务基准测试，用于评估通道基础模型（CFMs）。该基准涵盖了多种信道配置（3GPP统计仿真、射线追踪、工业/空中测量、车辆多模态仿真）和六个任务组（CSI反馈、频率/时间信道外推、传播状态分类、波束预测、定位等），旨在提供公平比较CFMs和特定任务模型的公共平台。
Motivation: 现有CFMs评估存在模型特定管道、数据/配置/任务/指标不统一的问题，导致无法公平比较不同CFMs或与任务专用模型对比。
Method: 构建CFM-Bench，包含六种信道配置，明确数据划分（隔离完整轨迹、测量会话等），禁止使用基准分割进行预训练，要求披露所有训练数据并禁止使用官方测试单元进行训练，定义六个任务组覆盖物理层、RAN和ISAC。
Conclusion: CFM-Bench为比较通道表示的可迁移性提供了公共基底。

papers.title: On Success and Simplicity: A Second Look at Transferable Vision-Language Attack Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Pre-training Models (VLPMs) are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Recent transferable attacks on VLPMs have followed a common pipeline with complicated loss functions or multi-stage text/image attacks. However, in this paper, we demonstrate that such a sophisticated attack pipeline can be simpler yet more successful. Specifically, we identify three previously overlooked issues caused by inappropriate cross-modal interactions and excessive operations. To address them, we propose the Simple Vision-Language Attack (SimVLA) pipeline, which observably improves transferability and efficiency. Experiments on four datasets and three downstream tasks validate the superiority of our pipeline. For instance, on Flickr30k text-image retrieval dataset, our SimVLA outperforms the SOTA baseline in R@1 transferability by 8.01\%-14.71\%, while consuming only about 35.73\% of the time and 46.26\% of the max VRAM. Overall, the superiority of our SimVLA highlights the importance of leveraging domain knowledge (e.g., our proposed cross-modal word identification), while blindly pursuing intricate operations (e.g, complex loss functions and redundant multi-stage designs) may even be harmful. We hope our SimVLA can serve as a simple yet effective backbone for future extensions. Code is available at https://github.com/RYC-98/SimVLA.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (TIFS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有可迁移视觉-语言攻击（VLPM）流程存在跨模态交互不当和操作冗余的问题，提出简单视觉-语言攻击（SimVLA）流程，通过简化损失函数和减少多阶段操作提升可迁移性和效率。实验表明，在Flickr30k图文检索任务上，SimVLA相比SOTA基线在R@1可迁移性上提升8.01%-14.71%，仅消耗约35.73%的时间和46.26%的显存。
Motivation: 现有针对VLPM的可迁移攻击通常采用复杂损失函数或多阶段攻击组合，但作者认为这些复杂设计可能引入低效甚至有害的跨模态交互，阻碍攻击成功率和效率。
Method: 提出SimVLA流程，核心是识别并修正三个被忽视的问题：不恰当的跨模态交互、过度操作和冗余设计。具体包括简化损失函数、移除不必要的多阶段攻击，并利用领域知识（如跨模态词汇识别）优化攻击生成。
Result: 在四个数据集和三个下游任务上验证，以Flickr30k为例，R@1可迁移性提升8.01%-14.71%，时间消耗约为SOTA基线的35.73%，最大显存消耗约为46.26%。
Conclusion: 本文表明，在可迁移视觉-语言攻击中，盲目追求复杂操作可能适得其反，而结合领域知识的简洁设计能同时提升效果和效率。SimVLA可作为未来扩展的简单有效基线。

papers.title: Explaining Process Control Optimisation Recommendations via GradientSHAP and Implicit Differentiation
papers.abstract_en: Automated optimisation is increasingly adopted in industrial processes, yet a trust gap persists between engineers who design these algorithms and operators who must act on their recommendations. Explainable AI methods like SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) have transformed interpretability for machine learning predictions; optimisation outputs could benefit from similar techniques. We present an approach that integrates Implicit Function Theorem (IFT) based sensitivity analysis with SHAP attribution and narrative generation via Large Language Models (LLM), producing explanations tailored for operators. Our approach leverages IFT to compute exact parameter sensitivities $\partial p^*/\partial x$ from the optimality conditions, enabling efficient GradientSHAP computation. For an industrial High Pressure Grinding Roll (HPGR) control optimisation problem with 22 features, we achieve equivalent SHAP attributions (correlation $>$0.99 with KernelSHAP) with over 40$\times$ speedup, enabling real-time natural language explanations. We validate on industrial scenarios and present feedback from domain experts on generated explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业过程控制优化中工程师与操作员之间的信任鸿沟，提出一种结合隐函数定理（IFT）敏感性分析、SHAP归因和大型语言模型（LLM）解释生成的方法。在22特征的高压辊磨机（HPGR）控制优化问题上，该方法实现了与KernelSHAP相关性>0.99的归因，并带来40倍以上的加速，支持实时自然语言解释。工业场景验证和领域专家反馈表明其有效性。
Motivation: 自动化优化在工业过程中日益普及，但工程师（设计者）与操作员（执行者）之间存在信任鸿沟；现有可解释AI方法多用于机器学习预测，而优化输出的解释需求未被充分满足。
Method: 利用隐函数定理从最优性条件精确计算参数敏感性∂p*/∂x，进而高效计算GradientSHAP归因；最后通过LLM将归因结果转化为面向操作员的自然语言解释。
Result: 在22特征的HPGR控制优化问题上，该方法与KernelSHAP的归因相关性>0.99，计算速度提升40倍以上，支持实时解释生成。
Conclusion: 所提框架在工业场景中验证有效，并获得了领域专家对生成解释的正面反馈。

papers.title: Stitch-Inferencer: Enhance Endoscopic Video Segmentation and Tracking via Panoramic Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Surgical video understanding is fundamental to navigation systems. Endoscopic perception is often hindered by a limited field-of-view and frequent instrument occlusions, making spatio-temporal context essential for robust inference. These challenges have motivated video models that aggregate information across frames. However, existing video models typically store past observations implicitly in learned feature representations, often requiring task-specific video training, substantial annotated data, and increased computational cost. We propose Stitch-Inferencer, a real-time, model-agnostic inference framework that replaces implicit feature memory with an explicit image-space panoramic canvas. By stitching valid observations across frames, Stitch-Inferencer preserves previously observed pixels in an online, instrument-free view, expanding the effective field-of-view and providing direct access to regions that are temporarily occluded or absent from the current frame. Downstream segmentation or tracking models are applied to a compact region of interest on the panorama, and their predictions are reprojected to the current frame, enabling existing models to exploit long-range context without retraining. Experiments on anatomy segmentation and point/box tracking demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse baselines while preserving real-time throughput. The stitching module alone runs at over 60 FPS, providing a practical inference-time solution to enhance endoscopic perception in computationally constrained intraoperative environments. Source code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了一种模型无关的实时推理框架 Stitch-Inferencer，通过将有效观测在图像空间拼接成全景画布，扩展内窥镜视野并恢复被遮挡区域，在不重新训练的前提下提升下游分割/跟踪模型的性能。实验在解剖分割和点/框跟踪任务上展示了一致改进，拼接模块速度超过 60 FPS。
Motivation: 内窥镜视野有限且器械遮挡频繁，现有视频模型依赖隐式特征记忆，需要任务特定训练和大量标注数据，计算开销大。
Method: 提出在线拼接全景画布，将先前帧的有效像素显式保留在图像空间中，对全景上的感兴趣区域应用分割/跟踪模型，再将预测重投影到当前帧。
Result: 在解剖分割和点/框跟踪任务上，多个基线模型均获得一致提升，且保持实时吞吐量，拼接模块运行帧率超过 60 FPS。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种实用推理时解决方案，在计算受限的术中环境下增强内窥镜感知，无需重新训练现有模型。

papers.title: Latent Trajectory Discrimination for AI-Generated Text Detection
papers.abstract_en: Most existing approaches to AI-Generated Text Detection (AIGTD) treat documents as static objects and base their decisions on aggregate statistics or globally compressed embeddings. However, this perspective overlooks the inherently dynamic nature of autoregressive generation, where content evolves progressively through the latent space. In this paper, we reformulate AIGTD as the problem of distinguishing between latent generation trajectories. Instead of relying on static representations, we model how textual representations evolve across the sequence. To this end, we propose Geometric Trajectory and Contrastive Learning (GTCL), a framework that segments the document into ordered local units, encodes each unit in an embedding space, and constructs a structured and sequence-level representation. GTCL then applies contrastive learning to these trajectories to learn geometric regularities associated with the autoregressive generation. Evaluations performed on three different benchmarks and several approaches show that GTCL outperforms detection baselines consistently, which implies that explicitly modeling sequential dynamics provides robust discriminative signals across models and domains. These results suggest that modeling trajectory differences could improve detection and open up a dynamic direction that has been underexplored in previous AIGTD literature.

papers.title: U-shaped Multi-granularity Learning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The prompt learning paradigm for vision-language models is effective yet faces a granularity dilemma: global prompts lack fine-grained semantic awareness, while local prompts ignore contextual associations, limiting cross-task generalization. This dilemma exists in dense prediction tasks. Inspired by U-Net, which unifies multi-level representations across granularities, we propose UPrompt, a U-shaped multi-granularity prompt learning framework for vision-language models. Similar to how U-Net integrates fine and coarse features through symmetric encoder-decoder pathways with cross-level connections, UPrompt constructs parallel multi-granularity representations in both visual and textual modalities, where coarse-to-fine cascaded enhancement propagates global context to refine local details, while fine-to-coarse hierarchical supervision ensures semantic consistency across scales. Extensive experiments on 17 benchmarks validate our effectiveness. UPrompt outperforms MAMET and VPKE by 4.1 and 7.3 rSum on MSCOCO, surpasses CoCoA-Mix by 5.09% in base-to-novel generalization, while maintaining competitive performance with minimal overhead (coarse-grained) and matching PSRC with 1/3 cost (medium-grained).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视觉语言模型prompt学习中的粒度困境（全局prompt缺乏细粒度语义、局部prompt忽略上下文关联），本文提出UPrompt，一种受U-Net启发的U形多粒度提示学习框架。UPrompt在视觉和文本模态构建并行多粒度表示，通过粗到细级联增强和细到粗层次监督实现跨尺度语义一致性。在17个基准上的实验表明，UPrompt在MSCOCO上超过MAMET和VPKE，在base-to-novel泛化上超过CoCoA-Mix，且参数量开销小。
Motivation: 现有prompt学习方法面临粒度困境：全局提示缺乏细粒度语义，局部提示忽略上下文关联，限制了跨任务泛化能力，尤其在密集预测任务中。
Method: 提出UPrompt框架，仿照U-Net的对称编码器-解码器路径与跨层连接，在视觉和文本模态构建并行多粒度表示，包括从粗到细的级联增强（传播全局上下文以细化局部细节）和从细到粗的层次监督（保证语义一致性）。
Result: 在17个基准上验证，UPrompt在MSCOCO上分别比MAMET和VPKE提升4.1和7.3 rSum；在base-to-novel泛化上比CoCoA-Mix提升5.09%；粗粒度版本开销极小且保持竞争力，中粒度版本以1/3成本匹配PSRC。
Conclusion: UPrompt通过U形多粒度提示学习有效解决了粒度困境，在多个密集预测任务上取得提升，且在不同粒度设置下保持开销优势。

papers.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize this problem as coverage of a predefined set of semantically specified modes, which we call target-mode coverage. We then propose multi-axis max@K, a group-based reinforcement learning objective for improving such coverage in diffusion-based T2I models. Given a group of samples and one score per target category, multi-axis max@K first takes the maximum score across samples for each category and then sums these category-wise maxima. The resulting credit assignment gives a sample positive weight on a category only when it increases that category's group-wise maximum, allowing different samples to contribute to different categories. We first validate the credit-assignment mechanism on a synthetic mixture and on SD3.5-M using deterministic pixel-based color rewards. We then evaluate the same objective on perceived-appearance fairness. Across three automatic evaluators on held-out prompts, multi-axis max@K improves the Fairness Score by 0.23-0.36 relative to the base model, while maintaining image quality and text alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多轴 max@K 强化学习目标，用于扩散文本到图像模型中的目标模式覆盖多样性。该方法对一组样本的每个类别取最大分数再求和，激励不同样本贡献不同类别。在合成数据和 SD3.5-M 上验证了信用分配机制，并在感知外观公平性上使 Fairness Score 提升 0.23-0.36，同时保持图像质量和文本对齐。
Motivation: 文本到图像模型生成的样本常只覆盖同一提示的少数视觉模式，多样性不足，且在人像提示中可能放大人口统计偏斜。
Method: 提出多轴 max@K 强化学习目标：对一组样本，对每个类别取样本间最大分数，再求和所有类别最大值，从而分配信用，使样本仅在其提升类别最大值时获得正权重。
Result: 在三个自动评估器上，对未见提示的 Fairness Score 相比基模型提升 0.23-0.36，图像质量和文本对齐持平。
Conclusion: 多轴 max@K 能有效改善扩散 T2I 模型的生成多样性和公平性，信用分配机制是核心。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contextualized Early Detection of Online Firestorms: A Sequential LLM-Based Approach
papers.abstract_en: Online firestorms are rapid collective escalations of highly negative user-generated content and may cause substantial reputational and economic damage. Existing detectors usually work with volume signals, sentiment scores, or predefined linguistic features. Such signals are useful, but they capture contextual meaning shifts in evolving discussion threads only indirectly. This paper proposes an LLM-based detection system with two operating modes. The first mode classifies complete Reddit threads retrospectively by combining local chunk-level assessments into a thread-level judgment. The second mode processes threads sequentially and issues early warnings when a sliding window exceeds calibrated thresholds. In this mode, the language model estimates three firestorm indicators: negativity share, escalation level, and contributor count. On a balanced Reddit dataset, the global mode achieves strong classification performance, while the early warning mode reaches high recall and detects escalating threads after only a small number of comments and distinct contributors. The results indicate that LLMs can be used not only for static judgment tasks, but also as repeated estimators in context-aware monitoring of social media discourse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LLM的在线风暴检测系统，包含两种模式：全局模式通过组合局部块级评估对完整Reddit线程进行事后分类；顺序模式使用滑动窗口和阈值触发早期预警，并估计三个指标（消极比例、升级程度、贡献者数量）。在平衡的Reddit数据集上，全局模式分类性能强，早期预警模式实现高召回率，仅需少量评论即可检测升级线程。
Motivation: 现有检测器依赖音量信号、情感分数或预定义语言特征，无法直接捕捉讨论线程中语境意义的动态变化。
Method: 提出两种操作模式：1）全局模式，将线程分割为局部块，对各块进行LLM评估并聚合为线程级判断；2）顺序模式，按顺序处理评论，对滑动窗口内的内容估计三个火暴指标，并在超过校准阈值时发出早期警告。
Result: 在平衡的Reddit数据集上，全局模式取得强分类性能；早期预警模式达到高召回率，能在少数评论和贡献者出现后检测到升级中的线程。
Conclusion: 结果表明，LLM不仅可用于静态判断，还可作为重复估计器用于社交媒体话语的上下文感知监控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens under a Fixed GPU Budget
papers.abstract_en: A growing gap separates inference context lengths from RL post-training: inference systems are approaching million-token contexts, while post-training workloads often remain at 256K tokens or below and rely on length generalization at deployment. The gap is especially important for AI agents, whose observations, tool outputs, documents, and prior decisions accumulate over long trajectories. LongStraw is an architecture-aware execution stack for million-token RL post-training under a fixed GPU budget, instantiated with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). It evaluates the shared prompt without autograd, retains only model-specific state needed by later tokens, and replays short response branches one at a time, reducing the live training graph at the cost of additional replay time. We implement it for the hybrid recurrent and full-attention Qwen3.6-27B and the compressed-attention mixture-of-experts GLM-5.2. On eight H20 GPUs, LongStraw completes grouped Qwen scoring and response backward at 2.1M positions for groups of 2 and 8; increasing the group size adds only 0.21 GB of peak allocated memory, while a separate stress test reaches 4.46M positions. On 32 H20 GPUs, we validate the end-to-end LongStraw execution path for a 2.1M-token prompt across all 78 layers of GLM-5.2. These experiments establish execution capacity rather than complete training correctness because the captured prompt state is detached and some distributed forward and gradient composition paths remain incomplete.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongStraw，一个面向固定 GPU 预算下百万 token 规模 RL 后训练的架构感知执行栈，基于 GRPO。通过共享 prompt 无梯度计算、仅保留后续 token 所需模型状态、以及逐次回放短响应分支，减少实时训练图大小。在 Qwen3.6-27B 和 GLM-5.2 上实现分组评分和响应反向传播达 2.1M 位置，组大小增加仅额外 0.21 GB 峰值内存，压力测试达 4.46M 位置。但在 32 GPU 上仅验证执行路径，未完成完整训练正确性。
Motivation: 推理上下文长度与 RL 后训练之间的差距日益增大：推理系统已接近百万 token 上下文，而后训练通常停留在 256K 以下，依赖部署时的长度泛化。这对 AI agent 尤其重要，因其观测、工具输出、文档和先前决策在长轨迹中累积。
Method: 提出架构感知执行栈 LongStraw，实例化为 GRPO。方法包括：共享 prompt 无梯度计算、仅保留后续 token 所需模型特定状态、以及逐次重放短响应分支（每次一个），以牺牲重放时间换取降低实时训练图大小。在混合循环与全注意力 Qwen3.6-27B 和压缩注意力 MoE GLM-5.2 上实现。
Result: 在 8 块 H20 GPU 上，分组 Qwen 评分和响应反向传播达 2.1M 位置（组大小 2 和 8）；增加组大小仅额外 0.21 GB 峰值内存；压力测试达 4.46M 位置。在 32 块 H20 GPU 上，验证了 2.1M token prompt 跨 GLM-5.2 所有 78 层的端到端执行路径。
Conclusion: 实验证明了执行容量而非完整训练正确性，因为捕获的 prompt 状态被分离，且部分分布式前向和梯度组合路径仍不完整。

papers.title: Optimal Self-Distillation for Rectified Flow via Linear Probing
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative models are increasingly trained using model-generated signals, creating both opportunities for self-improvement and risks of collapse. We study optimal self-distillation (SD) for rectified flow (RF): given a suboptimal teacher velocity field, can a student trained on a mixture of true RF velocities and teacher velocities provably improve the teacher? For linear RF with ridge regularization on fixed interpolation pairs, we prove an exact affine path identity, derive the optimal mixing coefficient in closed form, and show strict improvement in integrated velocity risk whenever the teacher risk is nonstationary along the regularization path. The optimal coefficient obeys a sign rule: positive mixing corrects under-regularized teachers, while negative mixing corrects over-regularized teachers. We also give one-shot generalized cross-validation (GCV) and validation tuning procedure that avoids grid search over mixing weights and repeated refitting. Combining this theorem with RF Wasserstein convergence bounds, we show that optimal self-distillation improves the velocity estimation terms controlling continuous-time and finite-step generation error. Experiments with Gaussian models, Gaussian mixtures, and image data show that optimal self-distillation improves velocity risk, mode recovery, and finite-step generation relative to both the teacher and pure distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究修正流（rectified flow）中的最优自蒸馏（self-distillation）。对于线性修正流，作者证明了精确的仿射路径恒等式，推导出最优混合系数的闭式解，并证明当教师风险沿正则化路径非平稳时，学生可以严格改进教师。最优系数服从符号规则：正混合纠正欠正则化教师，负混合纠正过正则化教师。还提出了避免网格搜索的一次性GCV和验证调优程序。结合Wasserstein收敛界，证明最优自蒸馏改进了控制连续时间和有限步生成误差的速度估计项。
Motivation: 现代生成模型越来越多地使用模型生成的信号进行训练，这既带来了自我改进的机会，也带来了崩溃的风险。研究在修正流框架下，能否通过自蒸馏从次优教师中学习到更好的学生模型，并给出理论保证。
Method: 提出最优自蒸馏框架：学生在线性修正流上训练，损失函数混合真实修正流速度和教师速度，并引入岭正则化。推导了最优混合系数的解析表达式，并给出了无需网格搜索的一次性广义交叉验证（GCV）和验证调优方法。
Result: 证明了当教师风险沿正则化路径非平稳时，学生可严格改进教师的风险；最优系数满足符号规则。在高斯模型、高斯混合模型和图像数据上，最优自蒸馏改进了速度风险、模式恢复能力和有限步生成质量。
Conclusion: 作者指出，对于线性修正流，最优自蒸馏可以理论保证地改进次优教师，并提供了实用的调优方法。实验验证了理论的有效性。

papers.title: DINE: Distance Is Not Enough -- Learning Global Deformation Priors for Robust Soft-Tissue Point Cloud Registration
papers.abstract_en: Non-rigid point cloud registration is central to soft-tissue shape analysis, but large deformations, noise, and outliers make correspondence estimation challenging. Most learning-based methods rely on local objectives such as Chamfer distance, which encourage point-wise proximity but do not constrain the global plausibility of the predicted deformation field. We address this limitation with DINE, a maximum a posteriori framework that augments distance-based registration with a learned statistical prior over displacement vector fields. DINE is applied to two registration backbones, Robust-DefReg and DefTransNet, using a two-stage strategy: a first-stage model is trained with Chamfer distance, its predicted deformation fields are used to estimate a prior, and the model is then refined with a combined distance and negative log-prior objective. We compare a full-field PCA Gaussian prior with a per-vector normalizing-flow prior. Experiments on DeformedTissue and SynBench show lower mean Chamfer distance under deformation and corruption. On DeformedTissue, DINE-PCA reduces Chamfer distance by approximately 27--69\% relative to the corresponding Stage-1 backbone across deformation levels, and improves robustness by up to 66\% for outliers and 83\% for Gaussian noise. On SynBench, improvements are modest at the smallest deformation levels and reach approximately 59--79\% from moderate to severe deformation. These results suggest that global deformation plausibility is an important constraint for reliable soft-tissue point cloud registration. (The code will be published soon.)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DINE 框架，用于软组织点云的非刚性配准。该框架基于最大后验估计，在距离损失（如 Chamfer 距离）基础上引入位移向量场的全局统计先验，以约束变形场的全局合理性。在 DeformedTissue 和 SynBench 数据集上，DINE 将 Chamfer 距离降低了约 27-69%，并对噪声和离群点的鲁棒性提升了 66-83%。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的非刚性配准方法主要依赖局部距离目标（如 Chamfer 距离），只关注点云间的局部接近性，而未对变形场的全局合理性施加约束，导致在大变形、噪声和离群点下配准不稳定。
Method: 提出两阶段训练策略：第一阶段用 Chamfer 距离训练基础配准网络（Robust-DefReg 或 DefTransNet），收集预测的变形场；第二阶段利用这些变形场估计全局先验（全字段 PCA 高斯先验或逐向量归一化流先验），然后用距离和负对数先验的联合目标精调网络。
Result: 在 DeformedTissue 数据集上，DINE-PCA 相对于基础网络将 Chamfer 距离降低约 27-69%，对离群点的鲁棒性提升 66%，对高斯噪声的鲁棒性提升 83%。在 SynBench 上，最小变形下改进较小，中等到严重变形下改进约 59-79%。
Conclusion: 全局变形先验是可靠软组织点云配准中的重要约束，引入先验可显著提升配准精度和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Introspective Attention Modulation for Safe Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art flow based text-to-image (T2I) models exhibit remarkable generative abilities but remain vulnerable to producing unsafe content. Prior safety efforts range from concept erasure and prompt filtering to classifier-based gating. However, simple techniques like parameter efficient adaptations of the models easily bypass such guardrails. We introduce a unique principled approach that achieves safety by regulating the model's attention dynamics through inference-time introspection, exhibiting intrinsic robustness. Our method analyzes and rebalances attention activations throughout image synthesis, steering generations away from unsafe concepts while preserving semantic alignment. This introspective control ensures safety of deployed models. Across standard and adversarial safety benchmarks, our approach achieves remarkable safety scores while maintaining or even improving alignment and perceptual quality. Our results reveal that attention-space regulation offers a considerably more promising path to safer diffusion transformer based image generation than the existing concept erasing mechanism.Our code can be accessed at https://basim-azam.github.io/iam/
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 20 pages, 7 figures. Project page: https://basim-azam.github.io/iam/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像生成模型生成不安全内容的问题，提出一种内省注意力调节方法，通过推理时调节注意力动态来避免生成不安全概念，同时保持语义对齐。在标准和对抗性安全基准上，该方法显著提升安全性，并保持甚至改善生成质量和对齐度。
Motivation: 现有基于流的最先进文本到图像模型容易生成不安全内容，而简单的防护措施（如概念擦除、提示过滤）容易被参数高效微调绕过。
Method: 提出一种基于推理时内省（introspection）的方法，通过分析和重新平衡注意力激活（attention activations）来调控图像合成过程，使生成远离不安全概念。
Result: 在标准与对抗性安全基准上达到极高的安全分数，同时保持或改善了语义对齐和感知质量，且比现有概念擦除机制更有效。
Conclusion: 注意力空间调节为扩散变压器（diffusion transformer）的文本到图像安全生成提供了比概念擦除更有前景的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Steering Robustness into World Action Models via Mechanistic Interpretability and Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) enable semantically- and physically-informed control but are brittle under distribution shift. In this work, we use mechanistic interpretability to study how robustness-relevant perturbations are represented in WAM activation space. Comparing activations across successful and unsuccessful rollouts, we find some WAM architectures exhibit low-dimensional linear separability for robustness-critical features, while others do not. This motivates the use of contrastive activation directions for training-free WAM steering. We also show that local linearity in WAM activation dynamics enables efficient feedback steering via model-based optimal control, yielding World-Action Linear Quadratic Regulator (WA-LQR), a minimally-invasive reduced-order LQR controller. Via mechanistic evaluations, we predict strong steerability in the Cosmos-Policy and DiT4DiT models but weak steerability in LingBot-VA, consistent with steering intervention results. On Cosmos-Policy and DiT4DiT, WA-LQR generalizes contrastive directions to new tasks and improves robustness to camera, gripper, and visual-noise perturbations over unsteered and prompt steering baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过机制可解释性分析世界行动模型（WAM）在分布偏移下的鲁棒性问题，发现部分架构的激活空间对鲁棒性相关特征呈现低维线性可分性，从而提出无训练的对比激活方向转向方法，并利用局部线性性质设计基于模型最优控制的WA-LQR控制器。实验表明，在Cosmos-Policy和DiT4DiT模型上该方法有效提升对相机、夹爪和视觉噪声扰动的鲁棒性，但在LingBot-VA模型上转向效果较弱。
Motivation: 世界行动模型（WAM）在分布偏移下鲁棒性不足，现有方法缺乏对内部表征的理解和有效的无训练干预手段。
Method: 利用机制可解释性比较成功与失败轨迹的激活差异，识别低维线性可分方向；基于此提出对比激活方向作为无训练转向向量，并利用激活动力学的局部线性性导出世界行动线性二次型调节器（WA-LQR），一种最小侵入性的降阶LQR控制器。
Result: 通过机制评估预测Cosmos-Policy和DiT4DiT具有强可转向性，LingBot-VA弱可转向性，与后续转向干预结果一致。WA-LQR在Cosmos-Policy和DiT4DiT上泛化对比方向至新任务，并在相机、夹爪和视觉噪声扰动下优于无转向和提示转向基线。
Conclusion: 本文展示了机制可解释性可指导世界行动模型的鲁棒性增强，但可转向性因模型架构而异，未来需探索更通用的方法。

papers.title: Frequency-Structured Field Learning for Light-Field Disparity Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Light-field disparity estimation requires global consistency in smooth or textureless regions and local precision near occlusion boundaries, thin structures, and abrupt depth transitions. Existing methods address these requirements through EPI matching, cost-volume or focal-stack construction, view aggregation, or direct convolutional regression, often relying on local windows, discrete disparity hypotheses, memory-intensive volumes, or attention-based aggregation. We instead formulate disparity estimation at the field level, predicting disparity from globally and locally updated EPI-derived latent features without explicitly constructing a disparity volume. We introduce FreqLF, an EPI-guided Fourier-local framework that encodes angular parallax cues from horizontal and vertical EPI stacks together with central-view appearance features. These cues are projected into a latent field and updated through stacked hybrid Fourier-local layers. Fourier low-mode updates enable global feature interaction, while local convolutions preserve spatial variations needed for fine disparity detail. A coordinate-conditioned Gaussian-mixture decoder then predicts disparity, using the mixture mean as the final estimate. Experiments on the HCI 4D Light Field Benchmark show that FreqLF approaches the accuracy of strong supervised baselines while avoiding explicit cost-volume construction in the base model. Ablations confirm the complementary roles of the Fourier and local branches, and scaling experiments demonstrate practical behavior across spatial resolutions. These results suggest that Fourier-local latent field learning is a competitive alternative for light-field disparity estimation. The code will be published soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FreqLF，一种基于 EPI 引导的傅里叶-局部框架，用于光场视差估计。该方法从水平和垂直 EPI 堆栈提取角度视差线索，结合中心视图外观特征，投影到潜在场并通过混合傅里叶-局部层更新，最后用坐标条件的高斯混合解码器预测视差。在 HCI 4D 光场基准上，FreqLF 接近强监督基线的准确性，且避免了显式成本体积构建。
Motivation: 现有光场视差估计方法依赖局部窗口、离散视差假设、内存密集型体积或注意力聚合，难以同时实现全局一致性和局部精度。
Method: 提出 FreqLF，首先从水平和垂直 EPI 堆栈提取角度视差线索并编码为潜在场，然后通过堆叠的混合傅里叶-局部层更新特征：傅里叶低模更新实现全局交互，局部卷积保留空间细节。最后使用坐标条件的高斯混合解码器预测视差，以混合均值作为最终估计。
Result: 在 HCI 4D 光场基准上，FreqLF 接近强监督基线的准确性，且避免了显式成本体积构建。消融实验证实傅里叶和局部分支的互补作用，缩放实验表明对不同空间分辨率的适用性。
Conclusion: 傅里叶-局部潜在场学习是光场视差估计的一种有竞争力的替代方案，无需离散视差假设或内存密集型体积。

papers.title: Causal Inference for Sequential Settings under Interference and Latent Confounding
papers.abstract_en: We study causal inference under outcome interference for sequential, observational settings. Specifically, we consider settings where the binary outcomes over N units are Markovian across T time steps. At each time step, the outcomes of N units have dependencies captured through an Ising model; each outcome is also impacted through an external field capturing the effects of its treatment as well as latent confounders. Similar to panel data literature, these latent confounders are modeled to have a low-rank factor structure. Our data is a single sample from this high-dimensional distribution. To estimate causal quantities of interest, we provide a computationally efficient method based on Maximum Pseudo-Likelihood Estimation (MPLE) for learning the model parameters. Under mild assumptions, we establish non-asymptotic consistency for parameter estimation and show this translates to faithful estimation of causal quantities of interest after sampling from the learned model. We demonstrate the efficacy of the method through synthetic experiments as well as a real-world case-study investigating causal effects of vaccine rates on COVID-19 death rates within US counties nationwide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究序列观测数据下的因果推断问题，考虑N个单位在T个时间步上的二元结果具有马尔可夫性，并通过Ising模型捕获单位间的依赖，同时受处理效应和潜在混杂因素影响。潜在混杂因素被假设为低秩因子结构。作者提出基于最大伪似然估计（MPLE）的高效学习算法，在温和假设下证明了参数估计的非渐近一致性，并表明从学习模型采样后，因果量的估计也是可靠的。通过合成实验和美国县级新冠疫苗率对死亡率的因果效应案例验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 在序列观测设置中，结果干扰（outcome interference）和潜在混杂（latent confounding）并存时，现有因果推断方法难以处理，尤其是在跨时间步的依赖下。
Method: 将序列二元结果建模为时变Ising模型，并通过低秩因子结构刻画潜在混杂；采用最大伪似然估计（MPLE）进行参数学习，并基于学习模型采样来估计因果量。
Result: 在温和假设下，参数估计达到非渐近一致性，因果估计量可靠；合成实验和新冠疫苗率案例验证了方法有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提出的MPLE框架能够有效处理具有干扰和混杂的序列因果推断问题，但方法依赖于Ising模型和低秩假设，可能对非线性依赖有限制。

papers.title: A Minimal Interpretable Architecture for Zero-Shot Reconstruction of Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recent foundation models (FMs) for zero-shot reconstruction of dynamical systems (DS) achieve strong out-of-domain generalization but provide little insight into the mechanisms that underlie their forecasts. Such an understanding could help to strip down overladen FM architectures to their bare essence and expose the minimal requirements for in-context learning in the DS domain. Toward this goal, here we iteratively reduce a recent powerful SOTA model for DS reconstruction, DynaMix (Hemmer & Durstewitz, 2025), to a minimal interpretable two-parameter form, which we call DynaBase. DynaBase produces forecasts through a linear blend of the current latent state and the nearest in-context neighbor and its temporal successor. Surprisingly, despite its extreme simplicity, DynaBase produces highly competitive zero-shot DS reconstructions across chaotic and cyclic systems, with a negligible parameter load, many orders of magnitude below that of other FMs. Even more, this extreme simplicity permits direct model optimization on DS reconstruction measures, as well as closed-form one-step analytical solutions on prediction MSE. Theoretical and empirical analysis of DynaBase further leads to a 1-parameter family of maps, with the context-parroting algorithm of (Zhang & Gilpin, 2026) recovered at one end, and chaotic (divergent but bounded) behavior at the other. We further show how different training strategies lead to models either optimal for short-term prediction or for DS reconstruction. Thus, DynaBase not only exposes the minimal mechanisms required for producing zero-shot DS reconstruction, but also reconciles within an accessible mathematical frame divergent observations in the literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过逐步简化现有的SOTA动力系统重建模型DynaMix，提出了一个极简的可解释双参数架构DynaBase。DynaBase通过当前潜在状态与最近上下文邻居及其时间后继的线性混合进行预测。尽管极度简单，它在混沌和周期系统的零样本重建上表现出色，参数负载远低于其他基础模型。理论分析进一步导出了一个单参数映射族，连接了上下文模仿算法和混沌行为。
Motivation: 现有动力系统重建的基础模型虽然泛化能力强，但机制不透明。理解其核心机制有助于剥离冗余架构，揭示该领域上下文学习的最小需求。
Method: 迭代简化DynaMix模型，提出DynaBase：仅含两个自由参数，通过线性组合当前状态和最近上下文邻居及其后继进行预测。支持直接优化重建指标，并存在关于预测MSE的闭式单步解析解。
Result: 在混沌和周期系统的零样本重建上，DynaBase取得了与DynaMix等复杂模型竞争的精度，但参数数量减少了多个数量级。训练策略不同会导致模型分别优化短期预测或动力系统重建。
Conclusion: DynaBase揭示了零样本动力系统重建所需的最小机制，并在一个可理解的数学框架内调和了文献中的不同观察结果。

papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video understanding have spanned motion, long video, and streaming interaction, driving this field toward real-world applications. Despite this progress, current open-source models remain limited in several ways. They often struggle to generalize across diverse video types, making them effective only in specific domains. High computational demands further restrict their efficiency and scalability. Moreover, most models are only partially open, with key components such as training code, strategy, or datasets unavailable, which hinders reproducibility and slows community-driven development. To address these issues, we introduce VideoChat3, a fully open, efficient, and generalist video-centric MLLM. VideoChat3 advances video understanding through two complementary designs. For efficiency, we introduce Inflated 3D Vision Transformer (I3D-ViT) and Adaptive Frame Resolution for Streaming Video Perception, which enables efficient spatiotemporal representation and reduces the cost of processing video inputs during training and inference. For effectiveness, we develop a scalable video data synthesis pipeline that curates three diverse, high-quality training datasets: VideoChat3-Academic2M, VideoChat3-LV116K, and VideoChat3-OL617K, covering general, long-form, and streaming video scenarios, improving the model's generalization across domains. By integrating these designs, VideoChat3 achieves a rare balance of broad generalization and computational efficiency. Experiments across general, long-form, and streaming benchmarks demonstrate that VideoChat3 surpasses prior open-source models with equal or larger parameter counts with only 4B parameters and higher efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoChat3 是一个全开源、高效且通用的视频多模态大模型（MLLM），旨在提升视频理解在多种场景下的泛化能力和计算效率。模型引入膨胀3D视觉Transformer（I3D-ViT）和自适应帧率流式视频感知以降低计算成本，并构建了三个高质量训练数据集（Academic2M、LV116K、OL617K）覆盖通用、长视频和流式场景。在多个基准上，仅4B参数的VideoChat3超越了同等或更大参数量的开源模型。
Motivation: 现有开源视频模型在泛化能力、计算效率方面存在局限，且大多仅部分开源（缺少训练代码、策略或数据集），阻碍了可复现性和社区发展。
Method: 提出两个互补设计：1）效率方面，使用膨胀3D视觉Transformer（I3D-ViT）和自适应帧率流式视频感知，减少视频输入处理成本；2）效果方面，开发可扩展的视频数据合成管道，构建三个高质量训练数据集（Academic2M、LV116K、OL617K），提升模型跨域泛化能力。
Result: 在通用、长视频和流式视频基准上，仅4B参数的VideoChat3超越了同等或更大参数量的开源模型，实现了更广泛化与更高效率的平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调VideoChat3通过全开源、高效架构和多样化数据集，在视频理解领域实现了罕见的泛化-效率平衡，但未提及在特定下游任务（如天气预测）上的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Still image and spatial-temporal tomato data enabling detection, segmentation, tracking, and video-instance segmentation using strong and weak labels
papers.abstract_en: In this manuscript we release two datasets for visual sensing of tomato plants grown in commercial-like settings and acquired using a robot. The first is BUTom21 which consists of still images and manual annotations. The second is BUTom-ST21 which consists of video-based data and semi-automated annotations through AI-based methods, referred to as pseudo-labels. In both cases, we provide pixel-level labels for the ripeness of the fruit. The aim is to provide the research community a challenging set of real-world imagery to explore methods to sense and estimate the state of tomato plants and their fruit, which is an important horticultural crop. Importantly, the spatial-temporal dataset provides individual fruit count and ripeness information enabling researchers to push the boundaries of field-based phenotyping.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Two novel datasets released - link to repository in document
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布两个番茄植株视觉数据集：BUTom21（静态图像+人工标注）和BUTom-ST21（视频数据+基于AI的半自动标注），提供像素级果实成熟度标签，旨在推动田间表型研究。
Motivation: 现有番茄植株数据集缺乏真实场景下的多模态标注，尤其是时空数据，限制了视觉感知和表型分析的研究。
Method: 发布两个数据集：BUTom21为静态图像与手动像素级标注；BUTom-ST21为视频数据，使用AI方法生成伪标签，两者均包含果实成熟度信息。
Result: 数据集提供个体果实计数和成熟度信息，可用于检测、分割、跟踪和视频实例分割等任务。
Conclusion: 该数据集为番茄植株的田间表型研究提供了具有挑战性的真实世界图像资源，有助于推动视觉感知方法的发展。

papers.title: Benchmarking Face Recognition without Real Faces
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic face datasets have become effective enough to train face recognition models with accuracy rivaling that of models trained on real photographs. This progress sidesteps the ethical and legal burdens of collecting real biometric data, yet evaluation has not kept pace. Even studies that train entirely on synthetic images still rely on real-face benchmarks to measure performance, leaving the privacy problem only half solved. We ask whether synthetic datasets can replace real benchmarks for face recognition evaluation. We test 12 synthetic datasets against 7 established real benchmarks using 24 pre-trained models that span both convolutional and transformer architectures. Our evaluation covers biometric verification metrics, similarity score distributions, cross-model ranking consistency, and the underlying distributional properties of each dataset. Benchmarking fidelity varies widely across the synthetic candidates, but the two strongest, MorphFace and Vec2Face, reproduce the relative behavior of real benchmarks and reach agreement levels that fall within the natural disagreement already observed among the real benchmarks themselves. These results establish that well-constructed synthetic datasets can support reliable comparative evaluation for face recognition, moving the field closer to a fully synthetic and privacy-preserving pipeline for both training and benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成人脸数据集能否替代真实基准用于人脸识别评估。测试了12个合成数据集和7个真实基准，使用24个预训练模型，发现两个最强合成数据集（MorphFace和Vec2Face）能复现真实基准的相对行为，其一致性水平落在真实基准之间的自然差异范围内。结论是良好构建的合成数据集可以支持可靠的人脸识别比较评估。
Motivation: 人脸识别训练已能使用合成数据避免隐私问题，但评估仍依赖真实基准，隐私问题未完全解决。需要验证合成数据集能否替代真实基准进行可靠评估。
Method: 系统评估：对12个合成数据集和7个真实基准，使用24个预训练模型（含卷积和Transformer架构），从生物识别验证指标、相似度分数分布、跨模型排序一致性、数据集分布特性等角度比较。
Result: 合成数据集的基准保真度差异大，但最强的MorphFace和Vec2Face能复现真实基准的相对行为，且一致性水平落在真实基准之间已有的自然差异内。
Conclusion: 良好构建的合成数据集可支持可靠的人脸识别比较评估，推动训练和评估的全合成隐私保护流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TanGO: Training-Free 3D Editing via Tangent-Space Guidance and Optimization
papers.abstract_en: While recent flow-matching 3D generative models (e.g., VecSet) adopt structured representations, their tokens share global context, causing conventional training-free editing to suffer from semantic artifacts such as collapsed preserved regions or incomplete transformations. To address this, we propose TanGO, a training-free framework that enables adaptive per-token steering in the tangent space of generative dynamics. To realize this selective control, we formulate a one-step optimal control rule and determine the strength of each token's control signal using a von Mises-Fisher inspired directional discrepancy derived from the source and target velocity fields. Experiments show that TanGO substantially reduces structural artifacts and achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing 3D editing baselines. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/siw00-lim/TanGO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TanGO，一个无需训练的3D编辑框架，通过在生成动态的切线空间中对每个token进行自适应引导，解决了现有flow-matching 3D模型编辑时的语义伪影问题。摘要报告在性能上超越现有基线。
Motivation: 现有free-form 3D编辑在flow-matching生成模型中因token共享全局上下文而导致编辑区域坍塌或转换不完全，产生语义伪影。
Method: 提出TanGO框架，在生成过程的切线空间中实现逐token控制。通过单步最优控制规则和von Mises-Fisher方向差异确定每个token的引导强度。
Result: 实验显示TanGO显著减少结构伪影，并在3D编辑任务上达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: TanGO通过切线空间引导实现了无需训练的精确3D编辑，代码已开源。

papers.title: Random Logit Scaling: Defending Deep Neural Networks Against Black-Box Score-Based Adversarial Example Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are increasingly adapted in various domains. However, adversarial examples pose a significant threat to the reliable deployment of these models. In recent years, some powerful adversarial example attacks have been proposed for the fast and query-efficient generation of adversarial examples, even in black-box scenarios, highlighting the need for scalable, low-cost, and powerful defenses. In this work, we present two contributions to the domain of black-box adversarial example attacks and defenses. First, we propose Random Logit Scaling (RLS), a randomization-based defense against black-box score-based adversarial example attacks. RLS is a plug-and-play, post-processing defense that can be implemented on top of any existing ML model with minimal effort. The idea behind RLS is to confuse an attacker by outputting falsified scores resulting from randomly scaled logits while maintaining the model accuracy. We show that RLS significantly reduces the success rate of state-of-the-art black-box score-based attacks while preserving the accuracy and minimizing confidence score distortion compared to state-of-the-art randomization-based defenses. Second, we introduce a novel adaptive attack against AAA, a SOTA non-randomized black-box defense against black-box score-based attacks that also modifies output logits to confuse attackers, demonstrating its vulnerability against adaptive attacks.

TL;DR: 本文提出随机对数缩放（RLS），一种基于随机化的后处理防御方法，针对黑盒基于分数的对抗样本攻击。RLS通过随机缩放输出logits来混淆攻击者，同时保持模型精度。实验表明RLS显著降低最先进黑盒分数攻击的成功率，并相比其他随机化防御最小化置信度失真。此外，本文还提出一种针对现有非随机化防御AAA的自适应攻击，揭示其脆弱性。
Motivation: 对抗样本严重威胁机器学习模型的可靠部署，尤其在黑盒场景下需要低成本、可扩展的防御方法。现有随机化防御存在置信度失真或精度损失的问题。
Method: 提出Random Logit Scaling (RLS)，一种即插即用的后处理防御：在推理阶段对模型logits进行随机缩放，输出扭曲的分数以迷惑攻击者，同时保持原始分类结果。
Result: RLS显著降低最先进黑盒分数攻击的成功率，保持模型精度，且置信度失真低于其他随机化防御。自适应攻击实验显示非随机化防御AAA易被攻破。
Conclusion: RLS是一种简单有效的黑盒防御，但需注意自适应攻击可能削弱其效果；未来工作需探索更强的随机化策略。

papers.title: Show Me How You Reason and I'll Tell You Who You Are: Reasoning Graphs for Robust LLM Authorship Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Given the current trend to employ large language models (LLMs) in almost any imaginable context, LLM-generated text detection and authorship attribution have become a pressing issue. Prior work has primarily focused on surface-level linguistic features, an approach shown to be susceptible to paraphrasing and other obfuscation techniques. In this paper, we go beyond the linguistic surface, extracting and analysing reasoning structures in LLM-generated texts with the goal of capturing more complex signals of LLM authorship. We propose a graph neural network approach that leverages reasoning graphs extracted by an argument mining pipeline, demonstrating improved robustness and generalisation over a traditional Longformer baseline. Our approach outperforms the baseline by up to 27 percentage points under the obfuscation attacks such as paraphrasing and backtranslation, and 19 percentage points when evaluated on the texts generated by the unseen model versions, simulating real-world conditions in which new LLM versions are continuously released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于推理图（reasoning graphs）的图神经网络方法，用于大语言模型（LLM）生成文本的作者归属检测。该方法超越传统基于表面语言特征的方法，在 paraphrasing 和 backtranslation 等混淆攻击下比 Longformer 基线提升高达27个百分点，并在未见过的模型版本上提升19个百分点。
Motivation: 现有LLM文本检测方法主要依赖表面语言特征，易受 paraphrasing 等混淆技术影响。本文旨在通过捕捉文本中的推理结构来获得更鲁棒的作者归属信号。
Method: 从LLM生成文本中利用论证挖掘流水线提取推理图，再使用图神经网络（GNN）进行分类识别。
Result: 在 paraphrasing 和 backtranslation 混淆攻击下，方法比 Longformer 基线提升27个百分点；在未见过的模型版本上提升19个百分点。
Conclusion: 推理图能够更有效地捕获LLM作者痕迹，具有更好的鲁棒性和泛化能力，适用于新版本LLM持续发布的现实场景。

papers.title: FlashDecoder: Real-Time Latent-to-Pixel Streaming Decoder with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video generation demands fast decoding as much as fast denoising, yet current latent video diffusion models rely on 3D convolutional decoders that are slow and memory-intensive at high resolutions or for long video. We introduce FlashDecoder, a fast, memory-efficient pure-Transformer video decoder that decodes latents to pixels frame by frame. At each step, the current frame attends only to a fixed-size window of past frames through a rolling KV cache. The fixed temporal window keeps decoding fast and memory bounded regardless of video length, enabling constant-latency streaming. Because frames are processed sequentially, temporal causality is enforced without explicit attention masks, enabling training at resolutions up to 1080p and matching the reconstruction quality of convolutional decoders. On the Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 latent spaces, FlashDecoder matches each convolutional decoder in reconstruction quality (e.g., 41.55dB vs. 41.49dB PSNR at 1080p) while decoding 3.6x-4.7x faster with up to 11x less memory on a single H100 GPU. With architecture-aware inference optimizations, the speedup widens to 12x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlashDecoder，一种纯 Transformer 的视频解码器，用于将潜在表示逐帧解码为像素。通过固定大小的滚动 KV 缓存实现时间因果性和恒定延迟流式处理，在 Wan2.1 和 Wan2.2 潜在空间上达到与卷积解码器相当的重建质量（1080p 下 PSNR 41.55dB vs 41.49dB），解码速度提升 3.6-4.7 倍，内存减少最多 11 倍，架构优化后速度提升可达 12 倍。
Motivation: 现有潜在视频扩散模型使用 3D 卷积解码器，在高分辨率或长视频时速度慢且内存占用大，难以满足实时视频生成需求。
Method: 采用纯 Transformer 架构，逐帧解码，每帧仅通过滚动 KV 缓存关注固定大小的历史窗口，从而保持解码时间和内存与视频长度无关，并自然实现时间因果性。
Result: 在单块 H100 GPU 上，与卷积解码器相比，PSNR 相当（1080p 下 41.55dB vs 41.49dB），解码速度提升 3.6-4.7 倍，内存减少最多 11 倍；结合架构感知优化后速度提升达 12 倍。
Conclusion: FlashDecoder 是一种高效、内存友好的视频解码方案，适用于实时流式生成，但仅在特定潜在空间和分辨率上验证，泛化性待进一步研究。

papers.title: Selectivity Drives Efficiency: Dataset Pruning for Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recent visual place recognition (VPR) studies have increasingly relied on large-scale datasets to train more robust and discriminative models. Although this trend significantly improves recognition performance, it also introduces substantial storage and training costs, especially when new architectures or training strategies need to be repeatedly developed and evaluated. Dataset pruning (DP) provides a promising way to improve data efficiency by retaining only informative training data. However, conventional DP methods mainly follow the sample-wise classification paradigm, which overlooks the relation-dependent training nature of VPR, where supervision is typically formed by image pairs rather than independent images. To address this issue, we propose a place-wise dataset pruning framework tailored for VPR. Instead of pruning individual images, our method treats each place as the basic pruning unit and introduces two complementary novel metrics, i.e., intra-place diversity (IPD) and inter-place similarity (IPS), to evaluate the training value of each place. By jointly considering these two metrics, our method ranks all places and constructs a compact yet informative coreset, thereby allowing the pruned dataset to still support the training of robust and discriminative VPR models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art DP baselines under different pruning ratios while reducing selection and training costs. Moreover, by pruning a merged dataset roughly 3.5$\times$ the size of GSV-Cities to a comparable scale, our coreset maintains highly competitive performance, achieving 94.5\% R@1 on MSLS-val and 97.0\% R@1 on Nordland with only NetVLAD. Codes will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对视觉地点识别（VPR）的数据集剪枝框架，以地点为基本剪枝单元，引入内部地点多样性（IPD）和地点间相似性（IPS）两个指标来评估每个地点的训练价值，从而构建紧凑而信息丰富的核心集。实验表明，该方法在不同剪枝比例下均优于现有数据集剪枝方法，并且能在缩减数据集规模的同时保持模型性能。
Motivation: 现有VPR模型依赖大规模数据集，导致存储和训练成本高，而传统数据集剪枝方法基于样本分类，忽略了VPR中关系依赖的训练特性（图像对监督）。
Method: 提出地点级数据集剪枝框架，以地点（place）为基本单元，提出内部地点多样性（IPD）和地点间相似性（IPS）两个互补指标，联合评估每个地点的训练价值，据此对地点排序并构建核心集。
Result: 在不同剪枝比例下一致优于现有剪枝基线，并降低了选择和训练成本。在合并数据集（约3.5倍GSV-Cities规模）上剪枝到可比规模后，仅用NetVLAD在MSLS-val上达到94.5% R@1，Nordland上97.0% R@1。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有效提升了VPR数据效率，且性能具有竞争力，代码将公开。

papers.title: StructureClaw: Traceable LLM Agents and an Executable Benchmark for Structural Engineering Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Addressing a structural-engineering request requires more than a single answer; it requires a chain of interdependent artifacts: interpreted requirements, a computable model, validation records, solver outputs, code-check records, and a final report. Evaluations centered on question answering or script generation rarely verify this complete evidence chain and may therefore reward fluent outputs even when the underlying engineering workflow is incomplete, internally inconsistent, or non-executable. To address this limitation, we present StructureClaw, an artifact-centered workbench in which LLM agents operate through governed engineering skills, typed tools, shared artifact state, and local analysis backends. We also introduce StructureClaw-Bench, an executable benchmark of 150 controlled scenarios spanning standard workflow execution, interactive robustness, and multimodal structural-model reconstruction. A scenario succeeds only when all required artifact- and execution-level assertions pass in a single run. Across ten agent-model configurations, each evaluated on the same 50 standard cases, the average Success Rate rises from 56.8% with the generic-skill baseline to 88.6% with the full automatic workflow. The interactive and multimodal evaluations identify two prominent remaining challenges: safe handling of invalid numerical inputs and fixture-consistent reconstruction of structural models. These findings show that artifact-centered evaluation can expose workflow-level failures that are difficult to identify from final responses alone, providing a more rigorous basis for evaluating and improving structural-engineering agents. The code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/structureclaw/structureclaw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StructureClaw，一个以工件为中心的结构工程代理工作台，以及包含150个可控场景的可执行基准 StructureClaw-Bench。基准要求一次性通过所有工件和执行级断言。在10种代理模型配置上，平均成功率从通用技能基线的56.8%提升到全自动工作流的88.6%。交互式和多模态评估揭示了处理无效数值输入和结构模型重建的一致性问题。
Motivation: 现有评估多基于问答或脚本生成，无法验证结构工程工作流中完整的证据链（如解释、模型、验证记录等），可能奖励流畅但不可执行的输出。
Method: 提出工件中心的工作台 StructureClaw，包含受控的工程技能、类型化工具、共享工件状态和本地分析后端；配套构建150个可控场景的可执行基准，涵盖标准工作流、交互鲁棒性和多模态结构模型重建。
Result: 在50个标准案例上，平均成功率从通用技能基线的56.8%提升到全自动工作流的88.6%。交互式和多模态评估中，主要挑战是安全处理无效数值输入和保持结构模型的重建一致性。
Conclusion: 工件中心的评估能够暴露工作流级别的失败，为改进结构工程代理提供更严谨的基础。

papers.title: Leveraging Instruction Tuning and Merging for Reasoning Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models (RLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in domains such as mathematics and coding. These domains permit reliable verification of model outputs, which is important for enabling the reinforcement learning that drives RLM performance gains. However, training RLMs on domains that lack reliable verifiers remains challenging. Meanwhile, for both verifiable and unverifiable domains, large amounts of unused supervised fine-tuning data with human-written solutions exist. In this work, we show that these data can be used efficiently to further improve RLM performance. For this, we first use classic instruction tuning, supervised fine-tuning without reasoning traces, on the RLM. Next, we merge our instruction-tuned model with the original reasoning model, recovering its reasoning behavior on the target domain. Our extensive evaluation demonstrates that our technique improves RLM performance in both verifiable and hard-to-verify domains, including coding and text summarization, while preserving RLM capabilities across other domains. Importantly, our method is highly cost-effective, enabling such improvements for less than USD $3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用已有的监督微调数据（含人工编写的解决方案）进一步提升推理语言模型（RLM）的性能。作者先对RLM进行经典指令微调（无推理链），然后将微调后的模型与原始推理模型合并，以恢复目标领域上的推理行为。实验表明该方法在可验证领域（如编码）和难验证领域（如文本摘要）均能提升性能，且成本极低（低于3美元）。
Motivation: 推理语言模型在可验证领域（数学、编码）表现优异，但在缺乏可靠验证器的领域训练困难。同时，大量已有的监督微调数据（含人类编写的解决方案）未被充分利用。
Method: 先使用经典指令微调（无推理轨迹）对RLM进行微调，然后将微调后的模型与原始推理模型进行合并，从而恢复推理行为。
Result: 在编码和文本摘要等可验证与难验证领域上，该方法提升了RLM的性能，同时保持了其他领域的能力，且成本低于3美元。
Conclusion: 利用已有的监督微调数据并进行模型合并，可以有效且低成本地提升RLM在多种领域上的性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在编码和文本摘要等可验证与难验证领域上，该方法提升了RLM的性能，同时保持了其他领域的能力，且成本低于3美元。
summary_sections.conclusion: 利用已有的监督微调数据并进行模型合并，可以有效且低成本地提升RLM在多种领域上的性能。

papers.title: Domain Adaptation of Mismatched Proximal Denoiser for Plug-and-Play Image Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Plug-and-play proximal gradient descent (PnP-PGD) enables flexible image reconstruction by using denoisers as implicit priors. In practice, these denoisers are often deployed outside their training domains. Existing analyses establish convergence under structural assumptions on the deployed denoiser, such as requiring it to be a proximal map or a contraction. However, they do not measure how domain mismatch affects convergence of PnP-PGD. We define this effect as \emph{proximal mismatch}: the discrepancy between a deployed denoiser $\widehat{\mathsf D}$ and a target-domain reference map $\mathsf D_\star=\operatorname{prox}_{R_\star}$ associated with the underlying regularizer $R_\star$. Under this mismatch, each denoising update becomes an inexact proximal step for the target objective. We further derive a stationarity bound that decays at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/K)$, with an additive term proportional to the average squared proximal mismatch. This result motivates adaptation via proximal matching rather than MSE-based adaptation alone. We study this approach with two established denoiser families: learned proximal networks and gradient-step denoisers. Experiments on Gaussian deblurring and super-resolution under substantial domain shift show that proximal matching adaptation improves reconstruction quality significantly over MSE-based adaptation, yielding the largest numerical gains in the few-shot regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究plug-and-play近端梯度下降（PnP-PGD）中因去噪器与目标域不匹配导致的近端失配问题，提出通过近端匹配（proximal matching）进行域适应，并证明了收敛性。实验表明，在高斯去模糊和超分辨率任务中，近端匹配适应显著优于基于MSE的适应，尤其在少样本场景下提升最大。
Motivation: 现有多样性方法在去噪器部署域与训练域不匹配时缺乏收敛性分析，且仅依赖MSE适应无法有效缓解近端失配。
Method: 定义近端失配量，推导出PnP-PGD的驻点界为O(1/K)加上平均平方近端失配项，并据此提出通过近端匹配进行域适应，在两种去噪器家族（学习近端网络和梯度步去噪器）上验证。
Result: 在显著域偏移的高斯去模糊和超分辨率实验中，近端匹配适应的重建质量明显优于MSE适应，尤其在少样本场景下数值增益最大。
Conclusion: 近端匹配适应是处理PnP-PGD中去噪器域不匹配的有效策略，优于传统的MSE适应。

papers.title: Proof-or-Stop: Don't Trust the Agent, Trust the Evidence -- Loop Engineering for Verifiable Evidence-Gated Lifecycle Control
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous coding agents increasingly execute multi-step software work, but lifecycle states such as reviewed, tested, DONE, and ready-to-merge remain claims unless supported by current evidence. We present Proof-or-Stop Lifecycle Control, a method that permits lifecycle transitions only when fresh, tracked-source-state-bound, mechanically verifiable evidence satisfies the relevant gate. The method treats agent outputs as claims rather than lifecycle state, and uses proof operationally to mean gate-admissible evidence under a stated trust model, not semantic program correctness. We evaluate an open-source implementation through mechanism tests, a powered control-policy ablation, and operated self-application evidence. The unattended-loop engine passed 10 of 10 scenarios with zero false-DONE, and local-key receipt bundles rejected 18 tamper classes with zero false accepts. In a 9,240-cell ablation, the pre-registered A4 versus A2-prime comparison reduced visible-pass/hidden-fail amplification from 31 of 1,800 injected cells under a compute-budgeted naive loop to 2 of 1,800 under the gated loop, a 1.6 percentage-point improvement in not-amplified rate with a 95 percent confidence interval of [0.8, 2.5]. A near-compute A3 versus A4 comparison, 14 of 1,800 versus 2 of 1,800, indicates that the gain is associated with enforcing review as a lifecycle gate rather than merely adding a reviewer. The self-application corpus contains 565 stories and 1,007 review findings, with 94.8 percent resolved, plus a 68-row high/critical cross-vendor exhibit. These results support Proof-or-Stop as a model-agnostic, host-neutral control layer for deciding which autonomous-agent claims a lifecycle may act on. The evaluation is limited to one model family, 24 ablation tasks, and a self-hosted corpus.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 10 figures, 29 numbered tables. Preprint v1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Proof-or-Stop Lifecycle Control 方法，要求自主编码代理的生命周期状态转换必须基于当前可验证的证据，而非代理的输出声明。该方法通过门控证据机制防止虚假状态，并在实验中实现零误判的 DONE 状态和抵抗 18 种篡改攻击。消融实验表明，强制审查作为生命周期门显著降低了可见传递与隐藏失败的放大现象。
Motivation: 自主编码代理在多步骤软件工作中会产生生命周期状态声明（如已审查、已测试、完成），但这些声明缺乏可验证的证据支撑，可能导致错误的状态转换。
Method: 提出一种模型无关的控制层，将代理输出视为待验证的声明，仅当最新的、绑定到跟踪源状态的机械可验证证据满足门控条件时，才允许生命周期状态转换。证据采用操作意义上的“证明”，而非语义正确性。
Result: 在机制测试中，无监督循环通过全部 10 个场景，零虚假 DONE；本地密钥收据束拒绝 18 种篡改类别，零误接受。在 9240 个单元的消融中，A4 与 A2-prime 比较将可见传递/隐藏失败放大从 31/1800 降至 2/1800，提升 1.6 个百分点（95% CI [0.8, 2.5]）。自我应用语料库包含 565 个故事和 1007 个审查发现，解决率 94.8%。
Conclusion: Proof-or-Stop 可作为自主代理声明生命周期决策的模型无关、宿主中立控制层，但评估限于单一模型家族、24 个消融任务和自托管语料库，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Analytical study of the optimal combination of binary classifiers based on classifiers-induced partitioning of the training set
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies an optimal linear combination of binary classifiers based on a logical structuration of the dataset via truth tables. The given classifiers partition data into equivalence classes, allowing for a rigorous analysis of the convexified empirical risk through a multidimensional generalization of classification calibrated functions. We establish sufficient conditions for the existence and uniqueness of the (global) point of minimum of the convexified empirical risk for any list of classifiers (when the number of classifiers is large, there frequently could be no point of minimum). In the case of three classifiers, our analysis allows to list all the configurations leading to either a unique solution, infima or non-unique points of minimum. Furthermore, we derive explicit analytical formulae for optimal weights using Exponential (Boost) and Logistic (Logit) loss functions, bypassing iterative optimization. The stability of the resulting classifier and the analysis of data quality can be evaluated through the introduction of the notion of $φ$-frontiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于训练集划分的二分类器最优线性组合，通过真值表对数据集进行逻辑结构化，建立了凸化经验风险的多维推广，并给出了最优权重的解析解。
Motivation: 二分类器组合的权重优化问题，当分类器数量大时，凸化经验风险可能不存在全局最小点，需要严格条件。
Method: 将分类器对训练集的划分等价类通过真值表分析，利用分类校准函数的多维推广，推导存在唯一最小点的充分条件。
Result: 在三个分类器情况下，枚举了所有配置类型；对于指数损失和逻辑损失，给出了最优权重的显式解析公式，无需迭代优化。
Conclusion: 通过 φ-frontier 概念评估组合分类器的稳定性和数据质量。

papers.title: Innocuous-Seeming Data, Latent Ideology: Ideological Generalisation in Finetuned LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning language models on small, curated datasets is standard practice for adapting them to specific policies or domains. We show that finetuning on narrow, factually-defensible, moderation-passing data can cause broad ideological shifts across unrelated domains, while preserving general capabilities. Training GPT-4.1 on right- or left-leaning economics Q&A yields matched ideological shifts on topics such as criminal justice, the environment, and cultural taste. The same effect appears with plausibly-deployed datasets such as workplace HR policy and practical finance queries, as well as on a science-pseudoscience axis where food-safety finetuning increases sycophantic agreement with users expressing false health beliefs. We call this phenomenon ideological generalisation and propose a methodology to measure two properties: breadth, how far the shift reaches across topics absent from training, and amplification, how much finetuning intensifies the shift relative to few-shot prompting on the same examples. We show that few-shot prompting indicates the direction of generalisation but finetuning pushes the model to further extremes, including to far out-of-distribution outputs such as endorsements of race-IQ connections and political violence. The effect replicates on Gemma-3, holds under judge-free evaluations and external benchmarks, survives mixing with generic data, and leaves GSM8K accuracy within $\pm 1$pp of the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，在窄领域、事实可辩护且能通过审核的数据上微调语言模型，会导致跨无关领域的广泛意识形态转变，同时保留通用能力。在GPT-4.1上，用左倾或右倾经济学问答微调后，模型在刑事司法、环境、文化品味等无关话题上也出现匹配的意识形态偏移；食品安全的微调甚至增加了对虚假健康信念的谄媚认同。作者将此现象称为意识形态泛化，并提出了衡量其广度和放大的方法。
Motivation: 微调语言模型是使其适应特定政策或领域的标准做法，但此前未系统研究窄领域微调数据是否会导致模型在无关话题上产生全局性意识形态偏移。
Method: 通过在GPT-4.1和Gemma-3上进行受控微调实验，比较不同意识形态方向的窄数据集（如经济学问答、HR政策、金融查询）对模型在多个无关话题上输出倾向的影响；并引入广度（shift跨越训练未涉及话题的范围）和放大（微调相对少样本提示的偏移强化程度）两个度量指标。
Result: 微调导致在刑事司法、环境、文化品味等未训练话题上出现匹配的意识形态偏移；少样本提示能指示偏移方向，但微调将模型推向更极端输出（如种族-IQ关联、政治暴力）；该效应在Gemma-3上复现，在无裁判评估和外部基准下成立，与通用数据混合后仍存在，而GSM8K准确率变化仅在±1百分点内。
Conclusion: 意识形态泛化是微调中不可忽视的风险：看似无害的窄领域微调可能引发模型在广泛话题上的系统性偏见，且偏移程度远超少样本提示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reachability-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Target-Oriented Path Exploration in Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) reasoning under the extrapolation setting focuses on forecasting future time-stamped events (facts) from historical data in a temporal knowledge graph. Existing approaches, reinforcement learning (RL)-based multi-hop reasoning methods are prominent for TKG reasoning because they produce human-interpretable predictions via explicit multi-hop path tracing. However, during RL training, rewards are typically sparse, and exploration is highly inefficient due to the vast, time-evolving action space. These issues hinder efficient training and often limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose RAPTOR (Reachability-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Target-Oriented Path Exploration), a self-supervised pretraining method that injects a reachability-aware inductive bias to the agent. By learning to estimate the reachability of candidate actions to the target entity, RAPTOR reduces exploration over unpromising paths and provides a strong initialization for downstream RL fine-tuning. Experimental results on the ICEWS14, ICEWS05-15, and ICEWS18 datasets demonstrate that RAPTOR pretraining markedly improves the training efficiency and consistently outperforms conventional baselines, establishing it as an effective approach for enhancing RL-based multi-hop reasoning methods for TKG reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RAPTOR，一种自监督预训练方法，通过注入可达性感知的归纳偏置，提高时序知识图谱推理中基于强化学习的多跳路径探索效率。在 ICEWS14、ICEWS05-15 和 ICEWS18 数据集上，RAPTOR 显著提升训练效率并超越基线。
Motivation: 强化学习方法在时序知识图谱推理中存在奖励稀疏和探索效率低的问题，原因在于动作空间巨大且随时间演变，导致训练困难和性能受限。
Method: 提出 RAPTOR 预训练方法，学习估计候选动作到目标实体的可达性，从而减少对无希望路径的探索，并为下游强化学习微调提供良好的初始化。
Result: 在 ICEWS14、ICEWS05-15 和 ICEWS18 数据集上的实验表明，RAPTOR 预训练明显提高了训练效率，并且一致优于传统基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 RAPTOR 是一种增强基于强化学习的多跳推理方法在时序知识图谱推理中有效性的方法。

papers.title: Does generative AI supersede supervised XMLC? A Benchmark Study on Automated Subject Indexing with German Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: With a large controlled vocabulary as the label set, the task of automated subject indexing in a library can be understood as a multi-label classification task. If the set of subject terms is large, the problem fits the Extreme Multi-Label Classification (XMLC) objective. In this study, we apply a selection of specialised supervised XMLC methods to the test case of subject indexing contemporary German scientific literature, collected at the German National Library (DNB). We contrast these results by including a classical lexical matching baseline and three of our own recently developed LLM-based methods into the benchmark. Algorithms are evaluated and compared in several metrics. This includes binary relevance comparisons with previously indexed material, as well as graded relevance ratings by professional subject librarians. A challenge for all methods is to reliably make suggestions from the long tail of the subject vocabulary. We find that supervised XMLC algorithms relying on transformer-based dense features give best results in terms of overall binary relevance metrics. However, focusing on graded relevance and performance in the long tail of our subject vocabulary, the LLM-based generative methods give better results, making them a promising alternative for future productive use.

papers.title: Measuring Spatial Clustering via Metropolis-Hastings Diffusion Distance
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel measure of the discrepancy between two probability distributions $f$ and $g$ on a graph - which we call the diffusion distance - that measures the rate of convergence of $f$ to $g$ under a graph-constrained Markov chain with stationary distribution $g$. As a default choice for this Markov chain, we use the Metropolis-Hastings transition matrix targeting $g$ with proposals given by a random walk on the graph. Our primary case of interest is when the second distribution $g$ is uniform, in which case the diffusion distance becomes a measure of spatial clustering in $f$. Used in this way, (Metropolis-Hastings) diffusion distance to uniformity extends Moran's $I$-type measures of spatial autocorrelation by incorporating global graph geometry rather than just local patterns. Indeed, Moran's $I$, the most well-known measure of spatial autocorrelation, can be viewed as a one-step heuristic for diffusion distance, so long as specific spatial weights are used. We establish theoretical bounds and a stability result for our measure, connecting it to graph spectra and optimal transport. We then turn our attention to outlining a statistical test for spatial clustering using diffusion distance. Under permutation null models, we derive high-probability bounds on diffusion distance underpinned by exact spectral formulas for convergence of distributions, enabling an efficient statistical test for spatial clustering on large datasets. We empirically compare diffusion distance to Moran's $I$ both as a numerical measure and as a statistical test. We show that diffusion distance exhibits higher power on synthetic data using a stochastic block model. Empirical analysis of Black population distributions for 100 U.S. cities shows that diffusion distance detects subtle differences in urban segregation patterns that Moran's $I$ does not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图约束马尔可夫链的扩散距离，用于衡量两个概率分布之间的差异，默认选择以均匀分布为目标（即空间聚类度量），并通过Metropolis-Hastings转移矩阵实现。该距离扩展了 Moran's I 型空间自相关度量，考虑了全局图结构而非仅局部模式。理论部分建立了与图谱和最优传输的联系，并基于排列零模型推导了高效统计检验。在随机块模型合成数据和美国城市黑人人口分布实证中，扩散距离比 Moran's I 具有更高的检验功效，能检测出更细微的城市隔离模式差异。
Motivation: 现有的空间自相关度量（如 Moran's I）主要捕捉局部空间模式，忽略了全局图结构，无法有效检测全局性的空间聚类特征。本文旨在提出一种能够整合全局图几何的度量，以更全面地衡量空间聚类。
Method: 定义扩散距离为在图上以目标分布 g 为平稳分布的马氏链中，从分布 f 收敛到 g 的速率，默认采用 Metropolis-Hastings 转移矩阵（以均匀分布为目标，通过随机游走提议）。建立理论界、稳定性结果，并基于排列零模型和高概率界推导统计检验。
Result: 在随机块模型合成数据上，扩散距离的统计检验功效高于 Moran's I。在100个美国城市黑人人口分布实证中，扩散距离检测到了 Moran's I 未能发现的细微城市隔离模式差异。
Conclusion: 扩散距离作为一种全局空间聚类度量，相比 Moran's I 能更敏感地反映空间分布的非均匀性，适用于大数据集的空间聚类统计检验。

papers.title: PAC Learning in Turn-Based Stochastic Games with Reachability Objectives: A Decentralized Private Approach via Expected Conditional Distance
papers.abstract_en: Reachability is the most fundamental logical objective, yet it is notoriously difficult to learn in reinforcement learning settings: even for Markov decision processes, PAC learning of reachability is impossible without additional assumptions. This difficulty also holds in turn-based stochastic games (TBSGs), where two adversarial players interact on a finite state space. In this work, we consider turn-based stochastic games with reachability objectives. For such settings, adversarial learning, in which players are adversarial even in the learning phase, is impossible. Therefore, the goal is to consider learning, in which both players learn the unknown model together. In this spirit, previous literature on PAC learning in TBSGs considers (a)~public information shared by both players; and (b)~centralized learning, which means that players share the same learning algorithm. In this work, our contribution is two-fold. First, we relax these strong assumptions and ensure learning: (i)~with private information not shared with the other player; and (ii)~decentralized learning where the players do not share the same learning algorithm. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first positive result for decentralized and private information learning of TBSGs with reachability objectives. Second, we introduce a game-theoretic generalization of the Expected Conditional Distance (ECD) parameter, which measures the expected length of reaching the target set. We establish a polynomial-sample complexity bound with respect to the number of states, actions, ECD parameter, and inverses of error tolerance and failure probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究回合制随机博弈（TBSG）中可达性目标的PAC学习，首次在去中心化和私有信息设置下取得正结果。作者放松了传统假设（公共信息和中心化学习），引入博弈论版本的期望条件距离（ECD）参数，并建立了关于状态数、动作数、ECD参数以及误差容忍度和失败概率倒数的多项式样本复杂度界。
Motivation: 在回合制随机博弈中，可达性目标的PAC学习在去中心化和私有信息下以往被认为不可能，现有工作依赖公共信息和中心化学习。本文旨在放松这些强假设，实现更实际的分散式学习。
Method: 放宽公共信息和中心化学习假设，允许玩家拥有私有信息且使用不同学习算法；引入博弈论泛化的期望条件距离（ECD）参数作为衡量可达目标集期望长度的指标。
Result: 首次证明在去中心化和私有信息设置下TBSG可达性目标的PAC学习是可行的，并给出了关于状态数、动作数、ECD参数、误差容忍度倒数及失败概率倒数的多项式样本复杂度上界。
Conclusion: 本文是首个在去中心化和私有信息下对TBSG可达性目标进行PAC学习的正结果，为更实际的多人随机博弈学习提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Rotational Motion-Induced Error Compensation for Phase-Shifting Profilometry-Based Eye Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: With the proliferation of immersive Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) for Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR), reliable and high-precision eye tracking has become increasingly important. Conventional 2D image-based methods offer low system complexity but remain limited in stability, accuracy, and robustness. Three-dimensional ocular surface reconstruction can provide richer geomet-ric information, and structured light profilometry is particularly attractive because it enables dense and accurate surface measurement. However, Phase-Shifting Profilometry (PSP), which estimates phase from sequentially acquired fringe images, is highly susceptible to motion-induced errors when the eye rotates between frames. This study proposes a rotational motion compensation framework for PSP-based dynamic 3D eye reconstruction. Relative eye rotation is estimated from image-based motion cues using a user-specific 3D eye model in a spherical-coordinate domain. The estimated motion is then used to compensate for camera-pixel mismatch and phase-shift errors caused by inter-frame rotation. A region-wise optimization strategy is further introduced to reduce residual artifacts by inde-pendently refining the compensation strength in different ocular regions. Experiments with a rotating fake eye under non-uniform motion demonstrate that the proposed method substantially suppresses motion-induced deformation and improves reconstruction accuracy. An additional experiment with a non-spherical rigid object indicates that the compensation principle is not restricted to spherical eye geometry. These results establish a practical basis for stable PSP-based dynamic 3D eye reconstruction toward future high-precision eye tracking in immersive environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于相移轮廓测量法（PSP）的动态眼重建中，因眼动引起的运动伪影问题，提出了一种旋转运动补偿框架。通过球形坐标系中的个性化3D眼模型估计相对眼动，补偿像素失配和相移误差，并采用区域优化策略减少残余伪影。实验表明该方法能有效抑制运动变形，提高重建精度。
Motivation: 现有PSP在动态眼重建中易受帧间眼动影响，导致相位估计误差和重建变形，需补偿方案。
Method: 提出旋转运动补偿框架：从图像运动线索估计相对眼动，利用个性化3D眼模型在球坐标系中建模；补偿相机像素失配和相移误差；引入区域优化策略独立调整不同眼区的补偿强度。
Result: 在非均匀旋转的仿生眼实验中，方法明显抑制运动变形，提高重建精度；在非球形刚体实验中验证了补偿原理的通用性。
Conclusion: 该补偿框架为PSP动态眼重建提供了实用基础，有望用于未来高精度眼动追踪。

papers.title: Asymmetric Peak-Aware Loss for Peak-Critical Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In many operational time-series forecasting applications, such as crowd demand forecasting, the risk related to under-prediction is substantially higher than that of over-prediction. Accurate prediction of rare demand spikes plays a critical role in downstream tasks. Yet most time-series forecasters are trained with symmetric objectives (e.g., MSE, MAE) and evaluated primarily on aggregate error, which can mask failures in extreme-values and peak-timing predictions. We introduce Asymmetric Peak-Aware Loss (APAL), a simple, model-agnostic objective that (i) penalizes under-predictions more heavily and (ii) increases the training weight of peak regions within each forecast window. We further propose a peak-critical evaluation protocol that complements MAE/MSE with channel-wise tail error (Top-10% and Top-1%) and peak metrics (precision, recall, F1 under timing tolerance, and peak timing error). We evaluate APAL on long-horizon multivariate forecasting across five state-of-the-art backbones, with a focus on pedestrian demand forecasting using (i) a production-ready subset of the City of Melbourne pedestrian hourly count dataset and (ii) a beach visitor count dataset. The generality of the loss function for time-series forecasting is tested on additional benchmarks. Across peak-critical datasets and settings, APAL improves tail accuracy and peak-prediction quality while exposing a controllable trade-off with aggregate error, making it a practical solution when peak-prediction failures are the dominant operational concern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出非对称峰值感知损失（APAL），一种模型无关的损失函数，用于峰值关键时间序列预测。APAL通过对低估预测施加更大惩罚，并增加预测窗口内峰值区域的训练权重，提升极端值和峰值时序的预测质量。在行人需求预测等数据集上，APAL改善了尾部精度和峰值预测质量，同时暴露了与聚合误差的可控权衡。
Motivation: 大多数时间序列预测器使用对称目标（如MSE）训练，且主要评估聚合误差，这可能掩盖极端值和峰值时序预测的失败。但在许多操作应用中，低估风险远高于高估，准确预测罕见需求峰值至关重要。
Method: 提出APAL损失函数，包含两个设计：（i）对低估预测施加更大惩罚；（ii）在预测窗口内增加峰值区域的训练权重。同时提出峰值关键评估协议，在MAE/MSE基础上增加通道级尾部误差（Top-10%, Top-1%）和峰值指标（精确率、召回率、F1及时序容差、峰值时序误差）。
Result: 在长程多变量预测中，使用五个最新backbone，在行人需求数据集（墨尔本行人小时计数子集和海滩游客计数）上，APAL改善了尾部精度和峰值预测质量，同时存在与聚合误差的可控权衡。还测试了损失函数在其他基准上的通用性。
Conclusion: APAL是峰值预测失败占主导操作关注点时的实用解决方案，允许用户控制峰值精度与聚合误差之间的权衡。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Tamed Stochastic Gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel tamed stochastic gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (tSGHMC) algorithm for sampling and stochastic optimization problems with superlinearly growing stochastic gradients. Under a certain continuity in average condition and a strong convexity condition, we establish a non-asymptotic error bound in Wasserstein-2 distance for tSGHMC with the rate of convergence equal to $1/4$. Then, we derive an upper estimate for the associated expected excess risk, which provides a theoretical guarantee for the performance of tSGHMC. To illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, we apply tSGHMC to practical examples, including a newsvendor problem and a Conditional Value-at-Risk minimization problem, using synthetic and real-world datasets. Numerical results support our theoretical findings. Furthermore, we compare tSGHMC with its first-order counterpart, namely, the tamed unadjusted stochastic Langevin algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that tSGHMC achieves lower root mean square error and expected excess risk across a range of tasks.

Method: 提出tSGHMC算法，在SGHMC的基础上引入驯化步长调整以处理超线性梯度。在强凸和平均连续性条件下，证明Wasserstein-2距离的非渐近误差界，收敛率1/4，并推导期望超额风险上界。
Result: 摘要报告tSGHMC在Wasserstein-2距离下收敛率为1/4的非渐近误差界。在报童和CVaR问题上的数值实验表明，tSGHMC的均方根误差和期望超额风险低于驯化非调整随机朗之万算法。
Conclusion: tSGHMC为超线性增长随机梯度问题提供了理论保证和有效算法，在随机优化和采样任务中优于一阶驯化拉格朗日方法。

papers.title: Subgrid-Scale Parameterization in Burgers' Equation Using Structure-Preserving Neural Networks and Entropy Variables
papers.abstract_en: We present a machine learning approach for developing subgrid-scale (SGS) parametrizations in coarse simulations of partial differential equations. We utilize structure-preserving neural networks and entropy variables to learn subgrid fluxes in coarse simulations of the Burgers' equation. In particular, we employ a decoupled neural network architecture explicitly separating the subgrid corrections into two distinct components: a conservative Flux Potential network and an Eddy Viscosity network. We demonstrate that this reduced-order framework maintains high physical fidelity, accurately reproducing the energy spectrum, spatial and temporal correlation functions, and dynamical characteristics of the full-scale system. Furthermore, we show that our approach is robust and applicable to parameters outside the training regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种机器学习方法，利用结构保持神经网络和熵变量来学习Burgers方程粗粒化模拟中的亚网格尺度通量。通过将亚网格修正分解为守恒通量网络和涡粘性网络，该方法保持了高物理保真度，准确再现了全尺度系统的能谱、时空相关函数和动力学特征，并对训练范围外的参数具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 偏微分方程粗粒化模拟中亚网格尺度参数化需要保留物理结构，但传统方法难以兼顾精度与鲁棒性。
Method: 采用解耦神经网络架构，将亚网格修正分为保守的通量势网络和涡粘性网络，并利用熵变量进行物理约束。
Result: 在Burgers方程粗粒化模拟中，该方法精确重现了全阶系统的能谱、时空相关函数和动力学特性，且对训练域外参数有效。
Conclusion: 该方法为开发高保真、鲁棒的亚网格参数化提供了有效框架，但当前仅在一维Burgers方程上验证。

papers.title: RW-Voice-EQ Bench: A Real World Benchmark for Evaluating Voice AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Current voice AI benchmarks typically evaluate isolated capabilities such as speech intelligibility, word error rate, or text-based dialogue quality, but they rarely test whether systems harness the acoustic information that distinguishes spoken language from its textual representation. To this end, we introduce the Real World Voice EQ Bench, a multidimensional benchmark for evaluating voice AI across text-to-speech (TTS), speech-to-speech (STS), speech understanding (SU), and automatic speech recognition (ASR). Our evaluations indicate that performance is highly dimension-specific. For TTS, naturalness, expressiveness, identity stability, and reliability are largely independent evaluation dimensions. For STS, access to audio does not guarantee use of vocal affect, and some agents remain largely transcript-driven. For SU, models perform unevenly across paralinguistic tasks. For ASR, real world accent, emotion, noise, and conversational conditions expose failures that are not captured by established clean-speech benchmarks. Together, these results show that voice AI should be evaluated as a profile of acoustic, expressive, interactional, and robustness capabilities rather than by a single aggregate score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RW-Voice-EQ Bench，一个用于评估语音AI系统的多维度基准，涵盖TTS、STS、SU和ASR任务。结果表明性能是维度特定的，语音AI应按照声学、表达、交互和鲁棒性能力轮廓评估，而不是单一分数。
Motivation: 现有语音AI基准通常评估孤立能力（如语音清晰度、词错误率或文本对话质量），很少测试系统是否利用区分口语与文本表示的声学信息。
Method: 引入了Real World Voice EQ Bench，一个多维度基准，评估文本到语音(TTS)、语音到语音(STS)、语音理解(SU)和自动语音识别(ASR)。评估多个维度如自然度、表现力、身份稳定性等。
Result: TTS中自然度、表现力、身份稳定性和可靠性在很大程度上是独立维度；STS中访问音频不保证使用声音情感，有些代理仍以文本为主导；SU中模型在副语言任务上表现不均；ASR中真实世界口音、情感、噪声和对话条件暴露了现有清洁语音基准未捕捉的失败。
Conclusion: 语音AI应按照声学、表达、交互和鲁棒性能力轮廓进行评估，而不是单一聚合分数。
Relevance: 0
