papers.title: GlobalForge: Towards Robust AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors achieve strong accuracy on clean benchmarks, but their performance drops sharply after images are propagated through real-world channels. We trace this fragility to what these detectors actually learn: they overfit to local artifacts left by generators in small spatial neighborhoods, which are easily destroyed by common propagation degradations such as JPEG compression and blur. Instead, we shift the discriminative cue from fragile local artifacts to more robust global structure. Building on this, we propose GlobalForge, a framework with two complementary modules. The Local Information Bottleneck (LIB) suppresses local components to block shortcut learning, while the Global Structural Reasoning (GSR) module forces every token to gather evidence from distant regions. Both modules are trained jointly under a contrastive structural loss based on degradation that keeps the resulting features stable under degradation. To support fine-grained robustness evaluation, we further introduce RealDeg-Bench, covering 7 common degradation operators and multi-step compound chains. GlobalForge improves average BAcc on 8 in-the-wild benchmark groups by $\mathbf{5.89\%}$ over the previous state-of-the-art, and is clearly ahead of representative baselines on RealDeg-Bench under both single and compound degradations. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GlobalForge-BE0F/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GlobalForge框架，用于鲁棒的AI生成图像检测。现有检测器容易过拟合局部伪影，在图像经过真实世界传播（如JPEG压缩、模糊）后性能急剧下降。GlobalForge通过局部信息瓶颈（LIB）抑制局部组件，并通过全局结构推理（GSR）迫使每个token从远距离区域收集证据，在对比结构损失下联合训练。还引入了RealDeg-Bench基准。在8个野外基准组上平均BAcc提升5.89%。
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在干净基准上表现良好，但在图像经过真实传播渠道后性能大幅下降，原因是检测器过度依赖容易被破坏的局部伪影。
Method: 提出GlobalForge框架，包含局部信息瓶颈（LIB）和全局结构推理（GSR）两个互补模块，并采用基于退化的对比结构损失进行联合训练。同时引入RealDeg-Bench基准用于细粒度鲁棒性评估。
Result: 在8个野外基准组上平均BAcc比前最优方法提升5.89%，在RealDeg-Bench上单重和复合退化下均明显优于代表性基线。
Conclusion: 通过从局部伪影转向全局结构特征，可以显著提升AI生成图像检测器在真实退化条件下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InCarEmo: A Multimodal Dataset for In-Cabin Emotion Recognition and Driver State Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Understanding driver emotion and state is critical for the next generation of intelligent in-cabin systems that ensure safety and enhance human-vehicle interaction. However, existing public datasets for in-cabin affective computing are largely limited to visual modalities and rarely include conversational information, making it difficult to capture the linguistic and interactive cues underlying driver emotion. To address these gaps, we introduce InCarEmo, a multimodal dataset for in-cabin emotion recognition and driver state monitoring. InCarEmo integrates RGB and infrared video, in-cabin audio, and dialogue text collected from scripted in-cabin scenarios designed to simulate realistic driver behaviors, covering diverse lighting conditions and driving contexts. The dataset supports three primary tasks: 1) multimodal emotion recognition, 2) fatigue detection, and 3) distraction monitoring. In addition to the original Chinese data, we construct an auxiliary English benchmark to support preliminary cross-lingual evaluation. We provide a unified benchmark with extensive baseline results across unimodal and multimodal methods, including analyses under modality-missing and noise conditions. Experimental results demonstrate the benefits of multimodal fusion and reveal remaining challenges under real-world noise and low-light conditions. By releasing InCarEmo, we aim to establish a comprehensive foundation for robust, interpretable, and human-centric in-cabin affective understanding, promoting safer and more empathetic driver-vehicle interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InCarEmo，一个用于车内情绪识别和驾驶员状态监控的多模态数据集。该数据集整合了RGB和红外视频、车内音频及对话文本，覆盖多种光照和驾驶场景，支持情绪识别、疲劳检测和分心监控三个任务。实验结果表明多模态融合的有效性，并揭示了在噪声和低光条件下的挑战。
Motivation: 现有车内情感计算数据集主要局限于视觉模态，缺乏对话信息，难以捕捉驾驶员情绪中的语言和交互线索。
Method: 通过设计脚本化车内场景模拟真实驾驶行为，收集RGB/红外视频、音频和对话文本，构建多模态数据集InCarEmo，并建立统一基准，评估单模态与多模态方法在模态缺失和噪声下的表现。
Result: 多模态融合方法在情绪识别、疲劳检测和分心监控任务上优于单模态方法，但在真实噪声和低光条件下仍存在挑战。
Conclusion: InCarEmo数据集为车内情感理解提供了全面基础，旨在推动安全、共情的驾驶交互研究。

papers.title: Stop Thinking, Start Looking: Efficient Post-Training for Multimodal Document Question Answering via Reasoning-Free Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Efficient multimodal document question answering with explicit visual grounding, locating the precise document region that supports each answer remains an open challenge. Current approaches bifurcate into Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), which requires large annotated datasets and reaches optimization plateaus, and reasoning-centric Reinforcement Learning (RL), which depends on verbose intermediate traces that inflate inference token cost without clear benefit. We introduce Perception-RFT, a training framework that applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to multimodal document QA, bypassing intermediate reasoning tokens to directly align visual features with structured grounding outputs. To rigorously evaluate the necessity of reasoning, we construct a reasoning variant under identical reward settings. We find that reasoning-enabled models suppress their reasoning traces during training, converging to direct perception-based policies at the 4B parameter scale, reducing per-query inference token length by more than 60%, while reasoning-enabled RL underperforms perception-only training. Through a fine-grained analysis of Qwen3-VL-4B optimization dynamics, we confirm that SFT saturation and cold-start RL instability established in text-domain post-training extend to multimodal, and identify a previously uncharacterized Grounding Divergence: a selective trade-off between semantic robustness and geometric precision on two out of distribution (OOD) benchmarks (4,828 samples) under joint RL optimization. We further show that an early SFT$\rightarrow$RL transition achieves comparable precision with 65% less training data.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026, Workshop on Efficient Multimodal Question Answering (EMM-QA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Perception-RFT 框架，将组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 应用于多模态文档问答，跳过中间推理步骤，直接对齐视觉特征与结构化定位输出。实验表明，4B 参数规模下推理 token 减少超过 60%，且带推理的强化学习性能不如纯感知训练；同时发现早期从 SFT 切换到 RL 可用 65% 更少数据达到相当精度。论文还识别了“定位发散”(Grounding Divergence) 现象——在联合 RL 优化下语义鲁棒性与几何精度之间存在选择性权衡。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖大规模标注数据 (SFT) 或冗长推理 token (RL)，效率低下且易陷入平台期。
Method: 使用 GRPO 直接对齐视觉特征与结构化定位输出，不生成中间推理 token。
Result: 推理 token 减少 60%+；推理启用的模型最终收敛为感知策略，且性能劣于纯感知训练；SFT→RL 提前切换可减少 65% 训练数据。
Conclusion: 在多模态文档定位中，推理并非必要；早期切换训练策略可显著提升数据效率。

papers.title: ReBind: Multi-Reference Video Editing via Structured Instructions with Explicit Reference Relationships
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion-based video generation models have made significant progress in multi-reference image-conditioned video editing. However, existing methods still struggle to coordinate information from multiple visual sources accurately. We identify a critical deficiency in existing approaches. Existing editing instructions lack explicit reference relationships, and most multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot generate them reliably. To address this problem, we propose ReBind, a systematic framework that introduces semantic instructions with embedded reference tokens as the intermediate representation for multi-reference image-conditioned video editing. Our key insight is embedding reference tokens at semantic positions to eliminate ambiguity and establish precise bindings between visual attributes and their sources. We develop ReBind-Instruct, a specialized MLLM that learns to establish explicit bindings between visual attributes and their reference sources through a two-stage progressive scheme for precise reference relationships. We further develop ReBind-Edit, which enables lightweight adaptation of text-to-video models to coordinate multiple references by binding visual attributes to their designated sources. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReBind substantially outperforms general-purpose MLLMs in instruction quality and achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source methods on reference image conditioned video editing. Our project webpage: https://rebind-mrv2v.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReBind 框架，用于多参考图像条件视频编辑。核心创新在于引入嵌入参考标记的语义指令作为中间表示，以消除歧义并建立视觉属性与其来源之间的精确绑定。通过两阶段渐进式训练专用多模态大语言模型生成指令，并轻量适配文本到视频模型，实现了对多个参考源的协调控制。实验表明该方法在指令质量和编辑效果上均达到开源领先水平。
Motivation: 现有方法在多参考视频编辑中缺乏显式的参考关系描述，且通用多模态大语言模型无法可靠生成此类指令，导致多源视觉信息协同困难。
Method: 提出 ReBind-Instruct，通过两阶段渐进式训练让专用多模态大语言模型学习生成嵌入参考标记的语义指令；提出 ReBind-Edit，轻量适配文本到视频模型，利用指令中的绑定关系协调多个参考源。
Result: ReBind 在指令质量上显著优于通用多模态大语言模型，并在参考图像条件视频编辑任务中达到开源方法的最优性能。
Conclusion: 嵌入参考标记的语义指令是解决多参考视频编辑中源-属性模糊性的有效中间表示，该框架为更复杂的多条件视频生成提供了新思路。

papers.title: An Intelligent-Cloud Edge Multimodal Interaction System for Robots
papers.abstract_en: Robust human-robot interaction in complex environments requires accurate gesture perception, semantic scene understanding, and reliable task planning under limited onboard computing resources. This paper presents a cloud-edge multimodal interaction framework that integrates an enhanced YOLO-based gesture detector with coordinated large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) agents. The proposed detector, incorporates the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into the neck and replaces the baseline bounding-box regression objective with Distance-IoU (DIoU) loss. These modifications improve feature discrimination and localization for small or partially occluded gestures in complex backgrounds. The cloud layer performs gesture detection, scene understanding, multimodal fusion, and action planning, whereas the TonyPi robot locally handles data acquisition, communication, action execution, and feedback. Experiments on a public gesture dataset and a custom dataset show that YOLO-DC achieves precision values of 98.9% and 95.0%, with mAP@0.5 values of 90.7% and 92.7%, respectively. System-level evaluation yields success rates of 95%, 88%, and 82% for single-action, composite-action, and vision-dependent tasks. A 30 participant evaluation yields an overall mean satisfaction score of 3.69 out of 5. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining refined gesture detection with multimodal agents for resource-constrained robotic interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个云边端协同的多模态交互框架，用于机器人在复杂环境中进行手势感知、场景理解和任务规划。框架的核心是改进的YOLO手势检测器（YOLO-DC），通过引入CBAM注意力模块和DIoU损失函数提升小目标及遮挡手势的检测精度。云端部署了LLM和VLM智能体完成多模态融合与动作规划，而TonyPi机器人本地负责数据采集与执行。实验表明，YOLO-DC在公共手势数据集上精度达98.9%（mAP@0.5 90.7%），自定义数据集上精度95.0%（mAP@0.5 92.7%）；系统级任务成功率为95%（单动作）、88%（复合动作）和82%（视觉依赖任务），用户满意度3.69/5。
Motivation: 现有机器人交互系统在有限计算资源下难以同时实现精准手势感知、语义场景理解和可靠任务规划，亟需一种云边协同框架来平衡计算负载与交互性能。
Method: 提出云边端两级架构：云端集成改进的YOLO-DC检测器（在neck中插入CBAM模块、将回归损失替换为DIoU）、LLM和VLM智能体，负责手势检测、场景理解、多模态融合与动作规划；边缘端（TonyPi机器人）负责数据采集、通信、动作执行与反馈。
Result: YOLO-DC在公共手势数据集上达到98.9%精度（mAP@0.5 90.7%），在自定义数据集上达到95.0%精度（mAP@0.5 92.7%）。系统级测试中，单动作、复合动作和视觉依赖任务的成功率分别为95%、88%和82%。30名参与者评估的平均满意度得分为3.69/5。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合精细手势检测与多模态智能体的云边端框架在资源受限机器人交互中的可行性，并验证了其在精度与任务成功率上的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Project Kaleidoscope: Contextual, Human-Aligned Evaluation for Real-World AI Applications
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations (Evals) are a deployment bottleneck for real-world AI applications: public benchmarks rarely match a team's users, context, or policies, and human review is often tedious to scale. Motivated by our work with AI applications in the public sector, this project addresses recurring evaluation challenges encountered when applications must satisfy local policy and governance requirements. We present Kaleidoscope, an integrated workflow for contextual functional evaluation that links persona-based test generation, contextualized rubrics, and human review for reliability-gated automated scoring. Generated test cases are scored against application-specific rubrics; human annotations provide reviewable labels; and LLM judges automate scoring only when their agreement with those labels meets a configured threshold. Kaleidoscope is therefore a practical, inspectable, iterative workflow for product teams. We report early evidence from a three-week pilot across four organizational use cases and custom-rubric judge experiments on 108 annotated Q\&A pairs spanning four domains and 14 evaluation dimensions. The results highlight useful features for end-to-end reliable, automated scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kaleidoscope，一个用于真实世界AI应用的上下文功能评估工作流，结合基于 persona 的测试生成、情境化评分标准和人工审核，实现可靠性门控的自动评分。在四个组织用例和108个跨领域Q&A对上的初步试验显示了端到端可靠自动评分的潜力。
Motivation: 公共基准测试很少匹配团队的用户、上下文或政策，而人工审核难以扩展，导致AI应用部署的评估瓶颈。
Method: Kaleidoscope 集成了基于 persona 的测试生成、情境化评分标准以及人工审核，只有当LLM评判与人工标签的一致性达到配置阈值时才进行自动评分。
Result: 在为期三周的试点中，涵盖四个组织用例和108个跨领域Q&A对（14个评估维度），结果表明该工作流有助于实现端到端可靠、可检查的自动化评分。
Conclusion: Kaleidoscope 是一个实用的、可检查的、迭代的工作流，适合产品团队进行上下文功能评估。

papers.title: Scalable Training of Continuous-Time Spiking Neural Networks with Differentiable Spike-Time Discretization
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time spiking neural networks (SNNs) provide an event-driven framework for temporal computation, computational neuroscience, and neuromorphic hardware. However, training deep continuous-time SNNs is severely constrained by the memory required for exact spike-time computation, which evaluates and retains candidate firing times over intervals determined by presynaptic spike ordering. Here we introduce a memory-efficient training framework based on differentiable spike-time discretization (DSTD) for leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with general membrane and synaptic time constants. DSTD maps irregular presynaptic spikes onto differentiable weighted events at fixed time points, replacing the input-dependent candidate dimension with $M$ fixed time intervals while accurately approximating continuous-time membrane-potential dynamics. This reduces candidate-related activation memory from $O(N_{\mathrm{out}}N_{\mathrm{in}})$ to $O(N_{\mathrm{out}}M)$ in the case of time-to-first-spike (TTFS) coding, where $N_{\mathrm{in}}$ and $N_{\mathrm{out}}$ denote the numbers of presynaptic and postsynaptic neurons, respectively. We further introduce synfire-chain-inspired temporal regularization that organizes layer-wise firing windows, mitigates dead-neuron failures, and enables pipeline-like processing. In dense LIF layers, DSTD reduced peak memory consumption by up to approximately 100-fold and training time by up to approximately 20-fold compared with exact spike-time computation. Together, these methods allowed us to train 9-layer convolutional SNNs on CIFAR-10 and 20-layer convolutional SNNs on Fashion-MNIST on a single GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种可微分尖峰时间离散化（DSTD）框架，用于高效训练连续时间脉冲神经网络。DSTD将不规则突触前尖峰映射到固定时间点的可微分加权事件，将候选相关激活内存从O(N_out N_in)降至O(N_out M)，在密集LIF层上峰值内存减少约100倍，训练时间减少约20倍。该方法结合synfire-chain启发的时序正则化，成功在单GPU上训练了9层CIFAR-10和20层Fashion-MNIST卷积SNN。
Motivation: 训练深层连续时间SNN受限于精确尖峰时间计算所需的大量内存，因为需要根据突触前尖峰顺序评估和保留候选发放时间。
Method: 提出可微分尖峰时间离散化（DSTD），将不规则尖峰映射到固定时间点的可微分加权事件，并用M个固定时间间隔替代输入相关的候选维度。同时引入synfire-chain启发的时序正则化来组织层间发放窗口，缓解死神经元问题。
Result: 在密集LIF层中，峰值内存减少约100倍，训练时间减少约20倍；在CIFAR-10上训练9层卷积SNN，在Fashion-MNIST上训练20层卷积SNN，均使用单GPU。
Conclusion: DSTD框架显著降低了连续时间SNN训练的内存和时间开销，使训练更深层网络成为可能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SmartRAG: Native Graph-Based RAG for Mobile Device
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) as personal assistants on mobile devices demands privacy, low latency, and offline availability, yet the computational cost of giant models clashes with strict edge-hardware budgets. We argue that this tension cannot be resolved by model compression alone; it requires decomposing on-device intelligence into complementary functional roles. We present SmartRAG, a fully on-device framework that organizes an intelligent assistant around four coordinated modules -- Perception, Memory, Focus, and Thinking. At the core of SmartRAG is EvoNER, a continually learnable named-entity recognizer that incrementally expands its label inventory through teacher-distilled updates, enabling the system to absorb previously unseen entity types without retraining the backbone LLM. Extracted knowledge is stored in MRGraph, a three-layer provenance-preserving knowledge graph, and retrieved at query time through a hybrid pipeline combining graph traversal, lexical matching, and dense semantic search. The on-device LLM is invoked only for high-value semantic operations -- labeling, planning, and answer synthesis -- keeping inference costs bounded. Experiments on four QA benchmarks (TriviaQA, Natural Questions, HotpotQA, MultiHopQA) show that SmartRAG with a quantized 1.7B-parameter backbone achieves multi-hop reasoning performance competitive with models up to 18$\times$ larger, while running entirely on commodity smartphones within practical memory and latency envelopes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartRAG，一种完全在设备上运行的框架，通过四个协调模块（感知、记忆、聚焦、思考）将大语言模型部署为移动设备上的个人助手。核心是 EvoNER，一种可持续学习的命名实体识别器，通过教师蒸馏增量扩展标签库，无需重新训练骨干 LLM。提取的知识存储在 MRGraph 三层溯源知识图谱中，查询时结合图遍历、词汇匹配和稠密语义搜索的混合管道。在四个问答基准（TriviaQA、Natural Questions、HotpotQA、MultiHopQA）上，使用量化 1.7B 参数的骨干网络，其多跳推理性能与模型高达 18 倍参数量相当，且完全在商用智能手机上运行，满足实际内存和延迟限制。
Motivation: 在移动设备上部署大语言模型作为个人助手面临隐私、低延迟和离线可用性的需求，但大模型的计算成本与严格的边缘硬件预算冲突。仅靠模型压缩无法解决这一矛盾，需要将设备端智能分解为互补的功能角色。
Method: 提出 SmartRAG 框架，包含四个模块：Perception（感知，通过 EvoNER 持续学习命名实体识别）、Memory（记忆，通过 MRGraph 三层溯源知识图谱存储知识）、Focus（聚焦，混合检索管道）、Thinking（思考，仅对高价值语义操作调用 LLM）。EvoNER 通过教师蒸馏增量更新标签库，MRGraph 保留知识来源。
Result: 在 TriviaQA、Natural Questions、HotpotQA、MultiHopQA 四个问答基准上，使用量化 1.7B 参数骨干的 SmartRAG 在多跳推理性能上与模型高达 18 倍参数量相当，且完全在商用智能手机上运行，内存和延迟满足实际要求。
Conclusion: SmartRAG 通过将设备端智能分解为互补模块，并仅对高价值语义操作调用 LLM，实现了在移动设备上高效运行且性能有竞争力的个人助手。框架的设计思路可能为其他边缘 AI 应用提供借鉴。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VIABench: A Comprehensive Video Benchmark Collected from Blind Individuals for Visual Impairment Assistance
papers.abstract_en: Visually impaired individuals (VIIs) encounter significant daily challenges due to limited access to visual information. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive results on general vision and language tasks, their practical utility in real-world blind assistance still remains largely underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce VIABench, a comprehensive video benchmark specifically designed to evaluate MLLMs in Visually Impaired Assistance scenarios using first-person videos recorded or shared by VIIs themselves. VIABench defines three core tasks, each targeting a distinct requirement in visual assistance. Proactive Reminder: Assesses the model's ability to interpret ongoing video content while proactively anticipating and verbally describing upcoming navigation-critical events; Visual Question Answering (VQA): Evaluates the model's capacity to answer user-posed questions about the environment or objects within the video; Vision-Guided Interaction: Tests context-aware reasoning to accomplish intentional interactions between user and environment. To ensure a robust and fair evaluation, we propose a rigorous benchmarking pipeline that supports both online (real-time) and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that current MLLMs still struggle to deliver comprehensive support for VIIs, especially in the Proactive Reminder task, which demands accurate anticipation and real-time responsiveness. We hope VIABench will drive future research toward developing customized MLLMs for real-world assistance, ultimately improving navigation and interaction experiences for visually impaired individuals. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/VIABench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIABench是一个专为评估多模态大语言模型在视觉障碍辅助场景中表现而设计的视频基准，包含主动提醒、视觉问答和视觉引导交互三个核心任务。基于视障人士自身录制的第一人称视频，实验表明当前MLLMs在主动提醒任务上表现不足，难以提供全面支持。
Motivation: 视障人士因视觉信息受限面临日常挑战，而MLLMs在真实盲人辅助中的实用性尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出VIABench基准，包含三个任务：主动提醒（预测并描述即将发生的关键导航事件）、视觉问答（回答环境或物体相关问题）和视觉引导交互（上下文感知的用户-环境交互），并支持在线实时和离线两种评估模式。
Result: 实验显示现有MLLMs在主动提醒任务上表现困难，无法准确预测和实时响应。
Conclusion: VIABench旨在推动定制化MLLMs的发展，以改善视障人士的导航和交互体验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Driven Approach to Modeling Tool Interoperability in Automotive Domain
papers.abstract_en: Interoperability between heterogeneous modeling tools remains a significant challenge in Model-Driven Engineering (MDE), particularly in the automotive domain where multiple modeling languages, as well as defacto standard proprietary and open-source tools coexist. This paper presents an LLM-driven approach for automated model interoperability by considering two relevant aspects: 1) mapping model instances to a target metamodel 2) merging of metamodels. The proposed methodology is demonstrated through transformations involving Ecore and SysML v2 based metamodels and incorporates structural validation of generated model instances against user-defined target models. Automotive case studies illustrate the feasibility of the approach and show that large language models can significantly reduce manual transformation effort while generating structurally valid target models for cross-tool interoperability.

papers.title: TopoAgent: A Self-Evolving Topological Agent for Multimodal Scientific Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general tasks, rigorous scientific reasoning remains challenging due to the limitations of monolithic, linear planning. Such sequential designs often suffer from visual-semantic misalignment, long-context hallucinations, and brittle execution under fixed task granularity. We propose TopoAgent, a self-evolving topological framework that replaces linear trajectories with dynamic, state-isolated graph evolution. TopoAgent first employs a front-end decomposer to fracture complex queries into visually-grounded atoms. These atoms are organized into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) based on their dependencies, enabling strict context isolation to shield the reasoning engine from irrelevant historical noise. Furthermore, we introduce adaptive atomic fission, which dynamically splits bottleneck nodes into finer-grained sub-atoms at runtime when tool capability boundaries are exceeded. Extensive experiments across mathematics, physics, and chemistry benchmarks demonstrate that TopoAgent significantly outperforms state-of-the-art linear agent frameworks, providing a robust, noise-resistant, and self-correcting paradigm for autonomous scientific reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoAgent是一个自演化拓扑框架，用动态有向无环图（DAG）替代传统线性推理流程，通过原子分解、上下文隔离和自适应原子分裂来增强多模态科学推理的鲁棒性和自我修正能力，在数学、物理和化学基准上超越现有线性代理。
Motivation: 多模态大模型在一般任务中表现优异，但在严格科学推理中因线性规划的视觉-语义错位、长上下文幻觉和固定任务粒度下的脆弱执行而受限。
Method: 前端分解器将复杂查询拆分为视觉接地原子，并按依赖关系组织为DAG实现严格上下文隔离；引入自适应原子分裂，在工具能力边界不足时动态拆分瓶颈节点为更细粒度子原子。
Result: 在数学、物理和化学基准上的大量实验表明，TopoAgent显著优于最先进的线性代理框架，提供了鲁棒、抗噪声和自我纠正的科学推理范式。
Conclusion: 该工作为自主科学推理提供了一种去噪、自演化的拓扑图范式，但摘要未讨论潜在的计算开销或跨领域泛化限制。

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Flow Matching for Topology Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Topology optimisation (TO) often requires repeated finite element analysis and sensitivity-based material updates, which can be costly when multiple candidate designs are needed under varying physical and design conditions. Generative TO offers a route to rapid design exploration, but existing models may rely on adversarial training, long reverse-diffusion sampling, or external guidance to maintain structural feasibility and physical consistency. This study develops a flow matching-based topology optimisation (FMTO) framework for conditional topology generation. Linear FMTO is first formulated as an endpoint-based baseline by interpolating between a Gaussian source field and the BESO reference topology. To introduce mechanically meaningful intermediate states, a trajectory-aware FMTO formulation is proposed, where volume-fraction-indexed BESO states are used to construct the probability path and target velocity field. This incorporates physics-guided optimisation history into generative flow learning without adding inference-time optimisation. A path--velocity mismatch analysis explains why moderate trajectory weighting can improve generation stability, whereas excessive guidance may over-constrain the learned transport. Numerical examples show that FMTO generates diverse topology candidates with improved compliance-related performance, volume-fraction satisfaction, topology fidelity, and substantially fewer sampling steps than a diffusion-based baseline. Under limited training data, trajectory-aware FMTO achieves the best overall performance with a moderate trajectory weight. Studies on trajectory-anchor density and three-dimensional topology generation further demonstrate the influence of path design and the applicability of the proposed framework beyond two-dimensional problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹感知流匹配（FMTO）框架用于条件拓扑生成。线性FMTO作为基线，而轨迹感知FMTO利用体积分数索引的BESO状态构建概率路径和目标速度场，将物理引导的优化历史融入生成流学习。数值实验表明，该方法生成多样拓扑候选，在合规性、体积分数满足度和拓扑保真度上优于扩散基线，且采样步数更少。在有限训练数据下，适度轨迹权重的轨迹感知FMTO取得最佳综合性能。
Motivation: 现有生成式拓扑优化依赖对抗训练、长反向扩散采样或外部引导来保持结构可行性和物理一致性，成本高昂。本文旨在发展一种无需推理时优化即可生成高质量拓扑的生成框架。
Method: 首先建立线性FMTO作为端点基线，在 Gaussian 源场和 BESO 参考拓扑之间插值。然后提出轨迹感知FMTO，使用体积分数索引的 BESO 状态构建概率路径和目标速度场，引入力学有意义的中间状态。通过路径-速度失配分析解释轨迹加权的影响。
Result: 数值示例显示，FMTO生成的拓扑候选在合规性相关性能、体积分数满足度和拓扑保真度上优于扩散基线，且采样步数显著减少。在有限训练数据下，适度轨迹权重的轨迹感知FMTO取得最佳总体性能。
Conclusion: 轨迹感知FMTO通过将优化历史融入生成流学习，在不增加推理成本的情况下提高了拓扑生成的质量和效率。框架可扩展到三维拓扑优化问题。

papers.title: MemPoison: Uncovering Persistent Memory Threats and Structural Blind Spots in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent external memory enhances agent continuity but introduces persistent security vulnerabilities: adversarial content can be injected via standard interaction channels, retained across turns, and later distort downstream behavior. To address this challenge, we propose MemPoison, a comprehensive benchmark and analysis framework featuring 1227 hand-validated cases across four attack types, three injection channels, and three representative memory substrates, evaluated on seven open-weight and three closed-weight model families. We introduce a three-tier taxonomy: (L1) direct single-record corruption, (L2) compositional multi-record corruption and (L3) context-triggered dormant corruption. Our evaluations reveal a distinct defense frontier: while baseline write-time defenses, such as consistency checks, substantially suppress direct L1 attacks, they fail to reliably suppress L2 and L3 attacks. Through mechanistic influence decomposition (MID), we demonstrate structural blind spots in write-time defenses, which admit seemingly benign records that later become harmful through joint retrieval composition or trigger-conditioned activation. Our findings advocate for shifting from static filtering to adaptive, context-sensitive memory defense strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemPoison基准，用于评估LLM代理在持久外部内存中的安全漏洞，包含1227个手工验证的案例，涵盖四种攻击类型、三种注入通道和三种内存基质，并在七个开源和三个闭源模型系列上评估。研究发现，写时防御（如一致性检查）能抑制直接攻击，但对组合式和多记录触发式攻击无效，揭示了结构性盲点。
Motivation: 持久外部内存增强了代理的连续性，但也引入了安全漏洞：对抗性内容可通过标准交互通道注入并保留，后续扭曲下游行为。
Method: 提出三级分类（L1直接单记录损坏、L2组合多记录损坏、L3上下文触发休眠损坏），并通过机制影响分解（MID）分析写时防御的结构性盲点。
Result: 实验表明，基线写时防御（如一致性检查）显著抑制L1攻击，但无法可靠抑制L2和L3攻击。
Conclusion: 呼吁从静态过滤转向自适应、上下文敏感的内存防御策略。

papers.title: Autoregressive Modeling of Film with Applications in Video Montage
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces FilmGPT, an autoregressive transformer designed to address the challenge of video montage--turning a collection of raw, "unwatchable" footage into coherent cinematic sequences. Inspired by language learning in modern LLMs, we train a long-context autoregressive transformer on a large corpus of movies. The aim is to implicitly capture the "grammar" of film directly from data rather than from hand-coded rules. Unlike other generative models, FilmGPT does not generate any new video frames. Instead, at inference time, we introduce a footage-constrained decoding algorithm to select the best next shot from the input raw footage according to the statistical patterns learned from films. We first evaluate these learned statistics directly by using the FilmGPT autoregressive model for next shot prediction on a standard benchmark of shot sequence ordering, outperforming the previous state of the art. We then evaluate our footage-constrained decoding algorithm on the full film editing task via a user study, and find that our FilmGPT-based editing significantly outperforms previous approaches. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of FilmGPT to a wide range of applications in video montage, from automatic video segment trimming to human-in-the-loop film editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FilmGPT，一个基于自回归Transformer的视频蒙太奇模型，通过学习大量电影语料隐式捕捉电影“语法”，在推理时通过镜头约束解码算法从原始素材中选择最佳下一镜头，无需生成新帧。在镜头序列排序基准上达到最先进水平，用户研究也表明其编辑效果优于之前方法。
Motivation: 视频蒙太奇（将原始不可看素材剪辑成连贯电影序列）缺乏自动化的、数据驱动的解决方案，传统方法依赖手工规则。
Method: 使用长上下文自回归Transformer在大规模电影语料上训练，隐式学习电影编辑规律；推理时采用镜头约束解码算法，根据模型概率从输入原始素材中选择最佳下一镜头。
Result: 在镜头序列排序标准基准上超越先前最先进方法；用户研究显示FilmGPT的完整电影编辑任务表现显著优于先前方法。
Conclusion: FilmGPT可应用于多种视频蒙太奇任务，如自动片段裁剪和人在回路编辑，证明了自回归方法在电影编辑领域的有效性。

papers.title: MCPEvol-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agent Performance Across Dynamic Evolutions of MCP Servers
papers.abstract_en: As Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers emerge as the core infrastructure for connecting LLMs with external tools, existing benchmarks leverage real-world MCP servers to evaluate LLM agents' tool-using capabilities. However, these benchmarks overlook the continuous evolution of tool interfaces and functionalities within MCP servers, resulting in flawed assessments that fail to capture the agent's adaptability in changing tool landscapes. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MCPEvol-Bench}, a novel benchmark for evaluating the task-solving capabilities of LLM agents under dynamic toolset evolution. Inspired by large-scale empirical study, we propose 11 mutation operators to simulate realistic tool evolution within 123 MCP servers. We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art LLMs on multiple versions of MCP servers, revealing that even frontier models struggle to adapt to evolving tools. For instance, GPT-5.4 and Claude-Sonnet-4-6 exhibit performance declines of 13.7\% and 14.4\% in evolved MCP servers, respectively, accompanied by substantial increases in planning and reasoning errors. These findings highlight the vulnerability of LLM-driven workflows, establishing MCPEvol-Bench as a standard for evaluating agent adaptability in dynamic tool environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MCPEvol-Bench基准，用于评估LLM智能体在动态工具集演化下的任务解决能力。通过实证研究提出11种变异算子模拟真实工具演化，并在123个MCP服务器上对12个前沿LLM进行基准测试，发现即使是最先进的模型（如GPT-5.4和Claude-Sonnet-4-6）在演化后的MCP服务器上性能分别下降13.7%和14.4%，规划与推理错误显著增加。该基准旨在评估智能体在动态工具环境中的适应性。
Motivation: 现有基准使用真实MCP服务器评估LLM智能体，但忽略了工具接口和功能的持续演化，导致评估无法反映智能体在变化工具景观中的适应能力。
Method: 通过大规模实证研究，提出11种变异算子模拟MCP服务器中工具接口和功能的演化，构建包含123个MCP服务器多版本的基准MCPEvol-Bench。
Result: 在12个前沿LLM上的实验表明，GPT-5.4和Claude-Sonnet-4-6在演化后的MCP服务器上性能分别下降13.7%和14.4%，且规划与推理错误显著增加。
Conclusion: LLM驱动的工作流在动态工具环境中存在脆弱性，MCPEvol-Bench可作为评估智能体适应性的标准基准。

papers.title: Analytic Abduction: Causal Decomposition and Governed Commitment for Human--AI Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Abductive reasoning operates in two directions. The synthetic mode builds explanations from available hypotheses; the analytic mode, conversely, identifies the latent factors whose interaction accounts for a complex observed state. This paper develops the analytic mode as a non-greedy, risk-sensitive discipline of commitment, in which candidate factors coexist and interact, resolving into committed conclusions only when explicit governance conditions are met. The formal core is the $κ$-$τ$ apparatus: $κ$ encodes the epistemic interaction among hypotheses, and $τ$ sets a commitment threshold calibrated to the decision's stakes. The central contribution is the causal cluster, a structured object recording which latent factors participate in a decomposition, with what weights and interaction structure, together with a two-level architecture (intra-cluster $κ^*$, inter-cluster $κ^{**}$) that guards against causal misattribution. Demonstrated in epidemiological crisis decomposition and adversarial cyber threat analysis, the framework's contribution to human-AI reasoning is the legibility of suspended decomposition as a shared coordination object, providing structural resistance to premature convergence. In practice, the decision-maker is handed not a single imposed answer but the competing explanatory scenarios, weighted by plausibility and paired with the evidence that would resolve between them, so that sound action is possible even before the ambiguity is resolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分析溯因（analytic abduction）作为非贪心、风险敏感的承诺机制，通过κ-τ装置编码假设间的认知交互和基于决策风险的承诺阈值，并引入因果聚类（causal cluster）结构记录潜在因素及其权重与交互，配合两层架构（簇内κ*、簇间κ**）防止因果误归因。在流行病危机分解和网络威胁分析中展示框架效用，强调悬而未决的分解作为共享协调对象可提高人类-AI推理的可读性。
Motivation: 现有溯因推理主要采用合成模式（从假设构建解释），而分析模式——识别交互潜在因素以解释复杂状态——尚未得到充分形式化，且缺乏风险敏感的承诺纪律，容易过早收敛。
Method: 提出κ-τ形式化框架：κ编码假设间的认知交互（epistemic interaction），τ设置与决策风险匹配的承诺阈值。核心构建是因果聚类（causal cluster），记录参与分解的潜在因素及其权重和交互结构，并采用两层架构（簇内κ*、簇间κ**）避免因果误归因。
Result: 在流行病危机分解和对抗性网络威胁分析案例中演示了框架的有效性，展示了分解的悬置（suspended decomposition）作为共享协调对象如何提供对过早收敛的结构性抵抗。
Conclusion: 框架不提供单一答案，而是给出带权重的竞争性解释场景及区分证据，支持在歧义未消时做出合理行动，提升人类-AI协同推理的透明度和可信度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TIDE: Trustworthy and Interpretable Battery Degradation Estimation with Contextual Learning and Symbolic Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Battery health estimation is fundamental for battery management in battery-powered systems, where inaccurate health states may affect control, maintenance, and service life. It becomes even more critical in intelligent connected systems, where estimation errors can propagate across interconnected devices and downstream decisions. In this paper, we propose TIDE, a trustworthy and interpretable battery degradation estimator for reliable battery health estimation. TIDE jointly considers accuracy, trustworthiness, and interpretability, which are all essential for practical deployment and downstream decision making. To realize these objectives, TIDE combines battery-domain knowledge with operational measurements in a three-component backbone. A knowledge-guided degradation prior promotes trustworthy estimation, a monotone residual component provides interpretable aging-consistent refinement, and a contextual learning component captures battery-specific operational effects for improved accuracy. The trained backbone is then distilled into a compact symbolic surrogate that provides a concise model-level interpretation of its learned estimation logic. Experiments show that TIDE achieves strong estimation accuracy, improving overall estimation fidelity by an average of 19.7% over representative baselines. Its knowledge-guided prior and monotone residual modelling substantially reduce aging-consistency violations, supporting trustworthy estimation. Meanwhile, the backbone enables component-level interpretation, while symbolic distillation provides a compact model-level representation of the learned estimation logic. These results support the practical use of TIDE for battery health monitoring and decision support in intelligent connected systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TIDE，一种可信且可解释的电池退化估计方法，结合知识引导的退化先验、单调残差组件和上下文学习组件，并通过符号蒸馏获得模型级解释。实验表明，TIDE在估计精度上平均提升19.7%，同时显著减少老化一致性违规。
Motivation: 电池健康估计对电池管理系统至关重要，但现有方法在准确性、可信度和可解释性上难以兼顾，尤其在智能互联系统中估计误差可能级联传播。
Method: TIDE由三部分组成：知识引导的退化先验（提供可信估计）、单调残差组件（可解释的老化一致性修正）和上下文学习组件（捕捉电池特定操作效应）。训练后的模型通过符号蒸馏压缩为简洁的符号代理，提供模型级解释。
Result: 在代表性基准上，TIDE将估计保真度平均提升19.7%，知识引导先验和单调残差建模显著减少老化一致性违规，同时支持组件级和模型级解释。
Conclusion: TIDE在准确性、可信度和可解释性上取得了良好平衡，适合智能互联系统中的电池健康监测与决策支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Image-to-Point Cloud Registration Made Easy with Rectified Flow-based LiDAR Upsampling
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-Point Cloud Registration (I2P) is essential for integrating camera and LiDAR in perception and autonomous systems, yet the modality gap between images and point clouds makes it difficult to achieve both high accuracy and strong generalization. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective I2P method that treats LiDAR as an imaging sensor: from a single sparse LiDAR scan, we generate a dense LiDAR intensity image using Conditional Rectified Flow, match it with a camera image using a pre-trained feature matcher, and estimate the 6-DoF relative pose via PnP-RANSAC. The proposed model is pre-trained through a self-supervised image completion task and fine-tuned on a small amount of LiDAR data (neither image-point cloud pairs nor ground-truth sensor poses are required), enabling it to scale to diverse LiDAR and camera configurations. Experiments on the R3LIVE dataset show that the proposed method achieves a mean error of 4.89° / 1.63 m, outperforming existing methods, while completing a single registration in approximately 0.68 s.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种简洁的图像-点云配准方法，将LiDAR视为成像传感器：通过条件整流流（Conditional Rectified Flow）从单次稀疏LiDAR扫描生成密集LiDAR强度图像，利用预训练特征匹配器与相机图像匹配，经PnP-RANSAC估计6-DoF位姿。模型通过自监督图像补全预训练，并在少量LiDAR数据上微调，无需图像-点云对或真实传感器位姿。在R3LIVE数据集上，平均误差4.89°/1.63 m，单次配准约0.68秒，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 图像与点云之间的模态差距导致高精度与强泛化难以兼得，现有方法通常复杂或需大量配准数据。
Method: 使用条件整流流将稀疏LiDAR扫描上采样为密集强度图像，再与相机图像进行特征匹配，通过PnP-RANSAC求解位姿。训练采用自监督图像补全任务预训练，随后在少量LiDAR数据上微调，无需配准标签。
Result: 在R3LIVE数据集上达到平均误差4.89°/1.63 m，优于现有方法；单次配准耗时约0.68秒。
Conclusion: 该方法将LiDAR视为成像传感器，利用生成模型弥合模态差异，具有简单、高效、易扩展至不同传感器配置的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Action QFormer: Structured Representation Shaping under Action Supervision in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Action supervision in vision-language-action (VLA) models is often treated as a downstream objective for learning action prediction. In this paper, we study it instead as a force that shapes inherited multimodal representations. We show that this shaping has a dual effect: it is necessary for forming action-compatible representations, but when action supervision is applied too directly to the inherited multimodal pathway, it can also destabilize representations that support language-side processing and object grounding. To address this tension, we introduce Action QFormer, a query-based action-facing interface that uses instruction-conditioned queries to reorganize inherited multimodal information into action-facing representations before downstream action generation. In zero-shot sim-to-real navigation, Action QFormer improves average closed-loop task success from 18.8% to 56.3%, raises fixed-instruction action-generation correctness from 22.5% to 75.5%, and nearly eliminates out-of-distribution instruction generations. Further analyses show that Action QFormer changes how action supervision shapes inherited multimodal representations, reducing broad upstream rewriting while preserving targeted and sometimes constructive action-supervised adaptation. These results suggest that improving VLA performance requires not only stronger pretrained backbones, but also better ways of selecting and organizing inherited multimodal information while controlling how it is shaped under action supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中动作监督的作用，发现它既有利于形成动作兼容的表示，也可能破坏语言侧处理和物体定位的稳定性。为此提出 Action QFormer，一个查询式的动作接口，通过指令条件查询重组多模态表示为面向动作的表示。在零样本仿真到现实导航任务中，将闭环任务成功率从18.8%提升至56.3%，固定指令动作生成正确率从22.5%提升至75.5%，并几乎消除分布外指令生成。分析表明 Action QFormer 减少了动作监督对上游表示的广泛改写，同时保留了有建设性的适应。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型将动作监督仅作为学习动作预测的下游目标，忽略了其对继承的多模态表示的双重影响：既必要又可能破坏表示稳定性。
Method: 提出 Action QFormer，一种基于查询的动作接口，使用指令条件查询从继承的多模态信息中重组面向动作的表示，在动作生成前进行结构化重塑。
Result: 零样本仿真到现实导航中，闭环任务成功率从18.8%提升至56.3%，固定指令动作生成正确率从22.5%提升至75.5%，分布外指令生成几乎消除。
Conclusion: 改进VLA性能不仅依赖更强的预训练主干，还需要更好的方式选择和重组继承的多模态信息，并控制动作监督对其塑造的方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Criticality and reduced dynamical resilience in PM2.5 pollution systems
papers.abstract_en: Concentration-based metrics underpin air-quality assessment, while dynamical persistence and recovery describe how rapidly high-PM2.5 episodes dissipate and how strongly they retain memory. Here we introduce a finite-memory multiplicative reversion (FMMR) process that links the lognormal concentration backbone of PM2.5 variability with event recurrence, temporal memory, variance amplification and local dynamical resilience. Across station observations and reanalysis data, elevated PM2.5 regimes show a coherent set of critical signatures: stronger memory, rising autocorrelation, broader upper tails, amplified variance, reduced resilience and more clustered exceedance events. Together, these co-occurring signals reveal dynamical criticality in PM2.5 pollution systems, with critical slowing down expressed as a loss of restoring capacity under high-pollution conditions. A gridded comparison across populated and emission-influenced regions further shows that areas with similar PM2.5 burden can differ in recovery capacity, while eastern China has shifted toward higher resilience during recent air-quality improvements and India and West Africa occupy lower-resilience states. By identifying where pollution burden and recovery capacity diverge, these findings establish dynamical persistence and resilience as complementary dimensions of PM2.5 risk and provide a quantitative basis for resilience-oriented air-quality assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过有限记忆乘法回归（FMMR）过程，将PM2.5浓度的对数正态分布与事件复发、时间记忆、方差放大和局部动力学韧性联系起来。研究发现，高PM2.5状态呈现临界慢化特征，包括更强的记忆、上升的自相关、更宽的尾部、放大方差、降低韧性以及更聚集的超阈值事件。基于网格的比较显示，相同污染水平的区域恢复能力不同，而中国东部在近年空气质量改善中韧性提升，印度和西非则处于较低韧性状态。
Motivation: 现有空气质量评估主要基于浓度指标，缺乏对污染事件动态持续性和恢复能力的量化分析。本文旨在引入动力学韧性和记忆性作为PM2.5风险的新维度。
Method: 提出有限记忆乘法回归（FMMR）过程，结合对数正态浓度分布与事件复发、时间自相关及方差放大，用于表征PM2.5系统的动力学临界性和韧性。
Result: 观测和再分析数据表明，高PM2.5区域呈现一致临界信号：记忆增强、自相关上升、尾部更宽、方差放大、韧性下降、超阈值事件更聚集。中国东部韧性上升，印度和西非韧性较低。
Conclusion: 动力学持续性和韧性是PM2.5风险的互补维度，可为面向韧性的空气质量评估提供定量基础。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Knowing You at First Glance: Inferring Apparent Personality from Faces
papers.abstract_en: Inferring apparent personality from facial images is important in social scenarios for embodied agents in human-robot interaction. Unlike inferring intrinsic personality traits via conversation, this task models first-impression personality perception based solely on facial appearance before interaction begins. Existing studies mainly focus on the Big Five personality model and often rely on language or multimodal inputs. As a result, it remains unclear whether facial cues alone can support meaningful associations with perceived personality traits. This question is particularly relevant for MBTI types, which are widely used in practice and more readily interpretable by large language models. To this end, we propose \textbf{GlanceFace}, an end-to-end framework for apparent personality inference leveraging vision-language models to introduce semantic priors and a semantic-enhanced facial representation module to capture subtle personality-related cues, together with an uncertainty-aware learning strategy to handle noisy and subjective annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance on MBTI-based apparent personality benchmarks and reveal relationships between facial characteristics and perceived personality traits, highlighting its potential to support adaptive initial interaction strategies for embodied agents. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/MrHuan3/GlanceFace.
papers.comment: Accepted by The 9th Chinese Conference on Pattern Recognition and Computer Vision, PRCV2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GlanceFace框架，利用视觉-语言模型从面部图像推断外显人格（MBTI类型），通过语义增强的面部表示模块和不确定性感知学习策略，在MBTI人格基准上取得了强性能，揭示了面部特征与感知人格特质的关系。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注大五人格模型，且常依赖语言或多模态输入，不清楚仅凭面部特征能否支持与感知人格特质的有意义关联，尤其是对MBTI类型。
Method: 提出端到端框架GlanceFace，包含三个组件：利用视觉-语言模型引入语义先验、语义增强的面部表示模块捕捉细微人格相关线索、不确定性感知学习策略处理主观标注噪声。
Result: 在MBTI外显人格基准上取得了强性能，并揭示了面部特征与感知人格特质之间的关系。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了从面部图像推断人格的可行性，可支持具身智能体的自适应初始交互策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ExaGEMM: Exploration Framework for CPU-Driven ML Inference via Associative In-Register Computing for Low-Bit GEMM
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit GEMM is increasingly central to efficient ML inference, yet very-low-bit execution remains a poor fit for conventional CPUs. Practical deployment spans fragmented regimes-from 1/2/4-bit weights to varying activation precision-whose feasibility, reuse opportunity, and support cost differ under fixed SIMD and register-file budgets, making lightweight CPU support selection a first-class design problem. We present ExaGEMM, a workload-aware codesign and exploration framework for CPU-native low-bit GEMM via register-resident LUT execution. The key insight is that existing SIMD datapaths already cover table generation and accumulation; the only new hardware is an in-register select/feed mechanism with explicitly modeled cost. ExaGEMM co-explores parameterized kernels and lightweight SIMD ISA support using analytical models of register feasibility, compute cost, memory traffic, and hardware overhead, pruning the candidate space by 99.2% before simulation. It then identifies non-dominated support points and generates ISA specs, gem5 patches, and GEMM kernels for validation. Across representative ML models and CPU targets, ExaGEMM improves latency by 13.29x over software-only baselines, while showing that workload-aware frontier selection is especially important for mixed-precision LLM workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ExaGEMM，一种面向CPU的低比特GEMM协同设计与探索框架，通过寄存器内LUT执行实现加速。在代表性ML模型和CPU目标上，相比纯软件基线提升13.29倍延迟，并强调混合精度LLM工作负载中工作负载感知前沿选择的重要性。
Motivation: 现有CPU对极低比特GEMM支持不佳，实际部署涉及碎片化配置（1/2/4比特权重、可变激活精度），在固定SIMD和寄存器文件预算下可行性、复用机会和支持成本各异，需要轻量级CPU支持选择。
Method: 提出ExaGEMM，基于寄存器驻留LUT执行，利用现有SIMD数据通路进行表生成和累加，新增寄存器内选择/馈送机制并显式建模成本。通过参数化内核和轻量级SIMD ISA支持的共探索，使用分析模型评估寄存器可行性、计算成本、内存流量和硬件开销，在仿真前剪枝99.2%的候选空间，然后识别非支配支持点并生成ISA规格、gem5补丁和GEMM内核。
Result: 在代表性ML模型和CPU目标上，相比纯软件基线延迟提升13.29倍，且工作负载感知前沿选择对混合精度LLM工作负载尤为重要。
Conclusion: ExaGEMM展示了CPU原生低比特GEMM通过寄存器内LUT执行可实现显著加速，强调了工作负载感知设计的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PolyQ: Codesigning End-to-End Quantization Framework for Scalable Edge CPU LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: CPUs are the most universal target for on-device LLM inference, but existing low-bit quantization methods offer either coarse operating points or fine-grained mixed precision that is difficult to execute efficiently on CPUs. We present PolyQ, a CPU-oriented compiler/quantization co-design for activation-aware channel-wise bit allocation under a user-specified average-bit budget. PolyQ assigns per-channel bit-widths from $\{2,3,4,8,16\}$, then uses a compile-time model compiler to permute and cluster channels into bit-homogeneous blocks, generate SIMD- and LUT-compatible kernels, and merge compatible permutations across operators to keep layout regularization off the runtime path. This turns fine-grained budget fitting into a practical fractional-bit deployment method for CPU-only inference. Across Falcon-H1-3B, Llama2-13B, and Qwen3-32B on WikiText-2, PolyQ provides stable quality scaling from 3--6\,b and improves perplexity by 2.4--32.1\% over prior methods at a 3\,b target. End-to-end measurements on three representative CPUs -- workstation, laptop, and mobile -- show that compiler layout regularization reduces activation reorder traffic by up to 70.8\%, prefill latency and decode throughput scale nearly proportionally with the configured bit budget, and energy/token overhead stays below 2\% relative to an optimized LUT-based back-end. These results show that fractional-bit CPU deployment is practical, predictable, and energy-efficient across diverse edge targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyQ 是一个面向 CPU 的编译器与量化协同设计框架，用于在用户指定的平均位宽预算下实现激活感知的通道级位宽分配。它从 {2,3,4,8,16} 中为每个通道分配位宽，并通过编译时编译器对通道进行排列和聚类，生成兼容 SIMD 和 LUT 的内核，并在算子间合并排列以消除运行时布局开销。在 Falcon-H1-3B、Llama2-13B 和 Qwen3-32B 模型上，PolyQ 在 3-6 bit 范围内实现了稳定的质量缩放，在 3 bit 目标下困惑度比先前方法改善 2.4-32.1%；在三种 CPU（工作站、笔记本、移动设备）上，编译器布局正则化将激活重排流量减少达 70.8%，预填充延迟和解码吞吐量几乎与配置位宽预算成比例缩放，每 token 能量开销相对于优化后的 LUT 后端低于 2%。
Motivation: 现有低比特量化方法要么提供粗粒度的操作点，要么提供细粒度混合精度但难以在 CPU 上高效执行，导致 CPU 上的端侧 LLM 推理缺乏实用且可扩展的量化方案。
Method: 提出 PolyQ，一种面向 CPU 的编译器/量化协同设计，包含三个步骤：1）在用户指定平均位宽预算下进行激活感知的通道级位宽分配（从 {2,3,4,8,16} 中选择）；2）编译时编译器将通道排列并聚类为位宽同质块，生成 SIMD 和 LUT 兼容的内核；3）跨算子合并兼容排列以消除运行时布局正则化开销。
Result: 在 Falcon-H1-3B、Llama2-13B 和 Qwen3-32B 上，PolyQ 在 3-6 bit 范围内提供稳定质量，在 3 bit 目标下困惑度改善 2.4-32.1%。在三种 CPU 上，布局正则化减少激活重排流量达 70.8%，预填充延迟和吞吐量接近线性缩放，每 token 能量开销低于 2%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在多样化的边缘目标上，分数位宽（fractional-bit）CPU 部署是实用、可预测且能效高的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SportD: Can VLMs Physically Strategize?
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models have become increasingly capable of interpreting visual scenes, but it remains unclear whether they can use information to make strategically effective decisions. We investigate this question in soccer, where models observe the seconds preceding an on-ball decision and must choose whether to shoot or pass to a specific teammate. Unlike conventional visual-understanding tasks, soccer enables decisions to be evaluated quantitatively by estimating the value of every available action. We introduce SportD, a benchmark comprising 478 on-ball decisions from the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Each model choice is evaluated against a possession-value model that estimates the action that most increases the attacking team's probability of scoring, allowing us to measure both optimal-action accuracy and the value forfeited by suboptimal decisions. Across three frontier VLMs, the best selects the highest-valued action on 31.4% of events, compared with 38.9% for the professional players, and all models incur significantly greater regret. Further analysis reveals a systematic preference for lower-variance and lower-reward actions: VLMs shoot less often and select substantially less progressive passes than either the optimal policy or the real players. The models also reproduce the player's specific action above chance even when that action is suboptimal, suggesting partial imitation of familiar play patterns rather than consistent evaluation of counterfactual alternatives. SportD provides a value-grounded testbed for measuring physical strategic reasoning in VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SportD基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在足球场景中的物理策略推理能力。该基准包含478个2022年世界杯的持球决策，每个决策通过控球价值模型量化动作最优性和价值损失。测试三个前沿VLM发现，最佳模型在31.4%的事件中选择了最优化动作，低于职业球员的38.9%，且所有模型产生了显著更高的决策后悔值。模型表现出系统性偏差：偏好低方差低奖励动作，射门更少，选择更不激进的传球，并且部分模仿球员的特定动作（即使该动作次优）。
Motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在理解视觉场景方面越来越强，但它们在基于信息做出战略有效决策方面的能力尚不清楚。足球领域允许通过定量评估每个动作的价值来检验这种能力。
Method: 构建SportD基准，从2022年世界杯中提取478个持球决策片段。每个决策使用控球价值模型估计最有利于增加进攻方得分概率的动作，从而衡量最优动作准确率和因次优决策损失的价值。
Result: 三个前沿VLM中，最佳模型在31.4%的事件中选择最优化动作，低于职业球员的38.9%；所有模型表现出显著更高的后悔值。VLM系统性偏好低方差低奖励动作：射门频率更低，选择的传球比最优策略或真实球员更不激进。此外，模型在高于随机水平的程度上复制了球员的特定动作（即使该动作次优），表明存在部分模仿而非一致的反事实评估。
Conclusion: SportD提供了一个基于价值（value-grounded）的测试平台，用于衡量VLM的物理策略推理能力。当前VLM在决策质量上不如职业球员，并存在系统性偏差，倾向于低风险低回报动作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Correctness-Aware Advantage Shaping via Contrastive Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly uses entropy for advantage shaping. However, entropy cannot distinguish useful uncertainty from detrimental confusion, limiting its effectiveness as a correctness signal. We propose Contrastive Policy Optimization (CPO), which uses token-level contrastive disagreement between reference-guided and vanilla generation distributions for correctness-aware advantage shaping. Both theoretical and empirical results show that this disagreement reliably indicates token-level correctness. We further show that On-policy Distillation is a special case of CPO, where the posterior distribution is instantiated by an external teacher model. CPO also resolves the zero-advantage problem. Experiments on in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that CPO substantially outperforms entropy-based RLVR methods while maintaining strong generalization. Further analysis shows that correct and incorrect responses naturally support exploration and exploitation respectively, and balancing both leads to the best performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对比策略优化（CPO），利用参考引导分布与原始分布之间的token级对比不一致性进行正确感知的优势塑形，替代传统熵正则化。理论和实验表明该不一致性可靠指示token级正确性，并能解决零优势问题。在域内和域外基准上，CPO均显著优于基于熵的RLVR方法，且保持强泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统RLVR使用熵进行优势塑形，但熵无法区分有用的不确定性和有害的混淆，限制了其作为正确性信号的有效性。
Method: 提出Contrastive Policy Optimization (CPO)，通过参考引导与普通生成分布之间的token级对比不一致性来实现正确感知的优势塑形。
Result: 理论和实验证明该方法可靠指示token级正确性，解决零优势问题；在域内和域外基准上显著优于基于熵的RLVR方法，并保持强泛化能力。
Conclusion: CPO通过对比不一致性实现正确感知的优势塑形，优于熵基方法；正确和错误响应分别支持探索和利用，平衡两者可获得最佳性能。

papers.title: Angular Gaussian Supervised Contrastive Learning for Long-Tailed Electrocardiogram Arrhythmia Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed label distributions reduce the reliability of deep learning for electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia diagnosis, particularly for clinically important but rare abnormalities. Existing rebalancing and logit adjustment methods mainly address class frequency while overlooking direction-dependent morphological variability across ECG classes. This study proposes Angular Gaussian Supervised Contrastive Learning (AG-SCL) for long-tailed multi-label ECG diagnosis. AG-SCL integrates three components into a unified framework: an Angular Gaussian contrastive branch that models full-covariance class uncertainty on unit-normalized embeddings, Adaptive Logit Adjustment that learns bounded label-state-specific prior corrections instead of fixed frequency-based margins, and tail-aware augmentation that generates morphology-preserving views while protecting the 7-25 Hz QRS-dominant band. The method was evaluated on the public PTB-XL benchmark and a nocturnal ECG dataset comprising 1317 hours of recordings from 141 subjects. AG-SCL achieved the best macro-level performance on both datasets. On PTB-XL, it obtained a balanced accuracy of 0.838, sensitivity of 0.709, specificity of 0.968, mean average precision of 0.495, and TPR at 5% FPR of 0.778. On Noc-ECG, the corresponding values were 0.918, 0.889, 0.947, 0.488, and 0.900. The largest gains occurred in rare or morphologically unstable rhythm classes, while ablation studies confirmed the contributions of full-covariance modelling, Adaptive Logit Adjustment, and tail-aware augmentation. AG-SCL improves long-tailed ECG diagnosis by combining prior calibration with anisotropic representation learning, enhancing sensitivity to rare arrhythmias while maintaining clinically relevant specificity. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Open-EXG/AG-SCL-for-Long-Tailed-ECG.

papers.title: Bad Memory: Evaluating Prompt Injection Risks from Memory in Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: A growing class of agentic systems maintain persistent state across sessions through memory files, behavioral preferences, and knowledge bases. While this makes agents more useful and self-improving, it also creates a new attack surface for prompt injections in which malicious instructions can be embedded within persistent files and influence future behavior. In this work, we study prompt injection attacks in memory-based agentic systems using a sandboxed synthetic workspace. We evaluate two agentic systems, Anthropic Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, across four models: Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.2, and GPT-5.5. Our results show that although it is difficult to make an agent overwrite its own memory files using untrusted external content, payloads already planted in those files can successfully attack current and future sessions. Attack success and payload persistence vary substantially across systems, models, adversarial goals, and multi-session attack sequences. These findings show that persistent memory changes the threat model for prompt injection and motivate defenses that protect memory updates without removing useful agent adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于记忆的智能系统（如 Anthropic Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex）中的提示注入攻击风险。通过沙盒合成工作区实验发现，虽然利用不可信外部内容让智能体覆盖自身记忆文件较难，但已植入记忆文件的有效载荷能够成功攻击当前和未来会话。攻击成功率和载荷持久性因系统、模型、对抗目标和多会话攻击序列而异，表明持久记忆改变了提示注入的威胁模型，并激励在不移除有用智能体自适应能力的前提下保护内存更新的防御方法。
Motivation: 智能系统通过记忆文件、行为偏好和知识库保持跨会话持久状态，这创造了新的提示注入攻击面，恶意指令可嵌入持久文件影响未来行为。
Method: 在沙盒合成工作区中，对两个智能系统（Anthropic Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex）及四种模型（Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.2、GPT-5.5）进行提示注入攻击实验，评估有效载荷植入和攻击成功率。
Result: 实验表明，从外部不可信内容覆盖自身记忆文件困难，但已植入记忆文件的有效载荷能成功攻击当前和未来会话；攻击成功率和载荷持久性因系统、模型、对抗目标和多会话攻击序列存在显著差异。
Conclusion: 持久记忆改变了提示注入的威胁模型，需要在不移除有用自适应能力的前提下保护内存更新的防御措施。

papers.title: Auditing Fairness-Privacy Trade-offs: Subpopulation-Level Effects of Fairness-Enhancing Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) models deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare, law enforcement, and finance must satisfy not only utility requirements but also fairness and privacy guarantees. While prior work has largely examined how privacy-preserving techniques affect fairness, the inverse question-how fairness-enhancing algorithms influence privacy leakage-remains underexplored. We present the first comprehensive study of how fairness interventions affect membership inference privacy risks at the subpopulation level. By adapting the Likelihood Ratio Attack (LiRA) for subgroup auditing, we uncover privacy disparities that aggregate evaluations obscure. We further analyze how Differential Privacy (DP) interacts with fairness-enhancing methods across different categories, showing that DP's privacy benefits and utility costs are unevenly distributed across subpopulations. Our results demonstrate that fairness interventions do not uniformly increase privacy risk; their impact depends on model architecture, subgroup size, and mitigation strategy. These findings reveal that fairness, privacy, and utility must be jointly evaluated at the subpopulation level, and we introduce the first unified empirical framework to support such auditing in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究公平性增强算法在子群体层面如何影响成员推理隐私风险。通过将似然比攻击（LiRA）适配为子群体审计工具，揭示了聚合评估所掩盖的隐私差异，并分析了差分隐私（DP）与公平性方法在不同子群体间的交互作用。结果表明公平性干预的隐私影响取决于模型架构、子群体大小和缓解策略，并非均匀增加风险。
Motivation: 现有工作主要研究隐私保护技术对公平性的影响，而公平性增强算法如何影响隐私泄露的问题尚未被充分探索，尤其是在子群体层面。
Method: 将似然比攻击（LiRA）适配为子群体审计工具，分析公平性干预对成员推理隐私风险的影响，并研究差分隐私（DP）与公平性方法在不同子群体类别上的交互。
Result: 公平性干预并不统一增加隐私风险；其影响取决于模型架构、子群体大小和缓解策略。差分隐私的隐私收益和效用成本在子群体间分布不均。
Conclusion: 公平性、隐私和效用必须在子群体层面联合评估，并首次提出了一个统一的经验框架以支持这种审计实践。

papers.title: Accelerating A/B-Tests with Counterfactual Estimation: Reducing Variance through Policy Overlap
papers.abstract_en: Online controlled experiments are the gold standard for hypothesis testing in online platforms. Notwithstanding their ubiquity, they are notoriously expensive to run, and issues of variance hamper statistical power in assessing treatment effects. While standard variance reduction techniques leverage model-based control variates to reduce outcome noise, they remain agnostic to potential structural relationships between competing policies. In this work, we identify a critical inefficiency in the standard A/B-testing protocol: when a treatment and control policy agree on an action, the resulting outcome contributes noise but no signal regarding the treatment effect -- unnecessarily inflating confidence intervals. We propose a novel experimental protocol that exploits this policy overlap to accelerate experimentation. The key insight is to frame the randomised treatment assignment mechanism as a meta-policy, and leverage $Δ$-Off-Policy Estimation methods to obtain unbiased estimates for average treatment effects. We prove analytically that our approach recovers standard A/B-testing practices in the general case, but that its variance scales with the divergence between policies rather than raw outcome variance. Hence, we dominate the standard Difference-in-Means estimator whenever policies have common support, and the improvement is strict whenever the overlap region contributes non-zero residual variance. Empirical results corroborate these theoretical insights -- holding promise for significant impact on the real-world evaluation of recommender systems, information retrieval pipelines, and large language model interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用处理策略与对照策略之间的重叠（policy overlap）来加速A/B测试的方法。通过将随机处理分配机制视为元策略并应用Δ-Off-Policy估计，获得平均处理效应的无偏估计，其方差与策略间的散度成比例而非结果方差。理论证明该方法在策略有共同支持时优于标准均值差估计器，实证结果支持该方法的有效性，预计对推荐系统、信息检索和LLM接口的评估有显著影响。
Motivation: 标准A/B测试中，当处理策略与对照策略选择相同动作时，结果仅贡献噪声而不提供关于处理效应的信号，导致置信区间不必要的变宽。现有方差缩减技术未利用策略间的结构关系，存在效率低下问题。
Method: 将随机处理分配机制建模为元策略，利用Δ-Off-Policy估计方法获得平均处理效应的无偏估计。该方法的方差与策略之间的散度（而非原始结果方差）成比例。
Result: 理论上证明在一般情况下该方法恢复标准A/B测试结果，但当策略存在重叠区域且该区域贡献非零残差方差时，方差严格减小。实证结果验证了理论推断。
Conclusion: 通过利用策略重叠可以显著减小A/B测试的方差，从而加速实验进程。该方法对在线平台中的假设测试（如推荐系统、检索流水线和LLM界面评估）具有实际意义。

papers.title: Hough-SIFT: Robust Image Registration for Linear Structures via Hough Space
papers.abstract_en: Image registration is essential in applications such as electronic image stabilization. Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), a widely used local keypoint detector and descriptor, typically provides accurate registration; however, it often fails in scenes with strong linear structures (e.g., shutters), where local features become ambiguous. We propose Hough-SIFT, a robust registration method that performs SIFT descriptor matching in Hough space. In this domain, linear structures form distinctive peaks that restore descriptor discriminability. Experiments demonstrate that Hough-SIFT is robust in linear scenes where SIFT frequently fails, while maintaining accuracy comparable to SIFT in normal scenes.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 6 figures. Supplementary video is available as an ancillary file. Accepted for oral presentation at the 29th Meeting on Image Recognition and Understanding (MIRU2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hough-SIFT，一种在 Hough 空间中进行 SIFT 描述符匹配的图像配准方法。针对强线性结构（如百叶窗）场景中 SIFT 特征模糊的问题，Hough 空间中的线性结构形成独特峰值来恢复描述符分辨能力。实验表明，该方法在 SIFT 经常失败的线性场景中表现鲁棒，同时在正常场景中保持与 SIFT 相当的精度。
Motivation: SIFT 在具有强线性结构的场景中容易失效，因为局部特征变得模糊，需要一种针对线性结构的鲁棒配准方法。
Method: 将图像变换到 Hough 空间，在该空间中进行 SIFT 描述符匹配。Hough 空间中线性结构形成清晰峰值，从而增强描述符的可区分性。
Result: 实验显示 Hough-SIFT 在线性场景中鲁棒性强于 SIFT，在正常场景中精度与 SIFT 相当。
Conclusion: Hough-SIFT 在保持 SIFT 原有优势的同时，有效改善了线性结构场景下的配准可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MagicPrompt: Ultra-Lightweight Prompt Tuning for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale video diffusion models (VDMs) deliver strong generation performance, but full fine-tuning for downstream tasks incurs prohibitive computational costs. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods have two critical flaws on billion-scale models: they still require substantial trainable parameters, and reward-based training suffers from noise-induced optimization instability in condition-guided tasks. We propose MagicPrompt, a lightweight framework that achieves extreme parameter efficiency and stable reward optimization. It first adopts Attention-Embedded Prompt Tuning, which steers generation via lightweight soft prompts with orders of magnitude fewer parameters while preserving pre-trained knowledge. It further introduces Dual-Space Reward Feedback Optimization, which uses self-supervised latent objectives to improve condition-guided reward training. Experiments show MagicPrompt reaches competitive performance with less than 1\% trainable parameters and notably reduces training costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MagicPrompt 是一种针对视频扩散模型的超轻量级提示调优框架，通过注意力嵌入的提示调优 (Attention-Embedded Prompt Tuning) 和双空间奖励反馈优化 (Dual-Space Reward Feedback Optimization) 实现极低的参数量和稳定的奖励优化，在保持生成性能的同时大幅降低训练成本。
Motivation: 现有大规模视频扩散模型在微调时计算成本过高，而参数高效微调方法在十亿级模型上仍需要大量可训练参数，且基于奖励的训练在条件引导任务中易受噪声影响导致优化不稳定。
Method: 提出 MagicPrompt，包含两个核心组件：1) 注意力嵌入的提示调优，通过轻量级软提示 (soft prompts) 以数量级更少的参数引导生成，同时保留预训练知识；2) 双空间奖励反馈优化，利用自监督潜在目标改进条件引导奖励训练的稳定性。
Result: 实验表明 MagicPrompt 使用不到 1% 的可训练参数即可达到有竞争力的性能，并显著降低训练成本。
Conclusion: MagicPrompt 提供了一种极端参数效率且稳定的视频扩散模型微调方案，在保持生成能力的同时显著减少计算开销。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: MagicPrompt 是一种针对视频扩散模型的超轻量级提示调优框架，通过注意力嵌入的提示调优 (Attention-Embedded Prompt Tuning) 和双空间奖励反馈优化 (Dual-Space Reward Feedback Optimization) 实现极低的参数量和稳定的奖励优化，在保持生成性能的同时大幅降低训练成本。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有大规模视频扩散模型在微调时计算成本过高，而参数高效微调方法在十亿级模型上仍需要大量可训练参数，且基于奖励的训练在条件引导任务中易受噪声影响导致优化不稳定。

summary_sections.conclusion: MagicPrompt 提供了一种极端参数效率且稳定的视频扩散模型微调方案，在保持生成能力的同时显著减少计算开销。

papers.title: Memory-Driven Self-Disclosure and Relational Turning Points: A Longitudinal Multimodal Study of Human-AI Interaction
papers.abstract_en: As conversational AI systems are designed for repeated use, a central question is how a series of interactions becomes a relationship. We present a longitudinal multimodal study of a memory-augmented conversational agent (24 participants x 10 sessions), in which participants rated five relational constructs -- familiarity, self-disclosure, perceived memory, conversational quality, and enjoyment -- after each session. Two complementary dynamics emerge. First, conversational quality strongly shapes how enjoyable a session feels in the moment but does not carry forward across sessions, whereas perceived memory is relationally conditioned -- predicted by prior relational state rather than reflecting system capability alone -- and it shapes later enjoyment indirectly, via subsequent self-disclosure. Second, relationships are punctuated by discrete turning points -- crashes and surges -- that are partially traceable in multimodal behavior and open different intervention windows: surges are more behaviorally detectable in the moment, enjoyment surges persist more reliably than enjoyment crashes recover, and some crashes are better forecast from person-specific behavioral drift than detected after they have already occurred. Together, the findings suggest that longitudinal human-AI relationships are built through both slow accumulation and abrupt turning points.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to ICMI 2026 (International Conference on Multimodal Interaction), October 5-9, 2026, Napoli, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过纵向多模态实验（24名参与者，每人10次对话）研究记忆增强的对话智能体如何与人建立关系。参与者每次会话后评估熟悉度、自我披露、感知记忆、对话质量和享受度。发现对话质量即时影响享受度但不跨会话传递，而感知记忆受先前关系状态影响，并通过后续自我披露间接影响后期享受度。关系的发展既有缓慢积累，也有由行为信号可检测的突变（崩溃与激增）。
Motivation: 随着对话AI被设计为重复使用，了解多轮交互如何演变为关系至关重要。现有研究多聚焦单次交互，缺乏对长期关系动态的纵向理解。
Method: 设计了一个记忆增强的对话智能体，进行10次会话的纵向实验，每次会话后收集五种关系构念的评分，并分析多模态行为数据（可能包括语音、面部表情等）以检测关系转折点。
Result: 对话质量即时影响享受度但无跨会话效应；感知记忆由先前关系状态预测，而非仅系统能力；关系存在可部分通过多模态行为追踪的突变（崩溃与激增），激增更易实时检测，崩溃可从个体行为漂移中预测。
Conclusion: 人机长期关系通过缓慢积累和突然转折共同构建，感知记忆和转折点的可检测性为设计自适应交互提供了窗口。

papers.title: Governing Artificial Intelligence: Public Preferences and Regulatory Options
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming economies, societies, and polities, raising fundamental questions about how it should be regulated. Policymakers face choices over whether to prioritize innovation or safety, rely on public oversight or private self-regulation, and govern nationally or internationally. Yet little is known about how citizens evaluate these competing priorities. Here we report a conjoint survey experiment conducted in seven countries with diverse political and economic profiles. We find that citizens strongly support regulating AI and generally prioritize safety over innovation, public governance over private self-regulation, and international over national approaches. The preference for safety is strongest among those who perceive AI as risky, unpredictable, and personally consequential. These findings reveal a systematic misalignment between dominant regulatory approaches and citizen preferences.
papers.comment: Main paper 16 pages; supplementary materials 51 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项在七个国家的联合调查实验（conjoint survey experiment），研究公民对人工智能监管的各种优先选项（创新 vs 安全、公共监督 vs 自我监管、国家 vs 国际）的偏好。结果发现公民强烈支持监管AI，普遍优先考虑安全而非创新、公共治理而非私人自我监管、国际方法而非国家方法。这些偏好与主流监管方法存在系统性的不一致。
Motivation: 政策制定者在AI监管中面临权衡（创新 vs 安全、公共监督 vs 自我监管、国家 vs 国际），但公民如何评价这些竞争优先级尚不清楚。
Method: 在七个政治经济背景各异的国家进行联合调查实验（conjoint survey experiment）。
Result: 公民强烈支持监管AI，优先考虑安全、公共治理和国际方法；对安全的偏好在认为AI有风险、不可预测且对个人有重大影响的人群中最强。
Conclusion: 这些发现揭示了主流监管方法与公民偏好之间的系统性错位。

papers.title: MathCoPilot: An Interactive System for Human-AI Symbiotic Paradigm of Mathematical Research
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM-based theorem provers have achieved impressive results on formal mathematics benchmarks, yet they remain confined to acting as autonomous agents that prove a stated proposition. In this paper, we propose MathCoPilot, a human-in-the-loop system that embodies a new human--AI symbiotic paradigm for mathematical research, in which the mathematician steers the high-level mathematical direction while AI agents carry out the detailed formalization and proof work under continuous human guidance. MathCoPilot unifies three core capabilities: (1) an interactive workbench where the mathematician and AI agents collaborate through a living proof blueprint that decomposes a proof into navigable steps the human can directly inspect, direct, and refine; (2) automated proving skill orchestration with adaptive knowledge base search and Lean-integrated iterative verification; and (3) topic-driven paper retrieval and automated formalization into a verified Lean knowledge base. Using MathCoPilot, we systematically compare four state-of-the-art LLMs, including Gemini~3.1~Pro, GPT-5.4, and Claude~Opus~4.7, on a FormalMATH subset and on two real PDE theorems requiring deep domain expertise, evaluating their ability to produce verified Lean~4 proofs and to identify errors in deliberately incorrect proofs. Our results show that while current models can handle undergraduate-level problems with high success rates under favorable autoformalization conditions, substantial challenges remain for domain-specific theorems requiring genuine mathematical understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MathCoPilot 是一个人机协同系统，旨在改变当前基于LLM的定理证明器仅作为自主智能体的局限，让数学家主导数学方向而AI负责形式化与证明细节。该系统通过交互式工作台、自动化证明编排和主题驱动论文检索三大能力，支持人类持续指导。在FormalMATH子集和两个真实PDE定理上评估了Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.7等模型，发现它们在本科级别问题上表现良好，但在需要真正数学理解的领域特定定理上仍面临挑战。
Motivation: 现有LLM定理证明器仅限于自主证明给定命题，缺乏人类引导和深层数学理解，难以处理需要专业知识的高阶定理。
Method: 提出MathCoPilot系统，包含三个核心能力：(1) 交互式工作台，支持人类与AI通过可导航的证明蓝图协作；(2) 自动化证明技能编排，结合自适应知识库搜索和Lean集成迭代验证；(3) 主题驱动论文检索与自动形式化，构建经过验证的Lean知识库。
Result: 在FormalMATH子集和两个真实PDE定理上的实验表明，当前模型在本科级别问题上有高成功率，但对于需要深度领域专业知识的定理，仍然存在显著挑战。
Conclusion: 虽然现有模型在有利的自动形式化条件下能处理本科问题，但领域特定定理的真正数学理解仍是重大挑战。

papers.title: Multi-LLM Collaborative MRI Report Generation for Visual Instruction Tuning in Brain Oncology
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and their extension to vision-language models (VLMs) have made it easier to combine text and images for tasks such as report generation. Existing VLMs in medicine typically focus on 2D images (chest X-rays), and their extension to 3D imaging has been difficult because of the lack of paired 3D imaging-text data. Thus, we introduce a new method for creating a 3D image-text dataset for brain oncology using 3D MRI scans of glioma and meningioma cases. We use a cooperative system in which several LLMs work together to generate and check reports, ensuring that they are accurate and clear. By leveraging the new 3D MRI-text dataset, we further build a VLM that converts MRI scans into tokens and aligns them with text instructions. Our VLM performed better in report generation and visual question answering tasks than other 2D and 3D methods. Our method not only improves the quality of reports but also helps with better diagnosis and treatment in brain oncology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑肿瘤领域3D MRI影像与文本配对数据缺乏的问题，提出一种多LLM协作生成并校验报告的方法，构建新的3D MRI-文本数据集，并基于该数据集训练视觉语言模型（VLM）。在脑肿瘤MRI报告生成和视觉问答任务上，该VLM表现优于其他2D和3D方法。
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型主要聚焦2D影像（如胸部X光片），缺乏3D影像与文本的配对数据，限制了在脑肿瘤等3D成像领域的应用。
Method: 提出多LLM协作系统，多个大语言模型（LLM）共同生成并校验报告，确保准确性和清晰度；利用生成的3D MRI-文本数据集训练VLM，将MRI扫描转换为令牌并与文本指令对齐。
Result: 在脑肿瘤MRI报告生成和视觉问答任务上，所提VLM优于其他2D和3D方法。
Conclusion: 该方法不仅提高了报告质量，还有助于脑肿瘤的诊断和治疗。

papers.title: Advanced Image Generation: Negative Prompt Optimization and Latent Classifier Guidance
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel system that integrates negative prompt optimization via a fine-tuned sequence-to-sequence LLM and latent-space classifier guidance to improve the quality of images generated by Stable Diffusion. Our approach automatically generates optimized negative prompts, and employs a CNN-RNN hybrid classifier to evaluate and guide diffusion steps, rolling back low-quality latent updates. Experimental results demonstrate that our dual-guidance framework reduces artifacts and improves semantic fidelity compared to baseline diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个双引导框架，通过微调序列到序列大语言模型（seq2seq LLM）自动优化负面提示，并利用CNN-RNN混合分类器在潜在空间评估扩散步骤，回滚低质量更新，从而提升Stable Diffusion生成图像的质量。实验表明，该方法能减少伪影并提高语义保真度。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型生成的图像常存在伪影或语义偏差，缺乏有效的自动引导机制来优化生成过程。
Method: 集成两个模块：一是基于微调seq2seq LLM的负面提示优化器，自动生成改进的负面提示；二是潜在空间分类器引导，使用CNN-RNN混合分类器在每个扩散步骤评估潜在状态，回滚评分低下的更新。
Result: 实验结果显示，该双引导框架相比基线扩散模型减少了图像伪影，并提升了语义保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提双引导框架能有效提高扩散模型生成质量，但未讨论泛化性及计算开销。

papers.title: Skeleton: Visual Authoring of Non-visual Data Experiences
papers.abstract_en: When sighted practitioners author accessible data visualizations, they build navigation structures (the nodes, edges, and input bindings that govern how assistive technologies traverse an interface) entirely in code, with no visual representation. Without a representation to react to, practitioners cannot develop judgment about what makes navigation good or bad, and the quality ceiling of non-visual experiences is set by the absence of a feedback loop. We address this problem through longitudinal co-design with practitioners across cartography, design systems, and open-source visualization, and make three contributions. First, we introduce an Inspector that renders navigation graphs as interactive node-link diagrams, and a Dimensions API that expresses navigation in terms of data dimensions rather than explicit graph construction. Second we present Skeleton, a direct-manipulation authoring environment in which the properties of an accessible navigation structure are translated into visual representations authors can observe and manipulate. Key techniques include a dual-view editor that simultaneously shows the system's navigation model and the end user's spatial experience, a scaffolding engine that automates spatial node placement by repurposing a visualization rendering pipeline, a live label-template editor with real-time screen-reader-output preview, and a testing mode that makes traversal sequence visually trackable. Third, we evaluate Skeleton through an in-situ study with 8 practitioners across visualization design, engineering, and research. Making navigation structure visible changed how practitioners engaged with accessible design: they reconsidered the architecture of their own visualizations, attended to a broader range of input modalities, and shifted from treating accessibility as a compliance task to treating it as a design problem. (abstract shortened for arxiv)
papers.comment: 9 pages core, 2 pages acknowledgements + references, 4 pages appendices. Accepted at IEEE VIS 2026, to appear in November 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无障碍数据可视化创作中导航结构不可见的问题，通过纵向协同设计提出Skeleton系统。Skeleton将无障碍导航结构转化为可视的节点-链接图，并提供直接操作环境，包括双视图编辑器、脚手架引擎、实时标签模板编辑器和测试模式。通过8位从业者的实地研究，发现可视化导航结构改变了从业者对待无障碍设计的方式，将其从合规任务转变为设计问题。
Motivation: 有视觉能力的从业者在创作无障碍数据可视化时，只能通过代码构建导航结构（节点、边、输入绑定），缺乏视觉反馈，导致无法判断导航质量的好坏，无障碍体验的质量上限受限于反馈循环的缺失。
Method: 通过纵向协同设计（与制图、设计系统、开源可视化领域的从业者合作），提出Skeleton系统：引入Inspector将导航图渲染为交互式节点-链接图；提供Dimensions API以数据维度表达导航；构建直接操作环境，包括双视图编辑器（同时显示导航模型和终端用户空间体验）、脚手架引擎（重用可视化渲染管线自动生成空间节点）、实时标签模板编辑器（带实时屏幕阅读器输出预览）以及测试模式（使遍历序列可视化可追踪）。
Result: 与8位从业者（可视化设计、工程、研究领域）的实地研究表明，使导航结构可见改变了从业者参与无障碍设计的方式：他们重新考虑自身可视化的架构，关注更广泛的输入模态，并将无障碍从合规任务视为设计问题。
Conclusion: 将导航结构可视化能够建立反馈循环，提升无障碍数据体验的质量，并转变从业者的设计思维。

papers.title: Sharp Stability Threshold and Certification for Designing Stable Residual Architectures
papers.abstract_en: We propose \emph{the sublinear-growth principle} for deep residual architectures -- a sharp stability threshold on the input-magnitude exponent of every residual block's velocity field: $$\|v(x, t)\| \leq c\,\|x\|^q + b, \qquad q \in [0, 1].$$ The threshold $q = 1$ is established via two independent arguments. Classical ODE theory gives a global forward flow on $[0, T]$ at $q \le 1$ and exhibits divergent velocity fields at any $q > 1$. The optimal-control analysis, via the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation, sharpens this to a selection statement: the training optimum is bang-bang on the boundary of the admissible class, so the optimum at $q > 1$ blows up while the optimum at $q \le 1$ is safe by construction. The exponent criterion $q \le 1$ is thereby a necessary and sufficient condition for stable training. It clarifies architectural placements that ensure the stability of training and inference, explaining, for instance, the stabilizing role of layer normalization. The sublinear-growth velocity fields form \emph{the right function space} on which forward dynamics, adjoint sensitivity, and architectural composition are all well-controlled. An arithmetic of input-magnitude exponents under the five operations that build residual blocks enables efficient certification of $q_k \le 1$ at the level of architectural primitives, in place of ad hoc trial and error in the search for stable neural architectural designs. A parameter-free modification reduces the supercritical Mamba block from $q = 5$ to $q = 1$ without layer normalization, demonstrating this point. Experiments on Mamba and PatchTST confirm that the $q \le 1$ variants train stably: the criterion is the input-magnitude exponent, not the presence of a normalization layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度残差架构的亚线性增长原理 (sublinear-growth principle)，为残差块的速度场设定一个尖锐的稳定性阈值：$\|v(x, t)\| \leq c\|x\|^q + b$，其中 $q \in [0, 1]$。通过常微分方程理论和最优控制分析，证明 $q \leq 1$ 是稳定训练的充要条件，$q > 1$ 则导致发散。该准则为架构设计（如层归一化的稳定作用）提供了理论基础，并展示了无需归一化即可将 Mamba 块的指数从 $q=5$ 降至 $q=1$ 的无参数修改。实验在 Mamba 和 PatchTST 上确认 $q \leq 1$ 的变体训练稳定。
Motivation: 深度残差网络的训练稳定性问题缺乏严格的数学界限；现有设计常依赖试错或归一化层，但缺乏对稳定性根本原因的理论理解。
Method: 提出亚线性增长原理，通过两套独立论证（经典 ODE 全局存在性分析和 HJB 方程最优控制分析）确定阈值 $q=1$，并给出残差块构建操作的指数算术规则，从而在架构原语层面高效认证 $q_k \leq 1$。
Result: 理论证明 $q \leq 1$ 是稳定训练的必要且充分条件；实验显示无归一化的 Mamba 变体在 $q=1$ 时训练稳定，而 PatchTST 上 $q \leq 1$ 准则同样有效。
Conclusion: 亚线性增长准则为设计稳定残差架构提供了可操作的理论工具，取代了试错式搜索；但摘要未涉及泛化性能或大规模验证。
Relevance: 0
