papers.title: Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction of Unordered Input with Global Consistency
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the method of choice for reconstructing and real-time rendering of captured scenes. To capture a scene with good visual quality, continuous image sequences are usually combined with out-of-order shots for better scene coverage. Structure from motion can reconstruct such captures, but only after they are all available and often with high computational cost. Incremental reconstruction methods -- often derived from SLAM solutions -- provide immediate feedback, but cannot handle the out-of-order capture we require. We provide the first immediate feedback solution for such radiance field capture that provides global consistency. We first introduce a method for fast matching in out-of-order sequences, by repurposing visual place recognition models and a covisibility graph, and provide an efficient way to find highly connected keyframes, improving quality even for ordered sequences. We show how these steps -- together with GPU optimization and careful Gaussian primitive placement -- provide fast local reconstruction, in our challenging radiance field reconstruction case. We then introduce a novel cluster-based method, again using the covisibility graph, to provide efficient loop closure that does not require sequential input. Finally, to handle large scenes in our context, we introduce a progressive hierarchy that allows our method to scale to large environments, without compromising efficiency. Our results show we provide immediate feedback 3DGS reconstruction with good visual quality in several datasets, with up to thousands of input images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个能即时反馈的无序输入3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)重建方法，利用视觉地点识别和共视性图实现快速匹配与局部重建，通过聚类闭环和渐进层次扩展到大场景，在多个数据集上取得良好视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有3DGS重建需要有序图像序列或完整采集后处理，无法处理无序拍摄且提供即时反馈。
Method: 采用视觉地点识别模型和共视性图进行无序序列快速匹配，通过GPU优化和精确高斯点放置实现快速局部重建；提出基于共视性图的聚类闭环方法，无需顺序输入；引入渐进层次结构支持大场景缩放。
Result: 在包含数千张图像的数据集上实现即时反馈的3DGS重建，视觉质量良好。
Conclusion: 该方法为无序图像采集提供首个即时且全局一致的辐射场重建方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One-Shot Generative Design for Disordered Metamaterials via Self-Organizing Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Disordered metamaterials feature microstructures with inherent randomness and irregularity, enabling them to achieve broader property coverage and superior performance unavailable in their regular counterparts. Despite their promise, designing disordered microstructures is substantially harder than designing regular ones. Their design remains trapped between manual parameterizations with limited expressiveness, and generative AI that is data-hungry and struggles to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose a generative design framework based on Neural Cellular Automata that dynamically grows complex microstructures through learned local interaction rules, inspired by the self-organizing processes in natural materials. This framework requires only a single training template, yet accommodates diverse disordered microstructures and adapts to irregular domains and arbitrary discretizations. By manipulating the learned local rules, we can steer the growth process to generate microstructures unseen during training, providing control over orientation, anisotropy, and directional thickness without retraining. As a dynamic, local growth process, it naturally produces spatially varying microstructures that transition smoothly to enable location-specific mechanical properties. We demonstrate this in a multiscale mechanical cloaking design, where microstructures vary across the space to meet an optimized heterogeneous property distribution. Our design enables excellent cloaking performance without complicated post-processing and incompatible assembly common in existing methods. This data-efficient, generalizable approach opens access to previously intractable disordered materials for biomedical implants and soft robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于神经细胞自动机 (Neural Cellular Automata) 的生成式设计框架，用于无序超材料 (disordered metamaterials) 的微观结构设计。该框架仅需单个训练模板，即可生成多样化的无序微观结构，能适应不规则区域和任意离散化，并通过操控局部生长规则控制取向、各向异性和方向厚度，无需重训练。多尺度力学隐身设计展示了其生成空间变化微观结构以实现局部力学性能的能力。
Motivation: 无序超材料的微观结构设计难度大，现有方法要么受限于手工参数化表达力不足，要么依赖数据驱动的生成 AI，数据需求大且泛化能力差。本文旨在提出一种数据高效、可泛化的设计方法。
Method: 基于神经细胞自动机构建生成式设计框架，通过学习的局部相互作用规则动态生长复杂微观结构，模仿自然材料的自组织过程。仅需一个训练模板，通过操纵局部规则来引导生长过程，生成训练中未见过的结构。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称在多尺度力学隐身设计中实现了优异的隐身性能，无需复杂的后处理和不兼容的组装。
Conclusion: 该框架数据高效、可泛化，为生物医学植入物和软体机器人等应用中之前难以处理的元序材料设计开辟了途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Tokens Compete? Token Representations against Supervised CNN Backbones for BirdCLEF+ 2026
papers.abstract_en: This paper details the DS@GT ARC team's approach to BirdCLEF+ 2026, multi-label detection of animal vocalizations in soundscapes from the Pantanal wetlands. The 2026 edition adds about an hour of labeled soundscapes, shifting the task toward supervised pipelines fit to the labeled set. First, we build a competitive supervised baseline that ensembles a frozen Perch v2 backbone, a trained HGNetV2-B0 sound-event-detection network, and a non-bird prototypical head, reaching a private leaderboard score of 0.936 at rank 1894 within a 90-minute CPU budget. Second, we ask whether token-based representations can compete, contrasting codec representations from neural audio codecs against semantic representations from foundational embeddings. We compare two bioacoustic specialist models against four token-based encoders trained on AudioSet. The repository for this work can be found at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/birdclef-2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文详细介绍了DS@GT ARC团队在BirdCLEF+ 2026竞赛中的方法，该竞赛涉及潘塔纳尔湿地声景中动物发声的多标签检测。2026版增加了约一小时的标注声景，使任务转向针对标注集的监督流程。首先构建了一个竞争性监督基线，集成了冻结的Perch v2骨干网络、训练过的HGNetV2-B0声音事件检测网络以及非鸟类原型头部，在90分钟CPU预算内达到私有排行榜0.936分（排名1894）。其次，探讨了基于token的表示是否能与监督CNN骨干竞争，对比了神经音频编解码器的编码表示与基础嵌入的语义表示，比较了两个生物声学专家模型和四个基于AudioSet训练的token编码器。
Motivation: BirdCLEF+ 2026竞赛增加了标注数据，使得监督方法成为主导；同时希望探索基于token的表示（如神经音频编解码器）是否能在声学识别任务中与监督CNN骨干竞争。
Method: 构建了一个集成冻结Perch v2、HGNetV2-B0以及非鸟类原型头的监督基线；另外对比了多种token编码器（包括生物声学专家模型和通用音频编码器）与语义嵌入的性能。
Result: 监督基线在私有排行榜上达到0.936分（排名1894），计算预算有限。token表示与监督CNN骨干的比较结果未在摘要中明确给出数值。
Conclusion: 短文表明在有限计算资源下，简单的集成就可以取得有竞争力的分数。token表示与监督骨干的对比可能揭示了不同表示方式的优劣。

papers.title: G$^2$SR: Geometric Methods for Fast and Memory-Efficient Gaussian-based Surface Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Few-view surface reconstruction recovers the visible surfaces of a scene from a few posed RGB images, providing the 3D models that robots need to explore and interact online. On mobile platforms, the reconstruction must be fast and geometrically accurate while keeping a small memory footprint to ensure safe and efficient operation. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a high-fidelity scene representation, but building it from a few views is ill-posed, as many distinct surfaces reproduce the same images, making traditional photometric methods prone to "floater" artifacts. End-to-end methods resolve the ambiguity by regressing splats with large, usually Transformer-based, networks that require heavy compute and memory while generalizing poorly to new scenes. We propose G2SR, which exploits a well-posed core of the task: given cross-view 2D splat correspondences, 3D splats follow analytically from multi-view geometry. G2SR employs a lightweight neural frontend to detect and track 2D Gaussian splats on the image plane and an analytic backend to triangulate each into a metric-scale 3D splat. On ScanNet, Replica, and DTU, G2SR matches or exceeds the geometric accuracy of state-of-the-art end-to-end methods while running at 69-89 reconstructions per second within 203 MB of GPU memory (5-107x less) for 2- and 3-view inputs at 384 x 512 resolution, offering a practical path to online Gaussian-based surface reconstruction.

papers.title: Interleaved Noise Injection Improves Clean, Corrupted, and OOD Performance
papers.abstract_en: Noise injection is a well-known technique in stochastic optimization. We report its surprising effectiveness with an interleaved (on-off-on-off...) rather than the usual monotonic decay schedule. We present a theoretical analysis of noise injection, which confirms that corruption by impulse noise approximates a Jacobian regularization, whereas Gaussian noise acts as a curvature penalty. This regularization behavior has been invoked to explain why noise injection increases model robustness. But the interleaved nature of our proposed schedule produces superior results even for the optimization objective: mixing phases of noisy data permits the optimizer to escape local minima and increase exploration without the risk of catastrophically forgetting the important features from the clean data. To stabilize this training scheme against the rapid changes of the loss when switching between clean and noisy data, we introduce a gradient-norm stabilization technique that scales noisy updates based on clean gradient magnitudes. We compare this method with other common augmentation methods and find substantial improvements in corruption tolerance and robustness to real-world distribution shifts on CIFAR-100-C, ImageNet-C, and ImageNet-R for ResNet and ViT architectures, with the best results being achieved by stacking our method on top of other augmentations. Through saliency and attention maps we show that the effect of interleaved noise injection stems from penalizing the failure modes encouraged by the inductive bias of the models: impulse noise works against the locality bias of convolutional (ResNet) architectures, and Gaussian noise reduces the tendency of attention-based models to pick up large-scale spurious features. Interleaved noise injection is therefore an effective tool to improve the test performance on clean, noisy, and out-of-distribution data at essentially zero computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出交错噪声注入调度（而非单调衰减）来改进优化和鲁棒性，理论分析表明脉冲噪声近似雅可比正则化，高斯噪声为曲率惩罚。该方法在CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C和ImageNet-R上显著提升干净、损坏和分布外数据的性能，且几乎无额外计算成本。
Motivation: 传统噪声注入通常采用单调衰减调度，但交错调度能更好地平衡探索与避免灾难性遗忘。
Method: 采用交替开关（on-off-on-off）的噪声注入调度，并引入梯度范数稳定技术以应对干净/噪声数据切换时的损失突变。
Result: 在CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C和ImageNet-R上，对于ResNet和ViT架构，相比常见数据增强方法，本方法在损坏容忍和真实分布偏移鲁棒性上均有实质性改进，与其他增强叠加效果最佳。
Conclusion: 交错噪声注入通过惩罚模型归纳偏差导致的失败模式（脉冲噪声对抗卷积局部性偏差，高斯噪声减少注意力模型的大尺度伪影），以几乎零成本提升干净、损坏和分布外数据测试性能。

papers.title: Depth-Dependent Hidden-State Collapse in Dynamical System Autoencoders for LiDAR Point-Cloud Classification
papers.abstract_en: We study Dynamical System Autoencoders (DSAE) for LiDAR point-cloud classification using spatial coordinates and Product Coefficient feature augmentations. The experiments compare separately trained DSAE architectures at encoder depths $K=1,\ldots,5$ and evaluate the resulting hidden representations with Random Forest, kNN, and a majority-class Dummy baseline. The main finding is a hidden-state collapse at $K=5$. For both xyz and xyz plus Product Coefficient inputs, the hidden-state standard deviation falls to the order of $10^{-5}$, while all three classifiers attain the same macro F1 score of $0.224688$. We prove that between-class hidden scatter is bounded by total hidden scatter, which in turn is controlled by the reported hidden-state variance. Thus a nearly constant hidden representation cannot retain substantial class-separating structure. Product Coefficients neither improve pre-collapse macro F1 nor prevent the $K=5$ collapse in the present DSAE setting. These results identify large-depth representation collapse as a concrete failure mode for DSAE LiDAR classification.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the 2026 IEEE High Performance Extreme Computing Conference (HPEC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态系统自编码器（DSAE）用于LiDAR点云分类时，随着编码器深度增加出现的隐藏状态崩溃现象。实验发现当深度K=5时，隐藏状态标准差降至10^-5量级，所有分类器（随机森林、kNN、多数类基线）的macro F1分数均相同（0.224688），证明表示崩溃导致分类能力丧失。乘积系数特征增强未能改善预崩溃性能或防止崩溃。
Motivation: 现有DSAE在处理多尺度LiDAR点云时可能因深度增加导致表示退化，其失效模式尚不明确。
Method: 比较不同编码器深度（K=1~5）的DSAE架构，使用空间坐标（xyz）和乘积系数特征增强，用随机森林、kNN和多数类基线评估隐藏表示。
Result: K=5时隐藏状态标准差约为10^-5，所有分类器macro F1分数均为0.224688；类间隐藏散布受限于总隐藏散布，而总散布由隐藏状态方差控制。乘积系数特征未改善结果。
Conclusion: 大深度表示崩溃是DSAE LiDAR分类的具体失效模式，乘积系数特征无法缓解该问题。

papers.title: Precise sample covariance spectral norm error -- an RDT view
papers.abstract_en: We study the sample covariance error of centered Gaussians. A remarkable breakthrough [66] established the correct error scaling order and explicitly revealed the critical role of both the effective rank and the true covariance spectrum. In this work, we move beyond scaling characterizations and determine the precise limiting value of the error's spectral norm. To do so, we develop a generic framework based on Random Duality Theory (RDT). Within this framework, we first determine closed-form, explicit RDT-based upper bounds. We then establish complementary lower bounds by introducing a novel bilinear-quadratic RDT lower-bounding mechanism. By combining this mechanism with a two-replica systems bounding strategy, we show that our lower and upper bounds match in large-dimensional contexts. Our theoretical results are supplemented with numerical evaluations and simulations, demonstrating an excellent agreement already for problem sizes on the order of thousands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究中心化高斯分布样本协方差误差的谱范数，利用随机对偶理论（RDT）推导了误差的精确极限值。作者开发了基于RDT的通用框架，先得到闭式上界，再通过新的双线性-二次型RDT下界机制及两副本系统策略得到匹配的下界，在大维场景下上下界一致。数值模拟显示，当问题规模达数千时理论结果与实验高度吻合。
Motivation: 已有工作[66]确定了样本协方差误差的正确缩放阶数，揭示了有效秩和真实协方差谱的关键作用，但未给出误差谱范数的精确极限值。本文旨在超越缩放刻画，确定该误差的精确极限。
Method: 基于随机对偶理论（RDT）建立通用框架：先推导闭式显式RDT上界，再引入新的双线性-二次型RDT下界机制，结合两副本系统边界策略证明下界与上界在大维情形下匹配。
Result: 摘要报告上下界在大维上下文中匹配，数值评估显示对于数千规模的问题，理论与模拟一致性极佳。
Conclusion: 本文通过RDT框架确定了样本协方差谱范数误差的精确极限，理论结果在有限样本下与数值模拟吻合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Generalist LLMs: Specialist Agentic Systems for Structured Code Workflow Execution
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated the adoption of software development agents, now widely available as Integrated Development Environment (IDE) extensions and standalone applications. While these agents are typically general-purpose, it remains unclear whether specialist agents justify their additional development effort. We investigate this question in the context of business process automation, focusing on the transformation of Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) diagrams into executable agentic workflows. Since BPMN specifies explicit control-flow semantics, we focus on deterministic workflows in which a fixed process model and inputs uniquely determine the executed path. We introduce a specialist workflow for this task and compare it against generalist agents such as Roo and Cline. Our results show that the specialist solution produces agents that outperform generalist baselines by approximately 9-20 percentage points in tool-use exactness, 2-4x in penalty-adjusted latency, and 3x fewer tool-call errors, while reducing generation token cost by over 95% and eliminating repair iterations. We also find that generalist agents generate code inconsistently in both functionality and quality, limiting their suitability for industrial settings where reliability and maintainability are essential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究专用智能体系统是否比通用LLM智能体在结构化代码工作流执行中更具优势，聚焦于BPMN图到可执行工作流的转换。结果显示，专用系统在工具使用精确度上提升9-20个百分点，延迟优化2-4倍，工具调用错误减少3倍，生成token成本降低95%以上，且无需修复迭代。通用智能体则生成代码不一致，不适合工业场景。
Motivation: 通用LLM智能体广泛用于代码开发，但在需要精确控制流的业务过程自动化场景中，其可靠性不足。论文探究专用智能体是否值得额外开发投入。
Method: 设计一个专用工作流，用于将BPMN图转换为确定性agentic工作流，并与通用智能体Roo和Cline进行对比评估。
Result: 专用方案在工具使用精确度上超过通用基线9-20个百分点，惩罚调整后延迟提升2-4倍，工具调用错误减少3倍，生成token成本降低95%以上，且无需修复迭代。通用智能体生成代码功能和质量不一致。
Conclusion: 在结构化代码工作流执行中，专用智能体显著优于通用智能体，更适合工业场景中对可靠性和可维护性的要求。

papers.title: Cotton-SF YOLO: Learning Structural and Frequency Cues for Early Cotton Square Detection in Complex Field Environments
papers.abstract_en: Cotton squares are important phenotypic indicators of the early reproductive growth of cotton, and automatic field detection of cotton squares provides an important basis for cotton growth monitoring and precision cultivation management. However, early cotton square detection in complex field environments remains insufficiently explored, as cotton squares are small, frequently occluded, easily blurred, subject to illumination variations, and exhibit low contrast against surrounding cotton leaves. To address these challenges, we propose a task-oriented framework based on YOLO26m, named Cotton-SF YOLO, for cotton square detection under natural field conditions. To improve the perception of small and irregular cotton square boundaries, we introduce Dynamic Snake Convolution into the detector, enabling adaptive extraction of deformable edge features. Furthermore, a frequency-domain feature modulation module is designed by incorporating spectral enhancement into the C2f structure, which recalibrate frequency-domain representations and strengthen discriminative edge and texture cues while reducing interference from complex cotton leaf backgrounds. Trained and evaluated on our newly constructed and annotated field dataset with manually annotated cotton squares, the proposed model achieves mAP$_{50}$, mAP$_{50:95}$, and recall values of 0.8196, 0.4942, and 0.7939, improving over the baseline YOLO26m by 1.25%, 3.45%, and 2.96%, respectively. Ablation experiments and visualization demonstrate that the best performance is achieved with the complementary effects of structural and frequency cues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复杂田间环境中早期棉花花苞（cotton square）检测的挑战，提出基于YOLO26m的任务导向框架 Cotton-SF YOLO。该框架通过引入动态蛇形卷积（Dynamic Snake Convolution）以自适应提取形变边缘特征，并设计频域特征调制模块（频谱增强C2f结构）以增强判别性边缘和纹理线索、减少复杂叶片背景干扰。在自建田间数据集上，模型达到mAP₅₀ 0.8196、mAP₅₀:₉₅ 0.4942、召回率0.7939，较基线YOLO26m分别提升1.25%、3.45%、2.96%，消融实验和可视化表明结构线索与频率线索的互补效果最佳。
Motivation: 早期棉花花苞在复杂田间环境中因目标小、遮挡频繁、模糊、光照变化以及与叶片对比度低而难以检测，现有研究对此探索不足。
Method: 基于YOLO26m，引入动态蛇形卷积（Dynamic Snake Convolution）提取形变边缘特征，并设计频域特征调制模块（频谱增强C2f结构）以重校准频域表示、增强判别性边缘和纹理线索、抑制叶片背景干扰。

papers.title: Tactile: Giving Computer-Using Agents Hands and Feet
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents are becoming capable software operators, but their interface to desktop applications is still often a brittle motor layer: they look at screenshots, predict coordinates, click, and hope that the visible state changed as intended. This collapses target grounding, action execution, and outcome verification into a single ambiguous operation. We present Tactile, an open-source tool layer that gives agents a more reliable "hands and feet" for desktop use. Tactile converts heterogeneous UI evidence--operating-system accessibility semantics, OCR-grounded text, and visual fallback regions--into action-grounded interface states: compact target candidates with source labels, roles or text, state, geometry, executable affordances, and verification cues. Agents operate through an observe-ground-act-verify loop that prefers native semantic actions when available, falls back to OCR-grounded coordinates when visible text is the best evidence, and keeps full provenance for replay and failure attribution. On macOSWorld-style tasks, adding Tactile improves Codex Success@100 from 41.1% to 50.0% overall and from 45.2% to 55.3% on accessibility-adapted tasks; a 96-task cross-agent subset shows consistent gains across Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Goose. These results suggest that reliable computer use requires not only stronger models, but also a reusable execution substrate that exposes software actions as semantic, verifiable, and auditable objects rather than anonymous screen coordinates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tactile，一个开源工具层，为计算机使用代理提供更可靠的“手足”。它整合操作系统辅助功能语义、OCR 文本和视觉回退区域，转化为动作基础界面状态，并支持观察-基础-动作-验证循环。在 macOSWorld 任务上，加入 Tactile 将 Codex Success@100 从 41.1% 提升至 50.0%，并在多个代理上取得一致改进。
Motivation: 当前计算机使用代理依赖截图和坐标点击，将目标定位、动作执行和结果验证混为一个模糊操作，导致系统脆弱且不可靠。
Method: 提出 Tactile 工具层，将异构 UI 证据（操作系统辅助功能语义、OCR 文本、视觉回退区域）转化为动作基础界面状态，包含目标候选、源标签、角色/文本、状态、几何、可执行功能和验证线索。代理通过 observe-ground-act-verify 循环操作，优先使用原生语义动作，回退到 OCR 坐标。
Result: 在 macOSWorld 任务上，Codex Success@100 从 41.1% 提升至 50.0%，在辅助功能适应任务上从 45.2% 提升至 55.3%。在 96 任务跨代理子集上，Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Goose 均有一致增益。
Conclusion: 可靠的计算机使用不仅需要更强的模型，还需要可重用的执行基底，将软件动作暴露为语义、可验证、可审计的对象，而非匿名屏幕坐标。

papers.title: Active Real-World Factor-Based Evaluation for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot manipulation policies trained on large, diverse datasets have shown remarkable promise across a wide range of tasks. However, rigorously evaluating these policies remains a fundamental challenge. Real-world performance depends on a large combinatorial space of task factors including object poses and camera viewpoints, making full, exhaustive evaluation intractable. Additionally, real hardware evaluation is slow and resource-intensive, so current practice is to use narrow test suites that can miss critical failure modes and misrepresent true deployment readiness. We propose an active evaluation framework that addresses this challenge by treating policy evaluation as a sequential experimental design problem. Our approach fits a probabilistic surrogate model over a structured space of task factors and adaptively selects evaluation configurations to maximize information gain over the policy's performance distribution, allowing for sample-efficient characterization of policy behavior across unseen conditions and a systematic identification of failure-prone regions. We conduct 2331 real-world evaluations across 3 tasks with 3 factor variations and find that our approach typically saves the evaluator at least 20-40% of trials compared to typical random testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对通用机器人操作策略的真实世界评估难题，提出一种主动评估框架，将策略评估建模为序贯实验设计问题，通过概率代理模型自适应选择评估配置以最大化信息增益，实现样本高效的策略行为刻画和失效区域识别。在3个任务、3个因子变体上的2331次真实世界评估表明，该方法相比随机测试通常节省20-40%的试验次数。
Motivation: 现有通用机器人策略评估依赖狭窄测试集，难以覆盖任务因子的组合空间，且真实硬件评估耗时耗资源，容易遗漏关键失效模式，无法反映真实部署就绪度。
Method: 提出主动评估框架，利用概率代理模型在结构化任务因子空间上进行自适应采样，选择能最大化策略性能分布信息增益的评估配置，实现样本高效的策略行为表征。
Result: 在3个任务、3个因子变体上进行了2331次真实世界评估，结果表明该方法相比典型随机测试通常节省20-40%的试验次数。
Conclusion: 该主动评估框架能够系统性地识别失效区域，提高评估效率，有望成为通用机器人策略标准化评估方法。

papers.title: Global drivers and barriers to the public acceptance of autonomous vehicles: Evidence from 17 countries
papers.abstract_en: This study investigated the public acceptance of Society of Automotive Engineers Level 3 conditionally automated cars, which can self-drive under certain specified conditions but require the human driver to remain ready to resume control when requested. Previous Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2)-based research has focused mainly on European samples, and so it is still unclear whether the same factors shape acceptance across broader world regions. This knowledge gap was addressed using the L3Pilot Global User Acceptance Survey. From an original dataset of 18,631 respondents, the final analytic sample comprised 18,603 respondents from 17 countries across Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, and South America. The data were analyzed using a UTAUT2-based structural equation model to examine how performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, and hedonic motivation shape the intention to use Level 3 cars. The model showed strong explanatory power. Across the analytic sample, the intention to use Level 3 cars was driven mainly by performance expectancy, social influence, and hedonic motivation. Effort expectancy and facilitating conditions also contributed, but they played smaller direct roles. Age, gender, and previous experience with advanced driver assistance systems were statistically significant, but comparatively weak predictors. Overall, the findings suggest that the acceptance of Level 3 automated cars depends less on demographic characteristics or ease-of-use concerns and more on whether people see the technology as useful, socially supported, and enjoyable to use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究调查了17个国家公众对SAE 3级有条件自动驾驶汽车的接受度。基于UTAUT2模型分析发现，使用意图主要由性能预期、社会影响和享乐动机驱动，而人口统计特征和努力预期作用较小。
Motivation: 此前基于UTAUT2的研究主要聚焦欧洲样本，缺乏全球范围的比较，因此本研究通过多国调查填补这一空白。
Method: 使用L3Pilot全球用户接受度调查，收集来自17个国家18603份有效问卷，应用基于UTAUT2的结构方程模型分析因素对使用意图的影响。
Result: 模型解释力强。主要驱动因素是性能预期、社会影响和享乐动机；努力预期和便利条件贡献较小；年龄、性别、ADAS经验统计显著但预测力弱。
Conclusion: 有条件自动驾驶汽车的接受度更多取决于有用性、社会支持和愉悦感，而非人口统计特征或易用性。

papers.title: Learning Mechanistic Reasoning for Chemical Reactions with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reaction mechanisms consist of the step-by-step sequences of elementary reactions that explain chemical transformations. Learning the mechanism logic is therefore essential for enhancing the fundamental chemical intelligence of large language models (LLMs). The stepwise deduction of reaction mechanism aligns naturally with the reasoning paradigms of reasoning LLMs. However, current chemical LLMs primarily emphasize coarse-grained name reactions for product prediction and retrosynthesis, often leading to physical inconsistencies and hallucinations. In contrast, specialized small-scale generative models for mechanism inference typically suffer from restricted generalization capacity across diverse chemical spaces. To overcome these limitations, we built a novel, large-scale reasoning dataset of reaction mechanisms. Furthermore, we established the FukuyamaBench, a difficult benchmark derived from Fukuyama's Advanced Organic Reaction Mechanism book, to rigorously evaluate model performance on hierarchical mechanism reasoning. Our fine-tuned Qwen3-30B-A3B achieves 8.3% exact pathway match on FukuyamaBench Set~A, surpassing the specialized FlowER model (5.1%), demonstrating that mechanism-aware training substantially enhances chemical reasoning in language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了大型化学反应机理推理数据集，并基于该数据集微调Qwen3-30B-A3B模型，在FukuyamaBench基准上实现8.3%的精确路径匹配，超越专用FlowER模型的5.1%，表明机制感知训练能显著提升语言模型的化学推理能力。
Motivation: 现有化学大语言模型主要聚焦粗粒度的命名反应预测，导致物理不一致和幻觉；专用小规模机理推理模型泛化能力有限。需构建大规模推理数据集以提升模型对反应机理的逐步推理能力。
Method: 构建大规模反应机理推理数据集，并微调Qwen3-30B-A3B模型；同时从Fukuyama《高等有机反应机理》书籍派生FukuyamaBench基准用于层次化机理推理评估。
Result: 在FukuyamaBench Set A上，微调模型取得8.3%的精确路径匹配，优于专用FlowER模型的5.1%。
Conclusion: 机理感知的训练方法能有效增强语言模型在化学推理任务上的表现，但当前模型在复杂路径匹配上仍有较大提升空间。

papers.title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents must integrate external tool returns into ongoing reasoning - a capability that standard left-to-right pretraining on code exposes only in its forward direction. We observe that the action-observation-continuation loop of a coding agent is structurally isomorphic to a function call site, where a caller binds arguments, a callee returns a value computed elsewhere, and downstream code consumes that value. This conditioning structure exists at internet scale in ordinary code. We exploit it through function-aware fill-in-the-middle (FIM) mid-training: a self-supervised objective that masks functions selected via program dependency graph analysis and a complexity-inferability double criterion. We mid-train Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B/14B) and Qwen3-8B on a 2.6B-token decontaminated corpus drawn from 968 GitHub repositories, then apply existing agentic post-training pipelines. Mid-training improves SWE-Bench-Verified by +2.8/+3.0 at 7B/14B and by +3.2 on Qwen3-8B; SWE-Bench-Lite gains are +3.7/+4.0/+5.4 on the same models. The improvement holds across two post-training pipelines (R2E-Gym, SWE-Smith) and on a non-Qwen2.5 base (Qwen3-8B with SWE-Lego). Beyond in-domain gains, mid-training also mitigates the capability erosion that agentic post-training otherwise inflicts on non-agent coding (e.g., LiveCodeBench) and non-coding tool-use benchmarks (tau-bench, BFCL): although the mid-training corpus contains Python code only, the function-call inductive bias survives post-training and yields consistent gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出函数感知的填充中间（FIM）中间训练方法，通过程序依赖图分析和复杂度-可推断性双重准则选择函数进行掩码，在2.6B token语料上对Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct和Qwen3-8B进行中间训练，提升了编程代理在SWE-Bench-Verified和SWE-Bench-Lite上的性能，并减轻了代理后训练对非代理编码和工具使用基准的能力侵蚀。
Motivation: 标准从左到右的预训练仅暴露代码的正向方向，而编程代理需要将外部工具返回集成到持续推理中，现有方法缺乏对这种能力的针对性训练。
Method: 提出函数感知的填充中间（FIM）中间训练，通过程序依赖图分析选择函数，并采用复杂度-可推断性双重准则决定掩码，对代码进行自监督学习。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/14B和Qwen3-8B上，SWE-Bench-Verified分别提升+2.8/+3.0和+3.2；SWE-Bench-Lite分别提升+3.7/+4.0/+5.4；在多种后训练流程和非Qwen2.5基座上均有效。
Conclusion: 函数感知的FIM中间训练能够增强编程代理的基础能力，并缓解后训练导致的非代理任务能力退化，即使语料仅含Python代码，函数调用的归纳偏置也能泛化到其他任务。

papers.title: ACID: Adaptive Caching for vIDeo generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models produce high-quality generations but remain slow at inference due to their sequential denoising procedure. Caching-based acceleration methods address this by reusing intermediate model outputs: leading dynamic approaches such as TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache accumulate a drift signal and skip expensive model evaluations when accumulated drift stays below a fixed threshold $τ$. This threshold controls an apparent tradeoff - raising it yields faster generation at the cost of visual quality, while lowering it preserves quality but sacrifices speed. We show this tradeoff is not fundamental; it is an artifact of holding $τ$ constant throughout denoising. We identify the existence of critical steps - timesteps where the drift signal changes rapidly - and show that applying a low threshold selectively at these steps while caching aggressively elsewhere recovers most of the quality of conservative caching at substantially higher inference speeds. Building on this insight, we propose ACID, a lightweight, training-free wrapper that monitors the rate of change of each method's existing drift signal to dynamically switch between a low and a high threshold. ACID is signal-agnostic and modular: it requires no retraining and plugs directly into existing dynamic caching methods without modifying their core mechanisms. Evaluated across three caching methods (TeaCache, EasyCache, DiCache) and three open-source video diffusion models (HunyuanVideo, Wan 2.1, CogVideoX), ACID consistently expands the Pareto frontier of visual quality versus inference speed beyond what any fixed threshold achieves. In particular, on TeaCache and HunyuanVideo, ACID achieves up to 2.16x speedup over the no-caching baseline, and up to 38% additional speedup over the conservative fixed-threshold baseline with negligible (<0.3 dB PSNR, <0.01 SSIM, <0.01 LPIPS) quality degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出视频扩散模型推理中动态缓存方法的固定阈值忽略去噪过程中漂移信号变化的不均匀性，提出ACID（自适应缓存）框架，通过监测漂移变化率动态调整阈值，在不牺牲质量的前提下提升速度。在多个模型和方法上的实验表明，ACID能扩展质量-速度的帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有动态缓存方法（如TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache）使用固定阈值，导致质量-速度权衡，作者认为该权衡并非固有，而是阈值恒定所致。
Method: ACID是一种轻量级、无需训练的外挂模块，通过监测每个现有方法漂移信号的变化率，在关键步骤（漂移变化快）使用低阈值，其他步骤使用高阈值，实现自适应切换。
Result: 在TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache三种方法及HunyuanVideo、Wan 2.1、CogVideoX三个模型上，ACID一致扩展帕累托前沿；在TeaCache+HunyuanVideo上最多加速2.16倍，相比保守固定阈值额外加速38%，质量下降可忽略（PSNR<0.3 dB, SSIM<0.01, LPIPS<0.01）。
Conclusion: ACID表明通过自适应阈值可以打破固定阈值带来的质量-速度权衡，是一种信号无关、即插即用的加速方案，无需重新训练或修改原方法核心。

papers.title: Self-Aware Recursively Self-Improving Agents for Personal Singularity: A Goal-, Scope-, Tool-, and Benchmark-Driven Multi-Agent Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can plan, use tools, maintain memory, and execute long-horizon tasks. This paper proposes Self-Aware Recursively Self-Improving (SARSI) agents: governed agents that maintain a persistent self-model of identity, goals, capabilities, limitations, uncertainty, relationships, history, and developmental change, and use that model to guide and evaluate recursive improvement. Self-awareness is defined functionally and does not imply subjective experience or phenomenal consciousness. We pair SARSI agents with personal singularity, a bounded human-AI co-development objective in which an agent ecosystem helps a user approach an expanding, user-defined feasible capability frontier. Each agent has a goal contract, bounded scope, validated tool registry, tool tests, end-to-end benchmarks, owner-controlled autonomy, routing, memory, self-model, and improvement policy. A scope router assigns every accepted task to one accountable primary agent and transfers out-of-scope work through structured handoffs. A user-facing Auto-Index selects interactive, hybrid, autonomous, or scheduled behavior without overriding external permissions. The architecture combines a planner-executor-verifier loop, an evidence-gated improvement loop, an external governance plane, decentralized lineages, an owner-directed agent foundry, and a Personal Singularity OS coordinating working, computational-imaging, work-process-learning, and personal-learning agents. We formalize functional self-awareness, scope, routing, improvement acceptance, bounded goal evolution, tool-first execution, and human capability transfer, and provide safety invariants, benchmark design, and a staged implementation roadmap. This is a position and systems-design paper, not evidence that consciousness, unrestricted recursive self-improvement, or personal singularity has been achieved.

TL;DR: 本文提出自感知递归自改进（SARSI）智能体架构，旨在通过有界的人类-AI共同发展目标（个人奇点）实现用户能力边界的扩展。SARSI智能体维护关于身份、目标、能力、局限、不确定性等内容的持久自模型，并通过目标合约、有界范围、验证工具库、端到端基准、改进策略等机制驱动递归改进。架构包括计划-执行-验证循环、证据门控改进循环、外部治理平面、去中心化谱系、用户导向智能体工厂及个人奇点操作系统。本文为立场与系统设计论文，未声称实现了意识或无限递归自改进。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体虽能规划、使用工具、执行长程任务，但缺乏对自身状态和边界的明确建模，难以实现安全、可控的递归自改进。作者旨在构建一种受约束的、自感知的智能体系统，在人类监督下逐步扩展用户能力边界。

Result: 本文为立场与系统设计论文，未提供实证结果或基准测试数据。摘要未报告定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者形式化了功能性自感知、范围、路由、改进接受、有界目标演化、工具优先执行和人类能力转移等概念，并提供了安全不变式、基准设计及分阶段实施路线图。未声称实现整体奇点或不受限递归自改进。

papers.title: From Reconstruction to Interpretation: Zero-Setup Multi-Phase Segmentation of X-ray Tomography Data
papers.abstract_en: X-ray tomography enables nondestructive characterization of material microstructures, while advances in micro-CT imaging have accelerated volumetric data acquisition and reconstruction. However, rapid interpretation remains limited by image segmentation, which often requires manual thresholding, user prompting, or material-specific model training. We present a zero-setup framework for multi-phase segmentation of synchrotron X-ray tomography data that generates interpretable masks for previously unseen datasets without user input or retraining during deployment. The framework combines a material-agnostic mask preparation strategy with a pretrained semantic segmentation network. It represents commonly occurring structural regions as background, sample, bright, dark-gray, light-gray, and porosity masks. Unlike conventional deep learning pipelines that require dataset-specific annotations and retraining, the proposed framework can be applied directly to new scans and produce diagnostic-level segmentations within minutes of reconstruction. This enables rapid assessment of scan quality, sample morphology, porosity, and attenuation variations during ongoing beamline experiments. The generated masks can later be manually refined or used to fine-tune application-specific models when greater accuracy or material-specific labeling is required. Evaluation on held-out synchrotron micro-CT images and qualitative testing on additional datasets demonstrate consistent and physically meaningful segmentations across varying samples and imaging conditions. The framework also substantially outperforms conventional intensity-based thresholding. By connecting high-speed reconstruction with immediate interpretation, the approach supports near-real-time beamline feedback and scalable AI-assisted scientific imaging workflows.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个零设置框架，用于同步辐射X射线断层扫描数据的多相分割，无需用户输入或重新训练即可生成可解释的掩码，支持近实时光束线反馈。
Motivation: 传统图像分割方法需要手动阈值、用户提示或材料特定模型训练，限制了X射线断层扫描数据的快速解读。
Method: 结合材料无关的掩码准备策略与预训练的语义分割网络，生成背景、样本、亮、暗灰、浅灰和孔隙度等掩码。
Result: 在保留的同步辐射微CT图像上评估，并在不同数据集上定性测试，产生一致且物理上有意义的分割，显著优于传统强度阈值方法。
Conclusion: 该框架连接高速重建与即时解读，支持近实时光束线反馈和可扩展的AI辅助科学成像工作流。

papers.title: Causal Supervision of Attention for Affective Behaviour Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The \textit{11th Affective Behaviour Analysis in-the-wild Competition} includes the Multi-Task Learning Challenge, where participants develop a unified framework for Valence-Arousal Estimation, Expression Recognition, and Action Unit Detection. The challenge lies in learning emotion-related representations that generalize across subjects while remaining robust to spurious factors such as identity, illumination, pose, and demographic variation. To aggregate features extracted by a pre-trained backbone into a compact representation for prediction, attention mechanisms selectively weight the most informative facial regions. However, these attention weights can still capture dataset-specific correlations rather than genuine affective cues. To address this limitation, we propose an attention pooling framework that combines causal supervision with cross-covariance regularization of attention components, encouraging subject-invariant attention and non-redundant representations that improve generalization. Our method achieves $CCC_{VA}=0.5123$ for VA estimation on the official validation set, together with $F_{EX}=0.3116$ and $F_{AU}=0.3974$ for expression recognition and action unit detection, respectively, resulting in an overall $P$ score (the sum of the individual task metrics) of $1.2214$.

TL;DR: 本文针对情感行为分析中的多任务学习挑战（效价-唤醒估计、表情识别、动作单元检测），提出一种结合因果监督与注意力组件交叉协方差正则化的注意力池化框架，旨在学习与情感相关且对身份、光照等干扰因素鲁棒的表示。在官方验证集上，方法取得效价-唤醒估计的CCC=0.5123，表情识别的F1=0.3116，动作单元检测的F1=0.3974，总分1.2214。

Method: 提出因果监督的注意力池化框架，结合交叉协方差正则化，鼓励注意力权重的主题不变性和表示的非冗余性。

Conclusion: 因果注意力正则化能有效提升情感表示对身份等干扰因素的鲁棒性，在多任务情感分析上取得竞争性结果。

papers.title: SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms classically suffer from poor sample efficiency. In robotics, a recent line of work has emerged addressing this problem by encoding physics priors in the learning process. However, most of these approaches are validated on well-defined, low-dimensional benchmark systems rather than high-dimensional robots with complex nonlinear dynamics. In this paper, we introduce \textit{SKooP (Symmetric Koopman Predictions)}, an approach combining the advantages of morphological symmetries with those of a Koopman model learned via autoencoder to enhance policy learning. SKooP learns a Koopman model of the system dynamics alongside the policy. The resulting Koopman predictions are used as privileged observations for the critic, allowing the agent to learn based on smoother, more informative features. We also incorporate group symmetries into the actor, critic, encoder and decoder networks to produce a highly equivariant policy. The SKooP approach is validated via in-depth analysis of the learned Koopman models and symmetric policies to showcase how each of these influences the agent's performance. We also show that the learned policies are transferable to different simulation environments. Our results show that SKooP consistently reduces convergence time and increases the learned reward for multiple challenging bipedal locomotion tasks on a quadruped robot. Project page: https://evelyd.github.io/SymmetricKoopmanPredictions
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), Pittsburgh, USA, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKooP (Symmetric Koopman Predictions) 方法，结合形态对称性与 Koopman 模型预测来加速强化学习在腿部机器人运动中的应用。通过自编码器学习 Koopman 模型，将其预测作为评论家的特权观察，并在网络结构中引入群对称性，提高策略学习效率和泛化性。在四足机器人上的双足行走任务中，SKooP 显著减少收敛时间并提升奖励，且策略可迁移到不同仿真环境。
Motivation: 强化学习样本效率低下，现有利用物理先验的方法大多在低维基准系统上验证，缺乏对高维、复杂非线性动力学机器人系统的有效方案。
Method: 通过自编码器学习系统动力学的 Koopman 模型，将 Koopman 预测作为评论家的特权观察；同时在演员、评论家、编码器和解码器网络中引入群对称性，生成高度等变的策略。
Result: 在四足机器人的多个双足行走任务上，SKooP 一致地减少策略收敛时间并提高累计奖励，且学习到的策略可迁移至不同仿真环境。
Conclusion: 论文通过深入分析展示了 Koopman 模型与对称性各自对性能的影响，验证了其组合在复杂机器人运动任务中的有效性。

papers.title: Backbone-Agnostic Stochastic Perturbation Learning for End-to-End Real-World Image Dehazing
papers.abstract_en: Real-world paired image dehazing remains challenging because haze degradation is spatially non-uniform, illumination-dependent, and physically ambiguous even when haze-free references are available. Existing end-to-end restoration networks usually learn a deterministic mapping from a hazy observation to a clean target, while degradation-sensitive feature responses, reverse haze-formation consistency, and cross-domain negative structure remain insufficiently exploited. In this paper, we propose Backbone-Agnostic Stochastic Perturbation Learning (BSPL), a plug-and-play framework for end-to-end real-world image dehazing. BSPL first introduces a Learnable Stochastic Perturbation Modulator (LSPM), which learns input-conditioned channel-wise and spatial-wise perturbation distributions and converts the resulting feature-response discrepancies into adaptive modulation weights. It then develops a Prior-informed Perturbation-guided Reconstruction Module (PPRM), which reuses the learned bottleneck perturbations together with transmission and atmospheric-light priors to reconstruct the hazy observation from the restored result and enforce degradation consistency. Furthermore, we propose a Dual-space Domain-diversified Distribution-aware Contrastive Loss ($D^3$CL) to regularize both clean restoration and hazy reconstruction spaces with real-world and synthetic negatives. Experiments on five real-world paired benchmarks show that BSPL consistently improves multiple representative backbones with only marginal additional inference overhead.

papers.title: Compile, Then Page: Executable SOP Programs and a Capability-Gated Runtime for Procedural LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agents must follow long-horizon, conditional, safety-critical standard operating procedures (SOPs). We compile machine-readable SOP constraints into executable pseudo-code and run them with a program-guided (PG) stack machine that pages the active frame while an LLM performs semantic execution. A three-arm SOPBench study across six models separates representation from runtime: compiled text never significantly hurts and gains up to 16.0 points where official prose underperforms. Runtime guidance is capability-gated. Two strong models independently show positive seven-domain PG contrasts (58:19 and 75:31 discordant pairs), whereas weak models are harmed. A full-program cursor ablation (active frame first, complete program retained) recovers much of the strong-model refusal gain; selective visibility adds a smaller improvement. Paired probe and audit measurements track this divide to spontaneous state discipline rather than reconstruction ability. On Bank the three primary arms rise from 70.4 to 86.4 to 92.8, with 100% refusal correctness. Practical guidance: compile first; enable active-frame paging only after a model-level discipline check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业代理需遵循长周期、条件性、安全关键的标准操作程序（SOP）的问题，提出将机器可读SOP约束编译为可执行伪代码，并通过程序引导（PG）栈机运行，同时由LLM进行语义执行。在SOPBench上，跨六个模型的三臂实验表明编译表示从未显著降低性能，最多提升16.0分；运行时采用能力门控，强模型在七个领域显示正PG对比，弱模型受损。实验还表明活动帧分页与选择性可见性对拒绝率有贡献，最终Bank分支得分从70.4升至92.8，拒绝正确率达100%。
Motivation: 企业代理需执行长时序、条件分支、安全关键的SOP，但现有方法常混合表示与运行时，且LLM难以严格遵循约束。
Method: 将SOP编译为可执行伪代码，并用基于栈的PG机分页活动帧，LLM负责语义执行；运行时通过能力门控决定是否启用PG机制。
Result: 在SOPBench上，编译文本相比官方散文提升最多16.0分；强模型（如GPT-4）在七个领域显示正对比（不一致对58:19和75:31），弱模型受损害；完全程序光标消融恢复强模型大部分拒绝增益，选择性可见性提升较小；Bank分支得分从70.4升至92.8，拒绝正确率100%。
Conclusion: 实用建议：优先编译SOP；仅在模型具备状态纪律检查能力后启用活动帧分页。

papers.title: The Hidden Footprint: Making Storage a First-Class Metric for LLM Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM agent benchmarks measure task completion, reliability, and inference cost, but not the persistent data an agent run leaves on disk, including logs, context snapshots, checkpoints, and debug traces. We introduce AgentFootprint, a cross-framework benchmark of post-run agent storage footprint. Its serialization-aware metric suite measures total retention, channel composition, duplication, growth, compressibility, and conversation-history reconstructability. It addresses a measurement trap: naive byte-level measurement understates duplication by an order of magnitude because database paging and JSON escaping obscure repeated content. A fixed-trace control separates agent-generated logical volume from persistence-layer amplification: replaying the same trajectory through seven persisting frameworks yields a 6.7x spread. Under identical models, tools, and tasks, configurations with 100% accuracy differ by 15.7x in retained bytes, although their defaults support different recovery and audit capabilities. Three full-history configurations grow superlinearly on a repeated-observation stress task. Exported trajectories from 108 instance-normalized SWE-bench Verified submissions span three orders of magnitude per instance, with no detectable correlation with resolve rate. A content-addressed store reduces retention by 4.8x-32.7x while preserving every reconstructability score. These results establish persistent storage as a resource metric to report jointly with accuracy and reconstructability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentFootprint，一个跨框架的LLM agent后运行存储足迹基准测试。它通过序列化感知度量套件测量总保留量、通道组成、重复性、增长、可压缩性和对话历史可重构性。实验发现，在相同模型、工具和任务下，不同配置的保留字节差异可达15.7倍，而准确率相同。内容寻址存储可将保留量减少4.8倍至32.7倍，同时保持可重构性。
Motivation: 现有LLM agent基准测试关注任务完成度、可靠性和推理成本，但忽略了运行时留下的持久数据（如日志、上下文快照、检查点和调试跟踪），这些数据占用大量存储且影响可审计性。
Method: 引入AgentFootprint基准测试，包含序列化感知的度量套件，通过固定轨迹控制分离agent生成逻辑量与持久化层放大效应，并采用内容寻址存储减少重复。
Result: 相同轨迹在7个不同框架下产生6.7倍的存储差异；相同准确率的不同配置在保留字节上相差15.7倍；SWE-bench已验证提交的导出轨迹每实例跨度三个数量级，且与解决率无显著相关性。
Conclusion: 持久化存储应作为与准确率和可重构性并列的资源度量指标，内容寻址存储能大幅减少重复数据而不损失可重构性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The RG-Flow Transformer: Encoding Scale-Free Dynamics in Scarce EEG
papers.abstract_en: Brain field potentials are scale-free: their power spectra follow a $1/f^β$ law whose aperiodic exponent $β$ tracks cortical state, and sleep depth in particular is a shift in $β$. We ask whether a transformer endowed with an explicit renormalization-group (RG) inductive bias the RG-Flow Transformer, which couples ordinary self-attention to a scale-aware stream with a learnable anomalous dimension $γ$, block-spin coarse-graining, and an entropy-gated synchronization bridge has an advantage over a parameter-matched vanilla transformer on \emph{real, scarce} EEG. Using the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF corpus with a strict leakage-free by-subject hold-out, we (i) benchmark RG-Flow against a param-matched vanilla transformer and a hierarchy-only ablation on 5-class AASM sleep staging, (ii) sweep the per-subject data budget to look for the inductive-bias crossover predicted when data are scarce, and (iii) test whether RG-Flow's learned $γ$ tracks the measured spectral exponent $β$ out-of-sample a quantity the vanilla model does not possess. Across $5$ subjects and $5$ seeds under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, RG-Flow and the vanilla transformer are statistically indistinguishable on 5-class staging (77.3\% vs 77.0\% accuracy; paired $p=0.294$), and the predicted scarce-data crossover does not appear: vanilla is numerically ahead at every data-limited budget. What does separate the models is interpretability RG-Flow recovers the continuous spectral exponent out-of-sample ($β$-recovery $R^2 = 0.416$), a capability the vanilla architecture has no analogue for.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀缺EEG数据中的睡眠分期任务，提出RG-Flow Transformer，在普通自注意力基础上引入重整化群（RG）归纳偏置，包括可学习异常维度γ、块自旋粗粒化和熵门控同步桥。在PhysioNet Sleep-EDF数据集上（5类AASM睡眠分期，留一被试交叉验证），RG-Flow与参数匹配的普通Transformer的分类准确率无显著差异（77.3% vs 77.0%，p=0.294），且数据稀缺时RG-Flow并未展现出归纳偏置优势；但其可解释性突出，能恢复连续频谱指数β（R²=0.416），而普通Transformer无法做到。
Motivation: 脑电图功率谱遵循1/f^β规律，其非周期性指数β反映皮层状态和睡眠深度，但现有Transformer缺乏对应的尺度不变性先验。作者猜想在数据稀缺时，加入RG归纳偏置的Transformer可能优于普通Transformer。
Method: 提出RG-Flow Transformer，通过耦合普通自注意力与尺度感知流：包含可学习异常维度γ、块自旋粗粒化操作以及熵门控同步桥，使模型显式利用尺度自由动力学。
Result: 在PhysioNet Sleep-EDF上，RG-Flow与普通Transformer在5类睡眠分期准确率上无显著差异（77.3% vs 77.0%）；数据预算扫描未出现预期的稀缺数据交叉点；RG-Flow能恢复连续频谱指数β，R²=0.416，提供模型无法天然支持的可解释性。
Conclusion: RG-Flow Transformer的核心优势不在于提升分类精度，而在于它能够学习并恢复物理上有意义的频谱指数β，从而赋予模型可解释性；这种能力是普通Transformer架构所不具备的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAG: A Web-Agent Benchmark and Harness for Multimodal Action and Guide Generation
papers.abstract_en: Digital Adoption Platforms (DAPs) are embedded overlays widely used on web systems to guide users through operations inside a page, helping them get started with unfamiliar interfaces quickly. Completing a real task, however, rarely means clicking a few buttons on a single page: it takes a sequence of actions that unfolds across changing page states. Prior studies have also treated automated web agent actions and guide text generation as two separate problems, and most of them feed models textual page representations such as the DOM or accessibility trees rather than the rendered screens that humans actually operate on. In this work we introduce MAG, the first benchmark that unifies task execution and guide writing into a single Multimodal Action and Guide task, with two grounding schemes over screenshots: Set-of-Mark element selection and raw pixel coordinates. We further build a complete harness for this compound task, covering annotation with LLM assistance and human verification, training, evaluation in live environments, and joint metrics for actions and guides. With this harness we evaluate frontier API models and open multimodal models, and report detailed analyses. Finally, we design a GRPO training method augmented with expert trajectories, which nearly doubles the success rate of a supervised 9B agent (from 6.9% to 13.2%) and improves guide quality at the same time. Even the strongest model completes fewer than 40% of the tasks, leaving ample room for future research.
papers.comment: 8 pages main text, 21 pages total including appendices; 11 figures, 7 tables, 2 algorithms. Benchmark, harness, and model checkpoints to be released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAG，首个将任务执行和指南生成统一为多模态动作与指南生成任务的基准，基于截图采用Set-of-Mark元素选择和原始像素坐标两种定位方案。构建了完整的工具链，涵盖LLM辅助注释、人工验证、实时环境训练评估以及联合指标。评估了前沿API模型和开放多模态模型，并设计了GRPO训练方法结合专家轨迹，将9B代理的成功率从6.9%提升至13.2%，同时提高指南质量。即使最强模型完成率也低于40%，表明仍有很大改进空间。
Motivation: 现有工作将自动化网页代理动作与指南文本生成视为两个分离的问题，且多数使用DOM或可访问性树等文本页面表示而非人类实际操作的渲染截图，导致任务执行与用户指导脱节。
Method: 构建MAG基准，统一动作与指南生成任务；提出两种截图定位方案：Set-of-Mark元素选择和原始像素坐标；开发完整工具链，包括LLM辅助注释、人工验证、实时环境训练评估及联合指标；设计GRPO训练方法，利用专家轨迹增强监督学习。
Result: GRPO训练将9B代理的任务成功率从6.9%提高到13.2%，并提升指南质量；评估中最强模型（API模型）完成率低于40%。
Conclusion: 当前最强模型在MAG基准上完成率不足40%，说明任务极具挑战性，为未来研究留下充足空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Workload-Driven Optimization for On-Device Real-Time Subtitle Translation
papers.abstract_en: This report studies on-device English-to-Traditional-Chinese subtitle translation for Taiwan under short inputs, short outputs, batch-size-one inference, low latency, and privacy constraints. These conditions limit the value of optimizations designed for long-context or high-throughput language-model serving. Starting from LMT-60-0.6B, preliminary profiling suggests that vocabulary projection becomes a more important decode-time cost after GGUF quantization reduces the relative cost of Transformer blocks. We replace the original 151k-token vocabulary with a 64k-token subtitle-domain tokenizer, migrate the embedding space, and adapt the model through embedding calibration followed by full supervised fine-tuning. On an OpenSubtitles2024 test set, LocalSubs achieves a 59.2% tie-excluded win rate against Google Translate under GPT-4o pairwise judging. Performance is strongest on short cues and declines as cue length increases. In a separate preliminary Apple M2 Metal profiling run, LocalSubs shows a 1.63x speedup over a 151k-vocabulary baseline. The code is available on https://github.com/aiden1020/localsubs .

papers.title: RASR: Range-Aware Scale Recovery for Metric UAV Navigation
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in image-goal UAV navigation under Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) denial is estimating metric distance and heading between current and goal views. Dense pairwise geometry models capture relative scene structure, but without a calibrated metric scale, they cannot directly provide reliable distance estimates for navigation. Although global scale calibration corrects the dominant scale bias, the remaining errors vary systematically with distance. In this paper, Range-Aware Scale Recovery (RASR) is proposed, which complements global scale calibration with range-aware residual correction. RASR encodes pairwise geometry extracted by a frozen Matching And Stereo 3D Reconstruction (MASt3R) backbone as a compact descriptor and separates the scale-recovery core from task-specific command calibration. On the official online evaluation of the UAVs in Multimedia 2026 PairUAV challenge, RASR achieved a total error of 0.003189, achieving a lower total error than global scale calibration alone. The results demonstrate that range-aware residual correction improves metric distance estimation beyond global scale calibration. Code and materials are available at https://github.com/lht-research/rasr-pairuav.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Technical report for the UAVM 2026 PairUAV Challenge

TL;DR: 针对GNSS拒止环境下图像目标无人机导航中度量距离和航向估计问题，提出范围感知尺度恢复（RASR）方法，通过范围感知残差校正补充全局尺度校准。在UAVM 2026 PairUAV挑战赛官方在线评估中，RASR将总误差降至0.003189，低于单独全局尺度校准。

papers.title: How Does Bayesian Causal Discovery Fail? Characterising Structural Consequences in Linear Gaussian Networks under Latent Confounding
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian causal discovery is widely used for its ability to quantify epistemic uncertainty over directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) through posterior inference. However, its behaviour under latent confounding remains poorly understood, as existing work typically notes that confounding breaks identifiability without characterising how the posterior distribution over DAGs responds. In this work, we analyse posterior behaviour under latent confounding in linear Gaussian causal models, focusing on additive latent confounding between exactly two observed variables. We derive a critical correlation threshold above which the score function favours graphs with a spurious edge between the confounded variables, and show that this threshold decreases with sample size -- more data lowers the correlation required for the spurious edge to be favoured. Beyond this threshold, we characterize two distinct posterior failure regimes determined by the local structure around the confounded variables. Our findings are supported by exact posterior computations on multiple graph structures, demonstrating both the predicted failure regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性高斯因果模型中潜在混淆变量影响贝叶斯因果发现的问题，理论分析了两个观测变量间加性混淆导致的后验失败。推导出临界相关阈值，超过该阈值后验倾向于包含混淆变量间的虚假边，且阈值随样本量增加而降低。进一步刻画了两种后验失败模式，并通过精确后验计算验证。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯因果发现通常假设无混淆，但实际数据中常存在混淆变量，而混淆如何具体扭曲后验分布缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 对线性高斯因果模型中的加性混淆进行理论分析，推导后验分数函数对虚假边的偏好条件，并通过多种图结构下的精确后验计算验证。
Result: 推导出临界相关阈值，超过该阈值后验倾向于包含虚假边，且阈值随样本量减小；并刻画了两种不同的后验失败模式。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了贝叶斯因果发现在混淆下的结构失败机制，为实际应用提供理论警示。

papers.title: Using AI-based Learning Assistants in Higher Education: A Large-Scale Descriptive Analysis
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we present a large-scale descriptive analysis of the use of an AI-based learning assistant (Syntea) in higher education. Based on objective log data from 77,543 students enrolled in distance studies, we examine usage patterns across gender, age group, study cluster, degree, and study mode. To date, existing research on educational chatbots has largely relied on comparatively small samples and self-reported survey data, while large-scale evidence on actual usage behavior remains limited. Our findings show that Syntea is already embedded in the study routines of many learners, but that usage differs across demographic and structural contexts. By identifying these patterns, our study provides an empirical basis for the further development of AI-based learning support and contributes a large-scale analysis of educational chatbot usage in higher education.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于77543名远程学生的客观日志数据，描述性分析AI学习助手Syntea的使用模式，涵盖性别、年龄、学科、学位和学习模式。发现Syntea已嵌入学习常规，但使用情况因人口统计和结构背景而异。
Motivation: 现有教育聊天机器人研究多依赖小样本和自我报告数据，缺乏大规模客观使用行为的证据。
Method: 对Syntea的日志数据进行大规模描述性分析，按性别、年龄组、学习集群、学位和学习模式等维度统计使用模式。
Result: Syntea已被许多学习者纳入日常学习，但使用模式在不同人口统计和结构背景下存在差异。
Conclusion: 研究为AI学习支持的进一步发展提供了实证基础，并对高等教育中教育聊天机器人的使用进行了大规模分析。

papers.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semantic visual-action tokenizer, which aligns visual representations with both semantics and actions, improving instruction following and action precision in subsequent policy learning. (2) Given the strictly causal nature of temporal dynamics, we adopt a causal pretraining paradigm, training from scratch to circumvent the catastrophic forgetting that frequently occurs when adapting bidirectional architectures. (3) To meet the demands of high-frequency inference, our model employs a sparse MoE backbone, expanding model capacity without compromising efficiency. (4) Real-time closed-loop control is realized through an enhanced asynchronous inference scheme, which predicts future latents in parallel with action execution while re-grounding each rollout on the latest observation via learned forward dynamics. Real-world deployment validates LingBot-VA 2.0 as a robust foundation model, as evidenced by its few-shot generalization across complex manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LingBot-VA 2.0，一个从头构建的视频-动作基础模型，用于通用机器人控制。相比传统视频生成模型，该模型通过四个核心设计——语义视觉-动作分词器、因果预训练范式、稀疏MoE骨干和异步推理机制——实现了实时闭环控制与少样本泛化。真实世界部署验证了其在复杂操作任务上的有效性。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型面向数字内容，不适用于物理环境，需要为具身智能从头设计视频-动作模型。
Method: 提出LingBot-VA 2.0，核心包括：(1)语义视觉-动作分词器，对齐视觉与语义及动作；(2)因果预训练范式，从头训练避免灾难性遗忘；(3)稀疏MoE骨干，扩展容量同时保持效率；(4)异步推理机制，并行预测未来潜在状态与动作执行，实现实时闭环控制。
Result: 真实世界部署表明该模型在复杂操作任务上具备少样本泛化能力，作为稳健的基础模型得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LingBot-VA 2.0是一个鲁棒的机器人基础模型，但在局限性方面未作讨论。

papers.title: Doomed from the Start: Early Abort of LLM Agent Episodes via a Recall-Controlled Probe Cascade
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents often waste inference compute by continuing multi-step trajectories that are already doomed to fail. We study early failure prediction and inference-time early stopping for LLM agents using hidden-state probes. Lightweight linear probes on internal activations predict eventual task failure from the first interaction round, substantially earlier than agent-monitoring methods based only on observable behavior. We turn this signal into a recall-controlled abort cascade for reducing LLM agent inference costs. The cascade applies a distribution-free calibrated failure detector at each early interaction round and jointly optimizes per-round recall budgets. This design ensures that eventually successful episodes survive all early-stopping gates at a user-specified global recall rate. After selection, the cascade is frozen and certified on independent data, providing an exact post-selection recall guarantee. We evaluate the method on TextCraft and WebShop with Qwen-2.5-7B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Qwen3-1.7B. The proposed LLM agent early-stopping cascade outperforms the best single-gate baseline in every model-environment pair, saving 1.5-8.8 times more compute at a 90% recall target. Achieved recall remains within one standard deviation of its target in all 24 configurations. The strongest settings reduce generated tokens by 60.2% on TextCraft and 54.9% on WebShop at 90% recall, while retaining savings of 45.0% and 41.5% at 95% recall. Behavior-only monitoring is consistently weaker, and adding behavioral features to hidden-state probes provides no further gain. We also characterize the sample complexity required to certify high-recall early-stopping policies. The code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理在多步轨迹中因早期失败而浪费推理计算的问题，提出基于隐藏状态探针的早期失败预测和推理时早停方法。轻量级线性探针从第一轮交互即可预测任务失败，并通过召回控制的中止级联（recall-controlled abort cascade）实现早停，保证用户指定的全局召回率。在TextCraft和WebShop上使用Qwen-2.5-7B等模型评估，该方法在90%召回目标下比最佳单门基线节省1.5-8.8倍计算量，生成令牌减少60.2%（TextCraft）和54.9%（WebShop）。
Motivation: LLM代理在注定失败的复杂任务中继续执行多步轨迹，浪费大量推理计算。现有基于可观察行为的监控方法无法提前发现失败，需要更早的失败预测机制。
Method: 提出召回控制的中止级联（recall-controlled abort cascade）：在每个早期交互轮次使用无分布校准的失败检测器，联合优化每轮召回预算，保证最终成功轨迹以指定全局召回率通过所有早停门。级联冻结后在独立数据上认证，提供精确后选择召回保证。
Result: 在TextCraft和WebShop上，该方法在90%召回目标下比最佳单门基线节省1.5-8.8倍计算量；生成令牌减少60.2%（TextCraft）和54.9%（WebShop）。在95%召回下仍保留45.0%和41.5%的节省。所有24个配置中召回率与目标偏差在一个标准差内。
Conclusion: 基于隐藏状态探针的早停方法显著优于仅依赖可观察行为的监控，且添加行为特征无额外收益。论文还刻画了高召回早停策略认证所需的样本复杂度。

summary_sections.result: 在TextCraft和WebShop上，该方法在90%召回目标下比最佳单门基线节省1.5-8.8倍计算量；生成令牌减少60.2%（TextCraft）和54.9%（WebShop）。在95%召回下仍保留45.0%和41.5%的节省。所有24个配置中召回率与目标偏差在一个标准差内。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基于隐藏状态探针的早停方法显著优于仅依赖可观察行为的监控，且添加行为特征无额外收益。论文还刻画了高召回早停策略认证所需的样本复杂度。

papers.title: A framework for single and multi-agent human-AI curiosity ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: This paper offers a framework for considering curiosity as an ecosystem. First, it suggests that a single agent's inquiry policy (how, when, and why an agent asks a question) depends on how the agent values immediate uncertainty reduction, costs, delayed return, and the value of keeping the question open. A key concept in the framework is that the weights on these decision-related terms can change with experience. For example, a period of cheap, quickly answered questions may change the cost of inquiry on a short timescale and change which kinds of questions the agent is drawn to answer over a longer timescale. Second, these ideas are extended to many agents exploring a shared knowledge landscape, and there the framework tracks inquiry volume, topic diversity, frontier-directed inquiry, redundancy, and reusable knowledge. The result is a conceptual framework for studying curiosity ecology and for future efforts towards designing multi-agent AI systems for discovery.

Motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个统一的生态系统视角来理解好奇心如何驱动智能体探索并影响知识发现过程，尤其是多智能体环境下的知识共享与演化。
Method: 构建概念框架，首先形式化单智能体在不确定性减少、成本、延迟回报和保持问题开放价值之间的决策权衡，并引入经验驱动的权重动态调整机制；然后将框架扩展至多智能体，定义查询量、主题多样性、前沿导向查询、冗余和可重用知识等指标以刻画集体探索行为。

Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架可用于研究好奇心生态学，并为未来设计多智能体AI发现系统提供指导，但未涉及具体实验验证或定量结果。

papers.title: Is the Geometry Doing the Work? An Operating-Point Audit of Hierarchy in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic vision-language models are designed to encode abstraction geometrically: general concepts near the origin, specific ones farther out, and entailment cones representing directed order. We ask whether trained MERU, HyCoCLIP, and PHyCLIP models actually use these mechanisms. We audit seven released checkpoints and matched from-scratch interventions, using diagnostics that distinguish active hyperbolic geometry from angular structure and supervision effects. All audited converged checkpoints remain near-Euclidean in the dimensionless radius $u=\sqrt{c}ρ$, which measures how strongly embeddings experience hyperbolic geometry: the largest observed image-side value is $0.37$ -- well below $u\approx0.84$, where local metric distortion reaches $10\%$. Releasing the curvature floor changes curvature and norms but not this regime, with mixed, generally modest downstream shifts. Trained entailment cones are saturated or nearly saturated, so low violation rates can arise from trivially wide cones rather than learned order. Preregistered semantic traversal detects weak within-branch order but no operative full-hierarchy readout. Shuffle-controlled tests detect no pair-specific radial ordering in released checkpoints, and no positive result is consistent across all three matched ViT-B seeds. We trace this to a low-curvature shortcut: lowering curvature widens entailment cones and suppresses violations without learning order. In the probed trajectories, gradient decomposition identifies entailment as the dominant curvature-lowering pressure during collapse. Yet curvature contracts even when entailment is removed, so the shortcut is not the sole cause. Under our diagnostics, the audited formulations do not demonstrate an operative radial or cone-based hierarchy. We distill the audit into a five-number geometry report for evaluating future hierarchy claims.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对现有的双曲视觉语言模型（MERU、HyCoCLIP、PHyCLIP）进行审计，检查其是否真正利用了双曲几何的层次结构。通过诊断发现，所有检查的模型在无量纲半径上保持近欧几里得特性，训练出的蕴含锥饱和或接近饱和，未展现有效的径向或锥形层次结构。
Motivation: 双曲视觉语言模型声称能通过几何方式编码抽象层次，但实际训练后的模型是否真的利用了这些机制尚不明确。
Method: 审计了七个已发布检查点和匹配的从头干预实验，使用诊断方法区分活跃的双曲几何与角度结构及监督效应，并进行了梯度分解分析。
Result: 所有审计模型的无量纲半径远低于双曲几何显著作用的阈值；蕴含锥饱和；语义遍历仅检测到弱分支内顺序；混洗控制测试未发现一致的径向排序。
Conclusion: 在当前配方下，双曲视觉语言模型并未展现出可操作的径向或锥形层次结构，审计结果总结为五数几何报告供未来评估使用。

papers.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
papers.abstract_en: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) for agentic tasks, where an LLM agent interacts with an environment over multiple turns and a student imitates a teacher over these multi-turn interaction histories. Fully online OPD is costly because each update requires fresh student rollouts through the environment and teacher queries at visited histories. We propose Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation (ReOPD), an off-environment alternative that reuses pre-collected teacher trajectories as replayed prefixes: the student acts at selected steps, while the teacher provides dense per-step supervision without executing new environment interactions. We show that multi-turn OPD introduces a prefix trap: making histories more student-on-policy improves relevance to the student, but can query the teacher on histories where its target is unreliable. This creates a two-sided distribution shift between student occupancy and teacher reliability. ReOPD addresses this by treating multi-turn OPD as a reliability-aware prefix distribution design and implements it with a simple step-decaying sampling schedule that emphasizes early, lower-shift prefixes. Across mathematical reasoning with Python and search environments over multiple teacher and student model scales, ReOPD preserves or improves OPD-level accuracy, uses zero tool calls during student training, and is at least 4$\times$ faster per rollout than OPD. ReOPD therefore turns expensive agent-environment interaction into a reusable offline resource, enabling scalable distillation across tools, tasks, and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究多轮交互中智能体（agent）任务的在线蒸馏（OPD）问题。提出ReOPD方法，通过重用预收集的教师轨迹作为重放前缀（replayed prefix），避免全在线OPD每次更新所需的代价高昂的环境交互。方法解决了多轮OPD中的前缀陷阱问题，即学生占据分布与教师可靠性的双向偏移，并通过逐步衰减采样策略强调早期低偏移前缀。实验表明，在数学推理与搜索环境中，ReOPD保持或提升OPD级精度，训练时无需工具调用，且每个rollout至少比OPD快4倍。
Motivation: 全在线OPD每次更新需要学生与环境交互并查询教师，成本极高，限制了大规模蒸馏的可行性。
Method: 提出ReOPD，将预收集的教师轨迹作为初始前缀（prefix），学生仅在选定步骤执行动作，教师提供密集的逐步监督，无需额外环境交互。将多轮OPD建模为可靠性感知的前缀分布设计，并采用简单的逐步衰减（step-decaying）采样策略，优先使用早期、偏移较小的前缀。
Result: 在数学推理（Python）和搜索环境上，使用多种教师与学生模型规模，ReOPD保持或提升OPD的准确率，训练中零工具调用，每个rollout速度至少是OPD的4倍。
Conclusion: 将昂贵的智能体-环境交互转化为可重用的离线资源，实现了跨工具、任务和环境的可扩展蒸馏，显著降低在线训练成本。

papers.title: Governing Generative AI Across Financial Institutions: A Framework for Generative AI Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence is moving from general-purpose experimentation toward specialized applications across banking, capital markets, insurance, payments, and wealth management. Its main contribution is not limited to conversational interfaces. Modern generative systems can synthesize large document collections, extract information from unstructured data, generate software and analytical code, create scenario narratives, support research workflows, and coordinate multi-step tasks. These capabilities make generative AI especially relevant to finance, where decisions often depend on combining quantitative data with contracts, policies,filings, news, customer communications, and expert judgment. This paper presents an application-oriented view of generative AI in finance. It organizes potential uses around five capability patterns, including knowledge synthesis, content generation, analytical assistance, interaction, and workflow orchestration, and maps them to major financia functions. Representative applications include investment research, customer service, lending support, fraud investigation, financial reporting, operations automation, software development, and personalized financial guidance. The paper also discusses common technical architectures, such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using assistants, multimodal models, and agentic workflows, and identifies practical factors that shape business value. The resulting landscape provides a foundation for researchers and practitioners seeking to understand where generative AI may produce the greatest operational and analytical impact in financial services

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向金融机构的生成式AI风险控制框架，将生成式AI的能力归纳为知识综合、内容生成、分析辅助、交互和工作流编排五种模式，并映射到银行、保险、支付等主要金融功能。摘要还讨论了检索增强生成、工具使用助手、多模态模型和智能体工作流等技术架构，以及影响商业价值的实践因素。
Motivation: 生成式AI正从通用实验转向金融领域的专业应用，但缺乏系统性的风险控制框架来指导其在关键金融功能中的部署。
Method: 提出应用导向的生成式AI风险控制框架，基于五种能力模式（知识综合、内容生成、分析辅助、交互、工作流编排）组织潜在用途，并映射到投资研究、客户服务、贷款支持、欺诈调查等金融功能。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但描述了框架如何帮助识别生成式AI在金融服务中产生最大运营和分析影响的领域。
Conclusion: 该框架为研究人员和从业者理解生成式AI在金融服务中的影响提供了基础，但未讨论具体风险管理指标或实证验证。

papers.title: ADP: Adversarial Dynamics Priors for Physically Grounded Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Adversarial Dynamics Priors (ADP) for perturbation-resilient humanoid locomotion control. Existing motion prior-based methods induce natural motion styles by imitating kinematic motion features, but they do not directly regularize dynamics features, such as CoM motion, centroidal momentum, contact forces, and contact states. To address this limitation, we replace kinematic motion-style feature with selected dynamics features extracted from locomotion trajectories as the target of adversarial regularization. To this end, we use trajectory optimization to construct a reference dataset and train a discriminator to evaluate whether policy-induced temporal windows are consistent with the resulting reference distribution. Without explicit motion tracking, ADP encourages policy rollouts to remain close to the reference support, even after perturbations. Experimental results show that, compared with AMP, the strongest baseline in our evaluation, ADP improves the $80\%$-success impulse threshold ($J_{80}$) by $16.7\%$, while reducing direction-averaged recovery time and velocity tracking error by $47.9\%$ and $35.4\%$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗动力学先验（ADP）用于抗扰动的人形机器人 locomotion 控制。与现有基于运动先验的方法不同，ADP 直接正则化动力学特征（如质心运动、接触力等），而不是运动学特征。通过轨迹优化构建参考数据集，训练判别器评估策略轨迹是否与参考分布一致。实验表明，与 AMP 基线相比，ADP 将 80% 成功脉冲阈值 J80 提升 16.7%，恢复时间和速度跟踪误差分别降低 47.9% 和 35.4%。
Motivation: 现有运动先验方法通过模仿运动学特征生成自然运动风格，但未直接正则化动力学特征（如质心运动、接触力等），导致在扰动下鲁棒性不足。
Method: 用轨迹优化构造参考数据集，提取动力学特征（质心运动、角动量、接触力和接触状态）作为对抗正则化的目标；训练判别器区分策略产生的时序窗口是否来自参考分布，无需显式运动跟踪。
Result: 与最强基线 AMP 相比，ADP 提高 80% 成功脉冲阈值 J80 达 16.7%，方向平均恢复时间降低 47.9%，速度跟踪误差降低 35.4%。
Conclusion: 本文表明针对动力学特征而非运动学特征的对抗正则化能有效提升人形机器人 locomotion 对扰动的鲁棒性。

papers.title: MVFusion-GS: Motion-Variance Guided Temporal Attention for High-Quality Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis for static scenes. Extending it to dynamic scenes via deformation fields has recently attracted significant attention, particularly for dynamic scene reconstructionband distractor-free. However, existing deformation networks lack explicit motion awareness: they neither capture long-term motion intensity nor exploit short-term temporal coherence, leading to inaccurate foreground deformation and pseudo-static residuals in the background. We present MVFusion-GS, a method that enhances deformation networks with two complementary motion-aware mechanisms. The Motion-Variance Guided Refinement aggregates per-Gaussian deformation statistics across time to estimate motion variance and uses it to guide dynamic-static separation during deformation prediction. The MotionFormer Temporal Attention module applies Transformer self-attention over neighboring timesteps to model local motion dependencies and improve temporal consistency. Extensive experiments on both dynamic scene reconstruction and distractor-free reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, showing that explicit motion awareness improves both foreground motion modeling and static background reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MVFusion-GS方法，通过运动方差引导细化（Motion-Variance Guided Refinement）和MotionFormer时间注意力模块增强变形网络，显式建模运动强度和时间连贯性，用于高质量动态场景重建和无干扰重建。实验表明该方法在动态场景重建和无干扰重建基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有动态场景重建的变形网络缺乏显式运动感知，既不能捕捉长期运动强度，也不能利用短期时间连贯性，导致前景变形不准确和背景伪静态残留。
Method: 提出两个互补的运动感知机制：1）运动方差引导细化（Motion-Variance Guided Refinement），聚合每个高斯随时间变化的变形统计以估计运动方差，并用于引导变形预测中的动态-静态分离；2）MotionFormer时间注意模块，对相邻时间步应用Transformer自注意机制以建模局部运动依赖并改善时间一致性。
Result: 在动态场景重建和无干扰重建基准上达到最先进性能，表明显式运动感知改善前景运动建模和静态背景重建。
Conclusion: 显式运动感知机制能有效提升动态场景重建质量，尤其在区分动态和静态区域方面。

papers.title: Are Performance-Optimization Benchmarks Reliably Measuring Coding Agents?
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level performance-optimization benchmarks such as GSO, SWE-Perf and SWE-fficiency evaluate coding agents by applying patches to real repositories and comparing runtime against unoptimized baselines and official reference patches. Their leaderboard scores are increasingly used as evidence of coding-agent progress, but those scores can conflate runtime instability, benchmark-specific scoring rules, and how many tasks are already solved by at least one public submission. We audit these issues across the three benchmarks. First, we replay the official reference patches for 740 code optimization tasks across four common types of Google Cloud machines. Most benchmark tasks can be replayed, but their reference patches satisfy the original benchmark validity rules in every cross-machine replay for only 39/102 GSO tasks, 11/140 SWE-Perf tasks, and 411/498 SWE-fficiency tasks; SWE-Perf is especially fragile because many reference patches produce close-to-zero runtime changes. Second, we show that public submission rankings depend strongly on the benchmark scoring rule. Among eight public submissions shared by GSO and SWE-fficiency, the official rankings disagree on 9 of 28 pairwise submission comparisons, and SWE-fficiency's leaderboard scoring rule assigns the worst ten tasks overly high score weights of 58.5%-82.8%. Third, looking across 10 public submissions for each task, we find that at least one submission matches or beats the reference patch on 85.3% (384/450) of replay-valid GSO and SWE-fficiency tasks, and beats the unoptimized base code on 99.8% (449/450). Our study complements leaderboard scores by identifying tasks with more reliable performance signals, quantifying per-task score contributions, and exposing the remaining performance gaps that are hidden by aggregate rankings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了GSO、SWE-Perf和SWE-fficiency三个代码性能优化基准的可靠性。通过重放参考补丁、分析评分规则和检查提交覆盖，发现大部分参考补丁在不同机器上无法复现（尤其是SWE-Perf），排行榜评分规则导致大量排名分歧，且多数任务已被至少一个提交超越。研究建议谨慎解读排行榜分数，并提供了更可靠的任务子集。
Motivation: 性能优化基准（如GSO、SWE-Perf、SWE-fficiency）的排行榜分数被广泛用作编码智能体进步的指标，但这些分数可能混淆了运行时噪声、评分规则偏差和任务解决率，亟需系统性审计。
Method: 对740个代码优化任务在四种Google Cloud机器上重放官方参考补丁，检验跨机器可重现性；比较八种公开提交的排名对评分规则的敏感性；统计有多少任务已被至少一个提交匹配或超越参考补丁。
Result: 跨机器重放中仅39/102（GSO）、11/140（SWE-Perf）和411/498（SWE-fficiency）任务满足原始有效性规则；评分规则导致28对提交比较中9对排名不一致；85.3%的可重放任务已被至少一个提交匹配或超越参考补丁。
Conclusion: 当前性能优化基准的排行榜分数不可靠，应结合任务级可靠性和得分贡献解读；研究提供了识别可靠任务和量化隐藏差距的方法。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Quantization for Object Detectors using Off-the-Shelf Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: With an increasing number of Object Detection (OD) models being deployed on edge devices, Zero-Shot Quantization for OD (ZSQ-OD) aims to quantize these models when access to the original training data is prohibited. Existing research on Zero-Shot Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) for OD synthesizes training sets through noise optimization. However, this approach struggles to maintain performance in low-bit regions. In this paper, we introduce GoodQ (Generative off-the-shelf models for object detector Quantization), a QAT pipeline that utilizes off-the-shelf generative models to construct a training set. We first identify three challenges that arise when introducing a generative model to the ZSQ-OD task: 1) each image contains dense information with multiple instances, 2) the class-wise distribution in the original dataset is imbalanced, and 3) the pseudo-labels assigned to the generated images can potentially act as noisy signals during QAT. GoodQ addresses these challenges by 1) introducing an Information-Dense Prompting strategy to generate multi-instance images, 2) applying Intrinsic Distribution-Aware Selection to match the pretrained class distribution, and 3) employing Teacher-guided Adaptive Noise Reduction to mitigate noise arising from the QAT process. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-bit ZSQ (W4A4) and extends quantization to extreme bit-widths (W3A3). Furthermore, we conduct an extensive analysis to uncover the underlying factors contributing to the efficacy of GoodQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GoodQ，一种利用现成生成模型（如扩散模型）为目标检测器构建训练集的零样本量化（ZSQ）流程。GoodQ通过信息密集提示（Information-Dense Prompting）生成多实例图像，通过内在分布感知选择（Intrinsic Distribution-Aware Selection）匹配预训练类别分布，并通过教师引导自适应降噪（Teacher-guided Adaptive Noise Reduction）减轻伪标签噪声。在低比特量化（W4A4和W3A3）上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有零样本量化感知训练（QAT）通过噪声优化合成训练集，在低比特区域性能下降；且直接使用生成模型构建训练集面临三个挑战：每个图像需包含多个实例、原始数据集类别分布不平衡、伪标签可能引入噪声。
Method: 提出GoodQ流水线：1）信息密集提示策略生成包含多个实例的图像；2）内在分布感知选择调整生成图像的类别分布以匹配预训练模型；3）教师引导自适应降噪在QAT过程中抑制伪标签噪声。
Result: 在低比特量化（W4A4）上取得最先进性能，并扩展到极低比特（W3A3）。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: GoodQ证明了现成生成模型在目标检测零样本量化中的有效性，并通过消融分析揭示了其成功因素。
Relevance: 0
