papers.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
papers.abstract_en: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagination play complementary roles. Language provides the abstract structure of a plan, including task decomposition, planning primitives, constraints, temporal order, and decision logic, while visual imagination grounds this structure through world state prediction and joint subgoal planning, associating each planning step with intermediate and final physical states. RxBrain adopts a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports language, image, and video understanding and generation within one model. To train this capability, we build an automatic pipeline that converts embodied videos into joint text-visual planning supervision by decomposing videos into planning steps and aligning them with visual state transitions. We further introduce RxBrain-Bench to evaluate whether models can represent embodied plans through joint textual and visual components rather than separate understanding or generation. Experiments show that RxBrain maintains embodied understanding and generation abilities, and produces plans with coupled textual reasoning, world state prediction, and joint subgoal planning. We also extend RxBrain to continuous robot action generation, where it shows promising real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining. These results provide an initial step toward foundation models for embodied cognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hy-Embodied-RxBrain，一种具身认知基础模型，将语言与视觉想象结合，通过统一的多模态Mixture-of-Transformers架构支持语言、图像和视频的理解与生成。模型将具身计划表示为单一规划序列，语言提供抽象结构，视觉想象通过世界状态预测和联合子目标规划进行接地。自动管道从具身视频中提取联合文本-视觉规划监督，并引入RxBrain-Bench评估。实验表明模型保持具身理解和生成能力，并扩展到连续机器人动作生成，展示了真实机器人上的有前景性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型侧重于场景理解和文本决策，生成世界模型主要预测未来视觉状态，缺乏将高层任务推理与物理状态联合表示的具身计划能力。
Method: 采用统一多模态Mixture-of-Transformers架构，支持语言、图像和视频的理解与生成；构建自动管道从具身视频中分解规划步骤并与视觉状态转换对齐，生成联合文本-视觉规划监督；引入RxBrain-Bench评估模型通过联合文本和视觉组件表示具身计划的能力。
Result: 实验表明RxBrain保持具身理解和生成能力，产生耦合文本推理、世界状态预测和联合子目标规划的计划；在连续机器人动作生成上表现有前景，无需大规模动作数据预训练。
Conclusion: 这些结果为具身认知基础模型提供了初步步骤，表明联合语言-视觉推理和想象在具身计划中的有效性。

summary_sections.method: 采用统一多模态Mixture-of-Transformers架构，支持语言、图像和视频的理解与生成；构建自动管道从具身视频中分解规划步骤并与视觉状态转换对齐，生成联合文本-视觉规划监督；引入RxBrain-Bench评估模型通过联合文本和视觉组件表示具身计划的能力。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明RxBrain保持具身理解和生成能力，产生耦合文本推理、世界状态预测和联合子目标规划的计划；在连续机器人动作生成上表现有前景，无需大规模动作数据预训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些结果为具身认知基础模型提供了初步步骤，表明联合语言-视觉推理和想象在具身计划中的有效性。

papers.title: NexForge: Scaling Executable Agent Tasks via Requirement-First Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Scaling executable agent training data is bottlenecked by substrate-first methods that tie task generation to predefined tools, repositories, or skill graphs: expanding coverage requires manual expansion of the substrate, each new domain demands a bespoke pipeline, and the resulting task distributions often reflect substrate convenience rather than real-world demand. We introduce NexForge, a requirement-first framework that compiles free-form capability requirements into executable agent training data. NexForge first performs research-based demand discovery to identify representative task forms, realistic scenarios, and their relative prevalence. It then applies distribution-aware task compilation and automatically retrieves or constructs the files, repositories, dependencies, and runtime configurations required to materialize each task, followed by teacher rollout collection and trajectory distillation. The same pipeline, without any domain-specific infrastructure, produces 3,600 terminal tasks and 2,000 office tasks, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Base from 22.5% to 52.0% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and from 813 to 1338 Elo on GDPval; scaling to 43.2K terminal tasks reaches 58.4%, surpassing Claude Opus 4.6. Scaled further, NexForge-synthesized data contributes to the training of Nex-N2, a family of publicly available agent models that lift Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to 75.3% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and to 1585 Elo on GDPval -- achieving state-of-the-art open-source performance and surpassing several frontier proprietary systems. Nex-N2 models are available at https://nex.sii.edu.cn/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NexForge 是一个需求优先的框架，通过研究驱动的需求发现、分布感知的任务编译以及自动文件与依赖检索，从自由形式的能力需求生成可执行的代理训练数据。该框架在无需领域特定基础设施的情况下，生成了3,600个终端任务和2,000个办公任务，将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Base 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的性能从22.5%提升至52.0%，在 GDPval 上从813 Elo提升至1338 Elo；扩展到43.2K终端任务后达到58.4%，超越 Claude Opus 4.6。进一步扩展后，NexForge 合成的数据用于训练 Nex-N2 模型系列，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到75.3%，在 GDPval 上达到1585 Elo，实现开源最先进性能并超越多个前沿专有系统。
Motivation: 现有可执行代理训练数据的扩展受限于以基板（substrate）优先的方法，这些方法将任务生成绑定到预定义的工具、仓库或技能图上，导致扩展覆盖需要手动扩展基板、每个新领域需要专用管道、任务分布反映基板便利性而非真实需求。
Method: NexForge 是一个需求优先的框架，首先进行研究驱动的需求发现以识别代表性任务形式、现实场景及其相对流行度；然后应用分布感知的任务编译，自动检索或构建实现每个任务所需的文件、仓库、依赖和运行时配置；最后进行教师轨迹收集与轨迹蒸馏。
Result: 在终端任务上，NexForge 将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Base 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的性能从22.5%提升至52.0%，在 GDPval 上从813 Elo提升至1338 Elo；扩展到43.2K终端任务后达到58.4%，超越 Claude Opus 4.6。Nex-N2 模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到75.3%，在 GDPval 上达到1585 Elo，实现开源最先进性能并超越多个前沿专有系统。
Conclusion: NexForge 展示了需求优先的任务合成能够有效扩展可执行代理训练数据，且无需领域特定基础设施，合成的数据可用于训练高性能代理模型。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Knowledge Dynamics: An Operational Framework for Saturation and Escape
papers.abstract_en: Feedback-driven loops support iterative improvement in large language models, reinforcement learning, and autonomous discovery, yet their gains often diminish under repeated internal feedback. We study why closed-loop knowledge systems saturate and what external information can move them beyond their current attractors. We introduce a three-level operational framework in which knowledge states $x_t$ evolve through transition kernels $K_θ$ indexed by a structural parameter $θ$. The governing structure is defined as the observational equivalence class of $θ$ induced by these kernels, while attractors and basins are properties of the fixed-$θ$ dynamics. A structural intervention changes $θ$ and produces a detectable kernel discrepancy on pre-specified probe states, making structural change falsifiable. Using a Lyapunov drift condition, we show that stable internal dynamics approach bounded stability regions with exponentially attenuated transients and a noise-controlled residual floor. We characterize escape through a metric condition on intervention-induced attractor displacement and a baseline-relative KL lower bound for increasing escape probability. This analysis also explains why conditional mutual information alone cannot certify escape: it measures variation among intervention-conditioned updates rather than departure from the no-intervention law. Case studies in LLM code repair, sparse-reward reinforcement learning, and Bayesian optimization use matched continuation controls to illustrate how feedback strength and alignment affect quality-improving escape. Our contribution is an operational connection among stability tools, measurable intervention effects, and cross-domain diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三层次操作框架，研究闭环知识系统为何饱和以及外部信息如何帮助逃离吸引子。通过李雅普诺夫漂移条件刻画稳定动力学，并给出结构干预导致可检测核差异的条件。案例涵盖 LLM 代码修复、稀疏奖励强化学习和贝叶斯优化。
Motivation: 反馈驱动的迭代改进在重复内部反馈下收益递减，现有理论缺乏对知识状态饱和机制和逃逸条件的统一刻画。
Method: 引入三层次框架：知识状态通过转移核演化，结构由核的观测等价类定义；利用李雅普诺夫漂移条件证明稳定动力学趋向有界稳定性区域，并给出基于干预诱导吸引子位移和 KL 下界的逃逸条件。
Result: 摘要表明稳定内部动力学具有指数衰减瞬态和噪声控制的残余底噪；逃逸条件通过干预诱导吸引子位移和基线相对 KL 下界量化。
Conclusion: 提供了稳定性工具、可测量干预效应和跨领域诊断之间的操作连接。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Open-AoE: An Open Egocentric Manipulation Dataset and Toolchain for Embodied Learning
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide scalable supervision for embodied intelligence, yet existing resources rarely combine low-cost continuous capture, manipulation-level structured annotations, and reusable tools for robot learning. We present Open-AoE, an open, community-oriented egocentric manipulation dataset and toolchain spanning the full pipeline from smartphone capture to model training. Its first release contains approximately 2,000 hours of manipulation video collected in natural environments by 500+ contributors using 400+ smartphones. The dataset provides text annotations, MANO-based hand poses, camera trajectories, and temporally localized atomic actions. Open-AoE further includes a data processing pipeline that transforms raw recordings into structured samples through temporal action segmentation, semantic annotation, hand reconstruction, and camera trajectory reconstruction. Meanwhile, we provide a separate downstream toolchain supports visualization, cross-embodiment retargeting, model-specific data conversion, and training recipes for VLA policies, WAMs, and World Models. By integrating scalable capture, structured processing, and downstream adaptation, Open-AoE reduces the barriers to both data contribution and reuse, providing practical open infrastructure for embodied model training, human-to-robot transfer, and world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Open-AoE 是一个面向具身学习的开放自我中心操作数据集与工具链，包含约 2000 小时由 500+ 贡献者使用 400+ 智能手机采集的自然环境操作视频，并提供文本标注、MANO 手部姿态、相机轨迹和原子动作标签。同时提供数据处理管线与下游工具链，支持 VLA 策略、WAM 和世界模型的训练。
Motivation: 现有自我中心视频资源缺乏低成本连续采集、操作级结构化标注和可复用工具的结合，阻碍了具身智能规模化发展。
Method: 构建从智能手机采集到模型训练的完整流水线：包括时间动作分割、语义标注、手部重建、相机轨迹重建的数据处理管线，以及可视化、跨具身重定向、模型数据转换和训练脚本的下游工具链。
Result: 数据集规模为约 2000 小时视频，来自 500+ 贡献者、400+ 设备，提供多层级标注和可复用的训练基础设施。
Conclusion: Open-AoE 通过整合可扩展采集、结构化处理和下游适配，降低了数据贡献与复用的门槛，为具身模型训练、人-机迁移和世界建模提供了实用的开放基础设施。

papers.title: Semantic Audio-driven Understanding for Dynamic Humanoid Whole Body Control
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in humanoid robotics and reinforcement learning have enabled the acquisition of highly expressive whole-body motion policies. However, most robotic performances remain based on pre-scripted sequences or externally triggered behaviors, limiting autonomy and responsiveness to dynamic environments. In this work, we introduce a novel multi-modal orchestration framework for semantic audio-driven humanoid control, enabling robots to autonomously select and execute appropriate motion skills in real time. The system processes continuous audio streams and routes them into music or speech branches. Music input is handled via audio fingerprinting and semantic embeddings to retrieve track identity and temporal alignment, allowing dynamic mapping between musical segments and motion policies. Speech input is grounded into a discrete library of imitation-learned skills, enabling direct human-robot interaction. Both modalities share a unified interface that schedules skill execution over a reinforcement learning control pipeline. We validate the approach in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid, showing robust sim-to-real transfer and consistent audio-conditioned policy selection. Supplementary materials are available at the following site: https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/semantic-WBC/
papers.comment: Accepted at 29th Robocup International Symposium, held on July 6th, 2026 in Incheon, Republic of Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态编排框架，使机器人能根据连续音频流（音乐或语音）实时选择和执行运动技能。音乐输入通过音频指纹和语义嵌入进行轨道识别和时间对齐，语音输入则映射到模仿学习的技能库。两者共享统一接口，经由强化学习控制流水线调度技能执行。在仿真和Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了鲁棒的模拟到现实迁移和一致的音频条件策略选择。
Motivation: 目前人形机器人的表演大多基于预编序列或外部触发行为，缺乏对动态环境的自主响应能力。
Method: 系统处理连续音频流，分支为音乐和语音。音乐通过音频指纹和语义嵌入检索轨道身份和时间对齐；语音输入映射到离散的模仿学习技能库。两者通过统一接口调度技能执行于强化学习控制流水线。
Result: 在仿真和Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了模拟到现实的稳健迁移，以及音频条件策略选择的一致性。
Conclusion: 该框架使人形机器人能基于语义音频理解自主控制全身动作，提高了自主性和对环境动态的响应能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantize with Confidence? An Empirical Study of Quantization for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: The growing adoption of local inference frameworks such as Ollama has made it increasingly common for developers to run large code models on laptops and other resource-constrained hardware. In these settings, post-training quantization is essential for reducing memory footprint and enabling practical deployment, yet its impact on generated code remains insufficiently understood. We empirically evaluate six state-of-the-art quantization methods (GPTQ, AWQ, QuIP#, AQLM, BitsAndBytes, and GGUF) on two representative large code model families, Qwen2.5-Coder and CodeLlama, using the multilingual McEval and CoderEval benchmarks for Python and Java. We assess functional correctness (pass@1) together with maintainability, reliability, security, and structural complexity. We also introduce a novel analysis of robustness under varying prompt complexity, characterized by Shannon entropy and token length. Our results show that quantization techniques differ meaningfully in their impact on correctness and code quality. AQLM consistently matches or exceeds the full-precision baseline, whereas QuIP# exhibits the largest correctness degradation, particularly on complex prompts. Security attributes remain stable across models, benchmarks, and programming languages, while robustness to prompt complexity varies across techniques. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting quantization strategies for deploying large code models on resource-constrained hardware and highlight the importance of evaluating quantized models beyond functional correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证研究了六种后训练量化方法（GPTQ、AWQ、QuIP#、AQLM、BitsAndBytes、GGUF）在Qwen2.5-Coder和CodeLlama两个大代码模型系列上的效果，使用McEval和CoderEval基准评估功能正确性、可维护性、可靠性、安全性和结构复杂度，并引入了基于Shannon熵和令牌长度的提示复杂度鲁棒性分析。结果表明，量化方法对正确性和代码质量的影响差异显著，AQLM一致匹配或超越全精度基线，而QuIP#在复杂提示下退化最严重，安全性保持稳定。
Motivation: 在资源受限硬件上部署大代码模型时，量化是减少内存占用的关键，但其对生成代码的影响尚未被充分理解。
Method: 对Qwen2.5-Coder和CodeLlama两个模型家族应用六种量化方法，在McEval和CoderEval基准上评估功能正确性（pass@1）、维护性、可靠性、安全性、结构复杂度，并引入基于Shannon熵和令牌长度的提示复杂度鲁棒性分析。
Result: AQLM一致匹配或超越全精度基线；QuIP#在复杂提示下正确性退化最大；安全性跨模型、基准和语言保持稳定；鲁棒性因技术而异。
Conclusion: 研究为资源受限硬件上部署大代码模型时的量化策略选择提供了实践指导，并强调了评估量化模型时需超越功能正确性的重要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RENEW: Towards Learning World Models and Repairing Model Exploitation from Preferences
papers.abstract_en: World models are widely used in offline reinforcement learning (RL) to improve sample efficiency and generate experience beyond a fixed dataset. However, they are vulnerable to model exploitation where data coverage is thin. Prior work addresses this either by collecting more expert demonstrations, which is often expensive, unsafe, or unavailable, or by conservative algorithms that avoid uncertain regions, which limits generalization. We propose instead to repair exploitation directly using human preferences over imagined rollouts, leveraging the strong intuitive physics that allows humans to easily spot egregious dynamics hallucinations. We formalize this as Dynamics Learning from Human Feedback (DLHF), a Bradley-Terry preference loss over trajectory log-likelihoods under a learned dynamics model. Unfortunately, naive DLHF is sample inefficient, so we introduce RENEW, which uses epistemic uncertainty to focus finetuning where the model is most exploitable. We evaluate on several Jumanji and classic control environments and find that while naive DLHF requires an outsize preference budget, RENEW makes the framework practical by improving sample efficiency, limiting catastrophic forgetting, and reducing exploitation in pretrained world models. Taken together, our results provide initial evidence that preferences can supervise world model dynamics directly, offering a new approach to addressing exploitation in offline model-based RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RENEW框架，通过人类偏好修复世界模型中的模型利用问题，使用不确定性引导的微调提高样本效率。在Jumanji和经典控制环境上评估，表明偏好可以直接监督世界模型动态。
Motivation: 离线强化学习中世界模型易受模型利用影响，现有方法要么收集专家示范昂贵，要么保守算法限制泛化。本文提出直接利用人类偏好修复利用问题。
Method: 提出动态学习从人类反馈（DLHF）的Bradley-Terry偏好损失，并引入RENEW使用认知不确定性聚焦微调于易利用区域。
Result: 在Jumanji和经典控制环境上，朴素DLHF需要过多偏好预算，而RENEW提高了样本效率，限制了灾难性遗忘，减少了预训练世界模型中的利用。
Conclusion: 摘要认为偏好可以直接监督世界模型动态，为离线模型基RL中的利用问题提供新方法。

papers.title: OvAi Focus: AI-based Multi-class Segmentation of Functional Ovaries and Adnexal Masses in Gynecological Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Ovarian cancer is the deadliest gynecological malignancy; accurate and objective segmentation of adnexal masses and functional ovaries in ultrasound (US) remains challenging due to operator variability and morphological complexity. We present OvAi Focus (SynDiag s.r.l., Italy), a stand-alone AI software medical device that performs multi-class semantic segmentation of functional ovaries and adnexal masses, distinguishing cystic from solid components. The system was trained and independently validated on a multicenter dataset of 1,081 adult women from 6 centers across Italy and Israel. Segmentation achieved DICE scores of 0.87 (complete lesion), 0.85 (cystic), 0.68 (solid), and 0.62 (functional ovary), in line with or superior to state-of-the-art approaches across heterogeneous acquisition settings.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at Ital-IA 2026 (6th CINI National Conference on Artificial Intelligence) in Rome, Italy. To be published in the CEUR-WS proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了OvAi Focus，一个用于妇科超声中功能性卵巢和附件肿块的多类语义分割的AI软件。系统在来自意大利和以色列6个中心的1081名成年女性数据集上训练并独立验证，分割DICE得分为：完整病变0.87，囊性0.85，实性0.68，功能性卵巢0.62，与现有方法相当或更优。
Motivation: 卵巢癌是最致命的妇科恶性肿瘤，超声中附件肿块和功能性卵巢的准确分割因操作者差异和形态复杂性而具有挑战性。
Method: 提出了OvAi Focus，一个独立运行的AI软件医疗设备，执行功能性卵巢和附件肿块的多类语义分割，区分囊性和实性成分。
Result: 在多种采集设置下，分割DICE得分分别为0.87（完整病变）、0.85（囊性）、0.68（实性）和0.62（功能性卵巢），与现有最优方法相当或更优。
Conclusion: 系统在异质采集设置下达到了与现有方法相当或更优的分割性能，但摘要未明确指出局限性。

papers.title: ReasFlow: Assisting Reasoning-Centric Scientific Discovery in Applied Mathematics via a Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent System
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models have fueled autonomous AI agents capable of tackling complex scientific tasks, yet existing automated research systems remain predominantly focused on empirically driven domains with quantitative benchmarks, leaving theory-driven discovery, particularly in mathematically grounded disciplines requiring rigorous proofs and synthesis of domain knowledge, largely underexplored. Key challenges include the difficulty of verifying theoretical reasoning at scale, insufficient reasoning ability for autonomous frontier exploration, and a scarcity of procedural heuristics in the literature. We introduce ReasFlow, an end-to-end autonomous agent system for reasoning-centric scientific discovery that operationalizes a collaborative paradigm where the human expert acts as Principal Investigator while the agent executes rigorous derivations as a capable graduate student. ReasFlow incorporates (i) a robust internal verification loop that audits logical coherence and corrects fundamental errors prior to human inspection, and (ii) an automated knowledge retrieval and self-improvement mechanism that proactively surfaces both declarative facts and overlooked procedural heuristics, substantially reducing expert intervention. The system unifies literature synthesis, algorithm design, theorem proving, experimentation, and manuscript preparation in a single system. Deployed to autonomously generate five complete research papers with rigorous theoretical and empirical content from minimal prompts, ReasFlow consistently achieves the highest evaluation scores among state-of-the-art open-access baselines under a curated LLM-based review rubric. ReasFlow is publicly accessible via the ReasLab platform, providing a collaborative workspace for AI-assisted theoretical research. Github repo: https://github.com/ReasLab/ReasFlow.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出ReasFlow，一种面向推理驱动科学发现的端到端自主多智能体系统，专为应用数学等需严格证明的理论领域设计。系统通过内部验证循环和自动知识检索减少人工干预，能自动完成文献综述、算法设计、定理证明、实验和论文撰写。实验显示，仅需少量提示即可自动生成五篇高质量研究论文，在基于LLM的评审中优于开源基线。
Motivation: 现有自动研究系统多聚焦于有定量基准的实证领域，未能有效支持理论驱动、依赖数学证明的学科，面临推理验证困难、自主推理能力不足及程序性启发式缺失等挑战。
Method: 提出ReasFlow系统，采用人类为首席研究员、智能体为研究生的协作范式。核心包括：内部验证循环（审计逻辑连贯性并纠正错误）和自动知识检索与自我改进机制（提炼声明性事实与程序性启发式），将文献综合、算法设计、定理证明、实验和手稿准备整合为单一系统。
Result: 系统在仅需少量提示下自动生成五篇完整研究论文（含严格理论与实证）。在基于LLM的评审准则下，ReasFlow在所有开源基线中持续获得最高评估分数。
Conclusion: ReasFlow为理论驱动的科学发现提供了可行的自动化方案，并开放平台供协作使用。但未探讨在特定数学领域的大规模验证或局限性。

papers.title: Low-Latency Relay Selection in NR-V2X Vehicular Communications via Graph Isomorphism Networks with Edge Features
papers.abstract_en: Reliable, low-latency uplink connectivity is a key requirement for C-V2X networks in dense urban environments, where fast channel variations and blockages often degrade direct vehicle-to-infrastructure links. Multi-hop relaying can restore coverage, but relay-link activation under radio, capacity, and routing constraints results in an NP-hard optimisation problem, typically solved via Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), whose runtime scales poorly with graph size. This paper introduces an edge-aware Learning-to-Optimise framework for real-time relay selection. Each V2X snapshot is modelled as a directed graph: node features encode vehicle state and traffic demand, while edge features capture radio-link capacity. An offline MILP oracle generates optimal relay configurations that supervise a Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge Features (GINE), enabling edge-level relay activation through a single forward pass, with tightly bounded inference latency. To bridge learning and exact optimisation, we also propose a hybrid GINE-Pruned MILP (GP-MILP) strategy in which GINE predictions prune the MILP search space. Experiments on a large-scale dataset generated via an OSM-SUMO-GEMV$^2$ pipeline show that GINE closely matches MILP decisions at the link level (accuracy 0.9589), F1-score (0.9544) on validation) and yields consistent end-to-end connectivity gains over a 1-hop MILP baseline (up to 9.2% with four RSUs and 12% with two RSUs). Inference latency remains tightly bounded, with all evaluated instances completing within 5~ms. Moreover, GP-MILP preserves MILP-equivalent solutions (same objective value) while achieving solver runtimes below 30~ms for more than 98%) of the graph instances, making MILP-grade optimisation compatible with stringent NR-V2X latency budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对NR-V2X密集城市环境中可靠低延迟上行链路的中继选择问题，提出一种基于图同构网络（GINE）的边缘感知学习优化框架。每个V2X快照建模为有向图，节点特征编码车辆状态和流量需求，边特征编码无线链路容量。离线MILP最优解作为监督信号训练GINE，实现单次前向传播的边级中继激活，推理延迟严格有界。实验表明GINE在链路级精度0.9589、F1分数0.9544，相比单跳MILP基线端到端连接增益最高12%，推理延迟低于5ms。进一步提出的混合GP-MILP策略在98%以上实例中保持MILP等价解的同时，求解器运行时间低于30ms，使MILP级优化满足NR-V2X严格延迟预算。
Motivation: C-V2X网络中，快速信道变化和遮挡常导致车辆到基础设施直连链路性能下降，多跳中继可恢复覆盖，但中继链路激活是NP-hard优化问题，传统MILP求解随图规模增大扩展性差，需要实时中继选择方法。
Method: 提出边缘感知学习优化框架：每个V2X快照建模为有向图，节点特征为车辆状态和流量需求，边特征为无线链路容量；离线MILP生成最优中继配置作为监督信号，训练图同构网络（GINE）实现单次前向传播的边级中继激活；另提出混合GP-MILP策略，用GINE预测剪枝MILP搜索空间。
Result: 在OSM-SUMO-GEMV²管道生成的大规模数据集上，GINE在验证集上达到链路级准确率0.9589、F1分数0.9544；与单跳MILP基线相比，端到端连接增益最高9.2%（四RSU）和12%（两RSU）。推理延迟严格有界，所有实例在5ms内完成。GP-MILP保持MILP等价解，98%以上实例求解器运行时间低于30ms。
Conclusion: 该框架使MILP级优化兼容NR-V2X严格延迟预算，为实时中继选择提供了可落地的学习优化方案。

papers.title: How Much of a 10-K Matters? Aggregation-Dependent Value of Full-Text versus Risk-Factor Sentiment
papers.abstract_en: Financial sentiment extraction has largely relied on news text and supervised extraction against return labels alone, leaving 10-K filings -- and volatility, the target risk disclosure is arguably best suited to informing -- comparatively unexplored. We extend a supervised lexicon-learning approach to 10-K filings and their Item 1A risk-factor sections, training sentiment scores against both return and volatility labels at three levels of aggregation: sector, portfolio, and individual firm. Across 1,383 filings from 94 Nasdaq-100 technology constituents (2006--2023), we evaluate the resulting twelve sentiment metrics on classification accuracy, correlation with realised market outcomes, and qualitative lexical content. Full-filing text produces more accurate sentiment at the sector and portfolio level for both targets, but this reverses at the individual-firm level, where the narrower Item 1A section performs better -- an effect we attribute to the interaction between document volume and the amount of independent training signal available at each level of aggregation. A Loughran-McDonald dictionary baseline is consistently, strongly negatively correlated with price at every level tested, underscoring the value of a supervised approach for regulatory disclosure text. These findings, and the design choices they motivate, establish the sentiment-generation methodology underlying a subsequent, larger-scale, multi-source system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了10-K年报全文及其Item 1A风险因素部分的情感分析，针对行业、投资组合和个股三个聚合层级训练情感评分以预测收益和波动率。基于94家纳斯达克科技公司1383份文件（2006-2023）的实验表明，全文在行业和投资组合层面准确率更高，但个股层面Item 1A表现更优；Loughran-McDonald字典基线在所有层级与价格强负相关。
Motivation: 现有金融情感提取多依赖新闻文本和收益标签，较少利用10-K文件及其针对波动率的风险披露，且缺乏对不同聚合层级的系统性比较。
Method: 扩展监督式词典学习方法到10-K全文及Item 1A部分，分别对收益和波动率标签训练情感评分，并在行业、投资组合、个股三个聚合层级评估。
Result: 全文在行业和投资组合层面准确率更高，但个股层面Item 1A表现更好；Loughran-McDonald字典基线在所有层级与价格强负相关。
Conclusion: 文档长度与独立训练信号量的交互作用导致不同聚合层级的最佳文本选择不同，验证了监督方法对监管披露文本的价值。

papers.title: The Cost and Network Limits of Space-Based AI Compute
papers.abstract_en: This paper evaluates whether large-scale AI data centers deployed in low-Earth orbit (LEO) could become a cost-effective alternative to terrestrial facilities. The analysis compares orbital and ground-based systems across launch cost, power generation, cooling, radiation exposure, and atmospheric reentry, as well as compute-network performance. A key distinction is the shift from terrestrial Clos networks to space-based mesh networks using laser inter-satellite links. Using bisection bandwidth, bisection intensity, and roofline-style models, we show that while LEO-based inference may be feasible, training frontier-scale LLMs in orbit is unlikely to be competitive with terrestrial data centers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估低地球轨道大规模AI数据中心是否成为地面设施的成本效益替代方案。通过比较发射成本、发电、冷却、辐射暴露、再入大气层及计算网络性能，指出基于激光星间链路的太空网状网络与地面Clos网络存在根本差异。结论是LEO推理可能可行，但轨道训练前沿规模LLM难以与地面数据中心竞争。
Motivation: 探讨太空部署大型AI数据中心作为地面设施替代方案的可行性与成本效益，填补太空AI计算经济性和网络限制的分析空白。
Method: 对比分析轨道与地面系统在发射成本、发电、冷却、辐射暴露、再入大气层以及计算网络性能；使用对分带宽、对分强度及roofline模型评估太空网状网络（激光星间链路）与地面Clos网络的差异。
Result: LEO推理可能具有可行性，但训练前沿规模LLM在轨道上预计无法与地面数据中心在成本和性能上竞争。
Conclusion: 太空AI计算在推理场景存在潜力，但训练大规模模型受网络和成本限制，难成地面设施的替代方案。

papers.title: Branching Policy Optimization: Sandbox-Native Language Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has emerged as the dominant paradigm for training large language model (LLM) agents that interact with executable sandboxes. State-of-the-art algorithms such as PPO, RLOO, and GRPO inherit their rollout topology from RLHF: for each prompt, N independent trajectories are sampled from the initial state, and an advantage is computed by subtracting a group baseline. This design ignores a defining property of agent sandboxes. They are deterministic, snapshottable, and resumable from any intermediate state. We argue that this property enables a fundamentally different rollout topology: rather than N independent trees of depth T, one can construct a single tree of N leaves whose siblings share prefixes, and therefore share variance. We instantiate this idea as Branching Policy Optimization (BPO), a sandbox-native RL algorithm that (i) adaptively snapshots the sandbox at high-entropy decision points along a backbone trajectory, (ii) forks K alternative actions per branch point and rolls out each to termination, and (iii) computes per-step advantages from sibling returns rather than from independent prompts. We prove this estimator is unbiased and has strictly lower variance than the trajectory-level baseline, with the reduction equal to the prefix-explained portion of return variance. On WebShop, ALFWorld, and SWE-bench Verified with Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B backbones, BPO improves success by 3.6--6.1 absolute points over GRPO and RLOO at matched compute, halves gradient-norm variance, and matches the best baseline using 38% fewer policy updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分支策略优化（BPO），一种专为可执行沙箱环境设计的强化学习算法，利用沙箱的确定性、可快照和可恢复特性，通过构建共享前缀的分支树而不是独立轨迹来降低方差。在WebShop、ALFWorld和SWE-bench Verified上，使用Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B骨干网络，BPO在相同计算量下比GRPO和RLOO提升成功率达3.6-6.1个绝对百分点，梯度范数方差减半，且只需38%的策略更新即可匹配最佳基线。
Motivation: 现有RL算法（如PPO、RLOO、GRPO）在沙箱环境中采用独立轨迹采样，忽略了沙箱的确定性、可快照和可恢复特性，导致方差较大且样本效率低。
Method: BPO算法自适应地在高熵决策点对沙箱进行快照，沿骨干轨迹分叉出K个替代动作并分别执行至终止，然后利用兄弟轨迹的回报计算每步优势，而非基于独立提示的基线。
Result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和SWE-bench Verified上，BPO相比GRPO和RLOO提升3.6-6.1个绝对百分点，梯度范数方差减半，且使用38%更少的策略更新即可达到相同性能。
Conclusion: BPO证明了利用沙箱特性的分支拓扑可以显著降低优势估计方差，提高强化学习训练效率，是沙箱环境中原生的RL算法设计。

papers.title: When a Verified World Model Still Loses: Play-Adequacy vs Prediction-Accuracy in LLM-Synthesized Code World Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can synthesize a game's rules as executable code - a Code World Model (CWM) - which a classical planner then searches over. Such models are typically accepted when they reach high transition accuracy on sampled trajectories. We argue this is the wrong notion of adequacy for planning. We show four things. (1) An LLM-synthesized CWM can pass a sampling gate at 100% transition accuracy and be $\geq 98\%$ state-accurate on the planner's own search distribution, yet lose systematically at play, because the $<1\%$ it gets wrong is exactly the pivotal dynamics; the play cost of the omitted rule is $0.091$ (seed-clustered 95% CI $[0.065,0.117]$, $n=4800$). We call this the verified-vs-correct gap, and confirm it end-to-end through the synthesis pipeline. (2) The harm follows a quantitative law, $\mathrm{danger}=\mathrm{play\_cost}\times(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$, whose $(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$ gate-miss factor is proven exact and whose play cost is empirically bounded. (3) The failure is not repaired by more data: LLM synthesis behaves as rule translation, not rule inference, and did not infer the omitted rule across models (GPT-5.x) and data regimes (including DAgger and targeted examples). (4) The same mechanism recurs on the belief-inference function of imperfect-information CWMs: we prove a coverage bound (a size-$N$ gate is identifying when $N\gtrsim b^{d_{\max}}$), explaining why shallow games such as Kuhn poker show no gap, and hand-construct Beacon, a verified-but-wrong inference function that passes the gate yet loses every game. These results suggest adequacy for planning-oriented world models should be measured on the search distribution or by play directly, not by prediction accuracy on sampled transitions.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 4 figures. Code and reproduction log: https://github.com/JaviMaligno/code-world-models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，大型语言模型合成的代码世界模型（CWM）即使通过采样轨迹的100%过渡准确率验证，仍可能在规划任务中系统性失败。作者发现，模型遗漏的关键动力学规则（<1%）正是游戏制胜的核心机制，导致验证-正确差距。这一现象遵循定量危险公式，且无法通过增加数据或使用更强LLM（如GPT-5.x）修复。对于不完全信息世界模型，类似问题存在于信念推理函数中。结论是：面向规划的CWM应通过搜索分布或直接游戏表现来评估，而非采样预测精度。
Motivation: 现有评估LLM合成世界模型的方式依赖于采样轨迹的预测准确性，但论文认为这并非规划的正确适切性度量，可能导致模型在游戏中失败。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验（包括端到端合成管线、DAgger数据增强、不同LLM模型）揭示验证-正确差距，并推导出危险公式 danger = play_cost × (1 - rarity)^N，同时证明不完全信息下的覆盖边界。
Result: LLM合成的CWM在100%采样准确率和≥98%状态准确率下仍系统性输掉游戏，遗漏规则的游戏成本为0.091（95% CI [0.065,0.117]）；该问题源于规则翻译而非规则推断，且不随数据增加而修复。
Conclusion: 评估规划导向的世界模型应基于搜索分布或直接游戏表现，而非采样轨迹的预测准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Feedback Improves Repair in an LLM Agent Loop
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents often retry after external validation rejects a candidate, but the interface between validation and the next model call remains underspecified. We introduce VeriHarness, a code-controlled agent loop in which models generate candidates while external validators control acceptance, budgets, and traces. We use it to compare raw diagnostics with feedback that identifies the failure location, observed value, and admissible alternatives. Across 50 paired TextWorld games under a four-call cap, feedback containing all three fields raises terminal success from 14/50 to 36/50 for Qwen2.5-Coder-14B (+44 percentage points) and from 8/50 to 29/50 for Llama-3.1-8B (+42 points). Ablations locate most of the gain in the admissible alternatives: feedback containing only the location and observed value remains near the raw diagnostic baseline. Presenting the complete repair information in prose instead of a keyed JSON record yields nearly the same success, providing no evidence that JSON syntax itself improves repair. The ordering persists across the tested call budgets and one sampled-decoding setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VeriHarness 框架，用于研究结构化反馈对 LLM agent 修复效果的影响。在 TextWorld 游戏中，包含失败位置、观察值和可替代方案的反馈将 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 的成功率从 14/50 提升至 36/50，Llama-3.1-8B 从 8/50 提升至 29/50。消融实验表明可替代方案是主要增益来源。
Motivation: LLM agent 在外部验证拒绝后常会重试，但验证与下一次模型调用之间的接口缺乏明确规范，限制了修复效率。
Method: 通过 VeriHarness 框架，在代码控制的 agent 循环中比较原始诊断与结构化反馈（包含失败位置、观察值和可替代方案）对修复性能的影响。
Result: 在 50 场 TextWorld 游戏、四轮调用限制下，包含所有三个字段的反馈使 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 成功率提高 44 个百分点（14→36），Llama-3.1-8B 提高 42 个百分点（8→29）；仅位置和观察值则接近原始诊断基线。
Conclusion: 结构化反馈中的可替代方案是修复改善的关键，而 JSON 格式相比自然语言并无额外优势。

papers.title: Towards Reliable AI-Assisted Analog Design: Template-Constrained LLM Agents for SAR ADC Generation
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant capability in software code generation, their application to analog Electronic Design Automation (EDA) is bottlenecked. Owing to limited circuit topology understanding and data, directly prompting LLMs and multimodal models leads to hallucinations and failure to produce schematics capable of passing rigorous SPICE simulations, as we show in our work. Instead, we propose an end-to-end, multi-step LLM agentic framework ATLAS, capable of generating a functional Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) that successfully passes simulation validation. To adhere to the rigid constraints of analog design, we utilize expert knowledge to ground the LLM in its planning, selection, parameterization, and iterative modification. As part of ATLAS, we introduce Template-Constrained Generation - which unlike other template-based works - builds towards a more generalized SAR ADC generation flow. We demonstrate a strong proof-of-concept of our framework by developing SAR ADCs across technology nodes and input specs. Overall, our expert-knowledge grounded multi-step agentic ATLAS establishes a pragmatic foundation for integrating LLMs into reliable analog design methodologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATLAS，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多步骤智能体框架，用于生成功能完整的逐次逼近寄存器（SAR）模数转换器（ADC）。该框架通过模板约束生成和专家知识引导，解决了LLM在模拟电子设计自动化（EDA）中难以生成可通过SPICE仿真的原理图的问题。摘要展示了跨工艺节点和输入规格的SAR ADC生成，作为概念验证。
Motivation: LLM在软件代码生成中表现优异，但在模拟EDA应用中因电路拓扑理解有限和数据不足，直接提示会导致幻觉和无法生成通过严格SPICE仿真的原理图。
Method: 提出多步LLM智能体框架ATLAS，包含模板约束生成（Template-Constrained Generation），利用专家知识在规划、选择、参数化和迭代修改中引导LLM，使其遵守模拟设计的刚性约束。
Result: 摘要报告成功生成了功能正确的SAR ADC，并通过SPICE仿真验证，跨不同工艺节点和输入规格展示了强概念验证。
Conclusion: ATLAS为将LLM集成到可靠的模拟设计方法论中建立了实用基础，但尚需进一步泛化到其他模拟电路。

papers.title: A vision foundation model for single-cell biology via spatial gene cartography
papers.abstract_en: Most single-cell foundation models are adapted from language models, representing each cell as a sequence of gene tokens. This discards the relationships among genes and often the magnitude of their expression. We present scVision, a vision foundation model that instead renders each cell as a continuous image. Using optimal transport, it places genes at fixed positions on a single shared, pan-tissue layout so that co-expressed genes become spatial neighbours, turning a transcriptome into an image in which gene programs appear as local texture. We pretrain a vision transformer by masked image modelling on 72 million human cells and use the frozen encoder with no fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluations on six independent, held-out studies, scVision is the most accurate cell-type annotator and recovers gene programs without supervision, ahead of existing foundation models and classical baselines; on multi-study integration it matches the strongest token-based model while conserving the most biological structure, without ever seeing a batch label. Permuting the gene layout with the network fixed sharply lowers accuracy, more than removing the vision transformer itself, showing that biologically meaningful position, not the network, carries the signal. By preserving expression magnitude and gene relationships, scVision reframes single-cell representation learning as a vision problem, connecting it to the mature methods of computer vision.

TL;DR: scVision 是一个将单细胞转录组数据转化为连续图像的视觉基础模型。通过最优传输将基因映射到共享的泛组织布局上，使共表达基因成为空间邻居，从而将转录组编码为图像。在7200万个人类细胞上使用掩码图像建模预训练ViT编码器，无需微调即可进行零样本细胞类型注释和基因程序恢复，在多研究整合中匹配最强模型并保留更多生物结构。

papers.title: When Directional Accuracy Lies: A Base-Rate-Honest Benchmark for LoRA-Adapted TimesFM on Equity Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large pretrained time-series models such as TimesFM are attractive for financial forecasting, but raw directional accuracy is a misleading scoreboard in equity markets. An early LoRA adapter in this project appeared to reach roughly 80% directional accuracy; we show this is not evidence of skill. Over a long horizon in a rising market, a trivial "always-up" rule attains comparably high accuracy without using the input at all. To separate genuine skill from this base-rate artifact, we build a reproducible, frozen-data benchmark with expanding walk-forward folds, a stratified held-out-ticker split, honest baselines (zero-shot TimesFM, always-up, random-walk, persistence, AR(1)), and paired significance tests (McNemar, Diebold-Mariano) under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. We apply the identical method to two universes -- a tech-heavy NASDAQ-100 and a broad S&P 500 -- reporting excess accuracy over the always-up base rate. Three findings replicate. First, when the historical ~80% condition is recreated, the high number is a base rate of ~0.70 that the fine-tuned model scores below. Second, pooled LoRA shows no directional skill over the base rate at any horizon on either universe (negative at the six-month horizon). Third, per-sector specialization is significantly worse than a single pooled adapter (Diebold-Mariano p<0.001 on held-out stocks at h=128). Fine-tuning's only measurable benefit is a statistically significant reduction in point-forecast error relative to zero-shot TimesFM, which nonetheless does not beat naive baselines and confers no tradeable directional edge. The contribution is methodological: a defensible, fully seeded protocol that prevents the base-rate trap, together with the replicated negative result it produces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示在股票预测中，LoRA微调TimesFM模型达到的约80%方向准确率实际上源于市场上涨的基率（base rate）假象。作者构建了一个可复现的基准测试，通过膨胀向前验证、分层持有股票分割、诚实基线（零样本TimesFM、永远上涨、随机游走、AR(1)等）以及配对显著性检验（McNemar、Diebold-Mariano）并控制Benjamini-Hochberg FDR，在NASDAQ-100和S&P 500两个股票池上验证了三个发现：1）历史高准确率是约0.70的基率，而微调模型低于该基率；2）LoRA在方向预测上无技能，在六个月horizon上为负；3）按行业专业化显著差于单一适配器（Diebold-Mariano p<0.001）。微调的唯一收益是点预测误差的统计显著降低，但未击败简单基线，不产生可交易的方向性优势。
Motivation: 金融市场中方向准确率易受市场上涨基率误导，现有评估未有效区分模型技能与基率假象，导致对LoRA微调大规模时间序列模型（如TimesFM）的虚假信心。
Method: 提出一个可复现的基准测试协议，包括膨胀向前验证、分层持有股票分割（stratified held-out-ticker split）、诚实基线（零样本TimesFM、永远上涨、随机游走、持久性、AR(1)），并使用McNemar和Diebold-Mariano检验，且控制Benjamini-Hochberg FDR。该方法应用于两个股票池（NASDAQ-100和S&P 500），报告超过永远上涨基率的超额准确率。
Result: 三个主要发现：1）历史约80%准确率是基率约0.70的假象，微调模型实际上低于该基率；2）LoRA在方向预测上无技能，在六个月horizon上为负；3）按行业专业化显著差于单一适配器（Diebold-Mariano p<0.001）。微调仅降低点预测误差，但未击败简单基线。
Conclusion: 贡献在于方法论：提供了一个防止基率陷阱的谨慎可复现协议，并产生了可复现的负面结果，强调金融预测中必须使用基率诚实的评估来避免虚假方向技能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlashDiff: Efficient Regional Execution and Scheduling for Diffusion Model Serving
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become the central backbone for modern image, video, and audio generation, but their efficient service remains a challenge. Unlike autoregressive decoding, diffusion inference repeatedly updates high-dimensional spatial or temporal latents over many denoising steps. This all-region execution pattern makes generation latency high and limits serving throughput. Existing multi-GPU parallelization methods can reduce per-step computation, but often introduce substantial activation exchange overhead, causing communication to offset or even outweigh the benefits of parallel execution. This paper presents FlashDiff, a diffusion serving system that improves inference efficiency through adaptive regional execution and scheduling. FlashDiff is based on the observation that diffusion refinement is not uniform across latent regions or denoising steps: different regions often stabilize at different rates, while neighboring steps exhibit strong temporal correlation. FlashDiff leverages these properties to selectively execute only regions that require further refinement and to reallocate the resulting compute slack across concurrent serving requests. FlashDiff consists of three mechanisms. First, it decomposes the latent representation into coherent execution regions using early-stage attention signals, preserving semantic structure while exposing fine-grained parallelism. Second, it uses a lightweight runtime controller to estimate region activity and bypass low-impact updates when further refinement is unlikely to affect output quality. Third, it applies an affinity-aware online scheduler that co-locates dependent regions, balances residual load across GPUs, and reuses reclaimed compute capacity to improve serving efficiency. Across real-world image, video, and audio workloads, FlashDiff reduces end-to-end serving latency by 30-97% and improves throughput by 1.2-2.2x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashDiff是一个针对扩散模型服务的系统，通过自适应区域执行和调度提高推理效率。根据观察，扩散模型的去噪步骤在不同区域和步骤间不均匀，FlashDiff利用此特性选择性执行需要进一步细化的区域，并重新分配计算资源。系统包含三个机制：基于注意力的区域分解、轻量级运行时控制器估计区域活动并跳过低影响更新、以及亲和性感知的在线调度器。在图像、视频和音频任务上，端到端延迟降低30-97%，吞吐量提升1.2-2.2倍。
Motivation: 扩散模型推理中，所有区域重复更新导致高延迟和低吞吐量，现有多GPU并行化方法引入大量激活交换开销，通信成本抵消并行收益。
Method: 提出FlashDiff系统，包含三个组件：1) 利用早期注意力信号将潜在表示分解为连贯的执行区域；2) 轻量级运行时控制器估计区域活性，跳过低影响更新；3) 亲和性感知在线调度器，共置依赖区域，平衡GPU负载，重用计算容量。
Result: 在真实世界的图像、视频和音频负载上，端到端服务延迟降低30-97%，吞吐量提升1.2-2.2倍。
Conclusion: FlashDiff通过区域级执行和调度有效提升了扩散模型服务的效率。

papers.title: FindMyText: Robust, Scalable Detection of Text Containment in Large Web-Crawled Corpora
papers.abstract_en: We present FindMyText, an open-source Python package designed to efficiently assess whether a given text appears, in part or in full, within a text corpus. The tool builds on prior techniques for document fingerprinting, but extends them with a novel mechanism to explicitly capture sequences of matching fingerprints. By identifying such chains, the tool can more reliably detect near-verbatim copies of a given text rather than mere textual similarities. This makes FindMyText particularly suited for verifying the presence of copyrighted material in a corpus. Leveraging a distributed, disk-based indexing framework, the system scales to large web-crawled datasets. Using a new benchmark for evaluating text containment methods, we show that FindMyText outperforms alternative approaches across three datasets (ArXiv papers, Wikipedia, and generic web content).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍FindMyText，一个用于检测给定文本是否部分或全部存在于文本语料库中的开源Python包。该方法基于文档指纹技术，并通过捕获匹配指纹序列来检测近似逐字复制，特别适合验证版权材料。利用分布式基于磁盘的索引框架，可扩展到大型网络爬取数据集。在ArXiv论文、维基百科和通用网络内容的基准测试中，FindMyText优于其他方法。
Motivation: 现有文本包含检测方法难以区分真正逐字复制与一般文本相似性，且难以扩展到大规模语料库，需要一种准确且高效的检测工具。
Method: 基于文档指纹技术，新引入捕获匹配指纹序列的机制，识别连续匹配指纹链以提高检测近似逐字复制的可靠性，并采用分布式、基于磁盘的索引框架支持大规模数据集。
Result: 在三个数据集（ArXiv论文、维基百科、通用网络内容）上的基准测试表明，FindMyText优于其他文本包含检测方法。
Conclusion: FindMyText提供鲁棒且可扩展的文本包含检测方案，特别适用于验证版权材料，作者强调其在新基准上的优越性能。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Source Retinal Fluid Segmentation in OCT
papers.abstract_en: Measuring retinal fluid from optical coherence tomography (OCT) drives treatment decisions in macular disease, but manual annotation is slow and segmentation models trained on one scanner degrade on another. We present an attention-guided TransUNet that segments three fluid types across four independent OCT sources, combining a domain-adaptive normalisation scheme with an uncertainty estimate that flags unreliable pixels. The model reaches a mean fluid Dice of 0.78, and -- most usefully for clinicians -- its uncertainty is 1.34x higher exactly where expert graders disagree (p<10^-4), turning a raw segmentation map into an actionable clinical triage signal.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code, model weights, and REST inference API are available on GitHub and Zenodo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种注意力引导的TransUNet模型，用于在四个独立OCT扫描仪来源上分割三种视网膜液类型，结合领域自适应归一化方案和不确定性估计，以提升跨域泛化能力。模型在流体分割上平均Dice达到0.78，且其不确定性在专家标注不一致的区域高出1.34倍（p<10^-4），可作为临床分诊信号。
Motivation: 视网膜液分割需要人工标注且速度慢，且现有模型在不同OCT扫描仪之间泛化能力差。
Method: 采用注意力引导的TransUNet架构，结合领域自适应归一化方案和不确定性估计，对每种流体类型进行分割并标记不可靠像素。
Result: 平均流体Dice为0.78，不确定性在专家分歧区域比一致区域高1.34倍（p<10^-4）。
Conclusion: 不确定性估计可将原始分割图转化为可操作的临床分诊信号，有助于临床决策。

papers.title: Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam
papers.abstract_en: The local sharpness of the loss, the top Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, determines the largest stable gradient step, but measuring it normally requires Lanczos or Hessian-vector iterations. We observe that a single Armijo backtracking line search already carries this information at the cost of a few forward passes: the accepted step $α$ brackets the \emph{directional} curvature $q = g^\top H g/\|g\|^2$ within the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette, $\logα$ tracks $\logλ_1$ at Pearson $-0.91$ to $-0.95$, giving a low-cost online Edge-of-Stability reading. Used once at initialisation, this measurement yields a learning-rate cap (a safeguard, not a faster optimiser) that makes Adam robust to a too-large initial learning rate across more than three orders of magnitude ($10^{-3}$ to $3.0$), at about one percent overhead, and it is a no-op when the chosen rate is already safe. One probe is enough: periodic in-training probing adds no robust benefit. The raw-gradient probe exposes the mechanism but needs a safety factor calibrated to the architecture by a one-minute divergence sweep. Probing along Adam's own update direction removes this calibration: a single fixed safety factor $κ= 2$ avoids divergence on all nine architectures we test and across the full learning-rate grids of all four benchmarks, and the recipe transfers to AdamW unchanged.

papers.title: Adversarial Pragmatics for AI Safety Evaluation: A Benchmark for Instruction Conflict, Embedded Commands, and Policy Ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations for language models increasingly depend on judgments about ambiguous natural-language behaviour: whether a model has followed an instruction, refused appropriately, complied with a policy, resisted an embedded command, or misreported progress in an agentic task. Existing benchmarks often compress these distinctions into pass/fail labels, obscuring whether failures arise from capability limits, policy ambiguity, instruction conflict, scaffold failure, or unstable evaluator judgments. This paper introduces adversarial pragmatics as a benchmark and annotation protocol for evaluating model behaviour under instruction conflict, embedded commands, quotation, scope ambiguity, deixis, indirect speech acts, and multi-turn agent transcripts. The contribution is empirical and methodological: a linguistically controlled taxonomy, an 18-item seed benchmark with validator-enforced metadata, a 54-row local seed pilot, an expert-evaluation protocol distinguishing task success, policy compliance, safety risk, refusal outcome, and evaluator confidence, and metrics for judge validity, diagnostic ambiguity, and taxonomy drift. The benchmark treats labels as inference licenses: it tests whether safety-relevant categories project across paraphrase, wrapper, model, and judge condition. In the pilot, a rubric-aided LLM judge graded its own outputs with expected-behaviour fields visible and still missed the safety-relevant minority classes.
papers.comment: 18-page main paper plus 10-page supplement; 6 figures and 11 tables total; code and data artifact available at the linked repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗语用学（adversarial pragmatics）作为评估语言模型安全行为的基准和注释协议，针对指令冲突、嵌入命令、引用、范围歧义、指示、间接言语行为和多轮智能体转录等场景。通过一个18项种子基准和54行本地种子试点，评估了模型在任务成功、政策合规、安全风险、拒绝结果和评估者置信度方面的表现。试点发现，即使有评分辅助，LLM裁判仍会遗漏安全相关的少数类。
Motivation: 现有安全评估通常将模糊的自然语言行为压缩为通过/失败标签，难以区分失败源于能力限制、政策歧义、指令冲突、脚手架失败还是评估者判断不稳定。
Method: 引入了对抗语用学基准，包含语言学控制的分类法、18项种子基准（含验证者强制元数据）、54行本地种子试点、专家评估协议（区分任务成功、政策合规、安全风险、拒绝结果和评估者置信度），以及用于判断有效性、诊断歧义和分类漂移的指标。标签被视为推理许可，测试安全相关类别在释义、包装器、模型和评估者条件下的投影一致性。
Result: 在试点中，一个基于评分辅助的LLM裁判在可看到期望行为字段的情况下，仍然遗漏了安全相关的少数类。
Conclusion: 论文强调了需要更细粒度、基于语言学控制的评估方法，以揭示安全失败的真正根源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ShopX: A Foundation Model for Intent-to-Item Fulfillment in Agentic Shopping
papers.abstract_en: The wave of AI-native applications is moving shopping beyond page- and feed-based browsing toward intent-driven experiences orchestrated by LLM agents. A common design wraps an LLM around existing search and recommendation pipelines, forcing complex intents through low-bandwidth retrieval or ranking interfaces and leaving a gap between language understanding and item-space fulfillment. Generative recommendation gives LLMs a direct item-space interface through semantic IDs (SIDs), but existing models mainly generate candidates for retrieval rather than translate flexible intents into item-space outcomes. We propose ShopX to address this bottleneck by unifying intent understanding, execution planning, and flexible SID-native item-space operations into a single foundation model. We deploy ShopX in agentic shopping workflows through a model-native item-fulfillment framework with a serving harness that defines a model-facing action protocol and exposes support surfaces for context access, catalog grounding, and state management. Within this framework, ShopX plans and composes SID-based item-space operations such as SID beam-search retrieval, listwise ranking, or product bundling. This model-centric design reduces lossy hand-offs between agent orchestration and item-space execution. To build ShopX, we design semantically recoverable, LLM-operable SIDs and a training recipe that equips a general LLM for flexible multi-turn item-space fulfillment while retaining the knowledge and instruction-following abilities needed by a shopping agent. We evaluate the ShopX framework against tool-mediated agentic systems on single- and multi-turn fulfillment tasks derived from anonymized Taobao production logs, showing that model-native fulfillment improves overall framework behavior, especially on complex or ambiguous requests.
papers.comment: The new version adds additional results and details
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShopX，一个统一的基座模型，将意图理解、执行规划和基于语义ID (SID) 的物品空间操作整合在一起，用于智能体购物场景。模型原生框架减少了智能体编排与物品空间执行之间的信息损失，并在来自淘宝生产日志的单轮和多轮任务上优于基于工具的智能体系统，尤其是处理复杂或模糊请求时。
Motivation: 现有智能体购物系统通常将大语言模型 (LLM) 包裹在传统搜索和推荐管道周围，导致复杂意图通过低带宽检索或排序接口传递，语言理解与物品空间执行之间存在鸿沟。
Method: 提出 ShopX，采用语义可恢复、LLM可操作的语义ID (SID) 以及训练方案，使通用LLM具备灵活的多轮物品空间执行能力，同时保留购物智能体所需的知识和指令遵循能力。框架包括模型原生物品执行框架、服务协议和上下文访问、商品目录锚定及状态管理支持。
Result: 摘要报告在来自淘宝生产日志的单轮和多轮任务上，ShopX框架优于基于工具的智能体系统，尤其在复杂或模糊请求上表现更优。
Conclusion: 模型原生的物品执行设计减少了智能体编排与物品空间执行之间的有损交接，有望提升智能体购物工作流的整体行为。

papers.title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image: Advancing Masked Discrete Diffusion for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image, a state-of-the-art masked discrete diffusion model (MDM) for high-resolution text-to-image synthesis. Compared with prior work on masked image generation, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image addresses two key challenges. First, unlike continuous diffusion models which progressively refine latent representations across the entire image, standard MDMs lack self-correcting capability because discrete tokens cannot be modified once they are unmasked. Second, although increasing the vocabulary size of discrete image tokenizers improves reconstruction fidelity, it introduces optimization difficulties for generative modeling as the per-token training signal becomes increasingly sparse. To address the first challenge, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image incorporates a token-editing mechanism that enables the model to dynamically revise already-unmasked tokens during inference, similar to how a sculptor iteratively refines their work. To tackle the second challenge, we propose a Grouped Cross-Entropy (GCE) objective that assigns positive learning signals to tokens neighboring the ground truth in embedding space, thereby alleviating signal sparsity. To further improve training efficiency, we implement a custom fused operator for GCE that significantly reduces VRAM usage in large-vocabulary settings. Experimental results demonstrate that these innovations substantially improve both training efficiency and image fidelity of masked discrete image generators, achieving a score of 0.90 on GenEval, 86.9 on DPG and 10.76 of HPSv3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image，一种改进的掩蔽离散扩散模型（MDM），用于高分辨率文本到图像合成。通过引入 token 编辑机制使模型能动态修正已取消掩蔽的 token，并设计分组交叉熵（GCE）损失函数缓解大词表带来的信号稀疏问题。实验在 GenEval（0.90）、DPG（86.9）和 HPSv3（10.76）上取得领先性能。
Motivation: 现有 MDM 缺乏自修正能力（离散 token 一旦取消掩蔽便无法修改），且增大离散图像 tokenizer 词表虽提升重建保真度却导致训练信号稀疏，优化困难。
Method: 提出 token-editing 机制，使模型在推理时能动态修改已生成的 token；采用 Grouped Cross-Entropy (GCE) 损失函数，对嵌入空间中邻近真实 token 的邻居也赋予正学习信号，并实现自定义融合算子以减少大词表下的显存占用。
Result: GenEval 得分 0.90，DPG 得分 86.9，HPSv3 得分 10.76，均表明训练效率与图像保真度显著提升。
Conclusion: 所提创新（token 编辑与 GCE）有效解决了 MDM 的两大关键挑战，推动了掩蔽离散图像生成器的性能边界。

papers.title: Flow Matching in Feature Space for Stochastic World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World modeling requires forecasting uncertain futures while preserving information useful for downstream perception. Existing visual world models often struggle to satisfy both goals: VAE-based stochastic models operate in low-dimensional reconstruction latents, which can limit perception performance, while deterministic predictors using strong pretrained features collapse multimodal futures into a single blurry mean. In this work, we propose FlowWM, a stochastic world model that performs flow matching directly within pretrained feature space (e.g., DINOv3). This is challenging because pretrained features are substantially high-dimensional, making standard diffusion recipes suboptimal. To address this, we investigate the design choices needed for feature-space flow matching and introduce a differentiable one-step projection mechanism that enables efficient training with temporal consistency and task-driven objectives. We evaluate FlowWM on two benchmarks: a synthetic benchmark for systematic evaluation of accuracy and diversity, and a real-world benchmark FuturePerception. FlowWM improves perception performance, mode coverage, and horizon robustness, validating our proposed design for stochastic world modeling in high-dimensional feature spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowWM，一种在预训练特征空间（如 DINOv3）中直接执行流匹配（flow matching）的随机世界模型。由于预训练特征维度极高，标准扩散配方效果不佳，作者研究了设计选择并引入可微的一步投影机制，实现高效训练、时序一致性与任务驱动目标。在合成基准和真实世界基准 FuturePerception 上的实验表明，FlowWM 提升了感知性能、模态覆盖范围和 horizon 鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有视觉世界模型难以同时保证预测不确定性的多样性和下游感知性能：VAE 模型在低维重建潜变量上操作，限制感知；确定性预测器使用强预训练特征但崩塌多模态未来为单个模糊均值。
Method: 提出 FlowWM，直接在预训练特征空间（如 DINOv3）中进行流匹配。为解决高维特征带来的挑战，设计适当的组件并引入可微的一步投影机制，实现高效训练并保持时序一致性和任务驱动目标。
Result: 在合成基准和 FuturePerception 基准上，FlowWM 提升了感知性能、模态覆盖范围和 horizon 鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 验证了在高维特征空间中进行随机世界建模的设计方案的有效性，表明该方法在准确性和多样性方面均优于基线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Building Agent Harnesses for Scientific Curation from Multimodal Sources
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery workflows often depend on structured curation from the literature. This is difficult for current agents because the key evidence is scattered across long text, dense tables, and figures, and the final records often require reasoning across multiple evidence fragments rather than copying a single span. We study scientific curation from multimodal sources and introduce Beaver, an agent harness that extracts structured information from scientific papers while preserving provenance to the supporting evidence. Beaver combines a frontier agent with multimodal evidence tooling, task scaffolding, and artifact-grounded autoresearch. These components turn curation into a staged, auditable workflow and enable an iterative evaluate--diagnose--revise loop, where persistent run artifacts expose stage-localized failures and guide harness updates. Experiments show that Beaver reaches 81.0 on Gold-Referenced Attribute Score (GRAS), an attribute-level measure of agreement with gold curated records, outperforming frontier agents by over 23 absolute points. Ablations show that task scaffolding, multimodal evidence tooling, and provenance traces each contribute meaningfully to performance, while attribute-level analysis shows the largest gains on high-value attributes that require cross-modal reasoning and normalization. These results show that, for scientific curation from papers with multimodal evidence, harness design is a central determinant of agent performance.

papers.title: TerraTransfer: Learning End-to-End Driving Policies Without Expert Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world deployments. Its standard training recipe, however, is expensive across all stages: collecting and labeling millions of driving frames is costly, and closed-loop RL on images is bottlenecked by the per-step cost of photorealistic rendering plus a forward pass through a large vision backbone. Self-play in vectorized simulators changes the economics: millions of rollout steps per second, and a state distribution naturally rich in collisions, near-misses, and recoveries that no driving log contains. Our approach exploits this asymmetry by decoupling learning to drive from learning to see. We pretrain a single policy by self-play, then align its latent space with a pretrained vision backbone, through the action KL divergence and a batch-relational low-rank structural loss. The action target comes from the self-play policy, so alignment never supervises against a logged trajectory: a paired dataset of (image, scene-state) frames suffices, with no need for the curated expert demonstrations that imitation pretraining is built on. On photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting closed-loop scenarios, the resulting end-to-end policy matches or exceeds prior end-to-end methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TerraTransfer 方法，通过自博弈在向量化模拟器中预训练驾驶策略，然后利用动作 KL 散度和批量关系低秩结构损失将其潜在空间与预训练的视觉主干对齐，从而无需专家演示即可学习端到端驾驶策略。在基于 3D 高斯溅射的闭环场景中，该方法达到或超过了现有端到端方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶训练成本高昂，需要大量标注数据或昂贵的闭环 RL。作者利用向量化模拟器的高效率和自然丰富的状态分布，解耦驾驶学习与视觉感知，降低训练成本。
Method: 通过自博弈预训练单一策略，再通过动作 KL 散度和批量关系低秩结构损失将其潜在空间与预训练的视觉主干对齐，对齐的动作目标来自自博弈策略，无需专家演示或人工标注。
Result: 在照片级真实感的 3D 高斯溅射闭环场景中，端到端策略达到或超过了现有端到端方法的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦驾驶学习与视觉感知的有效性，无需专家演示即可训练端到端驾驶策略。

papers.title: Models Can Model, But Can't Bind: Structured Grounding in Text-to-Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-optimization requires two separable capabilities: modeling -- choosing the right optimization structure -- and binding -- grounding every coefficient, index, and parameter in the concrete problem data. We study this via Text2Opt-Bench, a scalable benchmark of solver-verified optimization problems spanning 12 categories, from textbook linear programs to stochastic and multi-objective formulations with up to thousands of variables. Across 10+ models, we find that accuracy collapses as instance data grows, even when the formulation itself is simple. We call this the effective binding limit. We study it with a family of techniques, BIND, that externalize numeric data to structured files so the model binds data programmatically rather than transcribing from the prompt. When using an oracle for externalizing data, we recover between 12 and 27 accuracy points, confirming binding as a key -- but recoverable -- failure mode. In a deployable setting without oracle access, we validate our hypothesis by finetuning a model exclusively on binding and show that it outperforms end-to-end SFT and RL across three structurally distinct optimization categories, with a 1.5B binding specialist alone matching a 7B end-to-end baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted to COLM 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/SprocketLab/Text2Opt-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本到优化（Text-to-Optimization）中两类必要能力：建模（选择正确优化结构）和绑定（将系数、索引、参数具体化到问题数据）。作者构建Text2Opt-Bench基准（12类优化问题，从课本线性规划到含数千变量的随机/多目标问题），发现随着实例数据增长，模型准确率崩溃，称为有效绑定极限。提出BIND技术，将数值数据外部化到结构化文件，使模型以编程方式绑定数据；在oracle设置下恢复12-27个准确率点，在无oracle的部署设置中，1.5B绑定专用模型匹配7B端到端基线。
Motivation: 现有模型在文本到优化任务中，随着问题数据规模增加，准确率急剧下降，而建模能力本身相对完整，表明绑定是主要瓶颈，需针对性解决。
Method: 设计Text2Opt-Bench基准（12类优化问题）、提出BIND技术系列（外部化数值数据到结构化文件，使模型程序化绑定而非转录），并在部署设置中通过仅在绑定任务上微调模型验证效果。
Result: 在oracle设置下，BIND恢复12-27个准确率点；在无oracle部署设置中，1.5B绑定专用模型在三个优化类别上优于端到端SFT和RL，且匹配7B端到端基线。
Conclusion: 绑定是文本到优化中的关键且可恢复的失败模式；通过针对绑定的微调可显著提升性能，表明模型能专门化解决该问题。

papers.title: Data-driven analysis of metastability in a stochastic bistable system
papers.abstract_en: We present a methodology to analyze metastable properties of a simple prototypical stochastic bistable system by identifying slow inter-well and fast saddle escape processes using the formalism of the Koopman operator. Instead of studying noise-induced transitions by following the trajectories of the system, we track them by studying the time evolution and the decay rate of the subdominant mode of the Koopman operator, thus in a geometry-agnostic framework. The obtained escape time statistics together with the decay rate are in good agreement with the predictions - both the exponential and subexponential ones - of large deviation theory in the weak-noise limit, both in equilibrium and nonequilibrium conditions. The subdominant Koopman mode also allows for an accurate reconstruction of the competing basins of attraction. Furthermore, going deeper in the Koopman spectrum, we are able to recognise modes that are associated with intra-well variability as well as with the escape of trajectories from the saddle towards the attractor, both in the equilibrium and nonequilibrium case. Our methodology, being grounded in purely data-driven techniques, could provide a comprehensive, multi-scale framework for studying high-dimensional metastable systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Koopman算子的数据驱动方法，用于分析随机双稳系统中的亚稳态特性。通过识别次主导Koopman模式的衰减率，获得逃逸时间统计，与弱噪声极限下的大偏差理论预测一致。该方法可重构吸引盆，并区分阱内变异和鞍点逃逸模式，为高维亚稳态系统提供多尺度分析框架。
Motivation: 传统方法通过直接跟踪轨迹研究噪声诱导跃迁，效率低且依赖几何结构。需要一种几何无关、数据驱动的框架来分析亚稳态系统的慢速阱间和快速鞍逃逸过程。
Method: 利用Koopman算子次主导模式的衰减率追踪系统时间演化，避免直接模拟轨迹；通过数据驱动方式提取子主导Koopman模式及其衰减率，并与大偏差理论预测进行对比。
Result: 在平衡和非平衡条件下，逃逸时间统计与衰减率与大偏差理论的指数和次指数预测吻合良好；次主导Koopman模式能准确重建竞争吸引盆；进一步深入Koopman谱可识别阱内变异模式和鞍点逃逸模式。
Conclusion: 该数据驱动方法不依赖系统几何结构，可推广至高维亚稳态系统，为分析复杂随机动力系统的亚稳态特性提供多尺度框架。

papers.title: BathyFacto: Refraction-Aware Two-Media Neural Radiance Fields for Bathymetry
papers.abstract_en: Through-water photogrammetry from UAV imagery enables shallow-water bathymetry, but refraction at the air--water interface violates the straight-ray assumption of Structure-from-Motion and causes systematic depth bias. We present BathyFacto, a refraction-aware two-media extension of Nerfacto in Nerfstudio for metrically consistent underwater point clouds on simulated data. BathyFacto uses a shared hash-grid density field with a medium-conditioned color head and traces each camera ray as two segments: a straight air segment to a planar water surface and a refracted water segment computed using Snell's law and known refractive indices. A single proposal-network sampler operates on a virtual straight ray, while a kinked density wrapper corrects water-segment positions before density evaluation. Our pipeline converts photogrammetric reconstructions to Nerfstudio format, estimates the water plane from boundary markers, provides per-pixel medium masks, and supports refraction-corrected point-cloud export with reversible transforms to world and global frames. On a simulated scene with ground truth, BathyFacto achieves a Cloud-to-Mesh signed median deviation of $-0.001$,m and 85.7,% completeness at 0.2,m tolerance in the absolute global frame without rigid-body alignment. This compares with $+1.370$,m / 11.6,% for Nerfacto and $+1.409$,m / 9.9,% for BathyFacto without refraction. Even after a naive refractive-index depth correction, both baselines remain offset by approximately 0.4,m. Unlike a refraction-corrected Multi-View Stereo reference, which is reliable mainly for near-nadir views, BathyFacto recovers consistent geometry across the full range of camera incidence angles.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ISPRS Open Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing, Special Issue "3D Underwater Mapping from Above and Below"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BathyFacto 是一种折射感知的两介质神经辐射场扩展，用于从无人机影像进行浅水测深。它通过将 Nerfacto 中的光线分为直空气段和折射水段（使用斯涅尔定律），并采用共享哈希网格密度场和介质条件颜色头，实现了度量一致的水下点云。在模拟数据上，BathyFacto 在全局框架下达到云到网格中位数偏差 -0.001 米，完整度 85.7%（容差 0.2 米），显著优于基线方法。
Motivation: 传统水下摄影测量中，空气-水界面的折射违反了结构光运动的直线光线假设，导致系统性的深度偏差，限制了浅水测深的精度。
Method: BathyFacto 是 Nerfacto 的两介质扩展，使用共享哈希网格密度场和介质条件颜色头。每条光线被追踪为两个线段：一个从相机到平面水面的直线空气段，以及一个根据斯涅尔定律和已知折射率计算的折射水段。采用单一提案网络采样器操作于虚拟直光线，并使用弯曲密度包装器在密度评估前校正水段位置。
Result: 在模拟场景中，BathyFacto 在绝对全局框架下（无刚体对齐）实现云到网格中位数偏差 -0.001 米，完整度 85.7%（容差 0.2 米）；相比之下，Nerfacto 和未折射校正的 BathyFacto 分别为 +1.370 米/11.6% 和 +1.409 米/9.9%。即使经过简单的折射校正，基线仍偏移约 0.4 米。
Conclusion: BathyFacto 能够在整个相机入射角范围内恢复一致的几何形状，而折射校正的多视图立体参考方法仅对近天底视角可靠。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Domain Shift in Permission-Based Android Malware Detection
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based Android malware detectors often fail in real-world deployment due to domain shift, where models trained on one data source perform poorly on applications from another. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the generalizability and interpretability of permission-based detectors under cross-domain conditions. Using two complementary datasets (PerMalDroid and NATICUSdroid) and five ensemble classifiers, we first establish an intra-domain baseline, where models achieve over 92% accuracy, and then quantify a severe asymmetric performance drop. While models trained on PerMalDroid generalize well to NATICUSdroid (86% accuracy), the reverse direction sees a drastic drop to 73% accuracy. Explainable AI analysis reveals bimodal feature distributions and shows that feature importance is highly unstable, with key permissions losing or gaining influence across domains. The predictive feature sets for different domains are fundamentally mismatched, as models rely on different, dataset-specific permissions. Most importantly, an ablation study demonstrates that for most models, training on a noisy feature set leads to poor generalization, confirming that domain-specific artifacts are a greater obstacle than missing features. To mitigate this, we validate a hybrid training strategy based on the intersection of common features and successfully recover cross-domain performance, achieving 88% accuracy on PerMalDroid and maintaining 97% on NATICUSdroid. These findings highlight the importance of explainable, cross-domain-robust malware detection systems and provide a practical pathway toward improving real-world deployment of permission-based Android malware detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于权限的Android恶意软件检测器在跨域场景下的泛化性与可解释性。使用两个不同来源的数据集，发现域间性能存在严重非对称下降（正向86%，反向73%），可解释AI分析揭示特征分布双峰、重要性不稳定及数据集特有权限依赖。通过混合训练策略（基于共有特征交集）恢复跨域性能，达到88%-97%准确率。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的安卓恶意软件检测器在真实部署中因领域偏移（domain shift）而失效，现有研究缺乏对基于权限的检测器在跨域条件下的系统理解。
Method: 使用PerMalDroid和NATICUSdroid两个互补数据集及五种集成分类器，先建立域内基线，再量化跨域性能下降。通过可解释AI（XAI）分析特征分布和重要性稳定性，并进行消融实验。最后提出基于共有特征交集的混合训练策略。
Result: 域内准确率>92%，正向跨域86%，反向仅73%。可解释分析显示特征双峰分布且关键权限跨域敏感性变化。消融表明领域特定伪影是主要障碍。混合训练策略恢复性能至88%（PerMalDroid）和97%（NATICUSdroid）。
Conclusion: 论文强调基于权限的检测器需跨域鲁棒，可解释性有助于诊断领域偏移，混合训练是提升实际部署的有效途径。

papers.title: Agentic Vulnerability Reasoning on COTS Binaries
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for solving security tasks. However, existing evaluations usually require source code access, while commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) binaries dominate deployed software and require reasoning from stripped, optimized machine code. This discrepancy raises an important question: can modern LLM agents reason about vulnerabilities in critical COTS binaries? Motivated by this question, we build SLYP, a REACT-style pipeline for end-to-end vulnerability discovery and validation of COTS binaries. SLYP combines extensible MCP servers for binary exploration and dynamic debugging, and validates candidate vulnerabilities by synthesizing debugger-verified proof-of-concept (PoC) crashes. We evaluate SLYP and production coding agents, including Claude Code and Codex, on COTS Windows binaries centered on a 20-object COM benchmark. SLYP uncovers all 64 vulnerable entry functions while default production agents miss up to 15; SLYP also surfaces more true vulnerabilities than the state-of-the-art static analyzer, which discovers at most 35 with a large number of false positives. For validation, SLYP generates debugger-verified PoCs for 67.5% of cases, while default production agents generate none. Further ablations show that tool sets and model choice materially affect COTS binary reasoning. Our additional evaluation also demonstrates the generalizability of SLYP on Windows kernel targets. To date, SLYP has uncovered 39 zero-day vulnerabilities, 31 in COM/RPC services and 8 in kernel drivers, all disclosed to the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC), with 23 assigned CVEs and $203,000 bounty awards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SLYP，一个基于LLM agent的端到端漏洞发现与验证管线，针对商业闭源二进制（COTS binaries）进行安全分析。在20个COM对象的Windows二进制基准上，SLYP发现了全部64个易受攻击的入口函数，并为67.5%的案例生成了调试器验证的利用证明（PoC），而默认的生产级agent未生成任何PoC。此外，SLYP已发现39个零日漏洞，其中23个获得CVE编号和203,000美元赏金。
Motivation: 现有LLM agent安全评测通常需要源代码，而实际部署中大量商业二进制代码仅为剥离后的机器码，缺少针对COTS二进制的漏洞推理能力评估。
Method: 构建REACT风格的管线SLYP，结合可扩展的MCP服务器进行二进制探索与动态调试，通过合成调试器验证的PoC崩溃来验证候选漏洞。
Result: 在20对象COM基准上，SLYP发现全部64个易受攻击入口函数，而默认生产agent最多遗漏15个；SLYP生成67.5%案例的已验证PoC，生产agent为零；静态分析器最多发现35个但有大量假阳性。额外实验显示SLYP在Windows内核目标上具有泛化性，已发现39个零日漏洞。
Conclusion: SLYP证明了LLM agent在COTS二进制漏洞推理上的有效性，但性能严重依赖工具集和模型选择，且当前仅验证了Windows平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowBot: Inducing LLM Workflows with Bilevel Optimization and Textual Gradients
papers.abstract_en: LLM workflows, which coordinate structured calls to individual LLMs/agents to achieve a particular goal, offer a promising path towards building powerful AI systems that can tackle diverse tasks. However, existing approaches for building such workflows generally rely on human-crafted pipelines and prompts, which presents a substantial bottleneck in real world deployment. How can we automatically induce LLM-based agents and workflows in a data-driven way? This paper describes a simple data-driven approach for automatically inducing agents and LLM workflows. We formulate workflow induction as a bilevel optimization problem: an outer loop which optimizes a high-level sketch of the workflow (in particular how the LLM calls should be structured), and an inner loop which optimizes each individual LLM call one-by one. Both loops are optimized with ``textual gradients'' where for the inner loop we optimize each component in a modular way through ``backpropagating'' textual gradients layer-by-layer. We find that LLM workflows discovered through our \textsc{FlowBot} (work\textbf{flow} induction through \textbf{b}ilevel \textbf{o}ptimization and \textbf{t}extual gradients) approach performs competitively against strong baselines that make use of human-crafted or generated workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowBot，一种通过双层优化和文本梯度自动发现 LLM 工作流（workflow）的方法。外层优化工作流的高层结构，内层逐模块优化每个 LLM 调用，均使用文本梯度（textual gradients）进行优化。实验表明，FlowBot 发现的工作流在多个任务上与人工设计的工作流性能相当。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 工作流依赖人工设计的流水线和提示，部署成本高。需要一种数据驱动的自动方法来构建 LLM 代理和工作流。
Method: 将工作流归纳建模为双层优化问题：外层优化工作流的草图（即 LLM 调用的结构），内层逐模块优化每个 LLM 调用。内外层均使用文本梯度进行优化，其中内层通过逐层“反向传播”文本梯度实现模块化优化。
Result: FlowBot 发现的工作流在多个任务上与使用人工设计或生成的工作流的强基线竞争。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的双层优化结合文本梯度能自动发现有效的 LLM 工作流，减少人工干预。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry of tail allocation in conformal prediction intervals
papers.abstract_en: Lower and upper errors of a two-sided conformal prediction interval can have different scientific consequences. The division of target miscoverage between the two endpoints determines the corresponding tail-specific guarantees and can alter interval length at first order when tail scales differ. We characterize this allocation-length relation after separate one-sided split calibration, which preserves the tail-specific guarantees and marginal coverage whenever the allocation is selected independently of the calibration sample. Tail-quantile response to proportional rescaling determines the resulting length geometry. For regularly varying tails, normalized length converges to $g_γ(c)=c^{-ξ}+γ(1-c)^{-ξ}$, where $c$ is the upper-tail allocation fraction, $ξ$ is the tail index, and $γ$ is the lower-to-upper tail-scale ratio. A dominant tail produces a boundary optimum and makes the equal-tail interval asymptotically $2^ξ$ times as long as the optimum. Comparable tails produce an interior optimum, with equal-tail allocation optimal only at matching scales. An empirical allocation rule attains the corresponding optimum without estimating tail parameters. In the de Haan class the effect moves to an additive scale. Calibration resolution determines whether ordinary ranks can realize these allocations. When calibration tail counts remain bounded, two-sided rank feasibility also constrains the allocation. Tail homogeneity transfers the length relation over covariates, while opposite dominant tails preclude one globally efficient allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双侧共形预测区间中尾部分配（tail allocation）对区间长度的影响。在单侧分裂校准（split calibration）后，尾部分配与区间长度之间的关系由尾部的正则变化性质决定。对于正则变化尾部，归一化长度收敛至 $g_\gamma(c)=c^{-\xi}+\gamma(1-c)^{-\xi}$，其中 $c$ 为上尾分配比例，$\xi$ 为尾部指数，$\gamma$ 为下尾与上尾尺度比。等尾区间在主导尾部下不是最优的，而在可比尾部下存在内部最优。经验分配规则无需估计尾部参数即可达到最优。
Motivation: 双侧共形预测区间的下尾和上尾误差可能具有不同的科学后果，但现有方法通常默认等尾分配，未考虑尾部尺度差异带来的长度优化机会。
Method: 通过单侧分裂校准分别控制下尾和上尾误差，分析尾部分配比例 $c$ 与区间长度的函数关系，利用正则变化尾部理论推导归一化长度极限，并给出经验分配规则。
Result: 对于正则变化尾部，归一化长度收敛至 $g_\gamma(c)=c^{-\xi}+\gamma(1-c)^{-\xi}$；主导尾部导致边界最优，等尾区间长度是最优的 $2^\xi$ 倍；可比尾部产生内部最优，仅当尾部尺度匹配时等尾分配才最优。
Conclusion: 尾部分配对共形预测区间长度有显著的一阶影响，通过合适的分配可以大幅缩短区间长度，且可通过简单经验规则实现。但若校准样本尾部计数有界，则两尾部可行性限制分配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Synthetic Data for Causal Inference: Pitfalls, Remedies, and Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular data are often evaluated by distributional similarity, privacy distance, or train-on-synthetic-test-on-real predictive performance, but these criteria do not ensure validity for causal inference. We show that fully generative tabular synthesizers, including GAN- and LLM-based models, can preserve predictive utility while distorting average treatment effect (ATE) estimates. The failure is structural: ATE preservation requires both a realistic covariate law and an accurate treatment-effect contrast, whereas prediction loss penalizes treatment-effect error only through an overlap-weighted term. Thus, under imbalance or limited overlap, a generator may reproduce dominant observed outcomes while underlearning intervention-relevant contrasts. We formalize this mismatch through sensitivity and loss-decomposition results. Motivated by this causal analysis and intuition, we propose a hybrid synthetic-data framework for causal inference that generates covariates while modeling treatment and outcome mechanisms separately. We evaluate the framework in three settings: ATE preservation under fully generative versus hybrid synthesis, augmentation for practical positivity problems, and diagnostic simulation engines for comparing OR, IPW, AIPW, and TMLE before real-data analysis. We also stress-test the hybrid construction across settings that vary overlap, covariate dimension, seed sample size, and treatment-effect complexity, including a logistic outcome-model misspecification check. Across controlled simulation experiments, hybrid synthesis improves causal fidelity relative to fully generative baselines; the ACTG application shows improved predictive fidelity and potential for finite-sample estimator benchmarking. LLM-based hybrid synthesis is often more faithful than CTGAN in settings where causal fidelity can be assessed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了生成式合成数据在因果推断中的有效性，发现完全生成式方法（包括 GAN 和 LLM 模型）可能扭曲平均处理效应（ATE）估计，并提出一种混合合成数据框架来改进因果保真度。实验表明混合方法在保持因果推断有效性方面优于完全生成式基线。
Motivation: 现有合成数据评估标准（分布相似性、隐私距离、预测性能）不能保证因果推断的有效性，生成式方法可能扭曲ATE估计，导致因果分析错误。
Method: 提出混合合成数据框架：生成协变量，同时分别建模处理机制和结果机制，以保留处理效应对比。
Result: 实验表明混合合成方法比完全生成式基线（如CTGAN、LLM）在因果保真度上更好；ACTG应用显示预测保真度提高和有限样本估计量基准测试潜力。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的混合合成在可评估因果保真度的场景中通常比CTGAN更忠实，合成数据用于因果推断需谨慎评估处理效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An architectural capacity ceiling, not a barren plateau: why a fixed-encoding variational quantum circuit cannot fit the Lorenz-63 attractor
papers.abstract_en: Variational quantum circuits train poorly on chaotic forecasting, usually blamed on barren plateaus (exponentially vanishing gradients). Using an exactly simulable four-qubit variational quantum physics-informed circuit fit to Lorenz-63, we show the barren-plateau explanation fails: the failure is an architectural capacity ceiling fixed by the circuit time-encoding, not its trainable depth. Four measurements support this. (i) A McClean-comparable gradient-variance estimator sits at the local-cost Haar/2-design scale 2^(-2n)=3.9e-3 at n=4; on structurally live parameters it decays about ninefold with depth then saturates there, large enough to train, not an exponential collapse. (ii) At a common budget of 200 optimiser iterations (600, in three stages, for layer-wise), gradient descent, layer-wise, and SPSA reach the same order of magnitude of loss, so no optimiser unlocks a better basin. (iii) The output-Jacobian rank saturates at 33 from five layers on, so depth buys no new output directions. (iv) A Fourier analysis explains why: the qubit-1 phase encoding acts on the initial |0> and is inert, so the maximum accessible frequency is 2.5/t_max=0.83 Hz, identical at every depth and about 4.4x below the narrowest Lorenz component bandwidth. The corrected band has dimension 1+2x5=11 per observable, and 3x11=33 equals the measured rank ceiling exactly, unifying the two diagnostics. A trained depth sweep agrees: mean loss improves with depth then flattens once the rank saturates. We correct our earlier preprint diagnosis, which compared unnormalised gradient norms to the McClean threshold, and place the advantage of fixed reservoirs and classical echo-state networks in architecture, not quantum mechanics.
papers.comment: v2: major revision. TL;DR: 本文通过四量子比特变分量子物理信息电路拟合 Lorenz-63 系统，证明训练失败并非变分量子算法常见的贫瘠高原（梯度指数消失），而是由电路时间编码固定导致的架构容量上限。四个实验证据包括：梯度方差分析达到 Haar/2-设计尺度而非指数衰减、不同优化器在同一预算下达到相同损失水平、输出雅可比秩在五层后饱和为33、傅里叶分析显示最大可达频率不足 Lorenz 分量带宽的1/4。
Motivation: 变分量子电路在混沌预测任务中训练效果差，已有解释指向贫瘠高原，但该解释可能不充分，需要更精确的归因。
Method: 使用精确可模拟的四量子比特变分量子物理信息电路拟合 Lorenz-63 系统，通过梯度方差、优化器对比、输出雅可比秩、傅里叶分析四种诊断方法验证容量上限假说。
Result: 梯度方差在活跃参数上随深度衰减约九倍后饱和，未指数消失；优化器独立性验证损失在同一数量级；输出雅可比秩五层后饱和为33，等于傅里叶分析计算的 3×11=33；最大频率 0.83 Hz，仅为 Lorenz 最窄分量带宽的 1/4.4。
Conclusion: 变分量子电路在混沌预测中的训练失败源于架构容量上限而非贫瘠高原，固定储备池和经典回波状态网络的优势在于架构而非量子机制。
