papers.title: Explainable Geospatial AI for Satellite Ground Station Siting Using LiDAR-Derived Terrain Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Representative clutter height (RCH) is a key parameter in radio propagation and interference analysis because it captures the dominant height of local obstructions that drive terminal clutter loss. Current practice often relies on fixed clutter heights assigned to land use classes in Recommendation ITU-R P.452-18, but this misses within class variation and can lead to conservative exclusion zones and poor site ranking for low Earth orbit ground station siting and spectrum coordination. We present an interpretable, globally deployable machine learning framework for predicting RCH from open geospatial data. The model is trained using LiDAR derived labels from the U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program and inference time features from global land-cover, terrain, demographic, thermal, and optical remote sensing products. We define RCH using a robust 75th percentile clutter height statistic, evaluate multiple regressors, and select LightGBM for its accuracy, efficiency, and compatibility with feature attribution analysis. The final model achieves a mean absolute error of 1.79m and an R^2=0.765, reducing absolute error by more than 60% relative to the ITU baseline. Beyond aggregate fit, we evaluate domain facing criteria relevant to RF planning, including meter scale error, tolerance band accuracy, over and under estimation tails, agreement with ITU clutter height regimes, and SHAP-based physical plausibility. SHAP identifies tree canopy cover, land-cover semantics, and spectral reflectance as the most influential predictors. Studies on segmentation derived features, non-forest ablations, and land-cover matched international validation show that open geospatial data can improve clutter modeling at scale without sacrificing interpretability or deployability.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (IEEE CASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的机器学习框架，利用LiDAR衍生标签和全球开放地理空间数据预测代表杂波高度（RCH），用于卫星地面站选址和频谱协调。模型采用LightGBM，在测试集上达到MAE=1.79m，R²=0.765，相比ITU基线误差降低超60%。SHAP分析表明树冠覆盖、土地覆盖语义和光谱反射率是最重要特征。
Motivation: 当前ITU-R P.452-18建议中使用的固定杂波高度忽略了土地覆盖类别内的变异，导致保守的排除区和次优的地面站选址。需要更精确且可全球部署的RCH预测方法。
Method: 使用USGS 3D Elevation Program的LiDAR标签训练模型，结合全球土地覆盖、地形、人口、热红外和光学遥感等特征。选择LightGBM作为回归器，并通过SHAP进行特征归因解释。
Result: 模型MAE=1.79m，R²=0.765，绝对误差相比ITU基线降低超60%。模型在米级误差、容差带准确性、过/低估尾部分布、与ITU杂波高度体制的一致性以及SHAP物理合理性方面均评估良好。
Conclusion: 开放地理空间数据可以在不牺牲可解释性和可部署性的前提下，大规模改进杂波建模。

papers.title: Interpretable Language Model for Closed-Loop Type 1 Diabetes Control
papers.abstract_en: Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) is a chronic, life-threatening autoimmune condition characterized by the complete destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic beta cells. While Artificial Pancreas Systems (APS) powered by Reinforcement Learning (RL) have shown promise in automating insulin delivery, their ``black-box'' nature makes it hard for patients and doctors to trust them fully. This paper presents LLM-T1D, a promising approach that combines the precision of RL with the clear, human-like reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create a more transparent and reliable insulin pump controller. By training an expert RL system and distilling its knowledge into fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1 8B and Qwen3 8B models, we developed a controller that not only surpasses the RL system's performance but also explains its decisions in plain, understandable language. Tested on the FDA-approved UVA/Padova T1D simulator, the LLM controllers deliver excellent blood sugar control (73.5% Time in Range) while maintaining strict formal safety verification against hallucinations.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering conference (IEEE CASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-T1D，一种结合强化学习（RL）和大语言模型（LLM）的可解释胰岛素泵控制器。方法通过训练专家 RL 系统并将其知识蒸馏到微调后的 LLaMA 3.1 8B 和 Qwen3 8B 模型中，使控制器不仅能实现优于 RL 系统的血糖控制，还能用自然语言解释决策。在 FDA 批准的 UVA/Padova T1D 模拟器上测试，达到 73.5% 的时间处于目标血糖范围，并通过形式化安全验证防止幻觉。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的人工胰腺系统（APS）是黑盒，缺乏可解释性，难以获得患者和医生的完全信任。
Method: 训练一个专家强化学习系统，然后将其知识蒸馏到微调后的 LLaMA 3.1 8B 和 Qwen3 8B 语言模型中，使控制器能够用平实语言解释其胰岛素输注决策。
Result: 在 FDA 批准的 UVA/Padova T1D 模拟器上，LLM 控制器达到 73.5% 的时间处于目标血糖范围（Time in Range），性能超过原始 RL 系统，并保持了严格的形式化安全验证以防止幻觉。
Conclusion: 将 RL 的精确性与 LLM 的人类推理能力相结合，可以构建透明且可靠的胰岛素泵控制器，提高患者和医生的信任度。

papers.title: CARPRT: Class-Aware Zero-Shot Prompt Reweighting for Black-Box Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot image classification by computing the similarity score between an image and textual descriptions, typically formed by inserting a class label (e.g., "cat") into a prompt (e.g., "a photo of a"). Since the score for a given image-class pair is sensitive to the choice of prompt, existing studies ensemble multiple prompts using a weighting vector to aggregate scores across different prompts. Yet, in current strategies, the weighting vector assigned to each prompt is shared across all classes, implicitly assuming that prompts are conditionally independent of classes, which often does not hold in practice, as a prompt like "an aerial view of" might be apt for "airport" but ill-suited for "apple". To address this, we propose class-aware zero-shot prompt reweighting (CARPRT). This scoring scheme adjusts the weighting vector for each class label by capturing the class-specific relevance of different prompts in a training-free manner. For each class label and every available prompt, we quantify their class-specific relevance by averaging image-text relevance scores over images predicted to that class under the given prompt. These estimates are then normalized to derive class-specific weights. Evaluations on standard image classification benchmarks show that CARPRT outperforms existing class-independent reweighting methods, confirming that modeling prompt-class dependencies is crucial for effective zero-shot prediction and even broader VLM-based application settings that rely on prompt ensembling. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/CARPRT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类感知零样本提示重加权方法（CARPRT），针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）在零样本分类时，不同提示对各类别具有不同适用性的问题，通过无训练的方式为每个类别计算每个提示的类特定权重，从而改进提示集成效果。
Motivation: 现有提示集成策略对所有类别共享相同的提示权重，忽略提示与类别之间的条件依赖性，导致次优分类性能。
Method: 对于每个类别标签和每个可用提示，计算在给定提示下被预测为该类别的图像与提示之间的平均图像-文本相关性分数，并归一化得到该类别的特定提示权重，实现无训练重加权。
Result: 在标准图像分类基准上，CARPRT优于现有的类无关重加权方法，表明建模提示-类别依赖关系对零样本预测至关重要。
Conclusion: 所提出的类感知提示重加权方法有效提升VLM零样本分类性能，并可能推广至依赖提示集成的更广泛VLM应用场景。

papers.title: Analysis of Public Schools Educational Performance Based on Causal Models and Hierarchical Clustering
papers.abstract_en: The increasing availability of large-scale educational datasets has expanded the use of quantitative methods for investigating school performance. However, institutional heterogeneity among schools and the structural complexity of educational data pose substantial challenges to traditional statistical modeling approaches. This study investigates the existence of school typologies based on structural, pedagogical, and demographic characteristics, and examines how these typologies relate to performance in the Brazilian Basic Education Assessment System (Saeb). Using data from the Brazilian School Census and Saeb, data preprocessing and normalization procedures are applied followed by hierarchical clustering to identify groups of schools with similar structural profiles. After the identification of these typologies, causal analysis techniques are employed to investigate potential causal relationships between school characteristics and educational outcomes. The results reveal the presence of distinct school profiles and statistically significant differences in average performance among them. The causal analysis provides insights into the structural and contextual factors that may influence educational performance, contributing to a better understanding of the mechanisms associated with school effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用巴西学校普查和基础教育评估系统（Saeb）的数据，通过层次聚类识别出具有不同结构、教学和人口特征的学校类型，并采用因果分析技术探究学校特征与教育表现之间的因果关系。研究发现存在不同的学校轮廓，且各类学校在平均表现上存在显著统计差异，因果分析揭示了可能影响教育表现的结构性和情境因素。
Motivation: 大规模教育数据集日益可用，但学校间的异质性和教育数据的结构复杂性给传统统计建模带来挑战，需要新的方法识别学校类型并理解其与表现的关系。
Method: 先对巴西学校普查和Saeb数据进行预处理和归一化，然后应用层次聚类识别学校类型；在聚类基础上，采用因果分析技术探究学校特征与教育结果间的潜在因果关系。
Result: 发现了不同的学校轮廓，且各类学校在平均表现上存在统计显著的差异；因果分析提供了关于影响教育表现的结构性和情境因素的见解。
Conclusion: 本文表明基于聚类和因果分析的方法能有效识别学校类型并理解其与表现的关系，有助于更深入地理解学校效能的相关机制。

papers.title: Position: Explainability Research Must Prioritize Foundations over Ad-hoc Methods
papers.abstract_en: Despite the proliferation of Explainable AI (XAI) techniques -- from feature attributions to sparse autoencoders -- explanations rarely influence real-world workflows. In practice, they are often generated and discarded without guiding meaningful action. This gap reflects foundational shortcomings: research has not yet established methodologies for integrating explanations into end-to-end, human-in-the-loop systems. This position paper argues that the machine learning community must pivot from ad-hoc XAI methods toward addressing foundational & structural challenges, including unclear problem formulations, underspecified evaluation objectives, and the absence of pipelines for explanation-driven feedback. We support this claim through an analysis of recent ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR papers and a survey of XAI practitioners, revealing recurring issues that limit cumulative progress. We conclude by outlining a practical checklist designed to shift XAI toward a more human-centered, action-oriented paradigm. By emphasizing foundational clarity over the development of ad-hoc methods, we hope to provide a roadmap for integrating explanations into actionable, feedback-driven AI systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，认为可解释AI（XAI）研究应从临时方法转向解决基础性和结构性挑战，如不清晰的问题定义、未充分指定的评估目标和缺乏解释驱动反馈的管道。作者通过分析近期顶会论文和从业者调查支持其论点，并提出了一个以人为中心、行动导向的检查清单。
Motivation: 尽管XAI技术众多，但解释很少真正影响实际工作流程，往往被生成后丢弃，反映出研究在方法论上的基础性缺陷。
Method: 通过分析ICML、NeurIPS、ICLR论文和从业者调查，识别出限制累积进展的重复问题，并设计实用检查清单以引导XAI转向更以人为中心、以行动为导向的范式。
Result: 发现当前XAI研究存在形式化不清、评估目标模糊、缺乏反馈管道等问题，导致解释难以融入端到端系统。
Conclusion: 强调XAI应优先建立基础清晰性而非开发临时方法，为将解释整合到可操作、反馈驱动的AI系统提供路线图。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，认为可解释AI（XAI）研究应从临时方法转向解决基础性和结构性挑战，如不清晰的问题定义、未充分指定的评估目标和缺乏解释驱动反馈的管道。作者通过分析近期顶会论文和从业者调查支持其论点，并提出了一个以人为中心、行动导向的检查清单。
summary_sections.motivation: 尽管XAI技术众多，但解释很少真正影响实际工作流程，往往被生成后丢弃，反映出研究在方法论上的基础性缺陷。
summary_sections.method: 通过分析ICML、NeurIPS、ICLR论文和从业者调查，识别出限制累积进展的重复问题，并设计实用检查清单以引导XAI转向更以人为中心、以行动为导向的范式。
summary_sections.result: 发现当前XAI研究存在形式化不清、评估目标模糊、缺乏反馈管道等问题，导致解释难以融入端到端系统。

papers.title: Generalized Neural Distributional Regression
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Generalized Neural Distributional Regression (GNDR) framework, which seamlessly embeds deep neural networks into the parameter space of classical probability distributions. To reconcile the inherent non-identifiability of deep architectures with maximum likelihood theory, we propose a two-step semi-parametric estimation procedure. By isolating the terminal prediction heads and treating the upstream network as a fixed, non-linear basis expansion, GNDR enables the extraction of analytical Fisher Information matrices. This facilitates rigorous uncertainty quantification, generating observation-specific confidence bands and tolerance intervals via the multivariate Delta method. We demonstrate the framework's versatility and superior distributional calibration across diverse data modalities, including overdispersed clinical counts, right-censored transcriptomic survival profiles under a mixture cure framework, and zero-truncated age distributions derived directly from unstructured facial images. The methodology is natively implemented in the open-source Python package \textit{thetaflow}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出广义神经分布回归（GNDR）框架，将深度神经网络嵌入经典概率分布的参数空间。通过两步半参数估计程序处理深度架构的不可辨识性，并提取解析Fisher信息矩阵，实现观测级别的置信带和容忍区间。在过离散临床计数、右删失转录组生存数据（混合治愈模型）和零截断年龄分布（来自人脸图像）等不同模态数据上展示了优越的分布校准能力。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型缺乏严格的分布假设和不确定性量化能力，而传统统计分布模型难以处理高维复杂数据。需要一种能将深度表示学习与经典分布理论结合的框架，同时解决深度架构的非可辨识性对极大似然估计的影响。
Method: 提出GNDR框架，采用两步估计：第一步将上游深度网络作为固定非线性基展开，第二步隔离终端预测头进行半参数推理。利用解析Fisher信息矩阵和多元Delta方法生成观测特定置信带与容忍区间。
Result: 在过离散临床计数、右删失转录组生存数据（混合治愈框架）以及从无结构人脸图像中提取的零截断年龄分布上，方法展现出更好的分布校准和不确定性量化效果。
Conclusion: GNDR为深度神经网络提供了严格的不确定性量化工具，可应用于多种数据模态。框架已开源实现于Python包thetaflow。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Element-Aware Cross-Version Differencing of Scientific Documents via Layout-Aware Alignment and Structure-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-version differencing of scientific documents is essential in scholarly publishing and technical documentation, but remains challenging because scientific documents are page-structured artifacts containing heterogeneous elements such as text, tables, formulas, figures, and layout cues. Existing text-sequence-based methods often lose layout and structural information, while image-based methods lack semantic interpretability and are sensitive to rendering variation. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a layout-aware heterogeneous element-aware framework for scientific document differencing. The framework decomposes document versions into semantically typed elements, establishes cross-version correspondence through an alignment-first mechanism that jointly models spatial, content, and structural compatibility, and performs type-aware difference reasoning over aligned element pairs. It supports unified change detection, localization, structure-awareness analysis, and alignment/matching evaluation across text, tables, formulas, and figures. Experiments on real-world scientific PDF data from journal production proofreading workflows show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms element-specific baselines. It achieves detection F1 scores of 0.903, 0.855, 0.862, and 0.845 for text, tables, formulas, and figures, respectively, with further improvements in localization, structure awareness, and matching quality. Ablation and sensitivity analyses confirm the effectiveness of cross-version alignment, type-specific representations, structure-aware reasoning, and compatibility-weight design. These results demonstrate that heterogeneous element-aware differencing provides a robust and interpretable solution for scientific document comparison in realistic editorial production scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学文档跨版本差异比较中布局和结构信息丢失的问题，提出一个布局感知的异构元素感知框架，将文档分解为语义类型元素，通过对齐优先机制建立跨版本对应，并进行类型感知的差异推理。实验表明，该框架在文本、表格、公式、图上的检测F1分别达到0.903、0.855、0.862、0.845，优于元素级基线方法。
Motivation: 现有科学文档差异比较方法要么丢失布局和结构信息，要么缺乏语义可解释性，难以处理文本、表格、公式、图形等异构元素。
Method: 提出一个布局感知的异构元素感知框架，首先将文档版本分解为语义类型元素，然后通过联合建模空间、内容和结构兼容性的对齐优先机制建立跨版本对应，最后对对齐的元素对进行类型感知的差异推理。
Result: 在真实期刊生产校对数据上，文本、表格、公式、图的检测F1分别达到0.903、0.855、0.862、0.845，并在定位、结构感知和匹配质量上进一步改进。消融实验验证了跨版本对齐、类型特定表示、结构感知推理和兼容性权重设计的有效性。
Conclusion: 异构元素感知的差异比较为科学文档比较提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的解决方案，适用于实际的编辑生产场景。

papers.title: ReportMedSAM: Guiding Segmentation Through Radiology Reports
papers.abstract_en: Free-form radiology reports contain rich clinical descriptions, yet converting them for reliable segmentation remains challenging due to the inherent variability of natural language. Existing pipelines often rely on predefined organ phrases or brittle rule-based inference-time extraction, which limits their scalability to novel anatomical structures and makes them sensitive to linguistic variations. To address this, we propose ReportMedSAM, a report-driven framework that replaces discrete extraction with a learnable concept bank. By leveraging a frozen medical vision-language encoder (BiomedCLIP), we align organ-level concept embeddings with large-scale clinical corpora through contrastive learning, establishing mutually orthogonal semantic anchors. Our approach explicitly mitigates organ-level semantic collapse and ensures high robustness against diverse clinical synonyms (e.g., "renal" vs. "kidney" ). During inference, a clinical report is embedded and matched against this concept bank to dynamically activate task-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules. This decoupled design allows new concepts and experts to be added without retraining existing components, providing a parameter-isolated extension mechanism while keeping previously learned experts unchanged. Evaluated on the AbdomenAtlas 3.0 dataset, ReportMedSAM effectively interprets free-form reports, achieves competitive segmentation accuracy, and demonstrates seamless, non-interfering extension to novel clinical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自由文本放射学报告引导医学图像分割中自然语言变异性大、依赖预定义短语和规则提取的局限，该文提出ReportMedSAM框架。它引入可学习概念库，通过对比学习将器官级概念嵌入与临床语料对齐，建立正交语义锚点，缓解语义坍塌。推理时，报告嵌入匹配概念库，动态激活任务特定的混合专家模块（MoE），支持参数隔离式扩展新任务而不重训练旧组件。在AbdomenAtlas 3.0数据集上达到竞争性分割精度，并展示了无缝扩展到新临床任务的能力。
Motivation: 现有报告驱动分割方法依赖预定义器官短语或规则提取，对语言变异性敏感，难以扩展至新解剖结构。
Method: 利用冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器，通过对比学习构建器官级概念库（正交语义锚点）；推理时匹配报告嵌入，动态激活对应的MoE模块进行分割。
Result: 在AbdomenAtlas 3.0数据集上有效解释自由文本报告，分割精度具有竞争力，且能无干扰地扩展到新临床任务。
Conclusion: 该框架通过解耦设计和概念库实现了对语言变异的鲁棒性和参数隔离的任务扩展，但当前仅在腹部数据集上评估。

papers.title: DialogueVPR: Towards Conversational Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by how humans communicate spatial information, language-guided geo-localization has gained significant traction for its intuitive and practical value. Despite this progress, most methods still rely on a static, one-shot retrieval paradigm, which fails to handle the ambiguity and incompleteness inherent in real-world natural language descriptions. We propose a paradigm shift to reasoning retrieval and introduce Dialogue Place Recognition (DlgPR), which casts localization as an interactive, dialogue-driven reasoning process. To support this new task, we present DlgQuest-Cities, the first large-scale dialogue-based benchmark for place recognition, and a unified reasoning framework that couples a cross-modal multi-level retriever with an intelligent questioner, DQ-pilot. DQ-pilot is trained in a curriculum: supervised fine-tuning on a curated DQ-cities-20k subset followed by reinforcement refinement on a harder DQ-cities-10k split via GRPO. Two task-aligned metrics guide learning: a Discriminative Difficulty Index (DDI) for curriculum sampling and a Positional Retrieval Gain (PRG) reward that directly measures retrieval improvement induced by a question. Experiments show this reasoning-based approach significantly outperforms baselines. The code and model are available at https://github.com/Graysonggg/DlgPR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出范式转换，将视觉地点识别视为交互式对话推理过程，引入Dialogue Place Recognition (DlgPR)任务。构建了首个大规模对话式地点识别基准DlgQuest-Cities，并提出统一推理框架，包含跨模态多级检索器和智能提问器DQ-pilot，后者通过监督微调和基于GRPO的强化学习训练。实验表明该方法显著优于基线。
Motivation: 现有语言引导的地理定位方法依赖静态、一次性的检索范式，无法处理真实世界自然语言描述的模糊性和不完整性，需要向推理式检索转变。
Method: 提出Dialogue Place Recognition (DlgPR)任务，将定位建模为交互式对话推理过程。构建DlgQuest-Cities基准，并提出统一框架，包含跨模态多级检索器和DQ-pilot。DQ-pilot通过课程学习：先在DQ-cities-20k上监督微调，再在更难的DQ-cities-10k上使用GRPO进行强化学习优化。使用两个任务对齐指标：判别难度指数(DDI)用于课程采样，位置检索增益(PRG)奖励直接衡量问题带来的检索提升。
Result: 实验表明基于推理的方法显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该推理式方法优于基线，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: CoEvoT: Co-Evolving Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Graph-LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Graph learning under distribution shift presents a persistent challenge, where models adapt to new graphs with limited or even no supervision. Recent graph--LLM approaches move toward label-efficient prediction by linearizing graphs into prompts and using large language models (LLMs) as predictors, and can adopt Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to exploit LLM's multi-step reasoning capability. However, existing CoT-based graph--LLM methods generate intermediate thoughts while conditioning on fixed graph tokens, limiting step-wise refinement of structural cues. In this paper, we propose CoEvoT, a simple yet effective co-evolving CoT prompting framework for graph--LLM reasoning. CoEvoT couples text-to-graph token rewriting and graph-to-text reasoning guidance in a closed loop: each intermediate textual thought is used to update the graph token evidence state via a lightweight condition network, and the updated tokens are fed back into the next-step instruction to guide subsequent LLM reasoning. This enables step-wise, state-aware evidence refinement, rather than reasoning over a fixed graph snapshot. Extensive experiments on eight datasets demonstrate that CoEvoT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoEvoT，一个协同进化的链式思维提示框架，用于图-大语言模型推理。该方法通过文本到图 token 重写和图到文本推理指导的闭环，实现逐步的状态感知证据细化，在八个数据集上持续优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 CoT 的图-LLM 方法在生成中间推理步骤时依赖于固定的图 token，限制了结构线索的逐步细化，难以应对分布偏移下的标签高效学习。
Method: 提出 CoEvoT 框架，将文本-图 token 重写与图-文本推理指导耦合在闭环中：每个中间文本推理步骤通过轻量条件网络更新图 token 证据状态，更新后的 token 反馈到下一步指令中引导 LLM 推理，实现逐步的、状态感知的证据细化。
Result: 在八个数据集上的实验表明，CoEvoT 持续优于最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: CoEvoT 通过协同进化的 CoT 提示，实现了图-LLM 推理中结构线索的逐步细化，提升了分布偏移下的图学习性能。

papers.title: T5-CSBoost: Adversarial Perturbation Resistant LLM Fingerprinting
papers.abstract_en: While many AI-generated text (AIGT) detectors achieve strong performance on clean inputs, their accuracy degrades significantly under light paraphrasing, word substitutions, character edits, and distribution shifts. We present T5 Contrastive Style Boosted Classifier (T5-CSBoost), an extension to the T5-Sentinel framework that keeps the original next-token prediction objective for source attribution while introducing an auxiliary margin-based triplet loss over decoder embeddings. This contrastive style regularization encourages the learning of compact, perturbation-resistant stylistic representations, offering a lightweight yet effective alternative to prior approaches that rely on architectural modifications, adversarial training, or complex multi-task objectives without altering the underlying T5-small backbone. T5-CSBoost achieves state-of-the-art multiclass source attribution and binary human-vs-LLM detection on OpenLLMText and HC3 AIGT benchmarks. More importantly, T5-CSBoost demonstrates enhanced robustness to word and character level adversarial perturbations of up to 90% intensity, achieving state-of-the-art on the challenging MAGE/Deepfake stress-test suite, including unseen models, unseen domains, and extreme paraphrasing scenarios. Our results highlight that explicitly regularizing stylistic embeddings via contrastive learning is a practical and effective strategy for building more robust LLM fingerprinting systems in real-world adversarial settings.

papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有 AI 生成文本检测器在轻度改写、词替换等对抗性扰动下准确率显著下降，亟需鲁棒的指纹识别方法。
Method: 在 T5-Sentinel 框架中引入辅助的基于边缘的三元组损失，对解码器嵌入进行对比风格正则化，以学习紧凑且抗扰动的风格表示。
Result: 在 OpenLLMText 和 HC3 上取得 SOTA 多类源归属和二元检测效果；在 MAGE/Deepfake 压力测试中，对 90% 强度扰动及未见模型、未见领域和极端改写场景均达到最佳鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 对比学习显式正则化风格嵌入是构建鲁棒 LLM 指纹识别系统的实用且有效策略。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Limits of Reliability and Scaling in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are evaluated as though perfect reliability is achievable for any task given sufficient scale. We show this assumption is information-theoretically unjustified. Every generative task has a reliability ceiling that no model can exceed, determined by how much output uncertainty is resolvable from observable context. The gap decomposes into a resolvable component closable with additional context and a subjective component inherent to task ambiguity. Autoregressive generation further degrades this ceiling at a rate governed by the task's dependency kernel, which quantifies inter-token correlations in the output. From these two primitives, we derive a first-principles scaling law where LLM performance is bottlenecked by the scarcer resource: training data or model capacity. This law recovers the Chinchilla scaling law as a special case and provides a structural account of when scaling improves reliability. Beyond scaling, our framework unifies diverse practical phenomena, such as the benefits of retrieval-augmentation and the spectral mechanics of catastrophic forgetting. Our work formalizes the resource-complexity tradeoffs that govern model performance across domains, offering a unified theory of performance limits in generative language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论角度论证，大语言模型（LLM）的完美可靠性在理论上不可实现。生成任务存在一个由上下文可解析的不确定性决定的可靠性上限，该上限可分解为基于上下文可弥补的分量和任务固有歧义的主观分量。自回归生成进一步衰减该上限，衰减率由任务依赖核（衡量输出中标记间相关性）决定。由此推导出第一性原理的缩放律，其中模型性能受限于训练数据或模型容量中的更稀缺资源，该律统一了Chinchilla缩放律及其他现象如检索增强和灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 现有评估假定LLM在足够规模下可实现完美可靠性，但作者认为这一假设在信息论上不成立，需要形式化定性能极限。
Method: 从信息论推导可靠性上限，将不确定性分解为可解析和主观分量；分析自回归生成对上限的衰减，引入任务依赖核；推导出基于资源和容量的缩放律。
Result: 推导出通用缩放律，Chinchilla缩放律为其特例；框架统一解释了检索增强的好处和灾难性遗忘的谱机制。
Conclusion: 本文提供了生成语言模型性能极限的统一理论，形式化了资源-复杂度权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Introspection Fine-Tuning (IFT): Training Small LLMs to Introspect
papers.abstract_en: Can small language models detect and report on perturbations their own internal activations? We investigate this question through the lens of activation steering: injecting concept vectors into a model's residual stream and measuring whether the model can accurately report on the perturbation. We first show that the binary detection paradigm used in prior work -- prompting the model to answer Yes'' or No'' to whether it detects an injected thought -- is confounded in small models, as steering biases the model toward affirmative responses regardless of the question content. We therefore propose two confound-free evaluation paradigms: sentence localization (identifying which of $N$ sentences was perturbed, chance $= 1/N$) and strength comparison (identifying which of two sentences received a stronger injection, chance $= 50\%$). Evaluating across six models from two families (Llama-3.2 and Gemma-4), we find that models as small as 2B parameters introspect reliably well above chance, and that introspective ability generally increases with scale. Llama-1B, however, performs at or below chance. We then introduce \emph{Introspection Fine-Tuning} (IFT): supervised fine-tuning on sentence-localization examples constructed from the model's own perturbed forward passes. IFT raises Llama-1B sentence-localization accuracy from $9.6\%$ to $60.6\%$ (a $6\times$ improvement), with gains generalizing zero-shot to the held-out strength-comparison task ($30.2\% \to 52.2\%$). IFT also improves introspection for 3B and 8B models, while inducing negligible degradation on standard capability benchmarks. Our results suggest that introspective ability is not fixed by scale alone: it can be directly trained, and doing so unlocks latent self-monitoring capacity with implications for AI transparency and alignment. Our code is \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/IFT-introspection-2092/README.md}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小语言模型能否检测并报告自身内部激活的扰动。作者发现二元检测范式在小模型中存在混淆，因此提出句子定位和强度比较两种无混淆评估方法。实验表明2B参数以上的模型内省能力显著高于随机水平，而Llama-1B表现较差。作者提出内省微调（IFT），通过监督微调将Llama-1B的句子定位准确率从9.6%提升至60.6%，并零样本泛化到强度比较任务。结果表明内省能力可通过训练获得，且对标准能力基准影响很小。
Motivation: 现有研究使用二元检测范式评估模型内省能力，但在小模型中因激活偏置导致结果混淆，需要更可靠的评估方法。同时，小模型的内省能力是否可通过训练提升尚不清楚。
Method: 提出句子定位（识别N个句子中被扰动的句子）和强度比较（判断两个句子中哪个受到更强扰动）两种无混淆评估范式；并引入内省微调（IFT），利用模型自身扰动的前向传播构造句子定位训练样本进行监督微调。
Result: 在Llama-3.2和Gemma-4系列共6个模型上，2B参数以上模型内省能力显著高于随机水平；IFT使Llama-1B句子定位准确率从9.6%提升至60.6%（6倍提升），零样本泛化到强度比较任务（30.2%→52.2%），且对3B和8B模型也有提升，标准基准退化可忽略。
Conclusion: 内省能力不是仅由模型规模决定，可以通过直接训练解锁，从而提升AI透明度和对齐性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAPS: Modeling Co-Existing Subjective Perspectives and Shared Meaning in Multi-Agent Cognitive Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Human dialogue involves more than exchanging information; it also expresses beliefs, emotions, and subjective cognitive styles. Yet current AI dialogue systems often enforce semantic uniformity, sacrificing diversity and interpretability. We present MAPS (Multi-Agent Perspective Spaces), a novel framework that models dialogue between cognitively distinct agents through domain-weighted profiles, dynamic GRU-based memory, and interpretable token-level attention. MAPS enables agents to maintain individualized reasoning while progressively converging on shared meaning. Evaluations on EmpatheticDialogues, TopicalChat, and MultiWOZ show that MAPS supports semantic alignment without collapsing subjectivity. Our results demonstrate a path toward cognitively grounded, interpretable dialogue systems that balance expressiveness and coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAPS框架，通过领域加权档案、动态GRU记忆和可解释的token级注意力，为认知风格不同的智能体建模对话过程，使对话能够逐步收敛到共享含义而不破坏主体性。在EmpatheticDialogues、TopicalChat和MultiWOZ上评估，表明MAPS在实现语义对齐的同时保留了主观多样性。
Motivation: 现有对话系统强制语义一致性，牺牲了多样性与可解释性，无法捕捉人类对话中的信念、情感和认知风格差异。
Method: 提出MAPS（Multi-Agent Perspective Spaces）框架，包含领域加权档案（domain-weighted profiles）、基于GRU的动态记忆和可解释的token级注意力机制，使认知不同的智能体在对话中保持个体推理并逐步达成共识。
Result: 在EmpatheticDialogues、TopicalChat和MultiWOZ数据集上，MAPS实现了语义对齐而不丧失主观性。
Conclusion: MAPS展示了构建认知可解释、表达性与连贯性平衡的对话系统的可行路径。

papers.title: Simplicity Paradox: Debunking myths about prompting and datasets for LLM evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Probing the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and building robust solutions for Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) remain central challenges in natural language understanding. Furthermore, the rapid proliferation of LLMs has created the implicit assumption that more sophisticated prompting techniques yield better performance. Several studies claim better performance with more sophisticated prompting techniques, but do not provide a comprehensive evaluation. We address this gap through a comprehensive empirical study of 8 prompting techniques across 10 multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) datasets, encompassing 27 model configurations and roughly 4,300 unique questions evaluated more than 430,000 times. Our findings reveal a striking paradox that baseline prompting consistently outperforms complex reasoning techniques on various benchmarks. Only minimal expert and inductive role framing (CoT-Expert and CoT-Inductive) yields a small but statistically significant $\sim$3 percentage-point (pp) gain over baseline whereas every other elaborate technique we tested matches or under-performs it, often by large margins (up to 31~pp for Self-Analogical). We further investigate three critical phenomena: (1) the unexpected victory of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 in Elo ratings, (2) the performance-efficiency trade-offs across model variants with different thinking budgets, revealing model-dependent optimal configurations, and (3) the substantial variation in dataset difficulty, with 60% of benchmarks below 70% accuracy and a 47.5~pp spread from easiest to hardest, indicating considerable room for model improvement. These results suggest that the LLM evaluation community may be overcomplicating prompt engineering and that substantial performance gaps remain across diverse benchmarks, offering opportunities for genuine model improvements rather than prompt optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验发现，在多项选择问答（MCQA）任务中，简单的基线提示方法（如直接提问）通常优于复杂的推理提示技术，性能差距最高可达31个百分点。研究涉及8种提示技术、10个数据集、27个模型配置和超过43万次评估，揭示了一种“简单性悖论”。
Motivation: 当前LLM评估社区普遍认为更复杂的提示技术能带来更好性能，但缺乏系统性的验证。论文旨在通过全面实证研究填补这一空白。
Method: 对8种提示技术（包括基线、CoT、自类比等）在10个MCQA数据集上进行对比实验，涵盖27个模型配置，共约4300个独特问题，每个问题被评估多次。
Result: 基线提示在多数基准上优于复杂推理技术，仅CoT-Expert和CoT-Inductive带来约3个百分点的微小增益，而自类比（Self-Analogical）表现最差，落后基线31个百分点。此外，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507在Elo评分中意外领先，且数据集难度差异显著（60%的基准准确率低于70%）。
Conclusion: 提示工程可能被过度复杂化，真正的模型能力提升应关注基准本身而非提示优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Eta Given Delta: Defining LLM Tool Efficiency With Marginal Tool Utility
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces tool efficiency, a new quantitative metric to evaluate the rate of useful tool calls in an LLM agent trajectory. To ensure that tool efficiency is well-defined, we also introduce marginal tool utility, a new quantitative metric defined per tool call indicating whether a tool is useful or whether it can be safely removed from the tool suite without affecting accuracy while increasing tool efficiency; in this paper, we determine the sign of marginal tool utility for each tool call in a trajectory using LLM-as-a-Judge. While much prior work has been done to develop techniques that improve tool use by LLMs and design evaluation methods measuring efficiency indirectly using accuracy as a proxy, our work is centered on measuring efficiency directly via the quantitative metric proposed in this paper in post hoc trajectory analyses. It is our intention that this work contributes to the frontier of LLM evaluation research as a springboard for future benchmark designs and agent harness engineering (specifically with regards to creating lean tool suites) that optimize for metrics that complement but are distinct from accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出工具效率（tool efficiency）作为新定量指标，评估LLM智能体轨迹中有用工具调用的比例，同时定义每步调用的边际工具效用（marginal tool utility），利用LLM-as-a-Judge判断工具是否可移除。旨在直接测量效率而非通过准确率间接代理，为未来基准设计和工具集优化提供基础。
Motivation: 现有工作多通过准确率间接测量LLM工具使用效率，缺乏直接量化工具调用有用性的指标。
Method: 定义工具效率和边际工具效用，采用LLM-as-a-Judge对轨迹中每次工具调用的边际效用进行符号判定。
Result: 提出两个定量指标，可用于后验轨迹分析，衡量工具调用的有用性和整体效率。
Conclusion: 本文贡献于LLM评估前沿，为设计兼顾准确率与效率的基准和工具集提供新度量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 定义工具效率和边际工具效用，采用LLM-as-a-Judge对轨迹中每次工具调用的边际效用进行符号判定。
summary_sections.result: 提出两个定量指标，可用于后验轨迹分析，衡量工具调用的有用性和整体效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文贡献于LLM评估前沿，为设计兼顾准确率与效率的基准和工具集提供新度量。

papers.title: Polestar: Drift-Aware Cache Calibration and Token Commitment for Efficient Inference of Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The inference efficiency of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is constrained by two challenges: bidirectional attention precludes efficient KV-cache reuse, while increasing decoding parallelism with static confidence thresholds can compromise generation quality. We observe that both challenges arise from a shared phenomenon: as tokens are decoded, their contextual integration through bidirectional attention causes token representations to drift (evolve) across decoding steps. This insight motivates Polestar, a training-free inference framework that uses token representation drift as a unified signal to jointly address both challenges. Polestar comprises two components: Polestar-Cache, which identifies stale KV-cache positions via drift and performs sparse KV-cache refreshes to enable efficient reuse, and Polestar-Commit, which detects sharp drift events to reliably identify commit-ready tokens. Across mathematics and coding benchmarks on several dLLM families, Polestar sets a new state of the art on the accuracy-throughput Pareto frontier, achieving up to 10.73% accuracy improvement, up to 3.7x higher throughput, and high decoding parallelism of 3.67 tokens per forward pass over existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）推理效率的两个挑战：双向注意力阻碍KV-cache重用，以及静态置信度阈值解码并行化影响质量，发现两者源于token表示在解码步骤间的漂移现象。提出训练无关的推理框架Polestar，包括Polestar-Cache（基于漂移识别陈旧KV-cache位置并稀疏刷新）和Polestar-Commit（检测漂移事件确定可提交token）。在数学和编程基准上，Polestar在准确性-吞吐量帕累托前沿上取得新SOTA，准确率提升最多10.73%，吞吐量提升最多3.7倍，解码并行度达3.67 token/前向传递。
Motivation: dLLM推理中双向注意力导致KV-cache重用困难，而静态阈值解码并行化会损害生成质量，现有方法未统一处理。
Method: 提出Polestar框架，利用token表示漂移作为统一信号：Polestar-Cache执行稀疏KV-cache刷新，Polestar-Commit通过漂移事件识别可提交token。
Result: 在数学和编程基准上，相比基线，准确率提升最多10.73%，吞吐量提升最多3.7倍，解码并行度达3.67 token/前向传递。
Conclusion: 利用token表示漂移可同时解决双向注意力下的缓存重用和并行解码问题，实现更好的效率-质量权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token Time Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we introduce token time continuous diffusion (TTCD), a new diffusion language model which (a) operates in continuous space, deterministically mapping Gaussian noise to a final token canvas with no further sampling, and crucially (b) incorporates a new notion of per-token times, with some tokens proceeding from noise to token at a faster rate than others. Continuous space modeling helps TTCD avoid the parallel sampling of multiple tokens, which is a key source of inaccuracy at high speedups for models that iterate purely in discrete space. The notion of per-token times helps TTCD to better model conditional generation, allows for more sure tokens to proceed at a faster rate, and allows for differentiated inter-token influences during refinement. TTCD outperforms discrete models at high speedups. We train a 160M parameter TTCD model on OpenWebText, and then self-distill it; we find that at high speedups we are comparable in unconditional generation quality, and outperform in conditional generation, several existing models of similar size trained, on the same data, and self-distilled. We achieve similar gains in Sudoku solving as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 token time continuous diffusion (TTCD)，一种连续空间扩散语言模型，通过在连续空间中确定性映射高斯噪声到最终 token 画布，并引入逐 token 时间（per-token times）概念，使不同 token 以不同速率从噪声演化到最终 token。TTCD 避免了离散空间模型在高加速时并行采样多个 token 带来的不准确性，并在无条件生成质量可比的情况下，在条件生成任务中优于现有离散模型。
Motivation: 现有离散空间扩散语言模型在高加速并行采样时存在较大误差，且无法灵活处理不同 token 的确定性程度差异。
Method: TTCD 在连续空间中进行扩散，采用确定性映射（无额外采样），并引入逐 token 时间变量，使更确定的 token 演化更快，同时允许 token 间的差异化影响。
Result: 在 OpenWebText 上训练的 160M 参数 TTCD 模型经自蒸馏后，在高加速下无条件生成质量与同类离散模型相当，条件生成性能更优，并在数独求解任务上取得类似提升。
Conclusion: TTCD 表明连续空间与逐 token 时间机制可提升扩散语言模型在高加速下的生成质量与条件控制能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automatically Evolving Prompt Guidelines for Task-Specific Optimization
papers.abstract_en: For Large Language Models to reliably answer user queries, users must clearly specify requirements, context, and constraints. In practice, however, user queries are often underspecified, forcing models to infer unstated assumptions that may misalign with the actual user intent. Existing prompt engineering guidelines aim to mitigate this issue, they are typically generic and task-agnostic, limiting their practical utility. Additionally, existing guidelines are formed manually and in a non-systematic way. To this end, we study prompt guideline optimization: the problem of automatically generating task-specific guidelines that help write better-specified prompts for a given task and model. Our key observation is that existing (completed) task examples (aka reference answers) often implicitly encode the missing information required to complete underspecified queries, including behavioral constraints, contextual assumptions, and evaluation criteria. We therefore propose AGOPS, an automatic approach that evolves task-specific guidelines via an optimization scheme that involves a prompt LLM writer, a solver LLM and prompt evolution, which maximize downstream effectiveness on a set of examples (user queries with reference answers). At inference time, our guidelines help users write well-specified prompts, boosting the effectiveness of LLMs. We show across mathematical reasoning, medical question answering, and coding tasks, that prompt underspecification leads to major drops (up to 95.3%) in downstream task performance (compared to well-specified prompts) and, perhaps more importantly, that this drop can hardly be recovered by existing prompt optimization techniques. Users following AGOPS guidelines can regain this loss (increasing performance between 15.5 to 81.7% on average) consistently across all benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 用户查询欠指定问题，提出自动生成任务特定提示指南的方法 AGOPS。该方法利用参考答案隐式编码缺失信息，通过优化方案迭代演化指南，从而帮助用户写出更明确的提示。实验表明，欠指定导致性能大幅下降（最高 95.3%），而遵循 AGOPS 指南可恢复损失（平均提升 15.5-81.7%）。系统基于 LLM 编写器和求解器进行提示演化。
Motivation: 现有提示工程指南是通用且任务无关的，且由人工非系统地形成，无法有效解决用户查询欠指定问题。用户查询通常不明确，导致 LLM 推断错误假设，与实际意图不符。
Method: 提出 AGOPS，一种自动方法，通过优化方案演化任务特定指南。该方案涉及提示 LLM 编写器、求解器 LLM 和提示演化，最大化在用户查询及参考答案示例上的下游有效性。
Result: 在数学推理、医学问答和编码任务上，欠指定提示导致性能下降高达 95.3%，现有提示优化技术难以恢复。遵循 AGOPS 指南的用户平均可恢复损失，性能提升 15.5-81.7%。
Conclusion: 自动生成的任务特定提示指南能有效提升 LLM 在特定任务上的表现，弥补欠指定带来的性能损失。方法具有跨任务通用性。

papers.title: LBA: Textual Hard-Label Adversarial Attack under Low Query Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality adversarial texts with low query budgets remains a challenging problem in the hard-label scenario. Most existing approaches rely on greedy algorithms, where one position in the text is selected for substitution, followed by the substitutions of other positions. This local search approach may fail to discover high-quality adversarial examples and often leads to excessive query costs. Ideally, an optimal adversarial sample would consider all possible position combinations in the text, but exhaustive search is computationally impractical. To address this challenge, we propose a sampling-based method called LBA, which constructs an approximate distribution of high-quality adversarial examples by integrating both prior and posterior knowledge, and utilizes this distribution for sampling. As sampling progresses, posterior knowledge updates the approximate distribution, which in turn guides more effective sampling. Extensive experiments on six language models, ranging from small-scale to large-scale architectures across four datasets, demonstrate that LBA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on all evaluation metrics. Additionally, LLM-based assessment indicates that LBA generates more semantically preserved and comprehensible adversarial texts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LBA，一种基于采样的硬标签文本对抗攻击方法，在低查询预算下通过融合先验和后验知识构建对抗样本的近似分布，并利用后验知识迭代更新分布以引导有效采样。实验在六个语言模型和四个数据集上显著超越基线，LLM评估表明生成文本语义保留度和可理解性更优。
Motivation: 现有硬标签对抗攻击依赖贪婪局部搜索，可能错过高质量对抗样本且查询成本高；穷举所有位置组合不可行。
Method: LBA 构建一个融合先验和后验知识的近似分布，通过采样生成候选对抗样本，并利用后验知识更新分布，从而在低查询预算下高效搜索高质量对抗样本。
Result: 在六个语言模型（涵盖小规模到大规模架构）和四个数据集上，LBA 在所有评估指标上显著优于最先进基线；LLM评估表明其生成文本语义更保留且更易理解。
Conclusion: LBA 在低查询预算下实现了高质量的硬标签文本对抗攻击，通过采样和分布更新有效平衡了搜索效率与样本质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Just Keep Prompting: Evaluating Repetitive Socratic Prompting in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world settings requires not only strong visual reasoning but also stability under sustained conversational pressure. We introduce Just Keep Prompting (JKP), a multi-turn evaluation framework that measures VLM epistemic stability when users repeatedly challenge, question, or contradict a model's answer. JKP probes models for up to 10 follow-up turns using three strategies: Adversarial Negation (repeated rejection), Pure Socratic Interrogation (repeated calls to reassess certainty), and Context-Aware Socratic Summarization (reflecting the model's prior rationale back before asking for reconsideration). We evaluate GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Qwen3-VL-30B on a subset of the STAR benchmark across 720 multi-turn runs. Aggregate accuracy changes modestly from Turn 0 to Turn 10, but trajectory-level analysis reveals substantial instability: correct answers regress, wrong answers recover, and many runs exhibit repeated answer flipping. Repeated prompting has bounded upside and often acts as a destabilizer rather than a reasoning aid. The effect is strongly model-dependent: Qwen3-VL-30B achieves the highest final accuracy but becomes confidently wrong under direct contradiction; Gemini 2.5 Pro is comparatively stable but token-expensive; GPT-4o is the most brittle and oscillatory. These findings reveal that multi-turn VLM evaluation captures not just additional reasoning but pressure-response profiles: how models trade off visual grounding, calibration, and conversational compliance under repeated challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多轮评估框架 Just Keep Prompting (JKP)，用于衡量视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在用户反复质疑、提问或反驳时的认知稳定性。在 STAR 基准子集上对 GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Qwen3-VL-30B 进行了 720 次多轮测试，发现整体准确率变化不大，但轨迹分析表明存在显著不稳定性：正确答案退化、错误答案恢复、答案反复翻转。重复提示带来的提升有限，反而往往成为不稳定因素，且模型间表现差异明显。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 评估多关注单轮推理能力，忽略模型在真实对话中面对持续质疑时的稳定性，而部署时用户可能反复挑战模型的回答。
Method: 提出 JKP 框架，包含三种提示策略：对抗性否定 (Adversarial Negation)、纯粹苏格拉底式质询 (Pure Socratic Interrogation) 和上下文感知苏格拉底式总结 (Context-Aware Socratic Summarization)，对模型进行最多 10 轮后续追问。
Result: 在 STAR 基准子集上，从第 0 轮到第 10 轮总体准确率变化不大，但轨迹级分析显示大量不稳定行为：正确回答退化、错误回答恢复、多次翻转。模型依赖性强：Qwen3-VL-30B 最终准确率最高但易被矛盾说服；Gemini 2.5 Pro 较稳定但 token 消耗大；GPT-4o 最脆弱和振荡。
Conclusion: 多轮 VLM 评估不仅捕捉额外推理，还能揭示模型的压力响应特征——在重复挑战下如何权衡视觉基础、校准和对话顺从性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RegNetAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Network Regulatory Driver Identification in Cancer Genomics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce RegNetAgents, an AI-oriented multi-agent framework for structured, query-driven regulatory candidate identification across heterogeneous gene regulatory networks. The system enables unified analysis of bulk tumor and single-cell-derived ARACNe networks by integrating TCGA-derived cancer networks with large-scale single-cell regulatory networks from the GREmLN project. For a given focal gene, the framework performs dual-network classification, cancer gene filtering using OncoKB annotations, and mode-of-action (MoA) assignment for tumor-derived regulatory relationships. Candidates are ranked by evidence consistency across networks (Both, TCGA-only, GREmLN-only). The system is implemented as a multi-agent LangGraph DAG workflow, accessible through a unified Python API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) client, operating as a downstream analytical layer over precomputed regulatory networks rather than a network inference method. Across eleven breast cancer (BRCA) and twelve colorectal cancer (COAD) focal genes, RegNetAgents identifies candidate regulators significantly enriched for OncoKB-annotated cancer genes. TCGA-derived candidates show strong enrichment (Stouffer Z = 6.69 for BRCA and 6.95 for COAD), while GREmLN-derived candidates also demonstrate significant enrichment (Z = 5.51 for BRCA and 7.06 for COAD; all p < 0.0001). No enrichment is observed in housekeeping or non-driver control gene sets, supporting signal specificity. An extended module enables structured evaluation of oncogenic potential, druggability, clinical relevance, and network vulnerability, supporting end-to-end interpretation from candidate identification to biological hypothesis generation. RegNetAgents establishes an interpretable AI framework for cross-network regulatory candidate identification in cancer genomics.

papers.title: IMEX Interaction-Based Model Explanation
papers.abstract_en: In predictive modeling, the ability to explain why a model produces a given target prediction has become increasingly important [5, 10]. Black-box models do not provide a transparent description of the internal mechanisms that generate the prediction, making even accurate predictions difficult to interpret and validate. In critical contexts, predictive accuracy alone is not a sufficient validation metric if the reasons underlying model decisions remain unexplained. The IMEX (Interaction-Based Model Explanation) approach represents a methodological direction within explainable predictive modeling. IMEX is designed to identify which variables contribute most to the target prediction and which interactions among variables are significant in determining the target. The method does not impose limitations on higher-order interaction analysis, allowing the investigation of feature subsets with cardinality greater than two. Beyond the identification of feature importance, IMEX enables the exploration of interaction patterns that may be consistent with latent mechanisms influencing the outcome. Through the application of the IMEX algorithm, it is possible to construct an interpretability map of the predictions. The IMEX framework is built on two complementary metrics: Static Correlation Power (PCS), which quantifies the contribution of individual features, and Interaction Correlation Power (PCI), which captures non-additive effects among features. In the present work, the PCS component is experimentally validated through a comparison with INVASE [18] on three synthetic datasets with known structures. The results indicate that IMEX can recover relevant feature-level structures in the presence of non-linear, conditional, and multicollinear relationships between input features and prediction targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMEX（基于交互的模型解释）是一种解释预测模型的方法，旨在识别对预测目标贡献最大的变量以及变量间的重要交互作用。该方法支持高阶交互分析，并通过静态相关功率（PCS）和交互相关功率（PCI）两个互补指标构建预测的可解释性图。在三个已知结构的合成数据集上与INVASE对比，实验验证了PCS在非线性、条件性和多重共线性关系下恢复特征级结构的能力。
Motivation: 黑箱模型难以提供预测内在机制的透明解释，仅靠预测准确性不足以验证模型在关键场景下的可靠性，因此需要能够识别重要特征及其交互效应的可解释性方法。
Method: 提出IMEX框架，基于静态相关功率（PCS）量化单个特征贡献，基于交互相关功率（PCI）捕捉特征间的非加性效应，不限制高阶交互分析阶数，并通过算法构建预测的可解释性图。
Result: 在三个已知结构的合成数据集上，IMEX的PCS分量与INVASE对比实验表明，在输入特征与预测目标存在非线性、条件性和多重共线性关系时，IMEX能够恢复相关特征级结构。
Conclusion: IMEX为可解释预测建模提供了方法论方向，能识别重要变量和交互模式，且高阶交互分析无限制，有助于揭示影响结果的潜在机制。

papers.title: HG-RAG: Hierarchy-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) has proven to be a widely successful process at improving the quality of outputs from a Large Language Model (LLM) for wider context. However, RAG systems typically retrieve context from flat document stores, which struggles when queries require hierarchical or relational reasoning across structured knowledge. I present HG-RAG (Hierarchy-Guided RAG), a framework that performs graph-traversal over a hierarchical knowledge graph to deliver structured context to a language model. My retrieval pipeline resolves a named entity anchor from the query, then expands context upward through parent nodes, laterally through relational neighbors, and downward through child nodes when needed. I evaluate HG-RAG against a dense retrieval baseline across three world scales (18-800 nodes) with four query types: local fact, hierarchical, neighborhood, and multi-hop. Results show HG-RAG consistently outperforms the flat baseline on hierarchical, relational, and multi-hop reasoning tasks, while reducing hallucination and maintaining locality coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HG-RAG框架，通过层次化知识图谱的图遍历为大型语言模型提供结构化上下文，以改进检索增强生成。在18-800节点的三种规模上，针对本地事实、层级、邻域和多跳四种查询类型进行评测，结果表明HG-RAG在层级、关系和多跳推理任务上优于平面检索基线，并减少幻觉。
Motivation: 标准RAG系统从平面文档库检索，在处理需要层级或关系推理的结构化知识查询时效果不佳。
Method: 提出HG-RAG框架，从查询中解析命名实体锚点，然后通过父节点向上扩展上下文，通过关系邻居横向扩展，必要时通过子节点向下扩展。
Result: 在18-800节点的三种规模上，针对层级、邻域和多跳查询任务，HG-RAG一致优于密集检索基线，并减少幻觉，保持局部连贯性。
Conclusion: 摘要表明层级引导的检索可以有效提升结构化知识图谱上的RAG推理性能。

papers.title: Intelligent Three Level Learning Architecture for Autonomous UAV Swarms in Search and Rescue
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel three level hierarchical learning architecture for autonomous UAV swarms performing search and rescue operations. Unlike conventional approaches that apply a single learning paradigm across all hierarchy levels, the proposed architecture integrates three qualitatively different learning mechanisms corresponding to the biological hierarchy of reflexes, skills, and reasoning such as Hebbian neuroplasticity for individual agent adaptation, multi agent reinforcement learning with graph neural networks and behavior trees for tactical coordination, and model agnostic meta learning with BDI reasoning and a digital twin for strategic decision making. The architecture is formalized through twenty two architectural contracts organized across six components such as BDI, Behavior Trees, GNN, MARL, Neuroplasticity, Meta Learning that collectively provide six classes of formal guarantees such as safety, budget correctness, optimality, liveness, starvation freedom, and inter level consistency. We introduce Swarm Meta Cognition as a compositional property arising from the structured interaction of all three levels, enabling the swarm to monitor its own cognitive state and switch between cognitive strategies. Five constructive progress functions for SAR task types bridge the gap between abstract optimization theory and concrete operational scenarios. The main integration theorem establishes that when all contracts are satisfied, the hybrid neuro-symbolic system preserves all six guarantee classes. For the dynamic case with active learning, five new contracts extend the framework with three additional guarantees such as cognitive resilience, graceful degradation, and monotonic meta improvement. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the architecture addresses five fundamental limitations of existing hierarchical RL approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于自主无人机蜂群搜索救援的三层分层学习架构，整合了三种不同学习机制（Hebbian神经可塑性、多智能体强化学习与图神经网络/行为树、模型无关元学习与BDI推理/数字孪生），并通过22个架构合同提供六类形式化保证。作者引入蜂群元认知作为组合属性，并证明该混合神经符号系统在满足所有合同时可保留所有保证类别。
Motivation: 现有层次强化学习方法存在若干根本性限制，且通常在整个层次中使用单一学习范式，不足以应对搜索救援中跨层次的不同认知需求。
Method: 提出三层层次学习架构：个体适应层（Hebbian神经可塑性）、战术协调层（多智能体强化学习+图神经网络+行为树）、战略决策层（模型无关元学习+BDI推理+数字孪生）；通过22个架构合同定义组件间交互，并提供六类形式化保证。
Result: 理论分析表明该架构解决了现有层次强化学习方法的五个基本限制，并通过集成定理证明混合神经符号系统在满足合同条件下保留所有六类保证（安全性、预算正确性、最优性、活性、无饥饿、层间一致性）。动态激活学习情形下扩展出五个新合同，额外提供认知弹性、优雅降级和单调元改进保证。
Conclusion: 本文侧重于理论架构设计和形式化保证，未报告具体实验数值结果。作者强调蜂群元认知作为涌现组合属性，使蜂群能够监控自身认知状态并切换策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast-Fading Channel and Power Optimization of the Magnetic Inductive Cellular Network
papers.abstract_en: The cellular network of magnetic Induction (MI) communication holds promise in long-distance underground environments. In the traditional MI communication, there is no fast-fading channel since the MI channel is treated as a quasi-static channel. However, for the vehicle (mobile) MI (VMI) communication, the unpredictable antenna vibration brings the remarkable fast-fading. As such fast-fading cannot be modeled by the central limit theorem, it differs radically from other wireless fast-fading channels. Unfortunately, few studies focus on this phenomenon. In this paper, using a novel space modeling based on the electromagnetic field theorem, we propose a 3-dimension model of the VMI antenna vibration. By proposing ``conjugate pseudo-piecewise functions'' and boundary $p(x)$ distribution, we derive the cumulative distribution function (CDF), probability density function (PDF) and the expectation of the VMI fast-fading channel. We also theoretically analyze the effects of the VMI fast-fading on the network throughput, including the VMI outage probability which can be ignored in the traditional MI channel study. We draw several intriguing conclusions different from those in wireless fast-fading studies. For instance, the fast-fading brings more uniformly distributed channel coefficients. Finally, we propose the power control algorithm using the non-cooperative game and multiagent Q-learning methods to optimize the throughput of the cellular VMI network. Simulations validate the derivation and the proposed algorithm.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted by the IEEE TWC for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究车辆移动磁感应（VMI）通信中的快衰落信道建模与功率优化。针对VMI天线振动引起的快衰落，提出基于电磁场定理的三维天线振动模型，通过“共轭伪分段函数”和边界p(x)分布推导了CDF、PDF和期望。分析了快衰落对网络吞吐量和中断概率的影响。最后利用非合作博弈和多智能体Q-learning提出功率控制算法优化蜂窝VMI网络吞吐量。仿真验证了推导和算法。
Motivation: 传统MI通信被视为准静态信道，不存在快衰落；但VMI通信中天线振动引入快衰落，且不能用中心极限定理建模，现有研究对此现象关注不足。
Method: 提出三维天线振动模型，利用“共轭伪分段函数”和边界p(x)分布推导快衰落的统计分布（CDF、PDF、期望）；采用非合作博弈和多智能体Q-learning设计功率控制算法。
Result: 快衰落使信道系数分布更均匀；推导了中断概率等性能指标；功率控制算法可优化蜂窝VMI网络吞吐量。
Conclusion: VMI快衰落特性与传统无线快衰落不同，所提模型和算法可用于地下或移动MI通信网络设计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: All Polarized but Still Different: a Multi-factorial Metric to Discriminate between Polarization Behaviors on Social Media
papers.abstract_en: Online polarization has attracted the attention of researchers for many years. Its effects on society are a cause for concern, and the design of personalized depolarization strategies appears to be a key solution. Such strategies should rely on a fine and accurate measurement, and a clear understanding of polarization behaviors. However, the literature still lacks ways to characterize them finely. We propose GRAIL, the first individual polarization metric, relying on multiple factors. GRAIL assesses these factors through entropy and is based on an adaptable Generalized Additive Model. We evaluate the proposed metric on a Twitter dataset related to the highly controversial debate about the COVID-19 vaccine. Experiments confirm the ability of GRAIL to discriminate between polarization behaviors. To go further, we provide a finer characterization and explanation of the identified behaviors through an innovative evaluation framework.
papers.comment: ACM/SIGAPP Symposium On Applied Computing, Apr 2024, Avila, Spain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRAIL，首个基于多因素的个体极化度量，利用熵和广义可加模型（Generalized Additive Model）评估极化行为。在 Twitter 关于 COVID-19 疫苗的争议性数据集上，GRAIL 能够有效区分不同的极化行为，并通过创新评估框架提供更精细的行为表征与解释。
Motivation: 现有文献缺乏精细表征极化行为的方法，而设计个性化去极化策略需要精准的测量和理解。
Method: 提出 GRAIL 指标，基于多个因素，通过熵（entropy）评估各因素，并使用可适应的广义可加模型（Generalized Additive Model）整合多因素。
Result: 在 Twitter COVID-19 疫苗数据集上验证了 GRAIL 区分极化行为的能力，并通过评估框架提供了更精细的行为特征化和解释。
Conclusion: GRAIL 作为首个个体极化度量，能够有效区分极化行为，为个性化去极化策略提供支撑。
Relevance: 0
